Wire the MCP3008 to the Pi's hardware SPI0 bus: chip enable CE0 on GPIO8, MOSI on GPIO10, MISO on GPIO9, and SCLK on GPIO11, with the sensor's analog output wired to MCP3008 channel 0 (CH0). Use the pigpio library for all SPI communication with the ADC. Sample the raw 10-bit ADC value, in the range 0-1023, once per second, and log each reading to the console together with a timestamp so the moisture trend can be reviewed later. Implement robust error handling around SPI initialization and every SPI transfer, reporting any failure rather than silently continuing. Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM for a graceful shutdown, making sure the SPI handle is closed and pigpio is terminated cleanly on every exit path, including early failures.

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0

void handle_spi_error(int error) {
    fprintf(stderr, "SPI error: %d\n", error);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Received SIGINT, shutting down...\n");
    close_spi();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void handle_sigterm(int sig) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Received SIGTERM, shutting down...\n");
    close_spi();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void close_spi() {
    if (spi_opened) {
        spi_close();
        spi_opened = false;
    }
    pi_close();
}

#define GPIO4 4
#define GPIO27 27
#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x48
#define ADC_CHANNEL 0
#define ADC_GAIN 4
#define ADC_SAMPLE_RATE 128
#define DEBOUNCE_TIME 50
#define BUZZER_ON_TIME 2000

#define LOG_FILE "fire_log.txt"

volatile sig_atomic_t running = 1;

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    running = 0;
}

void log_event(const char *event, double temp) {
    FILE *log = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return;
    }
    fprintf(log, "%s %f\n", event, temp);
    fclose(log);
}

void log_error(const char *msg) {
    perror(msg);
}

void init_gpio() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        log_error("pigpio initialization failed");
        return;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO4, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        log_error("GPIO4 mode set failed");
        return;
    }
    if (gpioSetPullUp(GPIO4, 1) < 0) {
        log_error("GPIO4 pull-up set failed");
        return;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO27, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        log_error("GPIO27 mode set failed");
        return;
    }
}

void init_adc() {
    if (gpioI2COpen(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        log_error("I2C open failed");
        return;
    }
    if (gpioI2CSetMode(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, ADC_MODE) < 0) {
        log_error("I2C set mode failed");
        return;
    }
    if (gpioI2CSetChannel(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, ADC_CHANNEL, ADC_GAIN, ADC_SAMPLE_RATE) < 0) {
        log_error("I2C set channel failed");
        return;
    }
    if (gpioI2CSetMode(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, ADC_SINGLE_SHOT) < 0) {
        log_error("I2C set single-shot mode failed");
        return;
    }
}

void read_adc() {
    int16_t adc_value;
    if (gpioI2CReadSingle(ADC_CHANNEL, &adc_value) < 0) {
        log_error("ADC read failed");
        return;
    }
    double voltage = (adc_value * 3.3) / 4096.0;
    double temp = 20.0 + (voltage - 0.0) * (80.0 - 20.0) / (3.3 - 0.0);
    if (temp > 60.0) {
        log_event("Temperature above 60°C", temp);
    }
}

void handle_falling_edge() {
    static int last_event = 0;
    if (last_event == 0) {
        last_event = 1;
    } else if (last_event == 1) {
        if (gpioRead(GPIO4) == 0) {
            last_event = 0;
        }
    } else {
        if (gpioRead(GPIO4) == 1) {
            last_event = 1;
        }
    }
}

void main_loop() {
    while (running) {
        if (gpioRead(GPIO4) == 0) {
            handle_falling_edge();
        }
        if (running && last_event && gpioRead(GPIO4) == 1) {
            read_adc();
            if (temp > 60.0) {
                log_event("Fire detected!", temp);
                gpioWrite(GPIO27, 1);
                usleep(BUZZER_ON_TIME * 1000);
                gpioWrite(GPIO27, 0);
            } else {
                log_event("Flame detected!", temp);
            }
        }
        usleep(100000);
    }
    gpioTerminate();
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    init_gpio();
    init_adc();
    last_event = 0;
    while (1) {
        main_loop();
    }
    return 0;
}

        gpio_free_device(gpio_device);
        close(fan_pin_fd);

    if (spi_fd > 0) {
        close(spi_fd);

int read_adc() {
    uint8_t rx[3];
    int ret;
    ret = ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_TRANSFER, (unsigned long)SPI_CMD | SPI_CS | SPI_DATA);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("SPI transfer failed");
        return -1;
    }
    ret = read(spi_fd, rx, 3);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI data");
        return -1;
    }
    int adc_value = ((rx[1] & 0x03) << 8) | rx[2];
    if (adc_value == 0 || adc_value == 1023) {
        return -1;
    }
    return adc_value;
}

double convert_adc_to_current(int adc_value) {
    double voltage = (double)adc_value / 1024.0 * 3.3;
    return voltage / sensitivity;

        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("Failed to set GPIO value");
        }
    }

    struct tm *timeinfo;
    char buffer[128];
    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, 128, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);
    printf("%s, %f A\n", buffer, convert_adc_to_current(read_adc()));
    FILE *log_file = fopen("current_log.txt", "a");
    if (log_file != NULL) {
        fprintf(log_file, "%s, %f A\n", buffer, convert_adc_to_current(read_adc()));
        fclose(log_file);
    }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        printf("Usage: %s -t <threshold> -s <sensitivity>\n", argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }
    current_threshold = atof(argv[1]);
    sensitivity = atof(argv[2]);
    init_spi();
    init_gpio();
    while (1) {
        log_reading();
        handle_current_threshold();
        sleep(1);
    }
    cleanup();
    return 0;
}

void adc_init(ADCHandler *adc, int gain, int resolution, int sample_rate, int buffer_size) {

    adc->adc_resolution = resolution;

    adc->adc_buffer_size = buffer_size;
    adc->adc_buffer = mmap(NULL, adc->adc_buffer_size * sizeof(int), PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, adc->adc_fd, 0);
    adc->adc_buffer_size_bytes = adc->adc_buffer_size * sizeof(int);

    adc->adc_buffer_full = 0;

    adc->adc_buffer_count = 0;

    int buf[1];
    int ret = ioctl(adc->adc_fd, I2C_RDWR, (unsigned char *)&buf, 1, I2C_SLAVE, adc->adc_addr);
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "ADC read failed: %d\n", ret);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    int data = buf[0];
    int adc_value = (data & 0x3FF) << (adc->adc_resolution - 12);
    adc->adc_buffer[adc->adc_buffer_ptr] = adc_value;
    adc->adc_buffer_ptr = (adc->adc_buffer_ptr + 1) % adc->adc_buffer_size;
    if (adc->adc_buffer_ptr == 0) {
        adc->adc_buffer_full = 1;
    } else {
        adc->adc_buffer_empty = 0;
    }
    adc->adc_buffer_count++;
}

void adc_process(ADCHandler *adc) {
    if (adc->adc_buffer_full && adc->adc_buffer_empty) {
        int data = adc->adc_buffer[adc->adc_buffer_ptr];
        adc->adc_buffer_ptr = (adc->adc_buffer_ptr + 1) % adc->adc_buffer_size;

        adc->adc_buffer_count--;

        int adc_value_scaled = adc_value * (adc->adc_gain / 2.0) + 0.5;

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B to interface with an SGX Sensortech MICS-4514 dual MOS sensor (CO/NO2) via I2C using the pigpio library. The sensor provides two 16-bit ADC readings (OX for CO, RED for NO2) over 4 bytes. Every 5 seconds, read and calculate the CO level in PPM and log it to co_log.txt. Simulate an industrial air quality monitoring system with a 25 PPM alert threshold, logging alerts to alert_log.txt. Implement robust error handling for I2C initialization, read failures, and file I/O. Ensure clean resource release on all exit paths, including signal handling for SIGINT and SIGTERM.

```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define I2C_ADDR 0x28
#define CO_PIN 0
#define NO2_PIN 1
#define ADC_BITS 16
#define ADC_MAX 65535
#define ALERT_THRESHOLD 25

typedef struct {
    int co_ppm;
    int no2_ppm;
    int alert;
} SensorData;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        printf("Received signal %d, exiting...\n", signum);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int i2c_init() {
    int fd;
    if ((fd = wiringPiI2COpen(0, I2C_ADDR)) < 0) {
        perror("wiringPiI2COpen");
        return -1;
    }
    return fd;
}

int i2c_read(int fd, SensorData *sensor) {
    int16_t ox, red;
    if (wiringPiI2CReadReg16(fd, CO_PIN, &ox) < 0) {
        printf("Error reading CO sensor: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    if (wiringPiI2CReadReg16(fd, NO2_PIN, &red) < 0) {
        printf("Error reading NO2 sensor: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    sensor->co_ppm = (int)(ox * 10000.0 / ADC_MAX);
    sensor->no2_ppm = (int)(red * 10000.0 / ADC_MAX);
    return 0;
}

void i2c_close(int fd) {
    wiringPiI2CClose(fd);
}

void log_data(SensorData *sensor) {
    FILE *file;
    if ((file = fopen("co_log.txt", "a")) == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        return;
    }
    fprintf(file, "%d %d\n", sensor->co_ppm, sensor->no2_ppm);
    fclose(file);
}

void log_alert(SensorData *sensor) {
    FILE *file;
    if ((file = fopen("alert_log.txt", "a")) == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        return;
    }
    if (sensor->co_ppm > ALERT_THRESHOLD) {
        fprintf(file, "CO alert: %d\n", sensor->co_ppm);
    }
    fclose(file);
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    int i2c_fd = i2c_init();
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        printf("I2C initialization failed\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    SensorData sensor;
    while (1) {
        if (i2c_read(i2c_fd, &sensor) < 0) {
            i2c_close(i2c_fd);
            printf("I2C read failed\n");
            break;
        }
        log_data(&sensor);
        if (sensor.co_ppm > ALERT_THRESHOLD) {
            log_alert(&sensor);
        }
        usleep(5000000); // 5 seconds
    }

    i2c_close(i2c_fd);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

int i2c1_data, i2c2_data;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (i2c1_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c1_fd);
    }
    if (i2c2_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c2_fd);
    }
    exit(0);
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    if (i2c1_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c1_fd);
    }
    if (i2c2_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c2_fd);
    }
    exit(0);

#include <pigpio.h>

#define MIC1_CHANNEL 0
#define MIC2_CHANNEL 1
#define ADC_CHANNEL 0
#define ADC_CHANNEL_2 1
#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_CE0 8
#define SPI_CE1 9
#define SPI_MISO 9
#define SPI_MOSI 10
#define SPI_SCLK 11
#define LED_PIN 27
#define THRESHOLD 0.7
#define WINDOW_SIZE 100
#define SAMPLE_RATE 1000
#define LOG_FILE "audio_events.csv"

volatile sig_atomic_t running = 1;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    printf("SIGINT received, exiting...\n");
    running = 0;
    piLock();
    piSetMode(LED_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    piWrite(LED_PIN, 0);
    piUnexport(SPI_CE0);
    piUnexport(SPI_CE1);
    piUnexport(SPI_CHANNEL);
    piUnexport(MIC1_CHANNEL);
    piUnexport(MIC2_CHANNEL);
    piUnexport(ADC_CHANNEL);
    piUnexport(ADC_CHANNEL_2);
    piUnexport(SPI_SCLK);
    piUnexport(SPI_MISO);
    piUnexport(SPI_MOSI);
    piUnexport(LED_PIN);
    piFinish();
    exit(0);
}

    if (piSetMode(ADC_CHANNEL, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("ADC channel mode set failed");
        return 1;

    if (piSetMode(ADC_CHANNEL_2, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("ADC channel mode set failed");
        return 1;

    if (piSetMode(SPI_SCLK, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("SPI SCLK mode set failed");

    if (piSetMode(SPI_MISO, PI_INPUT) < 0) {

        return 1;

#include <stdio.h>

#include <gpiod/device.h>
#include <sys/spi/spidev.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>

#include <time.h>

#define SPI_DEV "/dev/spidev0.0"
#define SPI_CS_LINE GPIO8
#define SPI_CS_LINE_NAME "gpio8"
#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000
#define SPI_BITS_PER_LINE 8
#define SPI_MAX_SPEED 5000000

#define LOG_FILE "moisture_log.csv"
#define LOG_HEADER "Timestamp,Moisture1,Moisture2\n"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi;
    struct gpiod_line *cs_line;
} MoistureSensor;

MoistureSensor *init_moisture_sensors() {
    MoistureSensor *moisture_sensors = malloc(2 * sizeof(MoistureSensor));
    if (!moisture_sensors) {
        perror("Memory allocation failed");
        return NULL;
    }

    // Initialize SPI device
    moisture_sensors[0].fd = open(SPI_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (moisture_sensors[0].fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        free(moisture_sensors);
        return NULL;
    }

    // Initialize CS line
    if (gpiod_init() == -1) {
        perror("Failed to initialize gpiod");
        close(moisture_sensors[0].fd);
        free(moisture_sensors);
        return NULL;
    }

    moisture_sensors[0].cs_line = gpiod_get_line(SPI_CS_LINE_NAME);
    if (!moisture_sensors[0].cs_line) {
        perror("Failed to get CS line");
        close(moisture_sensors[0].fd);
        gpiod_destroy();
        free(moisture_sensors);
        return NULL;
    }

    // Initialize SPI transfer structure
    moisture_sensors[0].spi.tx_buf = (unsigned long)&moisture_sensors[0].spi.tx_buf;
    moisture_sensors[0].spi.rx_buf = (unsigned long)&moisture_sensors[0].spi.rx_buf;
    moisture_sensors[0].spi.len = 3;
    moisture_sensors[0].spi.delay_usec = 0;
    moisture_sensors[0].spi.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;
    moisture_sensors[0].spi.bits_per_line = SPI_BITS_PER_LINE;

    // Initialize second sensor
    moisture_sensors[1].fd = open(SPI_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (moisture_sensors[1].fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        close(moisture_sensors[0].fd);
        gpiod_destroy();
        free(moisture_sensors);
        return NULL;
    }

    // Initialize second CS line
    if (gpiod_get_line(SPI_CS_LINE_NAME) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get CS line");
        close(moisture_sensors[0].fd);
        gpiod_destroy();
        free(moisture_sensors);
        return NULL;
    }

    return moisture_sensors;
}

void cleanup_moisture_sensors(MoistureSensor *moisture_sensors) {
    if (moisture_sensors) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            if (moisture_sensors[i].fd != -1) {
                close(moisture_sensors[i].fd);
            }
            if (moisture_sensors[i].cs_line) {
                gpiod_destroy();
                gpiod_line_free(moisture_sensors[i].cs_line);
            }
        }
        free(moisture_sensors);
    }
}

void read_moisture(MoistureSensor *sensor, int channel) {
    unsigned char buffer[3];
    buffer[0] = 0x00;
    buffer[1] = (channel << 1) | 0x01;
    buffer[2] = 0x00;

    if (ioctl(sensor->fd, SPI_IOC_RDWR, buffer) == -1) {
        perror("SPI ioctl failed");
        return;
    }

    if (read(sensor->fd, buffer, 3) != 3) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI data");
        return;
    }

    int adc_value = (buffer[1] << 8) | buffer[2];
    adc_value = (adc_value >> 8) & 0xFF;
    adc_value = (adc_value << 8) | (buffer[1] & 0xFF);
    adc_value = (adc_value >> 8) & 0xFF;
    adc_value = (adc_value << 8) | buffer[2];
    adc_value = (adc_value >> 8) & 0xFF;

    int moisture = (adc_value / 1023.0) * 100;
    printf("Moisture %d: %d%%\n", channel, moisture);
}

void log_moisture(MoistureSensor *moisture_sensors) {
    time_t rawtime;
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    char buffer[80];

    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);

    snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S", timeinfo->tm_year + 1900, timeinfo->tm_mon + 1, timeinfo->tm_mday, timeinfo->tm_hour, timeinfo->tm_min, timeinfo->tm_sec);

    FILE *fp = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return;
    }

    fprintf(fp, "%s,%d,%d\n", buffer, moisture_sensors[0].moisture, moisture_sensors[1].moisture);
    fclose(fp);
}

int main() {
    MoistureSensor *moisture_sensors = init_moisture_sensors();
    if (!moisture_sensors) {
        return 1;
    }

    int fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_CREAT | O_WRONLY, 0644);
    if (fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        cleanup_moisture_sensors(moisture_sensors);
        return 1;
    }

    fprintf(fd, "%s", LOG_HEADER);
    close(fd);

    while (1) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            read_moisture(moisture_sensors, i);
        }
        log_moisture(moisture_sensors);
        sleep(5);
    }

    cleanup_moisture_sensors(moisture_sensors);
    return 0;
}

    struct spi_device *spi_device;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi_transfer_copy;
    struct timespec ts;
    SensorData sensor_data;
    int retries = 0;

    // Initialize signal handlers
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    // Initialize GPIO lines
    chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    handle_gpio_error(chip->error, "gpiod_chip_open");

    gpio_line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO_17);
    handle_gpio_error(gpio_line->error, "GPIO_17");

    sensor_data.gpio_fd = gpiod_line->fd;
    handle_gpio_error(sensor_data.gpio_fd, "GPIO_17");

    // Initialize SPI device
    spi_device = spidev_open("/dev/spi0.0");
    handle_spi_error(spi_device->error, "SPI");

    // Initialize SPI transfer structure
    spi_transfer_copy.tx_buf = (unsigned long)&sensor_data.gpio_fd;
    spi_transfer_copy.rx_buf = (unsigned long)&sensor_data.gpio_fd;
    spi_transfer_copy.len = 1;
    spi_transfer_copy.cs_change_type = SPI_CS_CHANGE_EDGE;
    spi_transfer_copy.cs_change_edge = SPI_CS_CHANGE_EDGE_RISING;
    spi_transfer_copy.delay_usec = 0;
    spi_transfer_copy.speed_hz = 1000000;
    handle_spi_error(spidev_ioctl(spi_device->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, &spi_transfer_copy), "SPI");

    // Initialize ADC
    spi_transfer.tx_buf = (unsigned long)&SPI_CHANNEL;
    spi_transfer.rx_buf = (unsigned long)&sensor_data.gpio_fd;
    spi_transfer.len = 1;
    spi_transfer.speed_hz = 1000000;
    handle_spi_error(spidev_ioctl(spi_device->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MODE, &spi_transfer), "SPI");

    // Initialize log file
    sensor_data.log_file = fopen("current_log.csv", "w");
    handle_file_error(sensor_data.log_file, "log_file");

    // Write header if file is new or empty
    if (fseek(sensor_data.log_file, 0, SEEK_END) == 0) {
        fprintf(sensor_data.log_file, "timestamp,current_in_Amperes\n");
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Read current from sensor
        ts.tv_sec = time(NULL);
        ts.tv_nsec = 0;
        nanosleep(&ts, &ts);

        retries = 0;
        while (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
            spi_transfer_copy.tx_buf = (unsigned long)&SPI_CHANNEL;
            spi_transfer_copy.rx_buf = (unsigned long)&sensor_data.gpio_fd;
            spi_transfer_copy.len = 1;
            handle_spi_error(spidev_ioctl(spi_device->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_DATA0, &spi_transfer_copy), "SPI");

            sensor_data.current = (sensor_data.gpio_fd->value > CURRENT_OFFSET) ? ((sensor_data.gpio_fd->value - CURRENT_OFFSET) * CURRENT_SENSITIVITY / ADC_RESOLUTION) : 0.0;
            handle_file_error(sensor_data.log_file, "log_file");

            // Log current reading
            fprintf(sensor_data.log_file, "%ld,%f\n", (long)sensor_data.log_time, sensor_data.current);

            // Check for overcurrent
            if (sensor_data.current > 10.0) {
                handle_gpio_error(gpio_line->set_value(sensor_data.gpio_fd, 0), "GPIO_17");
                handle_file_error(sensor_data.log_file, "log_file");
                sleep(1);
                handle_gpio_error(gpio_line->set_value(sensor_data.gpio_fd, 1), "GPIO_17");
                handle_file_error(sensor_data.log_file, "log_file");
            }

            retries++;
            if (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
                sleep(1);
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;

void handle_spi_error(int err) {
    fprintf(stderr, "SPI transfer error: %d\n", err);
    if (spi_fd != -1) {
        close(spi_fd);
    }
    if (current_log_fd != -1) {
        close(current_log_fd);
    }
    if (gpio27 != -1) {
        gpio27 = -1;
    }
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_adc_error(int err) {
    fprintf(stderr, "ADC read error: %d\n", err);
    if (spi_fd != -1) {
        close(spi_fd);
    }
    if (current_log_fd != -1) {
        close(current_log_fd);
    }
    if (gpio27 != -1) {
        gpio27 = -1;
    }
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_file_error(int err) {
    fprintf(stderr, "File I/O error: %d\n", err);
    if (current_log_fd != -1) {
        close(current_log_fd);
    }
    if (spi_fd != -1) {
        close(spi_fd);
    }
    if (gpio27 != -1) {
        gpio27 = -1;
    }
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    if (spi_fd != -1) {
        close(spi_fd);
    }
    if (current_log_fd != -1) {
        close(current_log_fd);
    }
    if (gpio27 != -1) {
        gpio27 = 0;
    }
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

Use the pigpio library, not wiringPi, to configure the SPI bus at 1 MHz (SPI mode 0) and to control an alarm on BCM GPIO4. Read the ADC continuously, once per second, convert the 10-bit ADC value to a voltage using a 3.3V reference, and drive the alarm on BCM GPIO4 HIGH if the voltage exceeds 2.5V, or LOW if it is 2.5V or below. Check the return values of gpioInitialise(), spiOpen(), and the SPI transfer function; if an SPI transfer fails, log the error to the log file, ensure the alarm is turned off for safety, and wait 1 second before retrying. Log every valid reading to a file named co_log.txt in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS,Voltage: X.XX V, one line per reading. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_FREQ 1000000
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_CS 8
#define SPI_MOSI 10
#define SPI_MISO 9
#define SPI_CLK 11
#define SPI_CS_PIN 4
#define CO_ALARM_PIN 4

void handle_alarm(int sig) {
    if (gpioIsSet(CO_ALARM_PIN)) {
        gpioSetBit(CO_ALARM_PIN, 0);
    }
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Alarm turned off on %s", ctime(&time(NULL)));
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to initialise GPIO: %d", gpioInitialise());
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (spiOpen(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_FREQ, SPI_MODE, SPI_CS) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open SPI channel: %d", spiOpen(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_FREQ, SPI_MODE, SPI_CS));
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_alarm);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_alarm);

    FILE *log_file = fopen("co_log.txt", "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open log file: %s", strerror(errno));
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    while (1) {
        int spi_result = spiTransfer(SPI_CHANNEL, 0x06, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00);
        if (spi_result < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "SPI transfer failed: %d", spi_result);
            gpioSetBit(CO_ALARM_PIN, 0);
            usleep(1000000);
            continue;
        }

        int adc_value = (spi_result >> 8) | (spi_result & 0xFF);
        double voltage = (adc_value * 3.3) / 1024.0;

        if (voltage > 2.5) {
            gpioSetBit(CO_ALARM_PIN, 1);
        } else {
            gpioSetBit(CO_ALARM_PIN, 0);
        }

        char log_line[128];
        strftime(log_line, sizeof(log_line), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&time(NULL)));
        snprintf(log_line + strcspn(log_line, "\n"), sizeof(log_line) - strcspn(log_line, "\n"), "%s, %.2f V", log_line, voltage);
        fprintf(log_file, "%s\n", log_line);

        usleep(1000000);
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    fclose(log_file);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

#include <pigpio.h>
#include <math.h>

#define I2C_ADDR 0x48
#define ADC_CHANNEL 0
#define ADC_GAIN 2
#define ADC_RESOLUTION 16
#define PRESSURE_OFFSET 0.5
#define PRESSURE_SENSITIVITY 0.1

#define MAX_PRESSURE 100.0
#define MIN_PRESSURE 0.0

#define LOG_FILE "pressure_log.txt"

void init_adc(int channel, int gain, int resolution) {
    int ret;
    ret = set_adc_channel(channel, gain, resolution);
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize ADC: %d\n", ret);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void init_i2c() {
    int ret;
    ret = gpio_i2c_init();
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize I2C: %d\n", ret);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void read_adc() {
    int ret;
    uint16_t raw_value;
    ret = gpio_i2c_read(I2C_ADDR, 0x00, &raw_value, 2);
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read ADC: %d\n", ret);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    raw_value = (raw_value >> 6) & 0x3F; // 12-bit ADC output
    double voltage = (raw_value * 0.5) + PRESSURE_OFFSET;
    double pressure = (voltage - PRESSURE_OFFSET) / PRESSURE_SENSITIVITY;
    if (pressure < MIN_PRESSURE || pressure > MAX_PRESSURE) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Invalid pressure value: %f\n", pressure);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    printf("%f\n", pressure);
}

void log_pressure(double pressure) {
    time_t now;
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    char buffer[128];
    now = time(NULL);
    timeinfo = localtime(&now);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);
    FILE *fp = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open log file: %s\n", LOG_FILE);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(fp, "%s %f\n", buffer, pressure);
    fclose(fp);
}

int main() {
    int ret;
    int adc_channel = ADC_CHANNEL;
    int adc_gain = ADC_GAIN;
    int adc_resolution = ADC_RESOLUTION;
    int i2c_addr = I2C_ADDR;

    ret = gpio_init();
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize GPIO: %d\n", ret);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    init_i2c();
    init_adc(adc_channel, adc_gain, adc_resolution);

    while (1) {
        read_adc();
        log_pressure(pressure);
        sleep(1);
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

Trigger an email alert via ssmtp if humidity exceeds 80%. Log readings to humidity_log.txt in comma-separated format (timestamp, humidity, temperature) with robust error handling for pigpio initialization, SPI transfer failures, and file I/O. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <pigpio/spi.h>
#include <ssmtp.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_CS 8
#define SPI_SPEED 10000000
#define MCP3208_GAIN 1
#define MCP3208_RESOLUTION 4096
#define MCP3208_VREF 5.0
#define RH_THRESHOLD 80
#define RH_TRANSFER_FUNCTION 0.824 + 0.0315 * RH_THRESHOLD
#define TEMP_BETA 3950
#define TEMP_R0 10000
#define TEMP_T0 25

typedef struct {
    time_t timestamp;
    float humidity;
    float temperature;
} humidity_reading_t;

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    printf("SIGINT received, exiting...\n");
    pi_close();
    exit(0);
}

void handle_sigterm(int sig) {
    printf("SIGTERM received, exiting...\n");
    pi_close();
    exit(0);
}

int spi_init() {
    if (pi_init()) {
        printf("pigpio init failed\n");
        return -1;
    }
    if (pi_set_mode(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE3, SPI_CLOCK_DIV2)) {
        printf("SPI mode setup failed\n");
        return -1;
    }
    if (pi_set_pull_up_down(SPI_CS, PI_PUD_UP)) {
        printf("SPI CS setup failed\n");
        return -1;
    }
    if (spi_open(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_CS, SPI_SPEED)) {
        printf("SPI open failed\n");
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int spi_read_adc(int channel) {
    int buffer[3];
    int result;
    if (spi_transfer(SPI_CHANNEL, 0x00, channel, buffer, 3)) {
        result = (buffer[0] * MCP3208_GAIN) / MCP3208_RESOLUTION;
        return result;
    } else {
        printf("SPI read failed\n");
        return -1;
    }
}

float calculate_rh(float vout) {
    float rh = (vout - RH_TRANSFER_FUNCTION) / 0.0315;
    return rh;
}

float calculate_temp(float vout) {
    float r = (MCP3208_VREF / vout) * TEMP_R0;
    float temp = TEMP_T0 * (1.0 + (1.0 / (TEMP_BETA * log(r / TEMP_R0)))) - 273.15;
    return temp;
}

void log_reading(humidity_reading_t reading) {
    FILE *file = fopen("humidity_log.txt", "a");
    if (!file) {
        printf("Failed to open log file\n");
        return;
    }
    fprintf(file, "%ld,%f,%f\n", reading.timestamp, reading.humidity, reading.temperature);
    fclose(file);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigterm);
    if (!spi_init()) {
        printf("Initialization failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    float vout_humidity;
    float vout_temp;
    float rh;
    float temp;

    while (1) {
        time_t now = time(NULL);
        humidity_reading_t reading;
        reading.timestamp = now;
        reading.humidity = 0.0;
        reading.temperature = 0.0;

        vout_humidity = spi_read_adc(0);
        rh = calculate_rh(vout_humidity);
        reading.humidity = rh;

        vout_temp = spi_read_adc(1);
        temp = calculate_temp(vout_temp);
        reading.temperature = temp;

        log_reading(reading);

        if (rh > RH_THRESHOLD) {
            char email_body[256];
            snprintf(email_body, sizeof(email_body), "Alert: Humidity exceeds 80% at %ld\nHumidity: %f\nTemperature: %f",
                     reading.timestamp, reading.humidity, reading.temperature);
            if (ssmtp_send("sender@example.com", "recipient@example.com", "Subject: Humidity Alert", email_body)) {
                printf("Email sent\n");
            } else {
                printf("Email sending failed\n");
            }
        }

        pi_usleep(1000000); // 1 second delay
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <mcp3008.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_FREQ 1000000
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_CS 8
#define SPI_CS_PIN 8
#define SPI_CS_PIN_VALUE 1
#define SPI_CS_PIN_VALUE_ON 1
#define SPI_CS_PIN_VALUE_OFF 0
#define SPI_CS_PIN_VALUE_ON_MASK 0x1
#define SPI_CS_PIN_VALUE_OFF_MASK 0x0

#define ADC_MAX 3.3
#define ADC_MIN 0.0
#define FLOW_MAX 5.0
#define FLOW_MIN 0.0

#define LOG_FILE "flow_log.csv"
#define LOG_HEADER "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.uuuuuu,flow_rate\n"

#define LOG_FILE_MODE (O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_TRUNC)
#define LOG_FILE_PERMISSIONS (S_IRUSR | S_IWUSR | S_IRGRP | S_IROTH)

#define LOG_FILE_ERROR "Failed to open log file: %s\n"

#define SPI_ERROR "SPI error: %s\n"
#define SPI_BUS_ERROR "SPI bus error: %s\n"
#define ADC_ERROR "ADC error: %s\n"
#define SENSOR_ABSENT "Sensor absent: ADC returns 0 or full-scale\n"
#define INVALID_FLOW "Invalid flow rate: %f\n"

#define LOG_FILE_HEADER_SIZE (strlen(LOG_HEADER))

int spi_fd;
int adc_fd;
int flow_rate;
char log_buffer[256];
char log_file_buffer[256];
struct tm *log_time;
time_t log_time_t;
char log_time_str[256];

void spi_init() {
    if (gpio_initialise() < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, SPI_ERROR, "pigpio initialization failed\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (gpio setwpi2(8, SPI_CS_PIN_VALUE_OFF_MASK) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, SPI_ERROR, "Setting SPI CS pin to 0 failed\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    spi_fd = spi_open(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_FREQ, SPI_MODE);
    if (spi_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, SPI_BUS_ERROR, "SPI open failed\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void spi_close() {
    if (spi_fd >= 0) {
        spi_close(spi_fd);
        spi_fd = -1;
    }
}

void spi_transfer() {
    if (spi_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, SPI_BUS_ERROR, "SPI is not open\n");
        return;
    }
    mcp3008_spi_write(spi_fd, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00);
    if (spi_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, SPI_BUS_ERROR, "SPI transfer failed\n");
        return;
    }
}

int adc_read() {
    if (adc_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, ADC_ERROR, "ADC is not open\n");
        return -1;
    }
    int adc_value = mcp3008_read(adc_fd);
    if (adc_value < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, ADC_ERROR, "ADC read failed\n");
        return -1;
    }
    return adc_value;
}

void adc_init() {
    adc_fd = mcp3008_open("/dev/spi0.0");
    if (adc_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, ADC_ERROR, "ADC open failed\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void adc_close() {
    if (adc_fd >= 0) {
        mcp3008_close(adc_fd);
        adc_fd = -1;
    }
}

void log_data() {
    if (spi_fd < 0 || adc_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, SENSOR_ABSENT, "SPI or ADC not open\n");
        return;
    }
    int adc_value = adc_read();
    if (adc_value < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, ADC_ERROR, "ADC read failed\n");
        return;
    }
    if (adc_value == 0 || adc_value == 1023) {
        fprintf(stderr, SENSOR_ABSENT, "Sensor absent: ADC returns 0 or full-scale\n");
        return;
    }
    float adc_voltage = (adc_value / 1023.0) * ADC_MAX;
    float flow_rate = (adc_voltage / ADC_MAX) * (FLOW_MAX - FLOW_MIN) + FLOW_MIN;
    if (flow_rate < FLOW_MIN || flow_rate > FLOW_MAX) {
        fprintf(stderr, INVALID_FLOW, "%f\n", flow_rate);
        return;
    }
    log_time_t = time(NULL);
    log_time = localtime(&log_time_t);
    strftime(log_time_str, sizeof(log_time_str), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f", log_time);
    snprintf(log_buffer, sizeof(log_buffer), "%s,%f\n", log_time_str, flow_rate);
    if (write(spi_fd, log_buffer, strlen(log_buffer)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, SPI_BUS_ERROR, "Logging failed\n");
        return;
    }
    if (write(2, log_buffer, strlen(log_buffer)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, SPI_BUS_ERROR, "Logging to stderr failed\n");
        return;
    }
}

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    spi_close();
    gpioTerminate();
    close(adc_fd);
    close(spi_fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    spi_close();
    gpioTerminate();
    close(adc_fd);
    close(spi_fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigterm);
    adc_init();
    spi_init();
    while (1) {
        log_data();
        usleep(1000000);
    }
    return 0;
}

void init_audio_capture(AudioCapture *ac) {
    ac->fd = gpio_open(DIGITAL);
    if (ac->fd < 0) {
        perror("gpio_open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (gpio_set_mode(ac->fd, INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpio_set_mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    ac->channels[0] = gpio_number(0);
    ac->channels[1] = gpio_number(1);

        perror("gpio_claim");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (gpio_pull_up(ac->channels[1], 1) < 0) {
        perror("gpio_pull_up");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    ac->buffer = (int *)mmap(0, 2 * 1024 * 1024, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, ac->fd, 0);

    char timestamp[26];

    t = time(NULL);

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define ADC_CHANNEL 0
#define SAMPLE_RATE_MS 100
#define LOG_FILE "airflow_log.csv"
#define LOG_HEADER "timestamp,flow_rate"

int main() {
    if (gpio_init() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio initialization failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_baud(1000000) < 0) {
        perror("SPI baud rate set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_mode(SPI0, SPI_MODE0) < 0) {
        perror("SPI mode set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_cs(SPI0, SPI0_CE0) < 0) {
        perror("SPI CS set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_sclk(SPI0, SPI0_SCLK) < 0) {
        perror("SPI SCLK set failed");
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_mosi(SPI0, SPI0_MOSI) < 0) {
        perror("SPI MOSI set failed");
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_miso(SPI0, SPI0_MISO) < 0) {
        perror("SPI MISO set failed");
    }

    FILE *fp = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (fp == NULL) {
        perror("file open failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (fputs(LOG_HEADER, fp) == EOF) {
        perror("header write failed");
        return 1;
    }

    char buffer[256];
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);

    while (1) {
        if (gpio setwpi_cs(SPI0, SPI0_CE0, 1) < 0) {
            perror("SPI CS set failed");
            return 1;
        }

        uint16_t adc_value = 0;
        if (gpio setwpi_read(SPI0, SPI0_MOSI, SPI0_MISO, SPI0_SCLK, SPI0_CE0, ADC_CHANNEL, &adc_value) < 0) {
            perror("SPI read failed");
            return 1;
        }

        double flow_rate = (adc_value * 0.0048828125) / 10.0 * 0.0241; // 0.0241 LPM per 10-bit ADC value
        if (isnan(flow_rate)) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Invalid ADC value: %d\n", adc_value);
            continue;
        }

        if (fputs(fprintf(fp, "%ld,%f\n", (long)ts.tv_sec * 1000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000, flow_rate), fp) == EOF) {
            perror("log write failed");
            return 1;
        }

        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        usleep(SAMPLE_RATE_MS * 1000);

        if (gpio setwpi_cs(SPI0, SPI0_CE0, 0) < 0) {
            perror("SPI CS set failed");
            return 1;
        }
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    fclose(fp);
    return 0;
}

    if (ioctl(dev->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI_IOC_WR_MODE");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(dev->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SCLK, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("SPI_IOC_WR_SCLK");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(dev->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MOSI, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("SPI_IOC_WR_MOSI");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(dev->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MISO, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("SPI_IOC_WR_MISO");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(dev->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_CS, 1) < 0) {
        perror("SPI_IOC_WR_CS");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(dev->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_SCLK, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("SPI_IOC_RD_SCLK");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(dev->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MOSI, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("SPI_IOC_RD_MOSI");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(dev->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MISO, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("SPI_IOC_RD_MISO");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(dev->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_CS, 1) < 0) {
        perror("SPI_IOC_RD_CS");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpiod_substream_request(dev->substream, dev->cs) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_substream_request");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpiod_chip_free(dev->chip) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_free");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void spi_close(spi_dev *dev) {
    if (dev->substream) {
        gpiod_substream_free(dev->substream);
    }

    if (dev->cs) {
        gpiod_line_free(dev->cs);
    }

    if (dev->chip) {
        gpiod_chip_free(dev->chip);
    }

    if (dev->fd) {
        close(dev->fd);
    }
}

int main() {
    spi_dev dev;
    dev.fd = 0;
    dev.chip = NULL;
    dev.cs = NULL;
    dev.substream = NULL;

    if (!spi_open(&dev)) {
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        struct timespec ts;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        printf("%ld.%09ld: ", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000000);

        int adc_value = 0;
        if (ioctl(dev.fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MOSI, &adc_value) < 0) {
            perror("SPI_IOC_RD_MOSI");
            continue;
        }

        double moisture = (adc_value - MIN_ADC_VALUE) / (MAX_ADC_VALUE - MIN_ADC_VALUE) * 100.0;
        printf("%.2f%%\n", moisture);

        if (adc_value == 0 || adc_value == 1023) {
            printf("Error: ADC value stuck at 0 or 1023\n");
        }
    }

    spi_close(&dev);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>

#include <fcntl.h>

#include <sys/sigaction.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/spi/spi.h>
#include <linux/spi/spidev.h>

#define SPI_DEV "/dev/spidev0.0"
#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_BITS_PER_WORD 8
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000  // 1 MHz

#define MCP3008_CMD 0x00
#define MCP3008_CMD_START 0x80
#define MCP3008_CMD_CONFIG 0x20
#define MCP3008_CMD_DONT_CARE 0x00

#define SPI_READ_CMD (MCP3008_CMD_START | MCP3008_CMD_CONFIG | MCP3008_CMD_DONT_CARE)

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi_transfer;
} SpiHandler;

void sigint_handler(int sig) {
    if (SpiHandler::instance->fd > 0) {
        close(SpiHandler::instance->fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = sigint_handler;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;

    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) == -1) {
        perror("sigaction failed");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    SpiHandler::instance = new SpiHandler();

    if ((SpiHandler::instance->fd = open(SPI_DEV, O_RDWR)) == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.multiple = 1;
    SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.tx_buf = NULL;
    SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.rx_buf = NULL;
    SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.len = 0;
    SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.cs = SPI_CHANNEL;
    SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.bits_per_word = SPI_BITS_PER_WORD;
    SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;
    SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.mode = SPI_MODE;

    if (ioctl(SpiHandler::instance->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE) == -1) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI mode");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (ioctl(SpiHandler::instance->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_BITS_PER_WORD, SPI_BITS_PER_WORD) == -1) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI bits per word");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (ioctl(SpiHandler::instance->fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SPEED_HZ, SPI_SPEED) == -1) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI speed");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    while (1) {
        SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.tx_buf = (unsigned char *) &SPI_READ_CMD;
        SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.len = 3;
        SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.delay_usecs = 0;
        SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.flags = SPI_IOC_TRANSFER_FLAG_NO_WAIT;

        if (ioctl(SpiHandler::instance->fd, SPI_IOC_RDWR, &SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer) == -1) {
            perror("SPI transfer failed");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        uint16_t result = SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.rx_buf[0] << 8 | SpiHandler::instance->spi_transfer.rx_buf[1];
        int moisture = (result * 100) / 1023;

        if (moisture < 0) {
            moisture = 0;
        } else if (moisture > 100) {
            moisture = 100;
        }

        printf("Moisture: %d%%\n", moisture);

        usleep(5000000); // 5 seconds
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

class SpiHandler {
public:
    static SpiHandler* instance;
    int fd;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer spi_transfer;
};

SpiHandler* SpiHandler::instance = nullptr;

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_FREQ 1000000
#define SPI_CS 0
#define SPI_CS_PIN 4
#define SPI_MOSI 1
#define SPI_MISO 0
#define SPI_CLK 2
#define SPI_CS_PIN_VALUE 0

#define MCP3008_CHANNEL_0 0
#define MCP3008_CHANNEL_1 1
#define MCP3008_CHANNEL_2 2

#define VREF 3.3

typedef struct {
    char timestamp[20];
    int channel;
    float voltage;
} log_entry;

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    printf("SIGINT received, closing SPI handle and terminating pigpio\n");
    close_spi();
    terminate_pigpio();
    fclose(csv_file);
    exit(0);
}

void log_data(log_entry entry) {
    char buffer[100];
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    time_t rawtime;
    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, 100, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", timeinfo);
    sprintf(entry.timestamp, "%s", buffer);
    fprintf(csv_file, "%s,%d,%f\n", entry.timestamp, entry.channel, entry.voltage);
}

void read_mcp3008(int channel) {
    int buffer[3];
    int result;
    int status;

    // Set up SPI
    status = spi_open(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE, SPI_FREQ);
    if (status < 0) {
        printf("SPI open failed: %d\n", status);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up CS pin
    gpio_set_mode(SPI_CS_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpio_write(SPI_CS_PIN, SPI_CS_PIN_VALUE);

    // Set up SPI configuration
    spi_set_mode(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE);
    spi_set_freq(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_FREQ);
    spi_set_bit_order(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_BIT_ORDER_MSBFIRST);
    spi_set_mode(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE);

    // Set up CS pin
    gpio_set_pull_up(SPI_CS_PIN, 0);

    // Send command to MCP3008
    buffer[0] = 0x01; // Start bit
    buffer[1] = (channel << 4) | 0x00; // Single-ended configuration byte
    buffer[2] = 0x00; // Dummy byte
    status = spi_write(SPI_CHANNEL, buffer, 3);
    if (status < 0) {
        printf("SPI write failed: %d\n", status);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Read result
    status = spi_read(SPI_CHANNEL, buffer, 3);
    if (status < 0) {
        printf("SPI read failed: %d\n", status);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Calculate voltage
    result = (buffer[1] & 0x03) << 8 | buffer[2];
    entry.voltage = (float) result * VREF / 1024.0;

    // Clean up SPI
    spi_close(SPI_CHANNEL);
    gpio_set_mode(SPI_CS_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    gpio_write(SPI_CS_PIN, 1);
}

int main() {
    pid_t pid;
    int status;
    log_entry entry;
    char csv_file[100];
    char buffer[100];

    // Set up signal handler
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    // Create CSV file
    sprintf(csv_file, "analog_log.csv");
    csv_file = fopen(csv_file, "w");
    if (csv_file == NULL) {
        printf("Failed to open CSV file: %s\n", csv_file);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(csv_file, "Timestamp,Channel,Voltage\n");

    // Initialize pigpio
    status = pi_init();
    if (status < 0) {
        printf("pigpio init failed: %d\n", status);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up SPI
    status = spi_open(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE, SPI_FREQ);
    if (status < 0) {
        printf("SPI open failed: %d\n", status);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up CS pin
    gpio_set_mode(SPI_CS_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpio_write(SPI_CS_PIN, SPI_CS_PIN_VALUE);

    // Set up SPI configuration
    spi_set_mode(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE);
    spi_set_freq(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_FREQ);
    spi_set_bit_order(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_BIT_ORDER_MSBFIRST);
    spi_set_mode(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE);

    // Set up CS pin
    gpio_set_pull_up(SPI_CS_PIN, 0);

    // Read and log data
    while (1) {
        read_mcp3008(MCP3008_CHANNEL_0);
        read_mcp3008(MCP3008_CHANNEL_1);
        read_mcp3008(MCP3008_CHANNEL_2);

        log_data(entry);
    }

    // Cleanup
    close_spi();
    terminate_pigpio();
    fclose(csv_file);

    return 0;
}

Wiring: ADS1115 SDA to GPIO2, SCL to GPIO3, ADDR to GND (address 0x48), A0 to the IR sensor's analog output; a 5V relay module's IN line is on GPIO17 (active-high) and simulates a magnetic door lock release, and a magnetic reed door sensor is on GPIO27 (active-low, pulled high, LOW = door open). Poll the ADC every 200 ms; if the distance reading drops below the calibrated threshold, energize the relay for 3 seconds to release the door lock, then de-energize it, then read the reed sensor and log "door opened" if LOW, otherwise "door not opened". Log every event with millisecond timestamps to /var/log/door_events.log. Check every libgpiod call, I2C ioctl, and file open; handle a sensor-absent I2C read failure by logging and continuing. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <time.h>

#define I2C_DEVICE "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x48
#define IR_SENSOR_PIN 0
#define RELAY_PIN 1
#define REED_PIN 2
#define ADC_PIN 3
#define BASELINE_SAMPLES 10
#define BASELINE_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS 50
#define ADC_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS 200
#define RELAY_ENERGY_TIME_MS 3000
#define THRESHOLD_PERCENTAGE 0.8

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int relay_fd;
    int reed_fd;
    int adc_fd;
    int baseline_samples[BASELINE_SAMPLES];
    double baseline_avg;
    double threshold;
    int last_trigger;
    int last_reed_state;
    time_t last_event_time;
} DoorSensorState;

DoorSensorState state;

void init_gpio(int pin, int direction) {
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;

    chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (chip == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    line = gpiod_chip_new_line(chip, pin, direction);
    if (line == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_new_line");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    edge = gpiod_line_new_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (edge == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_new_edge");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_unref(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    gpiod_line_edge_enable(line, edge);
    gpiod_chip_unref(chip);
    state.relay_fd = line->line->fd;
    state.reed_fd = line->line->fd;
    state.adc_fd = line->line->fd;
    state.relaid = gpiod_line_get_value(line, edge);
    state.reed_state = gpiod_line_get_value(line, edge);
    state.adc_fd = line->line->fd;
}

void init_i2c() {
    state.i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (state.i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(state.i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void init_adc() {
    struct adc1_data request;
    request.adc1_cmd = ADC1_CONFIG_SINGLE;
    request.adc1_channel = ADC1_CH0;
    request.adc1_gain = ADC1_GAIN_2_5V;
    request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_UNSIGNED;
    request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_SINGLE;

    if (ioctl(state.adc_fd, ADC1_GET_CONFIG, &request) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void read_baseline() {
    int i;
    double sum = 0;

    for (i = 0; i < BASELINE_SAMPLES; i++) {
        request.adc1_cmd = ADC1_CONFIG_SINGLE;
        request.adc1_channel = ADC1_CH0;
        request.adc1_gain = ADC1_GAIN_2_5V;
        request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_UNSIGNED;
        request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_SINGLE;

        if (ioctl(state.adc_fd, ADC1_GET_CONFIG, &request) < 0) {
            perror("ioctl");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        request.adc1_cmd = ADC1_CONFIG_SINGLE;
        request.adc1_channel = ADC1_CH0;
        request.adc1_gain = ADC1_GAIN_2_5V;
        request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_UNSIGNED;
        request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_SINGLE;

        if (ioctl(state.adc_fd, ADC1_GET_DATA, &request) < 0) {
            perror("ioctl");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        state.baseline_samples[i] = request.adc1_data;
        sum += request.adc1_data;
    }

    state.baseline_avg = sum / BASELINE_SAMPLES;
    state.threshold = state.baseline_avg * THRESHOLD_PERCENTAGE;
}

void read_adc() {
    struct adc1_data request;
    request.adc1_cmd = ADC1_CONFIG_SINGLE;
    request.adc1_channel = ADC1_CH0;
    request.adc1_gain = ADC1_GAIN_2_5V;
    request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_UNSIGNED;
    request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_SINGLE;

    if (ioctl(state.adc_fd, ADC1_GET_CONFIG, &request) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    request.adc1_cmd = ADC1_CONFIG_SINGLE;
    request.adc1_channel = ADC1_CH0;
    request.adc1_gain = ADC1_GAIN_2_5V;
    request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_UNSIGNED;
    request.adc1_data_format = ADC1_DATA_FORMAT_SINGLE;

    if (ioctl(state.adc_fd, ADC1_GET_DATA, &request) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    state.last_trigger = 0;
    if (request.adc1_data < state.threshold) {
        state.last_trigger = time(NULL);
        gpiod_line_set_value(state.relay_fd, 1);
    } else {
        gpiod_line_set_value(state.relay_fd, 0);
    }
}

void read_reed() {
    state.last_reed_state = gpiod_line_get_value(state.reed_fd);
}

void log_event(const char *event) {
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm *tm = localtime(&now);
    char buffer[128];
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tm);
    FILE *log_file = fopen("/var/log/door_events.log", "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(log_file, "%s %s\n", buffer, event);
    fclose(log_file);
}

void cleanup() {
    gpiod_line_unref(state.relay_fd);
    gpiod_line_unref(state.reed_fd);
    gpiod_chip_close(state.relay_fd);
    gpiod_chip_close(state.reed_fd);
    close(state.i2c_fd);
    close(state.adc_fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    gpiod_line_set_value(state.relay_fd, 0);
    gpiod_chip_close(state.relay_fd);
    gpiod_line_unref(state.relay_fd);
    gpiod_chip_close(state.reed_fd);
    gpiod_line_unref(state.reed_fd);
    close(state.i2c_fd);
    close(state.adc_fd);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    init_gpio(IR_SENSOR_PIN, GPIOD_DIR_OUT);
    init_gpio(RELAY_PIN, GPIOD_DIR_OUT);
    init_gpio(REED_PIN, GPIOD_DIR_IN);

    init_i2c();
    init_adc();
    read_baseline();

    while (1) {
        read_adc();
        read_reed();
        if (state.last_trigger > 0 && (time(NULL) - state.last_trigger) < RELAY_ENERGY_TIME_MS) {
            log_event("door opened");
        } else {
            log_event("door not opened");
        }
        log_event("door state: " + (state.last_reed_state ? "closed" : "open"));
        sleep(ADC_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS / 1000);
    }

    cleanup();
    return 0;
}

Configure the control byte for single-ended mode on channel 0 (AIN0) with the analog output disabled. Because the PCF8591 returns the result of the previous conversion, perform a dummy read first and discard that byte before reading the current sample. Sample every 100 ms and print each sample value (0-255) to stdout. Check every I2C ioctl/read/write call and exit with a non-zero code on failure. Handle SIGINT (Ctrl-C) cleanly by closing the I2C file descriptor before exiting.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"
#define PCF8591_ADDR 0x48
#define PCF8591_CONTROL 0x80
#define PCF8591_MODE 0x00
#define PCF8591_CHANNEL 0x40
#define PCF8591_SINGLE_ENDED 0x00
#define PCF8591_ANALOG_OUTPUT_DISABLED 0x00

int main() {
    int i2c_fd;
    int pcf8591_fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    int control_byte;
    int sample;
    int status;
    int exit_code = 0;

    // Open I2C device
    if ((i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("open i2c device");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Set I2C slave address
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, PCF8591_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("set i2c slave address");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Open PCF8591 control line
    if ((pcf8591_fd = gpiod_open(I2C_DEV, "pcf8591")) < 0) {
        perror("open pcf8591 control line");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Set control byte for single-ended mode
    if (gpiod_set_value(pcf8591_fd, PCF8591_CONTROL, PCF8591_CONTROL | PCF8591_MODE | PCF8591_SINGLE_ENDED | PCF8591_ANALOG_OUTPUT_DISABLED) < 0) {
        perror("set pcf8591 control byte");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Create a chip object
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_new()) == NULL) {
        perror("create chip object");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Add the control line to the chip
    if (gpiod_chip_add_line(chip, pcf8591_fd, 0) < 0) {
        perror("add control line to chip");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Create an edge object for the control line
    if ((edge = gpiod_line_create_edge(chip, pcf8591_fd, 0, GPIOD_EDGE_EDGE_NONE)) == NULL) {
        perror("create edge object");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Set the edge to trigger on value change
    if (gpiod_line_set_edge(edge, GPIOD_EDGE_VALUE_CHANGE) < 0) {
        perror("set edge to trigger on value change");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Enable the edge
    if (gpiod_line_enable(edge) < 0) {
        perror("enable edge");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Perform a dummy read to discard the previous conversion
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, 1, &control_byte, 1, 0) < 0) {
        perror("dummy read");
        exit_code = 1;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Read the current sample
    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, 1, &control_byte, 1, 0) < 0) {
            perror("read i2c");
            exit_code = 1;
            goto cleanup;
        }
        sample = (control_byte & 0xFF);
        printf("%d\n", sample);
        usleep(100000); // 100 ms delay
    }

cleanup:
    if (pcf8591_fd) {
        gpiod_line_close(edge);
        gpiod_chip_delete(chip);
        gpiod_close(pcf8591_fd);
    }
    if (i2c_fd) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    return exit_code;
}

Convert the raw voltage to magnetic field strength in Gauss using the SS49E transfer function (zero-field output approximately 2.5 V, sensitivity approximately 1.4 mV/Gauss, Vcc = 3.3 V), and store the last 10 readings in a circular buffer. If the rolling average of the buffer exceeds a compile-time threshold (e.g., 500 Gauss), immediately drive GPIO27 HIGH to signal motor shutdown and keep it HIGH. Log all readings, threshold events, and errors via syslog. Handle pigpio initialization failure, I2C/ADC read failures by skipping the sample and continuing, and invalid voltage readings outside 0-3.3 V. On SIGINT/SIGTERM, stop the I2C handle, reset GPIO27 to LOW, terminate pigpio, and close syslog. Do not use wiringPi, and do not include MQTT or networking code.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <pigpio/driver.h>
#include <pigpio/adc.h>
#include <pigpio/i2c.h>
#include <math.h>

#define SS49E_ADDR 0x48
#define ADC_CHANNEL 0
#define BUFFER_SIZE 10
#define THRESHOLD 500
#define VCC 3.3
#define ZERO_FIELD_VOLTAGE 2.5
#define SENSITIVITY 0.0014

typedef struct {
    float buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int head = 0;
    int tail = 0;
} CircularBuffer;

CircularBuffer cb;

void init_buffer() {
    memset(cb.buffer, 0, sizeof(cb.buffer));
}

void add_to_buffer(float value) {
    if (cb.head == cb.tail) {
        if (cb.tail < BUFFER_SIZE - 1) {
            cb.tail++;
        } else {
            cb.tail = 0;
        }
    }
    cb.buffer[cb.tail] = value;
    cb.tail = (cb.tail + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
}

float get_average() {
    float sum = 0;
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
        if (cb.buffer[i] != 0) {
            sum += cb.buffer[i];
            count++;
        }
    }
    return sum / count;
}

void handle_error(int error_code) {
    if (error_code) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Error: %d", error_code);
    }
}

void handle_i2c_error(int error_code) {
    handle_error(error_code);
    add_to_buffer(0.0);
}

void handle_adc_error(int error_code) {
    handle_error(error_code);
    add_to_buffer(0.0);
}

void handle_threshold(int threshold) {
    if (threshold > THRESHOLD) {
        gpioSetMode(27, PI_OUTPUT);
        gpioWrite(27, 1);
    } else {
        gpioSetMode(27, PI_OUTPUT);
        gpioWrite(27, 0);
    }
}

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (i2cDetach(1) < 0) {
            handle_error(-1);
        }
        gpioSetMode(27, PI_OUTPUT);
        gpioWrite(27, 0);
        piStop();
        close_syslog();
    }
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        handle_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(27, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        handle_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioWrite(27, 0) < 0) {
        handle_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (i2cInit(1) < 0) {
        handle_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (adcInit(0, SS49E_ADDR, ADC_CHANNEL, 0) < 0) {
        handle_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    init_buffer();

    while (1) {
        if (i2cPollForData(1) < 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(-1);
            continue;
        }

        if (adcRead(0, SS49E_ADDR, ADC_CHANNEL) < 0) {
            handle_adc_error(-1);
            continue;
        }

        float voltage = (float)adcValue / 32768.0 * VCC;
        if (voltage < 0.0 || voltage > VCC) {
            handle_error(-1);
            add_to_buffer(0.0);
            continue;
        }

        float field_strength = (voltage - ZERO_FIELD_VOLTAGE) / SENSITIVITY;
        add_to_buffer(field_strength);

        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Voltage: %.2f V, Field Strength: %.2f Gauss", voltage, field_strength);

        float average = get_average();
        if (average > THRESHOLD) {
            handle_threshold(average);
        }

        usleep(1000000); // 1 Hz
    }

    return 0;
}
```

**Note:** The `close_syslog()` function is not a standard function in C. To close the syslog, you can use the following code:

```c
#include <syslog.h>

void close_syslog() {
    close(openlog("mylog", LOG_PERROR, LOG_USER));
}
```

However, this is not necessary in this case because the program will exit when it receives SIGINT or SIGTERM. The syslog will be closed automatically when the program exits.

        pi_write(pi_temporary_disable);
        pi_close();
        return 1;

        perror("SPI clock set failed");
        pi_write(pi_temporary_disable);
        pi_close();
        return 1;

        perror("SPI pull-up/down set failed");
        pi_write(pi_temporary_disable);
        pi_close();
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_spi_timeout(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_TIMEOUT) < 0) {
        perror("SPI timeout set failed");
        pi_write(pi_temporary_disable);
        pi_close();
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_adc_channel(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MCP3008) < 0) {
        perror("ADC channel set failed");
        pi_write(pi_temporary_disable);
        pi_close();
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_gpio(pump_pin, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO output set failed");
        pi_write(pi_temporary_disable);
        pi_close();
        return 1;
    }

    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("log file open failed");
        pi_write(pi_temporary_disable);
        pi_close();
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        int adc_value;
        if (pi_adc_read(SPI_CHANNEL, &adc_value) < 0) {
            fprintf(log_file, "ADC read failed\n");
            continue;
        }

        if (adc_value < THRESHOLD) {
            pi_gpio_write(pump_pin, 1);
            pi_delay(pump_on_time);
            pi_gpio_write(pump_pin, 0);
            pi_delay(pump_off_time);
        }

        fprintf(log_file, "%ld, %d\n", (long)time(NULL), adc_value);
    }

    pi_write(pi_temporary_disable);
    pi_close();
    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;
}

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x48
#define ADC_ADDR 0x48
#define ADC_IN 0x00
#define ADC_GAIN 4
#define ADC_RESOLUTION 16
#define ADC_SAMPLE_RATE 100
#define LED_PIN 17
#define DEFAULT_THRESHOLD 100.0

int adc_fd;
int i2c_fd;
int gpio_fd;
double threshold = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    printf("SIGINT received, exiting...\n");
    if (gpio_fd > 0) {
        gpio_close(gpio_fd);
        gpio_fd = 0;
    }
    if (adc_fd > 0) {
        close(adc_fd);
        adc_fd = 0;
    }
    if (i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
        i2c_fd = 0;
    }
    exit(0);
}

void handle_adc_error(int err) {
    printf("ADC communication error: %d\n", err);
    if (adc_fd > 0) {
        close(adc_fd);
        adc_fd = 0;
    }
    exit(1);
}

void handle_i2c_error(int err) {
    printf("I2C communication error: %d\n", err);
    if (i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
        i2c_fd = 0;
    }
    exit(1);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        printf("Usage: %s <threshold>\n", argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }
    threshold = strtod(argv[1], NULL);
    if (isnan(threshold) || isinf(threshold)) {
        printf("Invalid threshold value\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pigpio_init() < 0) {
        printf("pigpio_init failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    gpio_fd = gpio_open(DIGITAL);
    if (gpio_fd < 0) {
        printf("gpio_open failed\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpio_set_mode(gpio_fd, DIGITAL_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        printf("gpio_set_mode failed\n");
        return 1;
    }
    gpio_pwm(gpio_fd, 1); // Set PWM to 1 (50% duty cycle)

    int i2c_major, i2c_minor;
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2CGETI(0, &i2c_major, &i2c_minor)) < 0) {
        printf("I2C major/minor version not available\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if ((i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        printf("Failed to open I2C device\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2CSETUP, 0) < 0) {
        printf("Failed to set up I2C device\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2CSETUP, I2CSETUP_I2CADDR(I2C_ADDR)) < 0) {
        printf("Failed to set I2C address\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if ((adc_fd = open("/dev/adc1", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        printf("Failed to open ADC device\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (ioctl(adc_fd, ADCSETUP, ADCSETUP_ADC1) < 0) {
        printf("Failed to set up ADC device\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (ioctl(adc_fd, ADCSETUP, ADCSETUP_ADC1 | ADCSETUP_GAIN(ADC_GAIN) | ADCSETUP_RESOLUTION(ADC_RESOLUTION) | ADCSETUP_SAMPLE_RATE(ADC_SAMPLE_RATE)) < 0) {
        printf("Failed to set up ADC device\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(adc_fd, ADCREAD, ADC_ADDR | ADC_IN) < 0) {
        handle_adc_error(ioctl(adc_fd, ADCREAD, ADC_ADDR | ADC_IN));
    }

    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(adc_fd, ADCREAD, ADC_ADDR | ADC_IN) < 0) {
            handle_adc_error(ioctl(adc_fd, ADCREAD, ADC_ADDR | ADC_IN));
        } else {
            double volts = (double) (ioctl(adc_fd, ADCREAD, ADC_ADDR | ADC_IN) - 0x800) / 0x1000 * ADC_GAIN / 1000.0;
            double gauss = volts / 0.001;
            printf("Magnetic field strength: %.2f Gauss\n", gauss);

            if (gauss > threshold) {
                gpio_write(gpio_fd, 1);
                usleep(500000);
                gpio_write(gpio_fd, 0);
                usleep(500000);
                usleep(1000000);
            } else {
                gpio_write(gpio_fd, 0);
            }

            usleep(100000);
        }
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <pigpio/spi.h>
#include <pigpio/gpiod.h>
#include <paho/mqtt2.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_CS_PIN 8
#define SPI_CLOCK 1000000
#define RELAY_PIN 17
#define MOISTURE_THRESHOLD_LOW 30
#define MOISTURE_THRESHOLD_HIGH 35
#define MQTT_TOPIC_SOIL_MOISTURE "soil_moisture"
#define MQTT_TOPIC_PUMP_CONTROL "pump_control"
#define MQTT_QOS 1
#define MQTT_KEEPALIVE 60
#define MQTT_CLIENT_ID "soil_moisture_publisher"

int moisture_sensor_present = 0;
int pump_on = 0;
int mqtt_client = 0;
int spi_fd = -1;
int spi_cs_fd = -1;
int spi_channel = -1;
int relay_fd = -1;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (spi_fd != -1) {
        spi_close(spi_fd);
        spi_fd = -1;
    }
    if (relay_fd != -1) {
        gpio_write(relay_fd, 0);
        relay_fd = -1;
    }
    if (mqtt_client != 0) {
        paho_mqtt_disconnect(mqtt_client);
        paho_mqtt_destroy(mqtt_client);
        mqtt_client = 0;
    }
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(0);
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    handle_sigint(signum);
}

void init_spi() {
    if (spi_fd == -1) {
        spi_fd = spi_open(0, SPI_CS_PIN, SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_CLOCK);
        if (spi_fd == -1) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "SPI open failed: %d", spi_fd);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

void init_gpio() {
    if (relay_fd == -1) {
        relay_fd = gpio_request_one(RELAY_PIN, GPIO_PUD_OFF);
        if (relay_fd == -1) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "GPIO %d request failed: %d", RELAY_PIN, relay_fd);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

void init_mqtt() {
    if (mqtt_client == 0) {
        if (paho_mqtt_init(NULL, MQTT_CLIENT_ID, 0) == -1) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "MQTT init failed: %d", paho_mqtt_init);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (paho_mqtt_connect(mqtt_client, MQTT_TOPIC_PUMP_CONTROL, MQTT_QOS, 0) == -1) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "MQTT connect failed: %d", paho_mqtt_connect);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (paho_mqtt_subscribe(mqtt_client, MQTT_TOPIC_SOIL_MOISTURE, MQTT_QOS) == -1) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "MQTT subscribe failed: %d", paho_mqtt_subscribe);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

void read_moisture() {
    int buffer[3];
    int value;
    if (spi_fd != -1) {
        spi_cs_fd = spi_cs_open(spi_fd, SPI_CHANNEL);
        if (spi_cs_fd == -1) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "SPI CS open failed: %d", spi_cs_fd);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        spi_channel = spi_channel_open(spi_fd, spi_cs_fd);
        if (spi_channel == -1) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "SPI channel open failed: %d", spi_channel);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        spi_transfer(spi_fd, buffer, 3, 0);
        value = (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
        if (value < 0 || value > 1023) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Sensor value out of range: %d", value);
            moisture_sensor_present = 0;
        } else {
            moisture_sensor_present = 1;
            if (value < MOISTURE_THRESHOLD_LOW) {
                pump_on = 0;
            } else if (value > MOISTURE_THRESHOLD_HIGH) {
                pump_on = 1;
            } else {
                pump_on = 0;
            }
        }
        spi_channel_close(spi_fd, spi_cs_fd, spi_channel);
        spi_cs_close(spi_fd, spi_cs_fd);
    }
}

void publish_moisture() {
    if (mqtt_client != 0) {
        char buffer[128];
        int value;
        if (moisture_sensor_present) {
            value = (int)(buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
            snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%d", value);
            paho_mqtt_publish(mqtt_client, MQTT_TOPIC_SOIL_MOISTURE, MQTT_QOS, 0, buffer, strlen(buffer));
        } else {
            paho_mqtt_publish(mqtt_client, MQTT_TOPIC_SOIL_MOISTURE, MQTT_QOS, 0, "sensor_absent", strlen("sensor_absent"));
        }
    }
}

void handle_command(const char *topic, const char *payload) {
    if (strcmp(topic, MQTT_TOPIC_PUMP_CONTROL) == 0) {
        if (strcmp(payload, "on") == 0) {
            if (gpio_fd != -1) {
                gpio_write(relay_fd, 1);
            }
        } else if (strcmp(payload, "off") == 0) {
            if (gpio_fd != -1) {
                gpio_write(relay_fd, 0);
            }
        }
    }

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigterm);

    init_spi();
    init_gpio();
    init_mqtt();

    while (1) {
        read_moisture();
        publish_moisture();
        usleep(60000000);
    }

    return 0;

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define CE_PIN 0
#define SPI_FREQ 1000000
#define VREF 3.3
#define ADC_CHANNELS 3
#define SAMPLE_RATE 5
#define FILE_NAME "sensor_data.csv"

volatile sig_atomic_t running = 1;

void handle_signal(int sig) {
    if (sig == SIGINT || sig == SIGTERM) {
        printf("Received signal %d, exiting...\n", sig);
        running = 0;
        pi_close();
        exit(0);
    }
}

int main() {
    if (pi_init(-1) < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_mode(SPI_CHANNEL, PI_SPI_MODE3) < 0) {
        perror("SPI mode set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_clock(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_FREQ) < 0) {
        perror("SPI clock set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_pull_up_low(SPI_CHANNEL, 1) < 0) {
        perror("SPI pull-up set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_mode(CE_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("CE pin set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_pull_up_low(CE_PIN, 1) < 0) {
        perror("CE pull-up set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    FILE *fp = fopen(FILE_NAME, "w");
    if (!fp) {
        perror("file open failed");
        return 1;
    }

            if (pi_read(pi_spi_num(SPI_CHANNEL), 0x00, 3, 0) < 0) {
                perror("SPI read failed");
                return 1;
            }

            char timestamp[20];

            if (fprintf(fp, "%s\n", timestamp) < 0) {
                perror("file write failed");
                return 1;
            }
        }

        if (fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_SET) < 0) {
            perror("file seek failed");
            return 1;
        }

        if (rewind(fp) < 0) {
            perror("file rewind failed");
            return 1;
        }

        if (pi_delay(SAMPLE_RATE) < 0) {
            perror("delay failed");
            return 1;
        }
    }

    fclose(fp);
    pi_close();
    return 0;

#define FAN_PIN 18
#define LOG_FILE "air_quality.log"

int adc_fd;
int fan_pin;
int spi_fd;
int spi_mode;
int spi_freq;
int spi_channel;
int spi_ce;
int fan_state = 0;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (fan_state == 1) {
        gpio pwm_set_duty_cycle(fan_pin, 0);
    }
    gpio pwm_close(fan_pin);
    gpio close(fan_pin);
    gpio close(spi_channel);
    close(spi_fd);
    close(adc_fd);
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    if (gpio initialise(NULL) < 0) {
        perror("pigpio initialisation failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio pwm_open(fan_pin, 0) < 0) {
        perror("fan pwm open failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio pwm_set_duty_cycle(fan_pin, 0) < 0) {
        perror("fan pwm set duty cycle failed");
        return 1;
    }

    spi_fd = gpio spi_open(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE, SPI_FREQ);
    if (spi_fd < 0) {
        perror("SPI open failed");
        return 1;
    }

    spi_ce = gpio spi_set_ce(spi_fd, 0);
    if (spi_ce < 0) {
        perror("SPI set CE failed");
        return 1;
    }

    adc_fd = gpio spi_open(spi_fd, SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE, SPI_FREQ);
    if (adc_fd < 0) {
        perror("ADC open failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio pwm_set_duty_cycle(fan_pin, 1) < 0) {
        perror("fan pwm set duty cycle failed");
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        struct spi_ioc_transfer spi_transfer;
        spi_transfer.iov_base = NULL;
        spi_transfer.iov_len = 0;
        spi_transfer.delay_usec = 0;
        spi_transfer.format = SPI_FORMAT_SPI16;
        spi_transfer.mostsignificantbit = 16;

        spi_transfer.buffer = (char *) &spi_fd;
        spi_transfer.len = 1;

        int adc_value;
        int co2_ppm;
        int fan_state;

        if (gpio spi_transfer(spi_fd, spi_transfer) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "SPI transfer failed\n");
            continue;
        }

        adc_value = (int) spi_fd;
        if (adc_value < 0 || adc_value > 1023) {
            fprintf(stderr, "ADC value out of range\n");
            continue;
        }

        co2_ppm = (adc_value * 0.5) - 50;
        fan_state = (co2_ppm > CO2_THRESHOLD) ? 1 : 0;

        char timestamp[20];
        time_t now = time(NULL);
        struct tm *gmtm = gmtime(&now);
        strftime(timestamp, 20, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", gmtm);

        FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
        if (log_file == NULL) {
            perror("log file open failed");
            return 1;
        }

        fprintf(log_file, "%s,%d,%d\n", timestamp, co2_ppm, fan_state);
        fclose(log_file);

        if (gpio pwm_set_duty_cycle(fan_pin, fan_state) < 0) {
            perror("fan pwm set duty cycle failed");
            return 1;
        }

        sleep(5);
    }

    return 0;
}
