#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>

#define SPI0_CE0 0
#define SPI0_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI0_CLOCK 1000000
#define IR_SENSOR_PRESENT 0
#define RELAY_GPIO 17
#define IR_SENSOR_THRESHOLD 20
#define DEBOUNCE_DELAY 100
#define POLLING_INTERVAL 100

int spi_fd;
int spi_clock;
int spi_cs;
int spi_channel;
int spi_fd_err;
int spi_cs_fd_err;
int spi_channel_err;
int spi_clock_err;

int spi_init() {
    int ret;

    spi_fd = open("/dev/spi0.0", O_RDWR);
    if (spi_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        return -1;
    }

    ret = ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_GET_CSPOL, &spi_cs);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get SPI CS control");
        close(spi_fd);
        return -1;
    }

    spi_cs = spi_cs & 0x3; // Mask to get CE0
    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_SET_CSPOL, spi_cs) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI CS control");
        close(spi_fd);
        return -1;
    }

    spi_clock = SPI0_CLOCK;
    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_SET_CLOCK, spi_clock) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI clock");
        close(spi_fd);
        return -1;
    }

    spi_channel = SPI0_CHANNEL;
    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_SET_CHANNEL, spi_channel) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI channel");
        close(spi_fd);
        return -1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int spi_read() {
    int ret;
    unsigned char buffer[1];

    ret = ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_READ, buffer, 1);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI data");
        return -1;
    }

    return buffer[0];
}

int gpio_init() {
    int ret;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;

    ret = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO device");
        return -1;
    }

    chip = gpiod_chip_get_current();
    if (chip == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get current GPIO chip");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return -1;
    }

    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, RELAY_GPIO);
    if (line == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return -1;
    }

    edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (edge == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO edge");
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return -1;
    }

    gpiod_line_enable(line, edge);
    return 0;
}

void gpio_release() {
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;

    chip = gpiod_chip_get_current();
    if (chip == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, RELAY_GPIO);
    if (line == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    edge = gpiod_line_get_edge(line);
    if (edge == NULL) {
        return;
    }

    gpiod_line_disable(line, edge);
    gpiod_line_free(line);
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
}

int main() {
    int ir_distance;
    int event_count = 0;
    int last_event_time = 0;
    int last_triggered = 0;
    int triggered = 0;
    int running = 1;
    int ret;

    signal(SIGINT, [](int) {
        gpio_release();
        running = 0;
        return 0;
    });

    spi_fd_err = spi_init();
    if (spi_fd_err < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    spi_cs_fd_err = spi_cs;
    spi_channel_err = spi_channel;
    spi_clock_err = spi_clock;

    gpio_release();
    ret = gpio_init();
    if (ret < 0) {
        return -1;
    }

    while (running) {
        usleep(POLLING_INTERVAL * 1000);

        ir_distance = spi_read();
        if (ir_distance < IR_SENSOR_PRESENT) {
            if (!triggered) {
                triggered = 1;
                last_triggered = event_count;
                event_count++;
                last_event_time = syscall(__NR_gettimeofday, NULL, NULL);
                FILE *log_file = fopen("door_events.log", "a");
                if (log_file) {
                    fprintf(log_file, "%ld: Triggered\n", last_event_time);
                    fclose(log_file);
                } else {
                    perror("Failed to open log file");
                }

                if (gpio_set_value(RELAY_GPIO, 1) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set GPIO value");
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (triggered) {
                triggered = 0;
                last_triggered = 0;
                event_count = 0;
                last_event_time = 0;
                FILE *log_file = fopen("door_events.log", "a");
                if (log_file) {
                    fprintf(log_file, "%ld: Released\n", last_event_time);
                    fclose(log_file);
                } else {
                    perror("Failed to open log file");
                }

                if (gpio_set_value(RELAY_GPIO, 0) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set GPIO value");
                }
            }
        }

        usleep(DEBOUNCE_DELAY * 1000);
    }

    gpio_release();
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>

#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <sys/spi/spidev.h>

#define SPI0_CE0 8
#define SPI0_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI0_SPEED 1000000
#define SPI0_MODE 0
#define SPI0_BITS 8
#define SPI0_TIMEOUT 100
#define MAX_RETRIES 3
#define DELAY 100

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_handle handle;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    int channel;
} GPIOController;

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct spi_ioc_transfer transfer;
    int channel;
    int speed;
    int mode;
    int bits;
    int timeout;
    int retries;
    int last_error;
} SPIController;

void handle_gpio_error(int line, int err, const char *msg) {
    if (err < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "GPIO error: %s on line %d\n", msg, line);
    }
}

void handle_spi_error(int err, const char *msg) {
    if (err < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "SPI error: %s\n", msg);
    }
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    if (sig == SIGINT || sig == SIGTERM) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Received signal %d, shutting down...\n", sig);
        close_gpio();
        close_spi();
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

void close_gpio() {
    if (gpio_controller.line) {
        gpiod_line_close(gpio_controller.line);
        gpiod_handle_free(gpio_controller.handle);
    }
}

void close_spi() {
    if (spi_controller.fd > 0) {
        close(spi_controller.fd);
    }
}

GPIOController gpio_controller;
SPIController spi_controller;

void init_gpio() {
    int line_fd = gpiod_new_line(gpio_controller.handle, SPI0_CE0, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_INPUT);
    if (line_fd < 0) {
        handle_gpio_error(line_fd, -1, "Failed to create GPIO line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    gpio_controller.fd = line_fd;
    gpio_controller.line = line_fd;
    gpio_controller.channel = SPI0_CE0;
    gpiod_line_request_edge(gpio_controller.line, GPIOD_EDGE_FALLING);
    gpiod_line_request_callback(gpio_controller.line, handle_gpio_callback);
}

void handle_gpio_callback(int line, int edge, int edge_count) {
    if (edge_count == 1) {
        spi_controller.retries = 0;
    }
}

void init_spi() {
    spi_controller.fd = open("/dev/spi0.0", O_RDWR);
    if (spi_controller.fd < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(-1, "Failed to open SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    spi_controller.transfer.tx_buf = (unsigned long) spi_controller.fd;
    spi_controller.transfer.rx_buf = (unsigned long) spi_controller.fd;
    spi_controller.transfer.cs = SPI0_CE0;
    spi_controller.transfer.speed_hz = SPI0_SPEED;
    spi_controller.transfer.mode = SPI0_MODE;
    spi_controller.transfer.bits = SPI0_BITS;
    spi_controller.transfer.delay_us = SPI0_TIMEOUT;
    spi_controller.retries = 0;
    spi_controller.last_error = 0;
}

void read_adc() {
    spi_controller.transfer.tx_buf[0] = 0x01;
    spi_controller.transfer.tx_buf[1] = (SPI0_CHANNEL << 4) | 0x80;
    spi_controller.transfer.tx_buf[2] = 0x00;
    spi_controller.transfer.len = 3;
    spi_controller.transfer.delay_useconds = 0;
    spi_controller.transfer.flags = SPI_IOC_MESSAGE(1);
    spi_controller.retries = 0;
    int result = spi_ioc_transfer(spi_controller.fd, &spi_controller.transfer);
    if (result < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(result, "Failed to read ADC");
        return;
    }
    int adc_value = ((spi_controller.transfer.rx_buf[1] & 0x03) << 8) | spi_controller.transfer.rx_buf[2];
    if (adc_value < 0 || adc_value > 1023) {
        handle_spi_error(-1, "Invalid ADC value");
        return;
    }
    spi_controller.last_error = 0;
    return adc_value;
}

void process_adc_value(int adc_value) {
    double ppm = (adc_value * 0.5) - 10.0;
    if (ppm > 50) {
        printf("Alcohol detected! Limit exceeded.\n");
    } else if (ppm < 20) {
        printf("Sobriety confirmed.\n");
    } else {
        printf("Alcohol level within acceptable range.\n");
    }
}

void log_reading(int adc_value) {
    time_t rawtime;
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    char buffer[128];
    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, 128, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC", timeinfo);
    FILE *log_file = fopen("alcohol_log.txt", "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(log_file, "%s ADC: %d\n", buffer, adc_value);
    fclose(log_file);
}

void retry_spi_read() {
    if (spi_controller.retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
        usleep(DELAY);
        spi_controller.retries++;
        read_adc();
    } else {
        handle_spi_error(-1, "Failed to read ADC after retries");
    }
}

void main_loop() {
    while (1) {
        int adc_value = read_adc();
        if (adc_value == 0 || adc_value == 1023) {
            printf("ADC read error: Sensor absent or faulty.\n");
            retry_spi_read();
        } else {
            process_adc_value(adc_value);
            log_reading(adc_value);
        }
        sleep(1);
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);
    init_gpio();
    init_spi();
    main_loop();
    return 0;
}

        close(log_file);
        pi_close();
        return 1;

        perror("Failed to set SPI MOSI pin mode");

        pi_close();

        return 1;

        close(log_file);
        pi_close();
        return 1;

    return 0;

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define MAX9814_AOUT_PIN 0
#define MCP3008_CS_PIN 8
#define MCP3008_MOSI_PIN 10
#define MCP3008_MISO_PIN 9
#define MCP3008_SCLK_PIN 11
#define LED_PIN 17
#define DEBOUNCE_TIME_MS 10
#define CALIBRATION_TIME 5000

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(MCP3008_CS_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting MCP3008 CS mode failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(MCP3008_MOSI_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting MCP3008 MOSI mode failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(MCP3008_MISO_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting MCP3008 MISO mode failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(MCP3008_SCLK_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting MCP3008 SCLK mode failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(LED_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting LED mode failed");
        return 1;
    }

    int spiHandle = spiOpen(0);
    if (spiHandle < 0) {
        perror("SPI handle creation failed");
        return 1;
    }

    int calibrationSamples = 0;
    int calibrationSum = 0;
    int calibrationAverage = 0;

    printf("Calibrating for %d seconds...\n", CALIBRATION_TIME);
    for (int i = 0; i < CALIBRATION_TIME; i++) {
        if (spiXfer(spiHandle, 0x6, 1, 1, 0) < 0) {
            perror("SPI transfer failed");
            return 1;
        }
        int adcValue = spiXfer(spiHandle, 0x06, 1, 1, 0) & 0x03;
        calibrationSum += adcValue;
        calibrationSamples++;
        usleep(1000000 / 60); // 60 Hz sampling rate
    }

    calibrationAverage = calibrationSum / calibrationSamples;

    printf("Calibrated average: %d\n", calibrationAverage);

    int threshold = calibrationAverage * 1.1;

    int lastLedState = 0;
    int lastSample = 0;

    while (1) {
        if (gpioRead(LED_PIN) == 1 && lastLedState == 0) {
            lastLedState = 1;
            printf("Sound detected!\n");
        } else if (gpioRead(LED_PIN) == 0 && lastLedState == 1) {
            lastLedState = 0;
            printf("Sound stopped.\n");
        }

        if (spiXfer(spiHandle, 0x6, 1, 1, 0) < 0) {
            perror("SPI transfer failed");
            return 1;
        }
        int sample = spiXfer(spiHandle, 0x06, 1, 1, 0) & 0x03;

        if (sample > threshold) {
            if (lastSample != sample) {
                gpioWrite(LED_PIN, 1);
                lastSample = sample;
            }
        } else {
            if (lastSample != 0) {
                gpioWrite(LED_PIN, 0);
                lastSample = 0;
            }
        }

        usleep(10000); // 10 ms debounce
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

        perror("open SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

        perror("SPI mode write");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_BITS_PER_WORD, SPI_WIDTH) < 0) {

        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SPEED_hz, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("SPI speed write");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MODE, &spi_mode) < 0) {
        perror("SPI mode read");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

        perror("SPI speed read");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    mosquitto_create_options_t create_options = {0};

        return 1;

        if (gpiod_line_event_wait(line, event) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_event_wait");
            gpiod_chip_release(chip);
            gpiod_line_release(line);

        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

int spi_read(int len, unsigned char *rx) {

        perror("pigpio_read");
        return -1;

    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    // Open the GPIO chip
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod")) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Find the GPIO line
    if ((line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO_PIN)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set the line to input with pull-down
    if (gpiod_line_set_mode(line, GPIOD_MODE_INPUT) == -1) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_mode");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (gpiod_line_set_pull(line, GPIOD_PULL_DOWN) == -1) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_pull");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Create an edge for the line
    if ((edge = gpiod_line_create_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_create_edge");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Create an event for the edge
    if ((event = gpiod_edge_create_event(edge, 0)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_edge_create_event");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set the event to trigger on both rising and falling edges
    if (gpiod_edge_set_event(edge, event, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH) == -1) {
        perror("gpiod_edge_set_event");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Start the event
    if (gpiod_edge_start(edge) == -1) {
        perror("gpiod_edge_start");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Initialize the last state
    state = gpiod_line_get_value(line);

    // Log the initial state
    if (gpiod_line_get_value(line) == 1) {
        printf("Flame detected! %s\n", ctime(&ts));
    }

    while (1) {
        // Read the current state
        state = gpiod_line_get_value(line);

        // Log the state
        if (alarm) {
            printf("Flame detected! %s\n", ctime(&ts));
        }
        if (state == 1) {
            // Log the event
            snprintf(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%ld,%d,1\n", (long)time(NULL), GPIO_PIN);
            FILE *log = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
            if (log != NULL) {
                fwrite(timestamp, sizeof(char), strlen(timestamp), log);
                fclose(log);
            } else {
                perror("fopen");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }

            // Print the alarm message
            printf("Flame detected! %s\n", ctime(&ts));
        } else {
            // Log the event
            snprintf(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%ld,%d,0\n", (long)time(NULL), GPIO_PIN);
            FILE *log = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
            if (log != NULL) {
                fwrite(timestamp, sizeof(char), strlen(timestamp), log);
                fclose(log);
            } else {
                perror("fopen");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }

        // Sleep for 1 second
        if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) == -1) {
            perror("clock_gettime");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        if (nanosleep(&ts, NULL) == -1) {
            perror("nanosleep");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    // Cleanup GPIO resources
    gpiod_line_free(line);
    gpiod_chip_free(chip);

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define MCP3008_CS 0
#define SPI_FREQ 1000000
#define LOG_FILE "soil_data.txt"

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    spiClose();
    fclose(log_file);
    gpioTerminate();
    printf("Goodbye!\n");
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    int adc_values[3];
    char log_file_buffer[256];
    struct tm *time_info;
    time_t raw_time;
    pid_t pid;

    if (signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("signal");
        exit(1);
    }

    if (gpioInitialise(NULL) < 0) {
        perror("gpioInitialise");
        exit(1);
    }

    if (spiOpen(SPI_FREQ, MCP3008_CS, 0) < 0) {
        perror("spiOpen");
        exit(1);
    }

    while (1) {
        raw_time = time(NULL);
        time_info = localtime(&raw_time);
        strftime(log_file_buffer, sizeof(log_file_buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time_info);

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            adc_values[i] = spiXfer(0, 0x01, 0x00, 3, 0x00);
            if (adc_values[i] < 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "Error reading ADC value %d\n", i);
                continue;
            }
            float moisture = (1.0 - (adc_values[i] / 1023.0)) * 100.0;
            printf("%s, Sensor %d: %f%%\n", log_file_buffer, i, moisture);
            if (fputs(log_file_buffer, log_file) < 0) {
                perror("fputs");
                exit(1);
            }
        }

        gpioDelay(60000);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO_PIN_17 17
#define GPIO_PIN_22 22
#define GPIO_PIN_23 23
#define GPIO_PIN_24 24

int main() {
    int line_fd;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_dir dir;
    struct gpiod_edge edge;
    struct gpiod_request request;

    // Initialize gpiod
    if (gpiod_init(NULL) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_init");
        return 1;
    }

    // Open GPIO subsystem
    if ((line_fd = gpiod_open(NULL)) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_open");
        gpiod_uninit(NULL);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up GPIO direction for all lines
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        int pin = GPIO_PIN_17 + i;
        if ((line = gpiod_get_line(line_fd, pin, &dir, &edge)) == NULL) {
            perror("gpiod_get_line");
            gpiod_uninit(NULL);
            return 1;
        }

        // Set direction to output
        if (gpiod_line_request_output(line, &request) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_output");
            gpiod_line_free(line);
            gpiod_uninit(NULL);
            return 1;
        }

        // Set initial value to LOW (assuming active-high relay modules)
        if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
            gpiod_line_free(line);
            gpiod_uninit(NULL);
            return 1;
        }

        // Release the line
        gpiod_line_request_free(line, &request);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
    }

    // Signal handler for SIGINT and SIGTERM
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = [](int signum) {
        // Deactivate all relays and release GPIO lines
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int pin = GPIO_PIN_17 + i;
            if ((line = gpiod_get_line(line_fd, pin, &dir, &edge)) == NULL) {
                perror("gpiod_get_line");
                gpiod_uninit(NULL);
                return 1;
            }
            if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
                perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
                gpiod_line_free(line);
                gpiod_uninit(NULL);
                return 1;
            }
            gpiod_line_request_free(line, &request);
            gpiod_line_free(line);
        }
        gpiod_uninit(NULL);
        printf("Exiting...\n");
        exit(0);
    };
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) < 0 || sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL) < 0) {
        perror("sigaction");
        gpiod_uninit(NULL);
        return 1;
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int pin = GPIO_PIN_17 + i;
            if ((line = gpiod_get_line(line_fd, pin, &dir, &edge)) == NULL) {
                perror("gpiod_get_line");
                gpiod_uninit(NULL);
                return 1;
            }
            if (gpiod_line_request_output(line, &request) < 0) {
                perror("gpiod_line_request_output");
                gpiod_line_free(line);
                gpiod_uninit(NULL);
                return 1;
            }
            if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 1) < 0) {
                perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
                gpiod_line_request_free(line, &request);
                gpiod_line_free(line);
                gpiod_uninit(NULL);
                return 1;
            }
            printf("Relay %d activated\n", i);
            sleep(1);
            if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
                perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
                gpiod_line_request_free(line, &request);
                gpiod_line_free(line);
                gpiod_uninit(NULL);
                return 1;
            }
            printf("Relay %d deactivated\n", i);
            sleep(1);
            gpiod_line_request_free(line, &request);
            gpiod_line_free(line);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define MCP3008_CHANNEL 0
#define LED_PIN 16
#define DEBOUNCE_TIME 10
#define LED_ON_TIME 500

int spi_fd;
int gpio16_fd;
int gpio8_fd;
int sound_level;
int sound_event_count = 0;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (spi_fd > 0) {
        close(spi_fd);
    }
    if (gpio16_fd > 0) {
        close(gpio16_fd);
    }
    if (gpio8_fd > 0) {
        close(gpio8_fd);
    }
    piLock();
    piSetMode(LED_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    piSetMode(LED_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    piSetMode(gpio8_fd, PI_OFF);
    piSetMode(gpio16_fd, PI_OFF);
    piUnlock();
    printf("Exiting...\n");
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct timespec ts;
    ts.tv_sec = 0;
    ts.tv_nsec = 0;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    if (piInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (piSetMode(LED_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("LED mode set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (piSetMode(gpio8_fd, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO8 mode set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (piSetMode(gpio8_fd, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO8 input mode set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (piSetMode(LED_PIN, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("LED input mode set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if ((spi_fd = spiOpen(0)) < 0) {
        perror("SPI open failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (piSetClockMode(0, PI_CLOCK_DIV2) < 0) {
        perror("SPI clock mode set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (piSetClockSpeed(0, 1000000) < 0) {
        perror("SPI clock speed set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        ts.tv_sec = time(NULL) / 60;
        ts.tv_nsec = (time(NULL) % 60) * 1000000000;
        nanosleep(&ts, NULL);

        if (piRead(gpio8_fd, &sound_level) < 0) {
            perror("SPI read failed");
            continue;
        }

        if (sound_level > 500) {
            if (sound_event_count % DEBOUNCE_TIME == 0) {
                if (piSetMode(LED_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
                    perror("LED output mode set failed");
                    return 1;
                }
                piWrite(LED_PIN, 1);
                sound_event_count = 0;
            } else {
                sound_event_count++;
            }
        } else {
            if (sound_event_count > 0) {
                sound_event_count = 0;
                if (piSetMode(LED_PIN, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
                    perror("LED input mode set failed");
                    return 1;
                }
                piWrite(LED_PIN, 0);
            }
        }

        if (sound_event_count > 0) {
            usleep(LED_ON_TIME * 1000);
        } else {
            usleep(DEBOUNCE_TIME * 1000);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#define ADC_CHANNEL 26
#define LED_CHANNEL 16
#define THRESHOLD 700
#define DEBOUNCE 50
#define SAMPLE_RATE 1000000

int adc_fd;
int gpio_fd;
int gpio16_state = 0;
int gpio26_state = 0;
int gpio26_detected = 0;
int gpio16_on = 0;
int running = 1;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (gpio26_detected) {
        gpio26_detected = 0;
        gpio16_on = 0;
    }
    printf("Shutting down...\n");
    running = 0;
    pi_event_clear(gpio26, 0);
    pi_event_clear(gpio16, 0);
    pi_set_mode(gpio26, PI_OFF);
    pi_set_mode(gpio16, PI_OFF);
    pi_close();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct timespec ts;
    ts.tv_sec = 0;
    ts.tv_nsec = 0;

    if (signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("SIGINT handler setup failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_init() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio initialization failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_adc_init(ADC_CHANNEL, SAMPLE_RATE) < 0) {
        perror("ADC initialization failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_mode(ADC_CHANNEL, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("ADC mode set to input failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_mode(LED_CHANNEL, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("LED mode set to output failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_pull_up_down(LED_CHANNEL, PI_PUD_OFF) < 0) {
        perror("LED pull-up/down set to off failed");
        return 1;

    adc_fd = pi_adc_open(ADC_CHANNEL);
    if (adc_fd < 0) {
        perror("ADC file descriptor failed to open");
        return 1;
    }

    gpio_fd = pi_gpio_open(LED_CHANNEL);
    if (gpio_fd < 0) {
        perror("GPIO file descriptor failed to open");
        return 1;
    }

    pi_event_callback(gpio26, 0, gpio26_detect_cb, NULL);
    pi_event_callback(gpio16, 0, gpio16_detect_cb, NULL);

    while (running) {

            perror("ADC read failed");
            continue;
        }

            gpio26_detected = 1;
            gpio16_on = 1;
            pi_set(gpio16, 1);

            ts.tv_nsec = 0;

            pi_set(gpio16, 0);
            printf("%ld.%09ld: Clap detected\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec);
            usleep(DEBOUNCE * 1000);

        if (!gpio26_detected && gpio26_state < THRESHOLD) {

        }

            break;
        }
    }

    pi_close();
    return 0;
}

void gpio26_detect_cb(int gpio, int level, int tick) {

        gpio16_on = 1;
        pi_set(gpio16, 1);
        ts.tv_sec = time(NULL);
        ts.tv_nsec = 0;
        nanosleep(&ts, &ts);
        pi_set(gpio16, 0);
        printf("%ld.%09ld: Clap detected\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec);
        usleep(DEBOUNCE * 1000);
    } else if (level == 0 && gpio26_detected) {
        gpio26_detected = 0;
    }

#define GP2Y0A21K0F_B -6.0
#define MAX_RETRIES 3
#define RETRY_DELAY 1

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int retries;
    int last_error;
} GPIOHandler;

void handle_gpio_error(int error) {
    if (GPIOHandler->retries > MAX_RETRIES) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Max retries reached. Exiting...\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "GPIO error: %d. Retrying in %d seconds...\n", error, RETRY_DELAY);
    sleep(RETRY_DELAY);
    GPIOHandler->retries++;
}

void read_distance() {
    char filename[128];
    struct stat st;
    GPIOHandler handler;

    handler.retries = 0;
    handler.last_error = 0;

    while (1) {
        snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "/sys/class/gpio/gpio17/value");
        handler.fd = open(filename, O_RDONLY);
        if (handler.fd == -1) {
            handle_gpio_error(errno);
            continue;
        }

        char value;
        if (read(handler.fd, &value, 1) != 1) {
            handle_gpio_error(errno);
            continue;
        }

        double voltage = (value == '1') ? 3.3 : 0.0;
        double distance = (GP2Y0A21K0F_A / voltage) + GP2Y0A21K0F_B;

        time_t now = time(NULL);
        struct tm *tm = localtime(&now);
        char timestamp[128];
        strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tm);

        FILE *log_file = fopen("distance_log.txt", "a");
        if (log_file == NULL) {
            handle_gpio_error(errno);
            continue;
        }
        fprintf(log_file, "%s %f\n", timestamp, distance);
        fclose(log_file);

        if (distance < 200.0) {
            printf("Feeder Activated\n");
        } else {
            printf("Feeder Idle\n");
        }

        close(handler.fd);
    }
}

void signal_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        char filename[128];
        snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "/sys/class/gpio/gpio17");
        unexport_gpio(filename);
        printf("GPIO unexported. Exiting...\n");
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int unexport_gpio(const char *gpio) {
    int fd = open(gpio, O_WRONLY);
    if (fd == -1) {
        perror("unexport_gpio");
        return -1;
    }
    if (write(fd, "unexport", 8) != 8) {
        perror("unexport_gpio");
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }
    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);

    read_distance();

    return 0;
}

    int value;
    if (gpio_spisub_readadc(channel, SPI0, 0, 0, &value) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error reading ADC: %d\n", gpio_errno());
        return -1;
    }
    return value;
}

void init_gpio(GPIOController *gpio) {

    }

    ret = gpiod_request_edge(gpio->handle, GPIO_LINE, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, &gpio->line);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_request_edge");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpiod_request_mode(gpio->handle, GPIO_LINE, GPIOD_MODE_INPUT, &gpio->line);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_request_mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpiod_release_mode(gpio->handle, gpio->line);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_release_mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = gpiod_release_line(gpio->handle, gpio->line);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_release_line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    gpio->fd = gpiod_open(gpio->handle, gpio->line);
    if (gpio->fd < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void cleanup_gpio(GPIOController *gpio) {
    gpiod_close(gpio->handle);
    gpiod_free(gpio->handle);
}

void init_spi(SPIController *spi) {
    int ret = open(SPI_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    spi->fd = ret;

    spi->spi.bits = SPI_BITS;
    spi->spi.mode = SPI_MODE;
    spi->spi.speed_hz = SPI_SPEED;

    spi->spi.tx_buf = (unsigned long)&spi->spi.tx_buf;

        perror("ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = ioctl(spi->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MODE, &spi->spi.mode);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = ioctl(spi->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_BITS_PER_FRAME, &spi->spi.bits);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    ret = ioctl(spi->fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MAX_SPEED_HZ, &spi->spi.speed_hz);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void cleanup_spi(SPIController *spi) {
    close(spi->fd);
}

void log_current(double current) {
    struct timeval tv;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    double timestamp = tv.tv_sec + tv.tv_usec / 1000000.0;
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(log_file, LOG_FORMAT, timestamp, current);
    fclose(log_file);
}

int main() {
    GPIOController gpio;
    SPIController spi;

    init_gpio(&gpio);
    init_spi(&spi);

    while (1) {
        double current;

        ret = spi->spi.tx_buf[5] = 0x00;
        ret = spi->spi.tx_buf[6] = 0x00;
        ret = spi->spi.tx_buf[7] = 0x00;

        ret = ioctl(spi.fd, SPI_IOC_IOC_WRITE, &spi->spi.tx_buf, 8 * sizeof(unsigned char));

            perror("ioctl");
            continue;

        ret = ioctl(spi.fd, SPI_IOC_RD_DATA0, &current);

            perror("ioctl");
            continue;
        }

        cleanup_spi(&spi);

        perror("pigpioInitialise");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

        perror("spiOpen");
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Open log file
    FILE *log_file;
    if ((log_file = fopen("current_log.txt", "w")) == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        spiClose(0);
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

        uint8_t tx[3] = {0x01, 0x80, 0x00};
        uint8_t rx[3];
        if (spiXfer(0, tx, rx, 3) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "SPI transfer error\n");
            continue;
        }

        // Compute 10-bit result
        int result = ((rx[1] & 0x03) << 8) | rx[2];

        // Convert to voltage
        double voltage = (result / 1023.0) * 5.0;

        // Check voltage range
        if (voltage < 0.0 || voltage > 5.0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Voltage out of range\n");
            continue;
        }

        // Convert to current
        double current = (voltage - 2.5) * (50.0 / 2.5);

        // Append to log file
        char timestamp[20];
        struct tm *now = localtime(&time(NULL));
        strftime(timestamp, 20, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", now);
        fprintf(log_file, "%s %.2f A\n", timestamp, current);
        fflush(log_file);

        // Delay
        gpioDelay(100000);
    }

    // Close log file
    fclose(log_file);

    // Close SPI
    spiClose(0);

    // Terminate pigpio
    gpioTerminate();

    return 0;
}

        return 100.0;
    } else {
        return 100.0 - ((adc_value - MIN_ADC) / (MAX_ADC - MIN_ADC)) * 100.0;
    }
}

void log_data(double moisture_level) {
    char buffer[128];
    struct tm *time_info;
    time_t raw_time;
    time(&raw_time);
    time_info = localtime(&raw_time);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time_info);
    sprintf(buffer + strlen(buffer), ",%.2f", moisture_level);
    FILE *file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (file != NULL) {
        fprintf(file, "%s", buffer);
        fclose(file);
    } else {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
    }
}

void read_mcp3008(int channel) {
    spi_config_t config = {0};
    config.mode = SPI_MODE0;
    config.bits = 8;
    config.delay = 0;
    config.speed = SPI_SPEED_1MHZ;
    config.channel = SPI_CHANNEL;
    config.cs = 0;
    config.rx_buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(3 * sizeof(uint8_t));
    if (config.rx_buf == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to allocate RX buffer");
        return;
    }
    if (spi_open(&config) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI");
        free(config.rx_buf);
        return;
    }
    uint8_t rx_buf[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        rx_buf[i] = 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (spi_read(&config, rx_buf[i]) < 0) {
            perror("SPI read failed");
            free(config.rx_buf);
            spi_close(&config);
            return;
        }
    }
    int adc_value = ((rx_buf[1] & 0x03) << 8) | rx_buf[2];
    free(config.rx_buf);
    spi_close(&config);
    return adc_value;
}

void close_spi() {
    spi_close(&config);
}

void terminate_pigpio() {
    if (pigpio_wake_up() < 0) {
        perror("Failed to wake up pigpio");
    }
    if (pigpio_stop() < 0) {
        perror("Failed to stop pigpio");
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    if (pigpio_init(NULL) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to initialize pigpio");
        return 1;
    }
    spi_config_t config = {0};
    config.mode = SPI_MODE0;
    config.bits = 8;
    config.delay = 0;
    config.speed = SPI_SPEED_1MHZ;
    config.channel = SPI_CHANNEL;
    config.cs = 0;
    config.rx_buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(3 * sizeof(uint8_t));
    if (config.rx_buf == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to allocate RX buffer");
        free(config.rx_buf);
        pigpio_stop();
        return 1;
    }
    if (spi_open(&config) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI");
        free(config.rx_buf);
        pigpio_stop();
        return 1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (spi_read(&config, config.rx_buf[i]) < 0) {
            perror("SPI read failed");
            free(config.rx_buf);
            spi_close(&config);
            pigpio_stop();
            return 1;
        }
    }
    int adc_value = ((config.rx_buf[1] & 0x03) << 8) | config.rx_buf[2];
    free(config.rx_buf);
    spi_close(&config);
    double moisture_level = calculate_moisture_level(adc_value);
    log_data(moisture_level);
    printf("%.2f\n", moisture_level);
    sleep(READ_DELAY);
    while (!termination_flag) {
        adc_value = read_mcp3008(MCP3008_CHANNEL);
        moisture_level = calculate_moisture_level(adc_value);
        log_data(moisture_level);
        printf("%.2f\n", moisture_level);
        sleep(READ_DELAY);
    }
    close_spi();
    terminate_pigpio();
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/select.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/v4l2.h>
#include <syslog.h>

#define FRAME_LOG_FILE "frame_log.txt"
#define FRAME_WIDTH 640
#define FRAME_HEIGHT 480
#define FRAME_SIZE (FRAME_WIDTH * FRAME_HEIGHT * 3 / 2)

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct v4l2_capability cap;
    struct v4l2_format fmt;
    struct v4l2_input input;
    struct v4l2_plane plane;
    void *frame_buffer;
    int frame_buffer_size;
    struct timeval last_frame_time;
} Camera;

void init_camera(Camera *cam) {
    cam->fd = open("/dev/video0", O_RDWR | O_NONBLOCK);
    if (cam->fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open video device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_QUERYCAP, &cam->cap) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to query camera capabilities");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    cam->fmt.pixelformat = V4L2_PIX_FMT_MJPEG;
    cam->fmt.fmt.pix.width = FRAME_WIDTH;
    cam->fmt.fmt.pix.height = FRAME_HEIGHT;
    cam->fmt.fmt.pix.field = V4L2_FRAMESIZE_FRAMES_FIELD_NONE;
    cam->fmt.fmt.pix.pixelformat = V4L2_PIX_FMT_MJPEG;

    if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_S_FMT, &cam->fmt) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set video format");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_S_INPUT, &cam->input) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set input");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    cam->plane.type = V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPTURE;
    cam->plane.index = 0;
    cam->plane.start = 0;
    cam->plane.end = FRAME_SIZE;

    if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_REQBUF, &cam->plane) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request buffer");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    cam->frame_buffer = mmap(0, cam->plane.end, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, cam->fd, cam->plane.start);
    if (cam->frame_buffer == MAP_FAILED) {
        perror("Failed to map buffer");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    cam->frame_buffer_size = cam->plane.end;
}

void capture(Camera *cam) {
    fd_set readfds;
    struct timeval tv;
    int ret;

    while (1) {
        FD_ZERO(&readfds);
        FD_SET(cam->fd, &readfds);

        tv.tv_sec = 0;
        tv.tv_usec = 100000; // 100ms

        ret = select(FD_SETSIZE, &readfds, NULL, NULL, &tv);

        if (ret == 0) {
            continue;
        }

        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("select() failed");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (FD_ISSET(cam->fd, &readfds)) {
            if (ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_DQBUF, &cam->plane) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to dequeue buffer");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }

            if (cam->plane.bytesused == 0) {
                continue;
            }

            if (cam->plane.bytesused < 0) {
                perror("Failed to dequeue buffer");
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }

            if (cam->frame_buffer_size != cam->plane.bytesused) {

prompt: Write a robust C program for a Raspberry Pi to capture a single 1920x1080 JPEG image from a USB camera at /dev/video0 and save it to "image.jpg", using the V4L2 API with memory-mapped (MMAP) buffers. Open the device in blocking mode (O_RDWR without O_NONBLOCK) so VIDIOC_DQBUF blocks until a frame is ready. Query device capabilities and verify V4L2_CAP_VIDEO_CAPTURE and V4L2_CAP_STREAMING are supported. Request the format V4L2_PIX_FMT_MJPEG at 1920x1080 with V4L2_FIELD_NONE, request 4 MMAP buffers, and query, mmap, and queue each one. Start streaming, dequeue one frame, verify buf.bytesused > 0, and write the raw MJPEG bytes directly to disk with no re-encoding. Implement clean resource release on all exit paths: stop streaming, munmap all mapped buffers, free the buffer array, close the file, and close the device fd. Install a SIGINT/SIGTERM handler so Ctrl+C cleanly tears down streaming and releases resources. Check every ioctl, open, mmap, and fopen return value, printing a descriptive error via perror/errno on failure. Do not use any external image libraries.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <signal.h>

#define V4L2_CAP_VIDEO_CAPTURE 0x00000001
#define V4L2_CAP_STREAMING 0x00000002
#define V4L2_PIX_FMT_MJPEG 0x00000003
#define V4L2_FIELD_NONE 0x00000000
#define MMAP_BUF_SIZE 4

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    struct v4l2_capability cap;
    struct v4l2_format fmt;
    struct v4l2_buffer buf;
    void *bufs[MMAP_BUF_SIZE];
    FILE *file;
} Camera;

void camera_handler(int sig) {
    Camera *cam = (Camera *) sig;
    if (cam->fd > 0) {
        ioctl(cam->fd, VIDIOC_SSTOP, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < MMAP_BUF_SIZE; i++) {
            munmap(cam->bufs[i], cam->bufs[i]->size);
        }
        free(cam->bufs);
        fclose(cam->file);
        close(cam->fd);
    }
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    Camera cam;
    cam.fd = open("/dev/video0", O_RDWR | O_NONBLOCK);
    if (cam.fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(cam.fd, VIDIOC_QUERYCAP, &cam.cap) < 0) {
        perror("VIDIOC_QUERYCAP");
        return 1;
    }

    if (!(cam.cap.capabilities & (V4L2_CAP_VIDEO_CAPTURE | V4L2_CAP_STREAMING))) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Device does not support video capture\n");
        return 1;
    }

    cam.buf.size = 0;
    cam.buf.type = V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPTURE;
    cam.buf.memory = V4L2_MEMORY_MMAP;

    if (ioctl(cam.fd, VIDIOC_QBUF, &cam.buf) < 0) {
        perror("VIDIOC_QBUF");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(cam.fd, VIDIOC_G_FMT, &cam.buf) < 0) {
        perror("VIDIOC_G_FMT");
        return 1;
    }

    cam.buf.pixelformat.pixelformat = V4L2_PIX_FMT_MJPEG;
    cam.buf.pixelformat.width = 1920;
    cam.buf.pixelformat.height = 1080;
    cam.buf.pixelformat.field = V4L2_FIELD_NONE;

    if (ioctl(cam.fd, VIDIOC_S_FMT, &cam.buf) < 0) {
        perror("VIDIOC_S_FMT");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(cam.fd, VIDIOC_REQBUF, &cam.buf) < 0) {
        perror("VIDIOC_REQBUF");
        return 1;
    }

    cam.bufs = malloc(cam.buf.buffersize);
    if (!cam.bufs) {
        perror("malloc");
        return 1;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < MMAP_BUF_SIZE; i++) {
        cam.bufs[i] = mmap(0, cam.buf.buffersize, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, cam.fd, i * cam.buf.buffersize);
        if (cam.bufs[i] == MAP_FAILED) {
            perror("mmap");
            return 1;
        }
    }

    cam.file = fopen("image.jpg", "wb");
    if (!cam.file) {
        perror("fopen");
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, camera_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, camera_handler);

    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(cam.fd, VIDIOC_DQBUF, &cam.buf) < 0) {
            if (cam.buf.bytesused > 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "VIDIOC_DQBUF failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
                return 1;
            } else {
                fprintf(stderr, "VIDIOC_DQBUF: %s\n", strerror(errno));
                break;
            }
        }

        if (cam.buf.bytesused > 0) {
            fwrite(cam.buf.buffer, cam.buf.bytesused, 1, cam.file);
            if (fwrite != 1) {
                perror("fwrite");
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

void cleanup(CameraCapture *cap) {

    if (!handle) {

        cleanup(cap);
        exit(1);

    if (!line) {

        cleanup(cap);

    cap->line = line;

    struct gpiod_event *event = gpiod_get_event(line, 0);
    if (!event) {
        perror("gpiod_get_event");
        cleanup(cap);
        exit(1);
    }
    cap->event = event;

    struct gpiod_request *request = gpiod_request_new();
    if (!request) {
        perror("gpiod_request_new");
        cleanup(cap);
        exit(1);
    }
    cap->request = request;

    struct gpiod_request_args args;
    args.flags = G_PIOD_REQ_FLAG_MMAP;
    args.size = FRAME_WIDTH * FRAME_HEIGHT * 2; // YUYV format
    gpiod_request_set_args(request, &args);
    gpiod_request_add_event(request, event, G_PIOD_REQ_FLAG_READ);
    gpiod_request_submit(handle, request);

    cap->buffer = mmap(0, args.size, PROT_READ, MAP_SHARED, cap->fd, 0);
    if (cap->buffer == MAP_FAILED) {

        cleanup(cap);
        exit(1);

    fd_set readfds;
    FD_ZERO(&readfds);

#define V4L2_CID_FOCUS_AUTO 0x1000

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    int fd;
    struct v4l2_capability cap;
    struct v4l2_control ctrl;
    struct v4l2_frmsizeTypeDef frmsize;
    struct v4l2_frameintTypeDef frameint;
    int res = 0;

    fd = open(argv[1], O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_QUERYCAP, &cap) < 0) {
        perror("VIDIOC_QUERYCAP");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (!cap.capabilities.cap_videocodec || !cap.capabilities.cap_frameperf) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Camera not supported\n");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    memset(&ctrl, 0, sizeof(ctrl));
    ctrl.control = V4L2_CID_FOCUS_AUTO;
    if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_QUERYCTRL, &ctrl) < 0) {
        perror("VIDIOC_QUERYCTRL");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ctrl.capabilities.control) {
        printf("Focus Auto Support: Yes\n");
    } else {
        printf("Focus Auto Support: No\n");
    }

    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

While a button is held, increment or decrement the corresponding servo position by 10 microseconds per loop iteration (50 ms loop delay), clamped to the 1000-2000 microsecond range. Initialize the pigpio library and check its return value, printing an error and exiting if it fails. Configure internal pull-up resistors on all button pins, and use gpioServo() for PWM output. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define SERVO_PIN_PAN 4
#define SERVO_PIN_TILT 5
#define BUTTON_PIN_UP 6
#define BUTTON_PIN_DOWN 7
#define BUTTON_PIN_LEFT 8
#define BUTTON_PIN_RIGHT 9

#define PULSE_WIDTH_CENTER 1500
#define PULSE_WIDTH_MIN 1000
#define PULSE_WIDTH_MAX 2000
#define PULSE_WIDTH_INCREMENT 10

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    printf("Shutting down PWM...\n");
    gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_PAN, 0);
    gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_TILT, 0);
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    printf("Pan servo on GPIO4, Tilt servo on GPIO5\n");
    printf("UP on GPIO6, DOWN on GPIO7, LEFT on GPIO8, RIGHT on GPIO9\n");
    printf("Center position: 1500 microseconds\n");

    // Set up servo pins
    gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_PAN, PULSE_WIDTH_CENTER);
    gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_TILT, PULSE_WIDTH_CENTER);

    // Set up button pins
    gpioSetPullUpCallback(BUTTON_PIN_UP, [](int gpio, uint32_t level, uint32_t mod, uint32_t edge) {
        if (level == 0) {
            int current = gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_PAN);
            if (current < PULSE_WIDTH_MAX) {
                gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_PAN, current + PULSE_WIDTH_INCREMENT);
            }
        }
    });

    gpioSetPullUpCallback(BUTTON_PIN_DOWN, [](int gpio, uint32_t level, uint32_t mod, uint32_t edge) {
        if (level == 0) {
            int current = gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_PAN);
            if (current > PULSE_WIDTH_MIN) {
                gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_PAN, current - PULSE_WIDTH_INCREMENT);
            }
        }
    });

    gpioSetPullUpCallback(BUTTON_PIN_LEFT, [](int gpio, uint32_t level, uint32_t mod, uint32_t edge) {
        if (level == 0) {
            int current = gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_TILT);
            if (current < PULSE_WIDTH_MAX) {
                gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_TILT, current + PULSE_WIDTH_INCREMENT);
            }
        }
    });

    gpioSetPullUpCallback(BUTTON_PIN_RIGHT, [](int gpio, uint32_t level, uint32_t mod, uint32_t edge) {
        if (level == 0) {
            int current = gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_TILT);
            if (current > PULSE_WIDTH_MIN) {
                gpioServo(SERVO_PIN_TILT, current - PULSE_WIDTH_INCREMENT);
            }
        }
    });

    // Set up signal handlers
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        sleep(50);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>

#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <camera-still.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define DEBOUNCE_MS 50
#define IMAGE_DIR "/home/pi/images"
#define LOG_FILE "/home/pi/motion_capture.log"

int main() {
    int fd, ret;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct gpiod_state *state;
    struct timespec ts;
    char filename[256];
    char logbuf[256];
    pid_t pid;
    int camera_return_code;

    // Open GPIO chip
    if ((fd = open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDONLY)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO chip");
        return 1;
    }

    // Get GPIO chip
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open(fd)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO chip");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Claim GPIO17
    if ((line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO17)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to claim GPIO17");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set GPIO17 to input with falling edge detection
    if ((edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_FALLING)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO17 to falling edge detection");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set GPIO17 to input with 50ms debounce
    if ((state = gpiod_line_request_state(line, GPIOD_STATE_DEBOUNCE, DEBOUNCE_MS)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO17 debounce");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Log initial state
    if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get current time");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }
    strftime(logbuf, sizeof(logbuf), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", localtime(&ts));
    snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "%s/%s.jpg", IMAGE_DIR, logbuf);
    if (access(filename, F_OK) == -1) {
        if (mkdir(IMAGE_DIR, 0700) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to create image directory");
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            close(fd);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    // Log initial state
    snprintf(logbuf, sizeof(logbuf), "%s: Initial state set", filename);
    syslog(LOG_INFO, logbuf);
    if (write(STDOUT_FILENO, logbuf, strlen(logbuf)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to log initial state");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        // Wait for GPIO17 to transition
        if (gpiod_line_wait_edge(line, edge, &ts) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to wait for GPIO17 transition");
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            close(fd);
            return 1;
        }

        // Check if GPIO17 is now high
        if (gpiod_line_get_state(line, state) == GPIOD_STATE_HIGH) {
            // Generate timestamped filename
            if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to get current time");
                gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                close(fd);
                return 1;
            }
            strftime(logbuf, sizeof(logbuf), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", localtime(&ts));
            snprintf(filename, sizeof(filename), "%s/%s.jpg", IMAGE_DIR, logbuf);
            if (access(filename, F_OK) == -1) {
                if (mkdir(IMAGE_DIR, 0700) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to create image directory");
                    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                    close(fd);
                    return 1;
                }
            }

            // Log event
            snprintf(logbuf, sizeof(logbuf), "%s: Motion detected at %s", filename, ctime(&ts));
            syslog(LOG_INFO, logbuf);
            if (write(STDOUT_FILENO, logbuf, strlen(logbuf)) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to log event");
                gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                close(fd);
                return 1;
            }

            // Capture image
            if ((pid = fork()) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to fork");
                gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                close(fd);
                return 1;
            }

            if (pid == 0) {
                // Child process
                if (camera_still_open(NULL) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to open camera");
                    _exit(1);
                }
                if (camera_still_set_option(CAMERA_STILL_OPTION_WIDTH, 640) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set camera width");
                    _exit(1);
                }
                if (camera_still_set_option(CAMERA_STILL_OPTION_HEIGHT, 480) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set camera height");
                    _exit(1);
                }
                if (camera_still_set_option(CAMERA_STILL_OPTION_Q, 85) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set camera quality");
                    _exit(1);
                }
                if (camera_still_set_option(CAMERA_STILL_OPTION_TIMEOUT, 2000) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set camera timeout");
                    _exit(1);
                }
                if (camera_still_set_option(CAMERA_STILL_OPTION_NOPREVIEW, 1) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to set camera preview off");
                    _exit(1);
                }
                if (camera_still_open_file(filename) < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to open camera file");
                    _exit(1);
                }
                if (camera_still_start() < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to start camera");
                    _exit(1);
                }
                camera_return_code = camera_still_stop();
                if (camera_return_code < 0) {
                    perror("Failed to stop camera");
                    _exit(1);
                }
                camera_still_close();
                _exit(0);
            } else {
                // Parent process
                if (camera_return_code == 0) {
                    // Log success
                    snprintf(logbuf, sizeof(logbuf), "%s: Image captured successfully", filename);
                    syslog(LOG_INFO, logbuf);
                    if (write(STDOUT_FILENO, logbuf, strlen(logbuf)) < 0) {
                        perror("Failed to log success");
                        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                        close(fd);
                        return 1;
                    }
                } else {
                    // Log failure
                    snprintf(logbuf, sizeof(logbuf), "%s: Image capture failed", filename);
                    syslog(LOG_ERR, logbuf);
                    if (write(STDOUT_FILENO, logbuf, strlen(logbuf)) < 0) {
                        perror("Failed to log failure");
                        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                        close(fd);
                        return 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Log no motion
            snprintf(logbuf, sizeof(logbuf), "%s: No motion detected", filename);
            syslog(LOG_INFO, logbuf);
            if (write(STDOUT_FILENO, logbuf, strlen(logbuf)) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to log no motion");
                gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                close(fd);
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }

    // Clean up
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    close(fd);
    return 0;

#include <stdio.h>

#include <string.h>

#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/select.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <sys/time.h>

#define CAPTURE_DEVICE "/dev/video0"
#define WIDTH 640
#define HEIGHT 480
#define CROP_X 100
#define CROP_Y 50
#define CROP_WIDTH 200
#define CROP_HEIGHT 150
#define YUYV_SIZE (CROP_WIDTH * CROP_HEIGHT * 2)

int main() {
    int fd = open(CAPTURE_DEVICE, O_RDWR | O_NONBLOCK);
    if (fd == -1) {
        perror("open");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    struct v4l2_capability cap;
    if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_QUERYCAP, &cap) == -1) {
        perror("VIDIOC_QUERYCAP");
        close(fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (!(cap.capabilities & V4L2_CAP_VIDEO_CAPTURE)) {
        perror("Not a video capture device");
        close(fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    struct v4l2_format fmt;
    fmt.pixelformat = V4L2_PIX_FMT_YUYV;
    fmt.fmt.pix.width = WIDTH;
    fmt.fmt.pix.height = HEIGHT;
    fmt.fmt.pix.field = V4L2_FIELD_NONE;

    if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_S_FMT, &fmt) == -1) {
        perror("VIDIOC_S_FMT");
        close(fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_REQBUFS, 1) == -1) {
        perror("VIDIOC_REQBUFS");
        close(fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    struct v4l2_buffer buf;
    buf.type = V4L2_BUF_TYPE_VIDEO_CAPTURE;
    if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_QUERYBUF, &buf) == -1) {
        perror("VIDIOC_QUERYBUF");
        close(fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (mmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, fd, buf.mmap_offset) == MAP_FAILED) {
        perror("mmap");
        close(fd);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    int timeout = 2000;
    fd_set readset;
    FD_ZERO(&readset);
    FD_SET(fd, &readset);

    struct timeval tv;
    tv.tv_sec = 0;
    tv.tv_usec = 0;

    while (1) {
        int result = select(fd + 1, &readset, NULL, NULL, &tv);
        if (result == -1) {
            perror("select");
            break;
        } else if (result == 0) {
            continue;
        }

        if (FD_ISSET(fd, &readset)) {
            struct v4l2_buffer new_buf;
            if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_QBUF, &new_buf) == -1) {
                perror("VIDIOC_QBUF");
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            if (ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_DQBUF, &new_buf) == -1) {
                perror("VIDIOC_DQBUF");
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            if (buf.mmap_addr == new_buf.mmap_addr) {
                if (buf.mmap_length != new_buf.mmap_length) {
                    perror("mmap length mismatch");
                    munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                    close(fd);
                    return EXIT_FAILURE;
                }
            } else {
                perror("mmap address mismatch");
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            if (buf.mmap_length / 8 != WIDTH * HEIGHT) {
                perror("mmap length mismatch");
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            if (fmt.pixelformat != (fmt.fmt.pix.pixelformat = buf.fmt.pix.pixelformat)) {
                perror("mmap format mismatch");
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            if (buf.fmt.pix.width != WIDTH || buf.fmt.pix.height != HEIGHT) {
                perror("mmap width/height mismatch");
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            if (buf.fmt.pix.field != V4L2_FIELD_NONE) {
                perror("mmap field mismatch");
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            if (buf.fmt.pix.pixelformat != V4L2_PIX_FMT_YUYV) {
                perror("mmap format mismatch");
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            void *frame = buf.mmap_addr;
            unsigned char *yuyv = (unsigned char *)frame;
            for (int i = 0; i < WIDTH * HEIGHT * 2; i += 4) {
                unsigned char y0 = yuyv[i];
                unsigned char u = yuyv[i + 1];
                unsigned char y1 = yuyv[i + 2];
                unsigned char v = yuyv[i + 3];

                if (i >= (CROP_X * CROP_Y * 2) && i < (CROP_X * CROP_Y * 2 + CROP_WIDTH * CROP_HEIGHT * 2)) {

            FILE *fp = fopen("cropped.yuv", "wb");
            if (!fp) {
                perror("fopen");
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            fwrite(cropped_yuv, YUYV_SIZE, 1, fp);
            if (fwrite != 1) {
                perror("fwrite");
                fclose(fp);
                munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
                close(fd);
                return EXIT_FAILURE;
            }

            fclose(fp);
            munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
            close(fd);
            return EXIT_SUCCESS;
        }
    }

    munmap(buf.mmap_addr, buf.mmap_length);
    close(fd);
    return EXIT_FAILURE;

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B, using the pigpio library, that reads pulses from a YF-S201 water flow sensor connected to GPIO17 and calculates the flow rate in liters per minute using the sensor's calibration figure of approximately 450 pulses per liter. Log the current flow rate and the running total volume to the console every 1 second, with robust error handling for GPIO initialization failures. Every 10 seconds, also update a small HD44780 LCD screen connected via I2C (bus 1, address 0x27) to display the current flow rate together with the accumulated volume, using pigpio's I2C functions and handling any I2C communication errors that occur. Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM for a graceful shutdown that releases all GPIO and I2C resources.

</think>

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <pigpio/i2c.h>

#define GPIO_PIN 17
#define LCD_ADDRESS 0x27
#define LCD_WIDTH 16
#define LCD_HEIGHT 2
#define LCD_LINE1 0
#define LCD_LINE2 1

#define CALIBRATION_PULSES_PER_LITER 450

typedef struct {
    int flowRate;
    double accumulatedVolume;
} FlowData;

FlowData flowData;

void handleFlowRate(int gpio, long ticks) {
    flowData.flowRate = (long)ticks / CALIBRATION_PULSES_PER_LITER;
    flowData.accumulatedVolume += flowData.flowRate / 60.0;
}

void handleI2CError(int err) {
    if (err) {
        printf("I2C error: %d\n", err);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void handleSigint(int sig) {
    printf("Received SIGINT signal. Shutting down...\n");
    piLock();
    piGpioTerminate();
    piI2CUninit();
    piSysUninit();
    piCleanup();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handleSigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handleSigint);

    if (piInitialise()) {
        printf("GPIO initialization failed\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    piSetMode(GPIO_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    piSetPullUp(GPIO_PIN, 0);
    piISR(GPIO_PIN, NULL, handleFlowRate);

    if (i2cOpen(1, LCD_ADDRESS, 400000, I2C_MASTER, 0) < 0) {
        printf("I2C initialization failed\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    char lcdBuffer[LCD_WIDTH + 1];
    char line1[LCD_WIDTH + 1];
    char line2[LCD_WIDTH + 1];

    while (1) {
        piDelay(1000);

        snprintf(line1, LCD_WIDTH, "Flow Rate: %.2f L/min", flowData.flowRate);
        snprintf(line2, LCD_WIDTH, "Total Volume: %.2f L", flowData.accumulatedVolume);

        if (i2cWrite(1, LCD_ADDRESS, line1, strlen(line1), I2C_WRITE) < 0) {
            handleI2CError(i2cError());
        }

        if (i2cWrite(1, LCD_ADDRESS, line2, strlen(line2), I2C_WRITE) < 0) {
            handleI2CError(i2cError());
        }

        printf("Flow Rate: %.2f L/min\n", flowData.flowRate);
        printf("Total Volume: %.2f L\n", flowData.accumulatedVolume);
    }

    return 0;
}

WavePattern right_to_left = {{7, 0}, {6, 0}, {5, 0}, {4, 0}, {3, 0}, {2, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, 0}};

void scan_row(int row, int col, int delay) {

    for (i = 0; i < GPIO_ROWS; i++) {
        gpio_rows[i] = GPIO_PIN_ROWS * i;

Scan columns from left to right with a 150 ms delay between columns: for each column, set the corresponding column cathode LOW and all row anodes HIGH to light the entire column, clearing the matrix before each column by setting all column cathodes HIGH and all row anodes LOW. Run the animation indefinitely until interrupted (Ctrl+C). Check every GPIO operation, handling chip-open failure, and cleanly release all GPIO lines on exit using a signal handler for SIGINT and SIGTERM. Do not use wiringPi or any deprecated library.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define GPIO_PIN_ROW 0
#define GPIO_PIN_COL 1
#define GPIO_PIN_COUNT 8

#define GPIO_PIN_ROW_PINS {2, 3, 4, 17, 27, 22, 10, 9}
#define GPIO_PIN_COL_PINS {14, 15, 18, 23, 24, 25, 8, 7}

int main() {
    int chip_fd, line_fd;
    gpiod_chip_t *chip;
    gpiod_line_t *line;
    gpiod_line_request_t request;
    int i;

    // Open the GPIO chip
    if ((chip_fd = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod")) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        return 1;
    }

    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_get_new(chip_fd)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_new");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Open all row lines
    for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PIN_COUNT; i++) {
        if ((line_fd = gpiod_chip_request_output(chip, GPIO_PIN_ROW_PINS[i], &request)) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_chip_request_output");
            goto cleanup;
        }
        if ((line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, line_fd)) == NULL) {
            perror("gpiod_chip_request_line");
            goto cleanup;
        }
    }

    // Open all column lines
    for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PIN_COUNT; i++) {
        if ((line_fd = gpiod_chip_request_output(chip, GPIO_PIN_COL_PINS[i], &request)) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_chip_request_output");
            goto cleanup;
        }
        if ((line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, line_fd)) == NULL) {
            perror("gpiod_chip_request_line");
            goto cleanup;
        }
    }

    // Set up the signal handler
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = [](int signum) {
        if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
            // Clean up GPIO lines
            for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PIN_COUNT; i++) {
                gpiod_line_free(chip, line);
            }
            gpiod_chip_close(chip, chip_fd);
            gpiod_chip_unexport(chip_fd);
            printf("Exiting...\n");
            exit(0);
        }
    };
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) < 0 || sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL) < 0) {
        perror("sigaction");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Clear the matrix
        for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PIN_COUNT; i++) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(chip, line, 1);
            gpiod_line_set_edge(chip, line, GPIOD_EDGE_NONE);
        }

        // Scan columns
        for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PIN_COUNT; i++) {
            // Set the current column cathode LOW
            gpiod_line_set_value(chip, line, 0);
            // Set all row anodes HIGH
            for (int j = 0; j < GPIO_PIN_COUNT; j++) {
                gpiod_line_set_value(chip, line, 1);
            }
            usleep(150000); // 150 ms delay

            // Set all column cathodes HIGH
            for (int j = 0; j < GPIO_PIN_COUNT; j++) {
                gpiod_line_set_value(chip, line, 1);
            }
        }
    }

cleanup:
    // Clean up GPIO lines
    for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PIN_COUNT; i++) {
        gpiod_line_free(chip, line);
    }
    gpiod_chip_close(chip, chip_fd);
    gpiod_chip_unexport(chip_fd);

    return 0;
}

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x4C
#define I2C_REG_ADDR 0x0D
#define I2C_READ 0
#define I2C_WRITE 1
#define I2C_READ_BYTES 2
#define I2C_WRITE_BYTES 2
#define I2C_TIMEOUT 100
#define I2C_READ_TIMEOUT 100
#define I2C_WRITE_TIMEOUT 100
#define I2C_READ_RETRY 3
#define I2C_WRITE_RETRY 3
#define CSV_HEADER "timestamp,distance\n"

int i2c_fd;
int gpio_fd;
int log_fd;
char log_buffer[256];
char log_filename[256];
char timestamp_buffer[256];

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (log_fd != -1) {
        close(log_fd);
    }
    if (i2c_fd != -1) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    if (gpio_fd != -1) {
        close(gpio_fd);
    }
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    if (gpio_init() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    snprintf(log_filename, sizeof(log_filename), "depth_log.csv");
    log_fd = open(log_filename, O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_TRUNC, 0644);

        perror("failed to open log file");
        return 1;
    }

        perror("failed to open I2C bus");
        return 1;

        return 1;

        perror("failed to write CSV header");
        return 1;
    }

            perror("failed to write newline");
        }

        if (write(log_fd, "\r\n", 2) < 0) {
            perror("failed to write newline");
        }

    }

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/sigaction.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_SLAVE 0x5A
#define PART_ID 0x00
#define MEAS_RATE0 0x08
#define COMMAND 0x47
#define PS_DATA0 0x24
#define PS_DATA1 0x25
#define BPM_OFFSET 100
#define SAMPLE_INTERVAL 100000  // 100ms

volatile sig_atomic_t running = 1;

void sigint_handler(int sig) {
    running = 0;
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = sigint_handler;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    int i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_SLAVE) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    uint8_t part_id;
    if (i2c_smbus_read_byte_data(i2c_fd, PART_ID, &part_id) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read PART_ID register");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (part_id != 0x1A) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Invalid part ID: 0x%02X\n", part_id);
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    uint8_t meas_rate0;
    if (i2c_smbus_write_byte_data(i2c_fd, MEAS_RATE0, 0x01) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write MEAS_RATE0 register");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    uint8_t command;
    if (i2c_smbus_write_byte_data(i2c_fd, COMMAND, 0x01) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write COMMAND register");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    FILE *csv_fd = fopen("heartrate.csv", "w");
    if (!csv_fd) {
        perror("Failed to open CSV file");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    while (running) {
        struct timeval tv;
        gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
        char timestamp[32];
        snprintf(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%ld.%06ld", tv.tv_sec, tv.tv_usec);

        uint16_t ps_data0, ps_data1;
        if (i2c_smbus_read_word_data(i2c_fd, PS_DATA0, &ps_data0) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading PS_DATA0: %d\n", i2c_smbus_get_errno(i2c_fd));
            continue;
        }
        if (i2c_smbus_read_word_data(i2c_fd, PS_DATA1, &ps_data1) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading PS_DATA1: %d\n", i2c_smbus_get_errno(i2c_fd));
            continue;
        }

        uint16_t proximity = (ps_data0 << 8) | ps_data1;
        uint32_t bpm = proximity / SAMPLE_INTERVAL + BPM_OFFSET;

        if (fprintf(csv_fd, "%s,%u\n", timestamp, bpm) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write to CSV file");
            close(i2c_fd);
            fclose(csv_fd);
            return 1;
        }

void handle_gpio_edge_fall(int gpio, int level, int tick) {

    }

#include <stdio.h>

#include <string.h>

#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x45
#define DISTANCE_RESULT_SIZE 16
#define TIMESTAMP_SIZE 20
#define TIMESTAMP_BUF_SIZE (DISTANCE_RESULT_SIZE + TIMESTAMP_SIZE + 1)

volatile int running = 1;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (running) {
        printf("Stopping...\n");
        pi_close();
        close(i2c_fd);
        close(log_file_fd);
        running = 0;
    }
}

int main() {
    struct timespec ts;
    char timestamp[TIMESTAMP_BUF_SIZE];
    char distance_result[DISTANCE_RESULT_SIZE];
    int i2c_fd;
    int log_file_fd;
    int pi_fd;
    int distance_result_read;
    int i2c_error;
    int log_file_error;
    int pi_error;

    // Initialize pigpio
    if (pi_init(NULL) < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up signal handler for SIGINT
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    // Open I2C bus 1
    i2c_fd = i2c_open(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("i2c_open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Open log file
    log_file_fd = open("distance_log.txt", O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
    if (log_file_fd < 0) {
        perror("open log file");
        return 1;
    }

    // Main loop
    while (running) {
        // Get current time
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        strftime(timestamp, TIMESTAMP_BUF_SIZE, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&ts));

        // Trigger measurement
        pi_write(pi_fd, 0x00, 0x01);

        // Wait 50 ms
        nanosleep((const struct timespec[]){{0, 50000000L}}, NULL);

        // Read distance result
        distance_result_read = pi_read(pi_fd, 0x00, DISTANCE_RESULT_SIZE);
        if (distance_result_read < 0) {
            i2c_error = pi_error;
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading distance result: %s\n", strerror(pi_error));
            continue;
        }

        // Read 16-bit distance result
        int distance_mm = (distance_result[0] << 8) | distance_result[1];
        if (distance_mm < 0 || distance_mm > 65535) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Invalid distance result: %d\n", distance_mm);
            continue;
        }

        // Log and print
        snprintf(distance_result, DISTANCE_RESULT_SIZE, "%d", distance_mm);
        snprintf(timestamp, TIMESTAMP_BUF_SIZE, "%s, %s", timestamp, distance_result);
        fprintf(log_file_fd, "%s\n", timestamp);
        printf("%s\n", timestamp);

        // Wait 200 ms
        nanosleep((const struct timespec[]){{0, 20000000L}}, NULL);
    }

    // Cleanup
    pi_close();
    close(i2c_fd);
    close(log_file_fd);

    return 0;
}

Use a 1 kOhm resistor in series on the echo line for protection, and note in a comment that the HC-SR04 operates at 5V while the Pi GPIO is only 3.3V tolerant.
