#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define PULSE_US 10000  // 10 microseconds
#define MAX_RANGE 38000  // 38 cm in microseconds
#define MAX_TIMEOUT 200000 // 200 ms in microseconds

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up GPIO 17 (trigger) and 18 (echo)
    if (gpioSetMode(17, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO 17 to output");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(18, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO 18 to input");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up echo rising and falling edge timeout
    if (gpioSetTimer(18, gpioRisingEdge, 0, MAX_TIMEOUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set echo rising edge timeout");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetTimer(18, gpioFallingEdge, 0, MAX_TIMEOUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set echo falling edge timeout");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;

    // Set up 1 kOhm resistor on echo line
    gpioSetPullUpDown(18, PI_OFF);

    // Set up 10 microsecond trigger pulse
    if (gpioWrite(17, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO 17 to high");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }
    usleep(PULSE_US);
    if (gpioWrite(17, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO 17 to low");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Wait for echo rising edge
        if (gpioWaitForEdge(18, PI_RISING) < 0) {
            perror("Echo rising edge timeout");
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        // Wait for echo falling edge
        if (gpioWaitForEdge(18, PI_FALLING) < 0) {
            perror("Echo falling edge timeout");
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        // Get pulse width in microseconds
        int pulse_us = gpioTick() - gpioTickAtLastEvent();

        // Check for invalid pulse duration
        if (pulse_us <= 0 || pulse_us > MAX_RANGE) {
            printf("Invalid pulse duration: %d\n", pulse_us);
            continue;
        }

        // Compute distance in cm
        double distance = (pulse_us * 0.0343) / 2.0;

        // Log reading with timestamp
        time_t now = time(NULL);
        struct tm *tm = localtime(&now);
        printf("%d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d %f cm\n", tm->tm_year + 1900, tm->tm_mon + 1, tm->tm_mday, tm->tm_hour, tm->tm_min, tm->tm_sec, distance);

        // Wait for 1 second
        usleep(1000000);
    }

    // Shutdown gracefully on SIGINT/SIGTERM
    signal(SIGINT, [](int) { gpioTerminate(); });
    signal(SIGTERM, [](int) { gpioTerminate(); });

    return 0;
}

        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the line to input mode
    err = gpiod_line_request_mode(line, GPIOD_MODE_INPUT);
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_mode");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the line to active-low
    err = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_FALLING);
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Open the buzzer line
    line_fd = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO18);
    if (line_fd < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_request_line");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }
    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip_fd, line_fd);
    if (!line) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the buzzer line to output mode
    err = gpiod_line_request_mode(line, GPIOD_MODE_OUTPUT);
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_mode");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Open the log file
    log_file = fopen("obstacle_log.txt", "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("fopen");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Initialize the buzzer to off
    err = gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0);
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        fclose(log_file);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up the timer for polling
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    ts.tv_sec += 0;
    ts.tv_nsec = 0;
    ts.tv_nsec += POLL_INTERVAL * 1000000; // 100 ms

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Read the sensor line
        err = gpiod_line_request_value(line, &buffer[0]);
        if (err < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_value");
            gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
            fclose(log_file);
            return 1;
        }

        // Check if the sensor line changed state
        if (buffer[0] == 0 && buffer[0] == 1) {
            // Log the state transition
            char timestamp[256];
            strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f", &ts);
            fprintf(log_file, "%s: Obstacle detected\n", timestamp);
        }

        // Set the buzzer line based on the sensor line state
        if (buffer[0] == 0) {
            err = gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0);
        } else {
            err = gpiod_line_set_value(line, 1);
        }
        if (err < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
            gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
            fclose(log_file);
            return 1;
        }

        // Update the timer
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        ts.tv_sec += 0;
        ts.tv_nsec = 0;
        ts.tv_nsec += POLL_INTERVAL * 1000000; // 100 ms

        // Check for SIGINT or SIGTERM
        if (signal(SIGINT, [](int sig) {
            gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
            fclose(log_file);
            return 0;
        }) == SIG_ERR) {
            perror("signal");
            return 1;
        }
        if (signal(SIGTERM, [](int sig) {
            gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
            fclose(log_file);
            return 0;
        }) == SIG_ERR) {
            perror("signal");
            return 1;
        }
    }

    // Graceful shutdown
    gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;
}

int i2c_fd;
int gpio_fd;
int distance_log_fd;
int model_id;
int system_mode_start;
int sysrange_start;
int result_interrupt_status;
int result_range_status;
int system_interrupt_clear;
int distance_log_created = 0;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
        i2c_fd = 0;
    }
    if (gpio_fd > 0) {
        close(gpio_fd);
        gpio_fd = 0;
    }
    if (distance_log_fd > 0) {
        close(distance_log_fd);
        distance_log_fd = 0;
    }
    printf("Graceful shutdown initiated.\n");
    exit(0);
}

void init_i2c() {
    if ((i2c_fd = i2c_open(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR)) < 0) {
        perror("i2c_open");
        exit(1);
    }
}

void init_gpio() {
    if ((gpio_fd = gpio_open()) < 0) {
        perror("gpio_open");
        exit(1);
    }
    if (gpio_set_mode(gpio_fd, PI_INPUT, 1) < 0) {
        perror("gpio_set_mode");
        exit(1);
    }
}

void init_sensor() {
    if ((model_id = i2c_read_byte(i2c_fd, MODEL_ID)) != 0xEA) {
        printf("Sensor not found. Exiting.\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    if (i2c_write_byte(i2c_fd, 0x00, 0x00) < 0) {
        perror("i2c_write_byte");
        exit(1);
    }
    usleep(200000); // 2 ms
    if (i2c_write_byte(i2c_fd, SYSTEM_MODE_START, 0x01) < 0) {
        perror("i2c_write_byte");
        exit(1);
    }
    if (i2c_read_byte(i2c_fd, SYSRANGE_START) & 0x01) {
        printf("Sensor not in continuous mode. Exiting.\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    if (gpio_set_pull_up(gpio_fd, 1) < 0) {
        perror("gpio_set_pull_up");
        exit(1);
    }
}

void poll_sensor() {
    int timeout = 0;
    while (timeout < TIMEOUT_MS) {
        if (i2c_read_byte(i2c_fd, RESULT_INTERRUPT_STATUS) & 0x01) {
            uint16_t distance_mm = i2c_read_word(i2c_fd, RESULT_RANGE_STATUS);
            char timestamp[20];
            struct tm *now = gmtime(&time(NULL));
            strftime(timestamp, 20, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", now);
            if (!distance_log_created) {
                if (fopen(DISTANCE_LOG_FILE, "w") == NULL) {
                    perror("fopen");
                    exit(1);
                }
                fprintf(distance_log_fd, "%s\n", LOG_HEADER);
                distance_log_created = 1;
            }
            fprintf(distance_log_fd, "%s,%d\n", timestamp, distance_mm);
            fflush(distance_log_fd);
            if (i2c_write_byte(i2c_fd, SYSTEM_INTERRUPT_CLEAR, 0x01) < 0) {
                perror("i2c_write_byte");
                exit(1);
            }
            timeout = 0;
        } else {
            usleep(POLL_INTERVAL_MS * 1000);
            timeout++;
        }
    }
}

void check_thresholds(uint16_t distance_mm) {
    if (distance_mm < DISTANCE_THRESHOLD_1) {
        printf("STOP\n");
    } else if (distance_mm < DISTANCE_THRESHOLD_2) {
        printf("APPROACH\n");
    } else if (distance_mm < DISTANCE_THRESHOLD_3) {
        printf("SLOW\n");
    } else {
        printf("CLEAR\n");
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    init_i2c();
    init_gpio();
    init_sensor();

    poll_sensor();

    gpio_close(gpio_fd);
    i2c_close(i2c_fd);
    fclose(distance_log_fd);

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define SENSOR_ID_1 1
#define SENSOR_ID_2 2
#define DEBOUNCE_MS 50
#define POLL_MS 10
#define LOG_FILE "proximity_log.txt"

void log_event(char* timestamp, int sensor_id, char* event_type) {
    FILE* log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(log_file, "%s,%d,%s\n", timestamp, sensor_id, event_type);
    fclose(log_file);
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("gpioInitialise failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(17, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode failed for GPIO 17");
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(27, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode failed for GPIO 27");
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    pid_t pid = fork();
    if (pid < 0) {
        perror("fork failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pid == 0) {
        while (1) {
            char timestamp[128];
            struct timespec ts;
            clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
            strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%03dZ", localtime(&ts.tv_sec));

            int sensor1 = gpioRead(17);
            int sensor2 = gpioRead(27);

            if (sensor1 != gpioRead(17)) {
                if (sensor1 == 0) {
                    log_event(timestamp, SENSOR_ID_1, "DETECTED");
                } else {
                    log_event(timestamp, SENSOR_ID_1, "CLEARED");
                }
            }

            if (sensor2 != gpioRead(27)) {
                if (sensor2 == 0) {
                    log_event(timestamp, SENSOR_ID_2, "DETECTED");
                } else {
                    log_event(timestamp, SENSOR_ID_2, "CLEARED");
                }
            }

            sleep(POLL_MS / 1000.0);
        }
    } else {
        while (1) {
            if (waitpid(pid, NULL, WNOHANG) > 0) {
                gpioTerminate();
                exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>

#define I2C_SLAVE 0x3 << 3
#define I2C_RESTART 0x1 << 3
#define I2C_WRITE 0x0 << 3
#define I2C_READ 0x1 << 3
#define I2C_STOP 0x2 << 3
#define I2C_ACK 0x0
#define I2C_NACK 0x1
#define I2C_MEAS_TRIGGER 0x01
#define I2C_MEAS_STATUS 0x06
#define I2C_DIST_HIGH 0x08
#define I2C_DIST_LOW 0x09

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_TIMEOUT 500000  // 50 ms in microseconds

typedef struct {
    char timestamp[26];
    int distance_mm;
} DistanceData;

void i2c_read_register(int fd, unsigned char reg, unsigned char *data, int len) {
    unsigned char buf[1];
    buf[0] = reg;
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, 0x49, I2C_WRITE | I2C_ACK) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
        return;
    }
    if (write(fd, buf, 1) != 1) {
        perror("write");
        return;
    }
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_READ, reg, len) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_READ");
        return;
    }
    if (read(fd, data, len) != len) {
        perror("read");
        return;
    }
}

void i2c_read_distance(int fd, unsigned char *distance_mm) {
    unsigned char dist_high, dist_low;
    i2c_read_register(fd, I2C_DIST_HIGH, &dist_high, 1);
    i2c_read_register(fd, I2C_DIST_LOW, &dist_low, 1);
    *distance_mm = (dist_high << 8) | dist_low;
}

int main() {
    int fd;
    struct timeval tv;
    DistanceData data;
    char timestamp[26];
    char csv_line[100];
    char csv_file[50] = "distance_log.csv";

    fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, 0x49, I2C_WRITE | I2C_ACK) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
        goto close;
    }

    while (1) {
        gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
        strftime(timestamp, 26, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&tv.tv_sec));
        snprintf(csv_line, sizeof(csv_line), "%s,%d", timestamp, 0);

        if (write(fd, &I2C_MEAS_TRIGGER, 1) != 1) {
            perror("write");
            continue;
        }

        tv.tv_sec = 0;
        tv.tv_usec = I2C_TIMEOUT;
        if (select(0, NULL, NULL, NULL, &tv) == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Timeout waiting for data-ready\n");
            continue;
        }

        if (read(fd, &data.distance_mm, sizeof(data.distance_mm)) != 1) {
            perror("read");
            continue;
        }

        snprintf(csv_line + strlen(timestamp), sizeof(csv_line) - strlen(timestamp), ",%d", data.distance_mm);
        if (write(fd, &I2C_MEAS_STATUS, 1) != 1) {
            perror("write");
            continue;
        }

        if (read(fd, &data.distance_mm, sizeof(data.distance_mm)) != 1) {
            perror("read");
            continue;
        }

        snprintf(csv_line + strlen(timestamp), sizeof(csv_line) - strlen(timestamp), ",%d", data.distance_mm);
        if (write(csv_file, csv_line, strlen(csv_line)) != strlen(csv_line)) {
            perror("write");
            continue;
        }

        if (close(fd) < 0) {
            perror("close");
            continue;
        }

        fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
        if (fd < 0) {
            perror("open");
            continue;
        }

        if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, 0x49, I2C_WRITE | I2C_ACK) < 0) {
            perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
            goto close;
        }
    }

close:
    if (close(fd) < 0) {
        perror("close");
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <string.h>

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x29
#define I2C_REG_ZONE_START 0x00
#define I2C_REG_ZONE_END 0x0F
#define I2C_REG_CONTROL 0x00
#define I2C_REG_CONTROL_ZONE_GRID 0x0F
#define I2C_REG_CONTROL_ZONE_GRID_8X8 0x08

#define I2C_ZONE_COUNT 64

int main() {
    int fd;
    struct iocb iocb;
    struct iocmt iocmt;
    char buffer[2];
    int zone_distance[I2C_ZONE_COUNT];
    int zone_index;

    if ((fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SLAVE");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    memset(&iocb, 0, sizeof(iocb));
    iocb.ioctlen = 2;
    iocb.ioctmp = buffer;

    memset(&iocmt, 0, sizeof(iocmt));
    iocmt.ioctmp = buffer;

    iocmt.ioctmp[0] = I2C_REG_ZONE_START;
    iocmt.ioctmp[1] = 0;
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SMBHCTL1, &iocmt) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SMBHCTL1");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    iocmt.ioctmp[0] = I2C_REG_ZONE_END;
    iocmt.ioctmp[1] = 0;
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SMBHCTL1, &iocmt) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SMBHCTL1");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    iocmt.ioctmp[0] = I2C_REG_CONTROL;
    iocmt.ioctmp[1] = I2C_REG_CONTROL_ZONE_GRID_8X8;
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SMBHCTL1, &iocmt) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl I2C_SMBHCTL1");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        for (zone_index = 0; zone_index < I2C_ZONE_COUNT; zone_index++) {
            iocmt.ioctmp[0] = I2C_REG_ZONE_START + zone_index;
            iocmt.ioctmp[1] = 0;
            if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SMBHCTL1, &iocmt) < 0) {
                perror("ioctl I2C_SMBHCTL1");
                close(fd);
                return 1;
            }
            zone_distance[zone_index] = (int)(buffer[0] << 8 | buffer[1]);
        }

        for (zone_index = 0; zone_index < I2C_ZONE_COUNT; zone_index++) {
            printf("Zone %d: %d mm\n", zone_index, zone_distance[zone_index]);
        }

        sleep(500);
    }

    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x29
#define REG_SOFT_RESET 0x7FFF
#define REG_START_Ranging 0x0009
#define REG_INT_STATUS 0x0046
#define REG_DISTANCE_H 0x0096
#define REG_DISTANCE_L 0x0097
#define DISTANCE_UNIT 1000  // mm

int main() {
    int i2c_fd;
    int soft_reset_ret;
    int start_ranging_ret;
    int int_status_ret;
    int distance_h_ret;
    int distance_l_ret;
    int distance_mm;
    char timestamp[24];
    struct timespec ts;

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise");
        return 1;
    }

    if ((i2c_fd = i2cOpen(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR)) < 0) {
        perror("i2cOpen");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if ((soft_reset_ret = i2cWrite(i2c_fd, 0x00, 1, REG_SOFT_RESET)) < 0) {
        perror("i2cWrite: Soft reset");
        i2cClose(i2c_fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (soft_reset_ret != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error writing to soft reset register: %d\n", soft_reset_ret);
        i2cClose(i2c_fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    usleep(10 * 1000); // 10 ms

    if ((start_ranging_ret = i2cWrite(i2c_fd, 0x00, 1, REG_START_Ranging)) < 0) {
        perror("i2cWrite: Start ranging");
        i2cClose(i2c_fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (start_ranging_ret != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error writing to start ranging register: %d\n", start_ranging_ret);
        i2cClose(i2c_fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        int_status_ret = i2cRead(i2c_fd, 0x00, 1, REG_INT_STATUS);
        if (int_status_ret < 0) {
            perror("i2cRead: Int status");
            i2cClose(i2c_fd);
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        if (int_status_ret == 0) {
            continue;
        }

        if ((distance_h_ret = i2cRead(i2c_fd, 0x00, 2, REG_DISTANCE_H)) < 0) {
            perror("i2cRead: Distance high");
            i2cClose(i2c_fd);
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        if (distance_h_ret == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading distance high register: %d\n", distance_h_ret);
            i2cClose(i2c_fd);
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        if ((distance_l_ret = i2cRead(i2c_fd, 0x00, 2, REG_DISTANCE_L)) < 0) {
            perror("i2cRead: Distance low");
            i2cClose(i2c_fd);
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        if (distance_l_ret == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading distance low register: %d\n", distance_l_ret);
            i2cClose(i2c_fd);
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        distance_mm = (distance_h_ret & 0xFF00) >> 8 | distance_l_ret & 0xFF;
        if (distance_mm < 0 || distance_mm > 65535) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Invalid distance value: %d\n", distance_mm);
            i2cClose(i2c_fd);
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&ts));
        fprintf(stderr, "%s.uuuuuu, Distance: %d mm\n", ts.tv_nsec / 1000000.0, distance_mm);

        usleep(500 * 1000); // 500 ms
    }

    return 0;
}

void signal_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (i2c_fd > 0) {
            i2cClose(i2c_fd);
        }
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(0);
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);
    return main();
}

Initialize pigpio and check for failure, configure trigger as output and echo as input, and measure distance by sending a 10 microsecond trigger pulse and timing the echo pulse width using a speed of sound of 343 m/s. Handle sensor timeouts -- echo stuck low or high for more than 50 ms -- by returning a sentinel error value and skipping that reading. Map valid distances from 2 to 400 cm to servo angle so that 2 cm maps to -90 degrees and 400 cm maps to +90 degrees. Log each reading with a timestamp to sensor_data.log, appending, once every 200 ms until interrupted. Install SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers for graceful shutdown that stop the servo (pulse 0), release resources, and call gpioTerminate() on all exit paths, including when the main loop exits due to a signal, ensuring no GPIO operations occur after termination. Use only valid BCM GPIO numbers on the Pi 4, and do not use GPIO 28.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define GPIO_TRIGGER 23
#define GPIO_ECHO 24
#define GPIO_SERVO 17
#define MAX_DISTANCE 400
#define MIN_DISTANCE 2
#define MAX_PULSE 2000
#define MIN_PULSE 1000
#define TIMEOUT 50000
#define LOG_FILE "sensor_data.log"
#define LOG_INTERVAL 200

int distance_to_angle(int distance) {
    if (distance < MIN_DISTANCE || distance > MAX_DISTANCE) {
        return -1;
    }
    return (int)((MAX_PULSE - MIN_PULSE) * (distance - MIN_DISTANCE) / (MAX_DISTANCE - MIN_DISTANCE)) + MIN_PULSE;
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    printf("Received signal %d, shutting down...\n", signum);
    gpioServo(0); // Stop servo
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise failed");
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_TRIGGER, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_ECHO, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_SERVO, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioServo(0) < 0) {
        perror("gpioServo failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("fopen failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    struct timeval start, end;
    gettimeofday(&start, NULL);

    while (1) {
        if (gettimeofday(&end, NULL) < 0) {
            perror("gettimeofday failed");
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        long elapsed = (end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) * 1000000 + (end.tv_usec - start.tv_usec);
        if (elapsed >= LOG_INTERVAL) {
            start = end;
            if (fprintf(log_file, "%ld,%d\n", elapsed, distance) < 0) {
                perror("fprintf failed");
                gpioTerminate();
                return 1;
            }
        }

        if (gpioWrite(GPIO_TRIGGER, 1) < 0) {
            perror("gpioWrite failed");
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        usleep(10);
        gpioWrite(GPIO_TRIGGER, 0);

        long start_time = 0;
        int distance = 0;
        int timeout = 0;

        gettimeofday(&start, NULL);
        while (timeout < TIMEOUT) {
            if (gpioRead(GPIO_ECHO) == 1) {
                gettimeofday(&end, NULL);
                long elapsed = (end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) * 1000000 + (end.tv_usec - start.tv_usec);
                distance = (int)(elapsed * 343000 / 2);
                timeout = 0;
            } else {
                gettimeofday(&end, NULL);
                timeout = end.tv_usec - start.tv_usec;
                if (timeout < 0) timeout += 1000000;
            }
            usleep(100);
        }

        if (timeout >= TIMEOUT) {
            fprintf(log_file, "%ld,ERROR\n", elapsed);
        } else {
            int angle = distance_to_angle(distance);
            if (angle < 0) {
                fprintf(log_file, "%ld,ERROR\n", elapsed);
            } else {
                gpioServo(angle);
                fprintf(log_file, "%ld,%d\n", elapsed, angle);
            }
        }
    }

    fclose(log_file);
    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

Send a 10 microsecond HIGH trigger pulse and use gpioSetAlertFuncEx for interrupt-driven measurement of the echo pulse width, computing distance using a speed of sound of 34300 cm/s divided by 2 for the round trip, and handling pigpio's 32-bit tick wraparound correctly. Valid readings range from 2 cm to 400 cm. Display the distance in centimeters on the console every 100 ms. Activate the buzzer continuously while the distance is less than 30 cm, and turn it off once the distance returns to 30 cm or above. Check pigpio initialization, GPIO mode configuration, and alert registration for errors, and detect and clearly report sensor-absent (timeout/no echo) and invalid reading (out-of-range) conditions. Perform a clean shutdown on SIGINT that turns off the buzzer and calls gpioTerminate().

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define TRIG_PIN 17
#define ECHO_PIN 27
#define BUZZER_PIN 22
#define SPEED_OF_SOUND 34300
#define DISTANCE_THRESHOLD 30
#define MEASUREMENT_INTERVAL 100000  // 100 ms

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up GPIO pins
    if (gpioSetMode(TRIG_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("TRIG_PIN mode failed");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(ECHO_PIN, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("ECHO_PIN mode failed");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(BUZZER_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("BUZZER_PIN mode failed");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up buzzer
    if (gpioSetPullUpDown(BUZZER_PIN, PI_OFF) < 0) {
        perror("BUZZER_PIN pull-up/down failed");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetBit(BUZZER_PIN, PI_ON) < 0) {
        perror("BUZZER_PIN on failed");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up interrupt handler
    gpioSetAlertFuncEx(ECHO_PIN, 0, (void (*)(void))measure_distance);

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        usleep(MEASUREMENT_INTERVAL);
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

void measure_distance(void *arg) {
    int tick_count = 0;
    int start_time = 0;
    int end_time = 0;
    int distance = 0;

    // Trigger the sensor
    gpioWrite(TRIG_PIN, 1);
    usleep(10000000);  // 10 microsecond trigger pulse
    gpioWrite(TRIG_PIN, 0);

    // Wait for echo pulse
    while (gpioRead(ECHO_PIN) == 0) {
        // Wait for echo pulse to start
        while (tick_count < 0) {
            tick_count = gpioGetTicks();
        }
        start_time = tick_count;

        // Wait for echo pulse to stop
        while (tick_count >= 0) {
            tick_count = gpioGetTicks();
        }
        end_time = tick_count;

        // Calculate distance
        distance = (SPEED_OF_SOUND / 2) * (end_time - start_time) / 1000000.0;

        // Check for valid reading
        if (distance >= 2 && distance <= 400) {
            printf("Distance: %.2f cm\n", distance);
        } else {
            printf("Invalid reading: %d cm\n", (int)distance);
        }

        // Check for sensor-absent condition
        if (distance == 0) {
            printf("Sensor absent\n");
        }

        // Check for buzzer condition
        if (distance < DISTANCE_THRESHOLD) {
            // Keep buzzer on
        } else {
            // Turn off buzzer
            gpioWrite(BUZZER_PIN, 0);
        }
    }
}

#include <pigpio.h>

#define MEASUREMENT_INTERVAL 200

        exit(1);

        gpioTerminate();
        exit(1);

        fprintf(stderr, "Set ECHO_GPIO alert callback failed: %s\n", gpioGetErrorString(gpioSetAlertFunc(ECHO_GPIO, pulse_callback)));
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(1);
    }

    struct timespec ts;
    char buffer[128];
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open log file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(1);
    }

    while (1) {

    gpioTerminate();
    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;

Run the trigger sequence: hold trigger low for 5 microseconds, pulse high for 10 microseconds, then low. Wait for the echo rising edge with a 30 ms timeout, then measure the echo pulse width with a 30 ms timeout, computing distance as (pulse_us * 0.0343) / 2.0 cm using a speed of sound of about 343 m/s at 20 degrees C. Reject readings outside 2-400 cm and log an error line instead. Handle sensor-absent (echo never rises) and timeout paths explicitly. Every second, log the reading with an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp to 'distance_log.txt', flushing the file after each write. Install a SIGINT handler that sets a volatile sig_atomic_t flag; on SIGINT release all libgpiod resources, close the log file, and exit cleanly. Use libgpiod bulk or per-line requests and do not leak resources on any exit path.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO18 18
#define TRIGGER_PULSE_US 10
#define ECHO_TIMEOUT_US 30000
#define MAX_DISTANCE 400
#define MIN_DISTANCE 2
#define SPEED_OF_SOUND 343.0

volatile sig_atomic_t sigint_received = 0;

int main() {
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_request *request;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct timespec start, end;
    int echo_rising_edge = 0;
    int echo_pulse_width_us = 0;
    int distance_cm = 0;
    char timestamp[128];
    FILE *log_file;

    // Open the gpiod chip
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod")) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Request trigger line as output
    if ((request = gpiod_chip_request_output(chip, GPIO17, 0)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_request_output");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Request echo line as input
    if ((line = gpiod_chip_request_input(chip, GPIO18, 0)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_request_input");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_request_close(request);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set trigger line to low
    if (gpiod_line_request_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_set_value");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_request_close(request);
        gpiod_line_close(line);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up edge detection for echo line
    edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_RISING);
    if (edge == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_request_close(request);
        gpiod_line_close(line);
        return 1;
    }

    // Open log file
    if ((log_file = fopen("distance_log.txt", "w")) == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_request_close(request);
        gpiod_line_close(line);
        return 1;
    }

    // Install SIGINT handler
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    while (!sigint_received) {
        // Wait for echo rising edge
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &start);
        while (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &end) == 0 || end.tv_nsec < start.tv_nsec + ECHO_TIMEOUT_US * 1000000) {
            if (gpiod_line_request_edge_status(edge) == GPIOD_EDGE_RISING) {
                echo_rising_edge = 1;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!echo_rising_edge) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Echo line did not rise within timeout\n");
            continue;
        }

        // Measure echo pulse width
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &start);
        while (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &end) == 0 || end.tv_nsec < start.tv_nsec + ECHO_TIMEOUT_US * 1000000) {
            if (gpiod_line_request_edge_status(edge) == GPIOD_EDGE_FALLING) {
                echo_rising_edge = 0;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!echo_rising_edge) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Echo line did not fall within timeout\n");
            continue;
        }

        echo_pulse_width_us = (end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) * 1000000 + (end.tv_nsec - start.tv_nsec) / 1000;
        distance_cm = (echo_pulse_width_us * SPEED_OF_SOUND) / 20000000.0;

        if (distance_cm < MIN_DISTANCE || distance_cm > MAX_DISTANCE) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Distance out of range: %d cm\n", distance_cm);
        } else {
            // Log distance
            snprintf(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%sZ", ctime(&time(NULL)));
            fprintf(log_file, "%s %d\n", timestamp, distance_cm);
            fflush(log_file);
        }

        // Reset trigger line
        if (gpiod_line_request_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_set_value");
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            gpiod_request_close(request);
            gpiod_line_close(line);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    // Close resources
    gpiod_line_request_close(edge);
    gpiod_request_close(request);
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    sigint_received = 1;
    // Release all resources
    gpiod_line_request_close(gpiod_line_request_edge(gpiod_line_request_input(gpiod_chip_request_input(chip, GPIO18, 0))));
    gpiod_request_close(gpiod_request_input(gpiod_chip_request_input(chip, GPIO18, 0)));
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    fclose(log_file);
    exit(0);
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define TRIG_GPIO 17
#define ECHO_GPIO 18
#define LOG_FILE "distance_log.txt"
#define TRIG_PIN 1
#define ECHO_PIN 0
#define MAX_PULSE_WIDTH 2500000 // 25 ms
#define MIN_PULSE_WIDTH 5800000 // 58 us

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(TRIG_GPIO, TRIG) < 0) {
        perror("TRIG mode failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(ECHO_GPIO, ECHO) < 0) {
        perror("ECHO mode failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetPullUpMode(TRIG_GPIO, PUD_OFF) < 0) {
        perror("TRIG pull-up mode failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetPullUpMode(ECHO_GPIO, PUD_OFF) < 0) {
        perror("ECHO pull-up mode failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetPullUpMode(ECHO_GPIO, PUD_DOWN) < 0) {
        perror("ECHO pull-down mode failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("log file open failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);

    int trig_isr_id = 0;
    gpioSetISRFuncEx(TRIG_GPIO, TRIG_EDGE_BOTH, NULL, NULL);
    gpioSetTimerFuncEx(1, 1000000, 0, NULL);

    while (1) {
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        fprintf(log_file, "%ld.%09ld %ld\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000, 0);
        fflush(log_file);

        gpioWrite(TRIG_GPIO, 1);
        usleep(1000000); // 1 ms delay
        gpioWrite(TRIG_GPIO, 0);

        int pulse_width = 0;
        while (pulse_width == 0) {
            clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
            pulse_width = (ts.tv_sec * 1000000) + (ts.tv_nsec / 1000);
            if (pulse_width > MAX_PULSE_WIDTH || pulse_width < MIN_PULSE_WIDTH) {
                fprintf(log_file, "%ld.%09ld %ld\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000, -1);
                fflush(log_file);
                break;
            }
        }

        if (pulse_width > 0) {
            double distance = (pulse_width * 343.0) / 2000000.0;
            fprintf(log_file, "%ld.%09ld %ld %f\n", ts.tv_sec, ts.tv_nsec / 1000, pulse_width, distance);
            fflush(log_file);
        }

        usleep(1000000); // 1 ms delay
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;
}

#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS_NUMBER
#define I2C_BUS_NUMBER 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x60
#define I2C_REG_0 0x22
#define I2C_REG_1 0x23
#define I2C_READ 0x3
#define I2C_WRITE 0x4
#define I2C_STOP 0x5
#define I2C_RESTART 0x6
#define I2C_SLAVE 0x71
#define I2C_RDWR 0x72

#define LOG_FILE "proximity_log.csv"
#define LOG_HEADER "timestamp,als_visible"

int i2c_fd = -1;
uint16_t als_visible;

void handle_i2c_error(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("I2C ioctl error");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void handle_log_error(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("Log file error");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (i2c_fd != -1) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "a") == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file for appending");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fclose(fopen(LOG_FILE, "w"));
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    if ((i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(errno);
    }

    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &als_visible) < 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(errno);
        }

        time_t rawtime;
        struct tm *timeinfo;
        char buffer[128];
        rawtime = time(NULL);
        timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
        strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);

        if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "a") == NULL) {
            handle_log_error(errno);
        }
        fprintf(fopen(LOG_FILE, "a"), "%s,%u\n", buffer, als_visible);
        fclose(fopen(LOG_FILE, "a"));

        sleep(5);
    }

    return 0;

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define GPIO_TRIGGER 23
#define GPIO_ECHO 24
#define GPIO_SERVO 18
#define SPEED_OF_SOUND 343000  // m/s
#define PULSE_WIDTH_MIN 500  // us for 0 degrees
#define PULSE_WIDTH_MAX 2500 // us for 180 degrees
#define PULSE_WIDTH_MIN_MAX 500  // min and max pulse widths for servo

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_TRIGGER, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_ECHO, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_SERVO, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioServo(GPIO_SERVO, PULSE_WIDTH_MIN) < 0) {
        perror("gpioServo");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        gpioWrite(GPIO_TRIGGER, 1);
        usleep(10);  // 10 us trigger pulse

        gpioSetMode(GPIO_ECHO, PI_OFF);
        gpioSetMode(GPIO_SERVO, PI_OFF);

        int start_us = gpioTick();
        int end_us = gpioTick();
        int duration_us = end_us - start_us;

        if (duration_us < 0) {
            duration_us = 0;
        }

        if (duration_us > 50000) {
            duration_us = -1;
        }

        if (duration_us == -1) {
            printf("Timeout\n");
            continue;
        }

        double distance = (duration_us * SPEED_OF_SOUND) / 1000000.0 / 2.0;

        int angle = 0;
        if (distance < 0.02) {
            angle = 0;
        } else if (distance > 2.0) {
            angle = 180;
        } else {
            angle = (int)((distance - 0.02) / (2.0 - 0.02) * (180 - 0));
        }

        if (angle < 0 || angle > 180) {
            angle = 0;
        }

        if (gpioServo(GPIO_SERVO, (int)((PULSE_WIDTH_MIN + PULSE_WIDTH_MAX) * angle / 180.0)) < 0) {
            perror("gpioServo");
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        printf("Distance: %.2f cm, Angle: %d degrees\n", distance, angle);

        usleep(100000);  // 100 ms delay
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_ADDR 0x68
#define WHO_AM_I 0x68
#define ACCEL_CONFIG 0x1C
#define GYRO_CONFIG 0x1B
#define SAMPLE_RATE_DIVIDER 0x19
#define ACCEL_XOUT 0x3B
#define ACCEL_YOUT 0x3D
#define ACCEL_ZOUT 0x3F
#define TEMP_OUT 0x40
#define GYRO_XOUT 0x43
#define GYRO_YOUT 0x45
#define GYRO_ZOUT 0x47

int i2c_fd;

void handle_i2c_error(int err) {
    printf("I2C error: %d\n", err);
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sensor_absent() {
    printf("Sensor not found. Exiting...\n");
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        printf("Received signal %d. Closing I2C and exiting...\n", signum);
        close(i2c_fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    printf("Program started. Logging accelerometer and gyroscope data...\n");

    // Set up I2C
    if (i2cOpen(1, I2C_ADDR, I2C_MASTER, 1000000) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }

    // Set up sensor configuration
    if (i2cWriteI2CBlockData(i2c_fd, ACCEL_CONFIG, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }
    if (i2cWriteI2CBlockData(i2c_fd, GYRO_CONFIG, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }
    if (i2cWriteI2CBlockData(i2c_fd, SAMPLE_RATE_DIVIDER, 0x07, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }

    // Reset and clear sleep bit
    if (i2cWriteI2CBlockData(i2c_fd, 0x6B, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }

    // Wait for sensor to stabilize
    sleep(1);

    // Clear sleep bit
    if (i2cWriteI2CBlockData(i2c_fd, 0x6B, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
    }

    // Read data block
    while (1) {
        if (i2cReadI2CBlockData(i2c_fd, ACCEL_XOUT, 0x3B, 0x3D, 0x3F, 0x40, 0x43, 0x45, 0x47) < 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(-1);
        }

        // Parse data
        int16_t accel_x = i2cReadInt16LE(i2c_fd, 0x3B);
        int16_t accel_y = i2cReadInt16LE(i2c_fd, 0x3D);
        int16_t accel_z = i2cReadInt16LE(i2c_fd, 0x3F);
        int16_t temp = i2cReadInt16LE(i2c_fd, 0x40);
        int16_t gyro_x = i2cReadInt16LE(i2c_fd, 0x43);
        int16_t gyro_y = i2cReadInt16LE(i2c_fd, 0x45);
        int16_t gyro_z = i2cReadInt16LE(i2c_fd, 0x47);

        // Print data
        printf("%d %d %d %d %d %d %d %d\n", accel_x, accel_y, accel_z, temp, gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z, 0);

        // Sleep for 100 ms
        usleep(100000);
    }

    return 0;
}

int i2cReadInt16LE(int fd, uint8_t reg) {
    uint8_t data[2];
    if (i2cReadI2CByteData(fd, reg, data[0]) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    if (i2cReadI2CByteData(fd, reg + 1, data[1]) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return (data[0] << 8) | data[1];
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ that uses the Linux I2C character device interface via /dev/i2c-1 to read ambient and object temperatures from a Melexis MLX90614ESF-BAA infrared temperature sensor at its default address 0x5A, for a contactless food safety monitoring system. Read ambient temperature from register 0x06 and object temperature from register 0x07 every 5 seconds. Log each timestamped reading to a comma-separated file named 'temperature_log.csv'. Handle I2C initialisation failures, sensor-absent scenarios (read errors), and file I/O errors gracefully rather than terminating unexpectedly. Handle SIGINT for clean resource release, closing both the I2C file descriptor and the log file before the process exits.

</think>
```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_DEVICE "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x5A
#define TEMP_REG_AMBIENT 0x06
#define TEMP_REG_OBJECT 0x07
#define LOG_FILE "temperature_log.csv"
#define LOG_INTERVAL 5

int i2c_fd = -1;
int log_fd = -1;

void i2c_init() {
    if ((i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEVICE, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        close(i2c_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_read_temp(int reg) {
    char buf[2];
    if (read(i2c_fd, buf, 2) != 2) {
        perror("Failed to read I2C register");
        close(i2c_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    return buf[0] << 8 | buf[1];
}

void log_temperature(double ambient, double object) {
    char line[100];
    snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%f,%f\n", ambient, object);
    if (write(log_fd, line, strlen(line)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to log file");
        close(log_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void handle_i2c_error() {
    if (i2c_fd != -1) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_log_error() {
    if (log_fd != -1) {
        close(log_fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    handle_i2c_error();
    handle_log_error();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    i2c_init();

    log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (log_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        handle_log_error();
    }

    while (1) {
        double ambient = i2c_read_temp(TEMP_REG_AMBIENT);
        double object = i2c_read_temp(TEMP_REG_OBJECT);

        log_temperature(ambient, object);

        sleep(LOG_INTERVAL);
    }

    return 0;
}

#define I2C_BUS 1

#define CRC8_POLYNOMIAL 0x31
#define CRC8_INIT 0xFF

#define SHT40_TEMP_MSB 0x02
#define SHT40_TEMP_LSB 0x03
#define SHT40_HUMID_MSB 0x04
#define SHT40_HUMID_LSB 0x05

#define SHT40_TEMP_OFFSET -45
#define SHT40_HUMID_OFFSET 0

#define SHT40_LOG_FILE "sht40_log.txt"
#define SHT40_LOG_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %f %d.%02d°C %d.%02d%%\n"

void crc8(uint8_t *data, int len) {
    uint8_t crc = CRC8_INIT;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= data[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            if (crc & 0x01) {
                crc = (crc >> 1) ^ CRC8_POLYNOMIAL;
            } else {
                crc >>= 1;
            }
        }
    }
    data[len] = crc;
}

    char buffer[256];
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    time_t rawtime;
    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), SHT40_LOG_FORMAT, timeinfo);
    fprintf(stderr, "%s", buffer);
    fprintf(stderr, "%d.%02d°C %d.%02d%%\n", (int)(temp + 0.5), (int)(humidity / 100.0 + 0.5), temp, humidity);
    fflush(stderr);

    if (close(fd) < 0) {

}

#define CMD_MEAS 0x362F
#define CRC_POLY 0x31
#define CRC_INIT 0xFF
#define SCALE_P 240
#define SCALE_T 200
#define OFFSET_T -45

typedef struct {
    uint8_t pressure_msb;
    uint8_t pressure_lsb;
    uint8_t temp_msb;
    uint8_t temp_lsb;
    uint8_t crc1;
    uint8_t crc2;
} SensorData;

static void cleanup() {
    if (fd != -1) {
        close(fd);
    }
    if (fp != -1) {
        fclose(fp);
    }
}

static void handle_error(const char *msg) {
    fprintf(stderr, "%s: %s\n", msg, strerror(errno));
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

static void sigint_handler(int sig) {
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

    sa.sa_handler = sigint_handler;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    if (fd == -1) {
        handle_error("Failed to open I2C device");
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {

        }

        data.pressure_lsb = buffer[1];

            handle_error("CRC mismatch for temperature");
        }

    return 0;

static uint8_t crc8(uint8_t data[], uint8_t len, uint8_t poly, uint8_t init) {
    uint8_t crc = init;
    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= data[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            if (crc & 0x80) {
                crc = (crc << 1) ^ poly;
            } else {
                crc <<= 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return crc;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B that uses the pigpio library to read temperature from an Analog Devices TMP05 digital temperature sensor connected to GPIO4 (physical pin 7). The TMP05 outputs a PWM-style signal where the ratio of high-time to total-cycle-time encodes the temperature; measure the high pulse width (TH) and total cycle width (TL) via busy-wait polling with microsecond-level timing, using gpioTick() for timestamps. Convert the reading to degrees Celsius using Temperature = 4215 - (2143 * TH / TL). Log each valid reading with an ISO-8601 timestamp to 'temperature_log.txt' in append mode, sampling once every 5 seconds. Check pigpio initialisation and file open results; detect sensor-absent or stuck-line conditions via a 50 ms timeout on each edge wait; guard against division by zero if TL is zero; flag readings outside the valid range -40 to +150 °C as errors; and after 3 consecutive failures, log a 'SENSOR MALFUNCTION' entry to the log file. Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM for clean shutdown, closing the file and releasing pigpio.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define TMP05_PIN 4
#define LOG_FILE "temperature_log.txt"
#define LOG_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f"
#define MAX_READINGS 3
#define MAX_LOG_ENTRIES 1000

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio initialisation failed");
        return 1;
    }

    FILE *logFile = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!logFile) {
        perror("failed to open log file");
        return 1;
    }

    struct timespec ts;
    int TH, TL, temp;
    int consecutiveFailures = 0;
    int lastError = 0;

    signal(SIGINT, [](int sig) {
        if (logFile) {
            fclose(logFile);
        }
        gpioTerminate();
        return 0;
    });
    signal(SIGTERM, [](int sig) {
        if (logFile) {
            fclose(logFile);
        }
        gpioTerminate();
        return 0;
    });

    while (1) {
        if (gpioEdgeWait(TMP05_PIN,_EDGE_RISING, 50000000, &ts)) {
            if (ts.tv_sec < 0) {
                consecutiveFailures++;
                if (consecutiveFailures >= MAX_READINGS) {
                    fprintf(logFile, "%s SENSOR MALFUNCTION\n", ctime(&ts.tv_sec));
                    consecutiveFailures = 0;
                }
                continue;
            }

            TH = gpioTick() - ts.tv_nsec / 1000000;
            TL = gpioTick() - ts.tv_sec * 1000000;
            if (TL == 0) {
                fprintf(logFile, "%s DIVISION BY ZERO\n", ctime(&ts.tv_sec));
                lastError = 1;
                continue;
            }

            temp = 4215 - (2143 * TH / TL);
            if (temp < -40 || temp > 150) {
                fprintf(logFile, "%s OUT OF RANGE\n", ctime(&ts.tv_sec));
                lastError = 1;
                continue;
            }

            fprintf(logFile, "[%s] %d\n", ctime(&ts.tv_sec), temp);
            consecutiveFailures = 0;
            lastError = 0;
        } else {
            if (consecutiveFailures < MAX_READINGS) {
                fprintf(logFile, "%s TIMEOUT\n", ctime(&ts.tv_sec));
                consecutiveFailures++;
            }
        }

        if (consecutiveFailures < MAX_READINGS && lastError == 0) {
            nanosleep((const struct timespec[]){{0, 500000000}}, NULL);
        }
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

#define CRC8_POLYNOMIAL 0x31
#define CRC8_INIT 0xFF

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS

typedef struct {
    uint32_t timestamp;
    double pressure;
    double temperature;
} AirflowData;

void i2c_read(int fd, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    ssize_t n;
    n = read(fd, buf, len);
    if (n < 0) {
        perror("read");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_write(int fd, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    ssize_t n;
    n = write(fd, buf, len);
    if (n < 0) {
        perror("write");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_ioctl(int fd, uint8_t *cmd, int len) {
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    i2c_write(fd, cmd, len);
}

void i2c_read_response(int fd, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    i2c_read(fd, buf, len);
    // CRC-8 check
    uint8_t crc = CRC8(buf, len - 1);
    if (crc != buf[len - 1]) {
        fprintf(stderr, "CRC-8 check failed\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

uint8_t CRC8(const uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    uint8_t crc = CRC8_INIT;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc = crc ^ buf[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
            if (crc & 0x80) {
                crc = (crc << 1) ^ CRC8_POLYNOMIAL;
            } else {
                crc = (crc << 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return crc;
}

void handle_sensor_absent(int signum) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Sensor absent\n");
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_bus_error(int signum) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Bus error\n");
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    switch (signum) {
        case SIGINT:
            fprintf(stderr, "Graceful shutdown\n");
            exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
        case SIGTERM:
            fprintf(stderr, "Graceful shutdown\n");
            exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
        default:
            break;
    }
}

int main() {
    AirflowData data;
    int fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    uint8_t cmd[2] = {CMD_CONTINUOUS, 0};
    i2c_ioctl(fd, cmd, 2);

    while (1) {
        uint8_t buf[10];
        i2c_read_response(fd, buf, 10);

        data.timestamp = time(NULL);
        data.pressure = (buf[0] << 5) + (buf[1] & 0x7F) * 0.0625;
        data.temperature = (buf[2] << 4) + (buf[3] & 0x0F) * 0.0625 - 40;

        fprintf(stderr, "Timestamp: %ld, Pressure: %.2f Pa, Temperature: %.2f°C\n", data.timestamp, data.pressure, data.temperature);

        char *csv = malloc(100);
        sprintf(csv, "%ld,%f,%f\n", data.timestamp, data.pressure, data.temperature);
        FILE *fp = fopen("airflow.csv", "a");
        if (fp == NULL) {
            perror("fopen");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        fputs(csv, fp);
        fclose(fp);

        sleep(1);
    }

    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

Configure the Configuration Register (pointer 0x02), setting bit 12 to enable a combined temperature-and-humidity measurement at 14-bit resolution. To read a sample, write the temperature register pointer 0x00 to the sensor, wait at least 20 ms for the 14-bit conversion (the DRDYn pin is not connected, so rely on this fixed delay), then read 4 bytes — 2 bytes temperature followed by 2 bytes humidity — in a single I2C read transaction. Convert the raw 16-bit values using Temperature (°C) = (raw / 65536.0) * 165.0 - 40.0 and Humidity (%RH) = (raw / 65536.0) * 100.0. Check the return value of every open(), ioctl(), read(), and write() call, and handle the sensor-absent path where the device file cannot be opened or the sensor fails to acknowledge. Log readings to the console every 5 seconds in the format "Temperature: XX.XX C, Humidity: XX.XX %"; on a read failure, print an error to stderr and continue the loop without exiting. Install a signal handler for SIGINT and SIGTERM so the program closes the I2C file descriptor and exits cleanly.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x40
#define CONFIG_REG 0x02
#define TEMP_REG 0x00
#define TEMP_SIZE 2
#define HUMID_REG 0x01
#define HUMID_SIZE 2

#define TEMP_OFFSET -40.0
#define HUMID_OFFSET 0.0
#define TEMP_SCALE 165.0
#define HUMID_SCALE 100.0

#define I2C_TIMEOUT 500  // 500 ms

int i2c_fd;

void handle_error(int err, const char *msg) {
    if (err < 0) {
        perror(msg);
    }
}

void handle_read_error(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error reading from sensor: %s\n", strerror(err));
    }
}

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (i2c_fd >= 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_msg msg[1];
    struct i2c_rdma_request request;
    uint8_t buffer[8];
    int temp_raw[2], hum_raw[2];
    double temp, hum;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        handle_error(i2c_fd, "open");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    request.msgs = msg;
    request.nmsgs = 1;
    request.offset = 0;
    request.iovlen = 1;
    request.iovbuf = buffer;

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        handle_error(ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE), "ioctl");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    msg[0].len = 8;

    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &request) < 0) {
            handle_read_error(ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR));
            continue;
        }

        memcpy(temp_raw, buffer, TEMP_SIZE);
        memcpy(hum_raw, buffer + TEMP_SIZE, HUMID_SIZE);

        temp = (temp_raw[0] / 65536.0) * TEMP_SCALE + TEMP_OFFSET;
        hum = (hum_raw[0] / 65536.0) * HUMID_SCALE + HUMID_OFFSET;

        printf("Temperature: %.2f C, Humidity: %.2f %\n", temp, hum);

        usleep(I2C_TIMEOUT * 1000); // Wait 500 ms
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B that uses the pigpio library (never wiringPi) to periodically read pressure values from a Melexis MLX90833 absolute pressure sensor connected over I2C bus 1 at its manufacturer-default 7-bit address 0x60. Log each reading to the console every 500 ms with a timestamp. Check all pigpio initialization and I2C read/write operations, handle sensor-absent and bus-error paths, and ensure clean resource release on all exit paths via SIGINT/SIGTERM signal handling.
raw:
<think>

</think>
```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x60
#define MLX90833_REG_PRES 0x00
#define MLX90833_REG_CONTROL 0x0F

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int sensor_present;
    int i2c_error;
} SensorData;

void handle_sensor_absent(SensorData *sensor) {
    printf("Sensor not present. Exiting...\n");
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_i2c_error(SensorData *sensor) {
    printf("I2C error. Exiting...\n");
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (sensor->fd > 0) {
        piLock();
        piUnlock();
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    SensorData sensor;
    sensor.fd = 0;
    sensor.i2c_fd = 0;
    sensor.sensor_present = 0;
    sensor.i2c_error = 0;

    // Initialize pigpio
    if (piInitialise() < 0) {
        printf("pigpio initialization failed\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Set up I2C
    sensor.i2c_fd = i2cOpen(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, 100000);
    if (sensor.i2c_fd < 0) {
        sensor.i2c_error = 1;
        handle_i2c_error(&sensor);
    }

    // Set up sensor
    sensor.fd = piOpen("/dev/spi0.3");
    if (sensor.fd < 0) {
        printf("SPI device open failed\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    // Set up I2C control register
    i2cWriteByte(sensor.i2c_fd, MLX90833_REG_CONTROL, 0x00);
    i2cWriteByte(sensor.i2c_fd, MLX90833_REG_CONTROL, 0x01);

    // Set up SPI control register
    spiSetClockMode(sensor.fd, SPI_CLOCK_MODE0);
    spiSetBitOrder(sensor.fd, SPI_BITORDER_MSBFIRST);
    spiSetSpeed(sensor.fd, 1000000);

    // Set up callback for SIGINT/SIGTERM
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    while (1) {
        if (!sensor.sensor_present) {
            handle_sensor_absent(&sensor);
        }

        if (sensor.i2c_error) {
            handle_i2c_error(&sensor);
        }

        // Read pressure
        uint8_t buffer[2];
        i2cReadByte(sensor.i2c_fd, MLX90833_REG_PRES, buffer, 2);
        int pressure = (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
        printf("Timestamp: %ld, Pressure: %d\n", (long)time(NULL), pressure);

        // Sleep for 500 ms
        usleep(500000);
    }

    // Clean up
    if (sensor.fd > 0) {
        piClose(sensor.fd);
    }
    if (sensor.i2c_fd > 0) {
        i2cClose(sensor.i2c_fd);
    }
    piTerminate();

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x60
#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_SLAVE 0x3

#define PRESSURE_MSB 0xAA
#define PRESSURE_LSB 0xAB
#define PRESSURE_SCALE 0.1

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int error;
} I2CContext;

static void i2c_open(I2CContext *ctx) {
    ctx->fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (ctx->fd < 0) {
        ctx->error = errno;
        perror("open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

static void i2c_close(I2CContext *ctx) {
    if (ctx->fd >= 0) {
        close(ctx->fd);
    }
}

static ssize_t i2c_write(I2CContext *ctx, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    if (ctx->fd < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return write(ctx->fd, buf, size);
}

static ssize_t i2c_read(I2CContext *ctx, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    if (ctx->fd < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return read(ctx->fd, buf, size);
}

static ssize_t i2c_ioctl(I2CContext *ctx, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {
    if (ctx->fd < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    return ioctl(ctx->fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
}

static void i2c_read_pressure(I2CContext *ctx, uint16_t *pressure) {
    uint8_t buf[2];
    if (i2c_read(ctx, buf, 2) < 0) {
        ctx->error = errno;
        perror("read");
        return;
    }
    *pressure = (buf[0] << 8) | buf[1];
}

static void handle_i2c_error(I2CContext *ctx) {
    if (ctx->error) {
        fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", ctx->error);
        ctx->error = 0;
    }
}

static void handle_sensor_absent(I2CContext *ctx) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Sensor absent\n");
    ctx->error = 0;
}

static void handle_i2c_failure(I2CContext *ctx) {
    handle_i2c_error(ctx);
    handle_sensor_absent(ctx);
}

static void handle_signal(int signum) {
    handle_i2c_failure(&ctx);
    i2c_close(&ctx);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    I2CContext ctx;
    ctx.error = 0;

    i2c_open(&ctx);

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    while (1) {
        handle_i2c_failure(&ctx);

        if (ctx.error) {
            continue;
        }

        uint16_t pressure;
        i2c_ioctl(&ctx, &ctx, 0);
        i2c_read_pressure(&ctx, &pressure);

        double pressure_kpa = (pressure * PRESSURE_SCALE);
        printf("%.2f kPa\n", pressure_kpa);

        sleep(1);
    }

    return 0;
}

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x25
#define I2C_SDA 2
#define I2C_SCL 3
#define I2C_COMMAND 0x362F
#define I2C_TIMEOUT 45
#define I2C_READ_BYTES 9
#define I2C_CRC_POLYNOMIAL 0x31
#define I2C_CRC_INIT 0xFF
#define I2C_PRESSURE 0
#define I2C_TEMPERATURE 1
#define I2C_CRC 2

#define I2C_LOG_FILE "pressure_log.txt"

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (close(i2c_fd) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_msg i2c_msg;
    struct i2c_rdma_request i2c_rdma_request;
    struct i2c_client_data i2c_client_data;
    int i2c_fd;
    int i2c_error;
    uint8_t i2c_buffer[I2C_READ_BYTES];
    uint8_t crc8;
    uint32_t pressure, temperature;
    char timestamp[20];
    FILE *log_file;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    i2c_client_data.bus = I2C_BUS;
    i2c_client_data.address = I2C_ADDR;
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, i2c_client_data.address) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    log_file = fopen(I2C_LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    while (1) {
        i2c_msg.addr = i2c_client_data.address;
        i2c_msg.flags = I2C_M_RD;
        i2c_msg.data[0] = I2C_COMMAND;
        i2c_rdma_request.request = I2C_RDMA_READ;
        i2c_rdma_request.offset = 0;
        i2c_rdma_request.length = I2C_READ_BYTES;

        i2c_error = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &i2c_msg, &i2c_rdma_request);
        if (i2c_error < 0) {
            perror("Failed to send I2C command");
            continue;
        }

        if (read(i2c_fd, i2c_buffer, I2C_READ_BYTES) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            continue;
        }

        crc8 = i2c_buffer[I2C_CRC_INIT];
        for (int i = I2C_PRESSURE; i < I2C_CRC; i++) {
            crc8 ^= i2c_buffer[i];
        }

        if (crc8 != i2c_buffer[I2C_CRC]) {
            fprintf(stderr, "CRC error\n");
            continue;
        }

        pressure = i2c_buffer[I2C_PRESSURE] << 8 | i2c_buffer[I2C_TEMPERATURE];
        temperature = i2c_buffer[I2C_TEMPERATURE] << 8 | i2c_buffer[I2C_CRC];

        sprintf(timestamp, "%s", ctime(&time(NULL)));
        fprintf(log_file, "%s,%d,%d\n", timestamp, pressure / 60, temperature / 200);

        sleep(I2C_TIMEOUT);
    }

    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;
}

#define CRC_INIT 0xFF

#define PRESSURE_OFFSET 0x8000
#define PRESSURE_SCALE 60.0

typedef struct {
    uint32_t timestamp;
    float pressure;
} SensorData;

        perror("write");
        close(fd);
        return 1;

    if (flock(fd, LOCK_EX) == -1) {
        perror("flock");
        close(fd);
        return 1;

        perror("pigpio_init");
        close(fd);

                close(fd);
                pigpio_close();

            sprintf(&buffer[strlen(buffer)], "%ld,%f\n", data.timestamp, data.pressure);

                perror("write");
                close(fd);
                pigpio_close();
                return 1;
            }
            free(buffer);
            buffer = NULL;

            perror("pigpio_i2c_write");
            close(fd);
            pigpio_close();
            return 1;

        usleep(8000); // Wait 8 ms

        if (pigpio_i2c_read(fd, 3) == -1) {

            pigpio_close();

            perror("pigpio_i2c_read");
            close(fd);
            pigpio_close();
            return 1;

        if (data.crc != CRC8(data.bytes[0], data.bytes[1])) {

        data.pressure = (data.bytes[0] << 8) | data.bytes[1];

            perror("fprintf");
            close(fd);
            pigpio_close();
            return 1;
        }
    }

    close(fd);
    pigpio_close();
    return 0;
}

uint8_t CRC8(uint8_t data[], int len) {
    uint8_t crc = CRC_INIT;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc = crc ^ data[i];

                crc = (crc << 1) ^ CRC_POLY;
            } else {
                crc <<= 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return crc;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ that uses the pigpio library for GPIO timing to read pressure data from a Melexis MLX90824 SENT pressure sensor connected to GPIO 4 (BCM), for an automotive brake pressure monitoring system. Implement the SENT protocol with a tick time of 3 us: a synchronization pulse of 56 ticks, followed by a status nibble, 3 data nibbles, and a checksum nibble, where a valid nibble pulse width is 12 to 271 ticks (36-813 us). Validate the checksum as the sum of the nibbles modulo 16, and convert the 12-bit raw value to pressure using the linear transfer function raw * scale + offset. Detect sensor-absent (timeout) and bus-error (checksum or pulse-width) conditions, logging errors to stderr without crashing. Log each pressure reading with a timestamp to pressure_log.txt in the format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, Pressure: XXXX.XX Pa". Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM for clean resource release.
raw:
<think>

</think>
```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define GPIO_PIN 4
#define TICKS_PER_US 1000000
#define SYNC_TICKS 56
#define NIBBLE_SIZE 4
#define MAX_NIBBLES 4
#define CHECKSUM_SIZE 1
#define MAX_NIBBLES_SIZE (MAX_NIBBLES * NIBBLE_SIZE + CHECKSUM_SIZE)
#define MAX_RAW_VALUE 4095
#define SCALE 0.0001
#define OFFSET 0.0

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int gpio;
    int tick_time;
    int sync_ticks;
    int sync_ticks_start;
    int sync_ticks_end;
    int status_nibble;
    int data_nibbles[MAX_NIBBLES_SIZE];
    int checksum_nibble;
    int raw_value;
    int checksum;
    int error;
    struct timeval start_time;
    struct timeval end_time;
} PressureSensor;

void handle_error(PressureSensor *sensor) {
    if (sensor->error == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor-absent (timeout) detected.\n");
        sensor->error = 1;
    } else if (sensor->error == 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Checksum or pulse-width invalid.\n");
        sensor->error = 2;
    }
}

void handle_timeout(PressureSensor *sensor) {
    if (sensor->error == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor-absent (timeout) detected.\n");
        sensor->error = 1;
    }
}

void handle_signal(int signum, siginfo_t *siginfo, void *context) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        handle_error(sensor);
        close(sensor->fd);
        close(sensor->gpio);
        pi_event_clear(pi_event_id(sensor->gpio));
        pi_set_mode(sensor->gpio, PI_OFF);
        pi_close(sensor->gpio);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    PressureSensor sensor;
    sensor.fd = 0;
    sensor.gpio = GPIO_PIN;
    sensor.tick_time = TICKS_PER_US;
    sensor.sync_ticks = SYNC_TICKS;
    sensor.sync_ticks_start = 0;
    sensor.sync_ticks_end = 0;
    sensor.status_nibble = 0;
    sensor.checksum_nibble = 0;
    sensor.raw_value = 0;
    sensor.checksum = 0;
    sensor.error = 0;
    sensor.start_time.tv_sec = 0;
    sensor.start_time.tv_usec = 0;
    sensor.end_time.tv_sec = 0;
    sensor.end_time.tv_usec = 0;

    if (pi_init(NULL) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "pigpio init failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (pi_set_mode(sensor.gpio, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Setting GPIO mode failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (pi_set_pull_up_down(sensor.gpio, PI_PUD_OFF) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Setting GPIO pull-up/down failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (pi_event_callback_add(sensor.gpio, handle_timeout, NULL) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Setting event callback failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (pi_event_callback_add(sensor.gpio, handle_signal, NULL) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Setting signal callback failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    sensor.fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (sensor.fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Opening I2C bus failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (ioctl(sensor.fd, I2C_SLAVE, 0x2A) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Setting I2C slave address failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    sensor.gpio = pi_gpio_open("/dev/gpiod/major/gpio/4");
    if (sensor.gpio < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Opening GPIO device failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (pi_event_callback_add(sensor.gpio, handle_timeout, NULL) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Setting event callback failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (pi_event_callback_add(sensor.gpio, handle_signal, NULL) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Setting signal callback failed.\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    pi_set_mode(sensor.gpio, PI_OUTPUT);
    pi_set_pull_up_down(sensor.gpio, PI_PUD_OFF);

    pi_event_clear(pi_event_id(sensor.gpio));

    while (1) {
        sensor.sync_ticks_start = pi_tick();
        pi_write(sensor.gpio, 0x00, 1);
        pi_event_clear(pi_event_id(sensor.gpio));
        pi_set_mode(sensor.gpio, PI_OUTPUT);
        pi_set_pull_up_down(sensor.gpio, PI_PUD_OFF);
        pi_event_callback_add(sensor.gpio, handle_timeout, NULL);
        pi_event_callback_add(sensor.gpio, handle_signal, NULL);
        pi_write(sensor.gpio, 1, 1);
        pi_event_clear(pi_event_id(sensor.gpio));
        pi_set_mode(sensor.gpio, PI_INPUT);
        pi_set_pull_up_down(sensor.gpio, PI_PUD_OFF);

        sensor.sync_ticks_end = pi_tick();
        sensor.tick_time = (sensor.sync_ticks_end - sensor.sync_ticks_start) / TICKS_PER_US;
        if (sensor.tick_time < 36 || sensor.tick_time > 813) {
            handle_error(&sensor);
        } else {
            sensor.status_nibble = (pi_read(sensor.gpio, 0, 1)[0] & 0x0F);
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NIBBLES; i++) {
                sensor.data_nibbles[i] = (pi_read(sensor.gpio, 0, 1)[0] & 0x0F);
            }
            sensor.checksum_nibble = (pi_read(sensor.gpio, 0, 1)[0] & 0x0F);
            sensor.raw_value = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NIBBLES; i++) {
                sensor.raw_value = (sensor.raw_value << 4) | sensor.data_nibbles[i];
            }
            sensor.checksum = (sensor.status_nibble + sensor.data_nibbles[0] + sensor.data_nibbles[1] + sensor.data_nibbles[2] + sensor.data_nibbles[3] + sensor.checksum_nibble) % 16;
            if (sensor.checksum != sensor.checksum_nibble) {
                handle_error(&sensor);
            } else {
                sensor.pressure = (sensor.raw_value * SCALE) + OFFSET;
                gettimeofday(&sensor.end_time, NULL);
                fprintf(stderr, "Pressure: %.2f Pa\n", sensor.pressure);
                fprintf(stderr, "Timestamp: %s\n", ctime(&sensor.end_time.tv_sec * 1000 + sensor.end_time.tv_usec / 1000));
                fprintf(stderr, "Raw value: %d\n", sensor.raw_value);
                fprintf(stderr, "Checksum: %d\n", sensor.checksum);
                fprintf(stderr, "Tick time: %.2f us\n", sensor.tick_time * 1000);
                fprintf(stderr, "\n");
            }
        }
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi Zero W that uses the pigpio library to monitor a greenhouse with an Adafruit TMP117 High Precision Temperature Sensor over I2C bus 1 at the default address 0x48. On startup, verify the sensor's device ID register reads 0x0117. Read the temperature register 0x00 (2 bytes, signed, LSB = 0.0078125 °C) every 60 seconds and append each reading as a 4-byte little-endian float to a binary file named greenhouse_temps.dat. Handle I2C communication failures gracefully without crashing, and ensure clean resource release — the I2C handle, the file stream, and the pigpio library — on all exit paths via SIGINT/SIGTERM signal handling.

#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x48
