#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x44
#define MEASUREMENT_COMMAND 0xFD
#define TEMPERATURE_BYTES 2
#define HUMIDITY_BYTES 2
#define CRC_BYTES 1
#define CRC_POLYNOMIAL 0x31
#define CRC_INIT 0xFF

#define TEMPERATURE_OFFSET -45
#define TEMPERATURE_SCALE 175.0
#define HUMIDITY_OFFSET -6
#define HUMIDITY_SCALE 125.0

#define LOG_FILE "environmental_data.txt"

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (pigpio_is_initialized()) {
        pigpio_close();
    }
    if (close(i2c_fd) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close I2C handle");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (fclose(log_file) != 0) {
        perror("Failed to close log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    if (pigpio_init(&pi) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to initialize pigpio");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pigpio_set_mode(pi, PI_MODE_I2C) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C mode");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pigpio_i2c_open(pi, I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    i2c_fd = pigpio_i2c_open(pi, I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR);

    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pigpio_i2c_write(pi, i2c_fd, &MEASUREMENT_COMMAND, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write measurement command");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pigpio_i2c_waitpi(pi, i2c_fd, 0, 8.5) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to wait for measurement completion");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pigpio_i2c_read(pi, i2c_fd, &raw_temp, TEMPERATURE_BYTES) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read temperature");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pigpio_i2c_read(pi, i2c_fd, &raw_hum, HUMIDITY_BYTES) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read humidity");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pigpio_i2c_read(pi, i2c_fd, &crc_temp, CRC_BYTES) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read temperature CRC");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pigpio_i2c_read(pi, i2c_fd, &crc_hum, CRC_BYTES) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read humidity CRC");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (crc_temp != CRC_INIT) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Invalid temperature CRC\n");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (crc_hum != CRC_INIT) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Invalid humidity CRC\n");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    temperature = (float) (TEMPERATURE_OFFSET + raw_temp * TEMPERATURE_SCALE / 65535.0);
    humidity = (float) (HUMIDITY_OFFSET + raw_hum * HUMIDITY_SCALE / 65535.0);

    char log_line[128];
    struct timeval tv;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    snprintf(log_line, sizeof(log_line), "%ld %f %f\n", (long)tv.tv_sec, temperature, humidity);

    if (fopen(log_file, "a") < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file for append");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (fputs(log_line, log_file) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to log file");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (fflush(log_file) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to flush log file");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (fclose(log_file) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close log file");
        pigpio_close();
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    sleep(5);

    return 0;
}

    uint16_t data[BUFFER_SIZE];
    uint32_t next;
    uint32_t count;
} TemperatureBuffer;

static TemperatureBuffer buffer;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    // Flush buffer to file
    write_buffer_to_file();
    // Release resources
    pi_close();
    pi_gpios_unexport(I2C_BUS);
    exit(0);
}

void write_buffer_to_file() {
    FILE *fp = fopen(LOG_FILE, "wb");
    if (!fp) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < buffer.count; i++) {
        fwrite(&buffer.data[i], sizeof(uint16_t), 1, fp);
    }
    fclose(fp);
}

void init_i2c() {
    if (pi_i2c_open(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, 400000, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(1);
    }
}

void init_buffer() {
    buffer.next = 0;
    buffer.count = 0;
}

void read_temp() {

        perror("Failed to read temperature");
        return;
    }
    buffer.data[buffer.next] = (buffer.data[buffer.next] << 8) | (buffer.data[buffer.next - 1] >> 8);
    buffer.data[buffer.next] = buffer.data[buffer.next] * 0.0078125;
    buffer.count = (buffer.count + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
}

void run_loop() {
    init_i2c();
    init_buffer();
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);
    while (1) {
        read_temp();
        usleep(SAMPLE_INTERVAL * 1000000);
    }

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x49
#define I2C_READ_BYTES 4
#define I2C_FLOW_OFFSET 0
#define I2C_TEMP_OFFSET 2
#define I2C_FLOW_MASK 0x3FFF
#define I2C_TEMP_MASK 0x0FFF

#define SLPM_OFFSET -0.1
#define SLPM_DIVISOR 0.8
#define SLPM_MULTIPLE 25.0
#define CELSIUS_OFFSET -40.0
#define CELSIUS_DIVISOR 0.8
#define CELSIUS_MULTIPLE 80.0

#define LOG_FILE "flow_log.txt"

void handle_error(int error, const char *message) {
    fprintf(stderr, "Error: %s\n", message);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    close(i2c_open(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, I2C_READ));
    close(log_file);
    pigpio_stop();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    int log_file = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (log_file < 0) {
        handle_error(-1, "Failed to open log file");
    }

    if (signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint) == SIG_ERR) {
        handle_error(-1, "Failed to set SIGINT handler");
    }

    if (pigpio_init() < 0) {
        handle_error(-1, "Failed to initialize pigpio");
    }

    int i2c_fd = i2c_open(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, I2C_READ);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        handle_error(-1, "Failed to open I2C handle");
    }

    if (i2c_read(i2c_fd, I2C_READ_BYTES, NULL) < 0) {
        handle_error(-1, "Failed to read I2C data");
    }

    uint16_t flow_raw = (i2c_data[0] << 14) | (i2c_data[1] & 0x3FFF);
    uint16_t temp_raw = (i2c_data[2] << 10) | (i2c_data[3] & 0x0FFF);

    double slpm = ((flow_raw / 16384.0) + SLPM_OFFSET) / SLPM_DIVISOR * SLPM_MULTIPLE;
    double celsius = ((temp_raw / 4096.0) + CELSIUS_OFFSET) / CELSIUS_DIVISOR * CELSIUS_MULTIPLE;

    fprintf(log_file, "Timestamp: %s, Flow Rate: %.2f SLPM, Temperature: %.2f°C\n", 
        ctime(&time(NULL)), slpm, celsius);

    while (1) {
        if (i2c_read(i2c_fd, I2C_READ_BYTES, NULL) < 0) {
            fprintf(log_file, "Error reading I2C data: %s\n", strerror(errno));
            i2c_read(i2c_fd, I2C_READ_BYTES, NULL);
        }

        flow_raw = (i2c_data[0] << 14) | (i2c_data[1] & 0x3FFF);
        temp_raw = (i2c_data[2] << 10) | (i2c_data[3] & 0x0FFF);

        slpm = ((flow_raw / 16384.0) + SLPM_OFFSET) / SLPM_DIVISOR * SLPM_MULTIPLE;
        celsius = ((temp_raw / 4096.0) + CELSIUS_OFFSET) / CELSIUS_DIVISOR * CELSIUS_MULTIPLE;

        fprintf(log_file, "Timestamp: %s, Flow Rate: %.2f SLPM, Temperature: %.2f°C\n", 
            ctime(&time(NULL)), slpm, celsius);

        sleep(1);
    }

    close(i2c_open(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, I2C_READ));
    close(log_file);
    pigpio_stop();
    return 0;
}

Validate each CRC-8 (polynomial 0x31, initial value 0xFF), then convert the raw values using temperature = -45 + 175 * raw / 65535 and humidity = 100 * raw / 65535. Log readings every 5 seconds to sht31d_data.log with ISO-8601 timestamps in the format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS,temperature,humidity". Check pigpio initialization, the I2C bus open, the file open, the I2C write, the I2C read, and CRC validation, retrying a failed I2C transaction up to 3 times; on persistent sensor failure, log the error with a timestamp and continue running. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define SHT31_ADDR 0x44
#define I2C_TIMEOUT 100
#define MAX_RETRIES 3
#define CRC_POLY 0x31
#define CRC_INIT 0xFF

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int retries;
    int last_error;
} SHT31;

void sht31_init(SHT31 *sht31) {
    sht31->fd = -1;
    sht31->retries = 0;
    sht31->last_error = 0;
}

void sht31_open(SHT31 *sht31) {
    sht31->fd = i2c_open(I2C_BUS, SHT31_ADDR);
    if (sht31->fd < 0) {
        sht31->last_error = -1;
        sht31->retries = 0;
    }
}

void sht31_close(SHT31 *sht31) {
    if (sht31->fd >= 0) {
        i2c_close(sht31->fd);
        sht31->fd = -1;
    }
}

void sht31_write(SHT31 *sht31, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    if (sht31->fd < 0) {
        sht31->last_error = -1;
        sht31->retries = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (i2c_write(sht31->fd, buf, len) < 0) {
        sht31->last_error = -1;
        sht31->retries = 0;
        return;
    }
    sht31->retries = 0;
}

void sht31_read(SHT31 *sht31, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    if (sht31->fd < 0) {
        sht31->last_error = -1;
        sht31->retries = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (i2c_read(sht31->fd, buf, len) < 0) {
        sht31->last_error = -1;
        sht31->retries = 0;
        return;
    }
    sht31->retries = 0;
}

void sht31_validate_crc(SHT31 *sht31, uint8_t *buf, int len) {
    if (sht31->fd < 0) {
        sht31->last_error = -1;
        sht31->retries = 0;
        return;
    }
    uint8_t crc = CRC_INIT;
    for (int i = 0; i < len - 1; i++) {
        crc = crc ^ buf[i];
        crc = crc << 8 | crc >> 8;
        crc ^= CRC_POLY;
    }
    if (crc != buf[len - 1]) {
        sht31->last_error = -1;
        sht31->retries = 0;
    } else {
        sht31->retries = 0;
    }
}

void sht31_read_measurement(SHT31 *sht31, uint8_t *buf) {
    uint8_t cmd[] = {0x2C, 0x06};
    sht31_write(sht31, cmd, 2);
    sht31_read(sht31, buf, 6);
    sht31_validate_crc(sht31, buf, 6);
}

void sht31_convert(SHT31 *sht31, uint8_t *buf, float *temperature, float *humidity) {
    if (sht31->last_error != 0) {
        return;
    }
    *temperature = -45 + 175 * (buf[0] << 8 | buf[1]) / 65535;
    *humidity = 100 * (buf[2] << 8 | buf[3]) / 65535;
}

void sht31_log(SHT31 *sht31, float temperature, float humidity) {
    char timestamp[26];
    struct tm *now;
    time_t t = time(NULL);
    now = localtime(&t);
    strftime(timestamp, 26, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", now);
    FILE *log = fopen("sht31d_data.log", "a");
    if (log) {
        fprintf(log, "%s,%f,%f\n", timestamp, temperature, humidity);
        fclose(log);
    }
}

void sht31_handle_error(SHT31 *sht31) {
    if (sht31->last_error == -1) {
        char error[128];
        switch (sht31->last_error) {
            case -1:
                sprintf(error, "I2C open failed");
                break;
            case -2:
                sprintf(error, "I2C write failed");
                break;
            case -3:
                sprintf(error, "I2C read failed");
                break;
            case -4:
                sprintf(error, "CRC validation failed");
                break;
            default:
                sprintf(error, "Unknown I2C error");
                break;
        }
        printf("Error: %s\n", error);
    }
}

void sht31_run(SHT31 *sht31) {
    sht31_open(sht31);
    if (sht31->last_error == -1) {
        printf("I2C open failed\n");
        return;
    }
    while (1) {
        uint8_t buf[6];
        sht31_read_measurement(sht31, buf);
        if (sht31->last_error == -1) {
            sht31_handle_error(sht31);
            continue;
        }
        float temperature, humidity;
        sht31_convert(sht31, buf, &temperature, &humidity);
        sht31_log(sht31, temperature, humidity);
        sleep(5);
    }
}

void sht31_cleanup(SHT31 *sht31) {
    sht31_close(sht31);
}

void sht31_signal_handler(int sig) {
    sht31_cleanup(&sht31);
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    SHT31 sht31;
    sht31_init(&sht31);
    signal(SIGINT, sht31_signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, sht31_signal_handler);
    sht31_run(&sht31);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR1 0x64
#define I2C_ADDR2 0x65
#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS

#define I2C_READ_BLOCK_SIZE 16
#define I2C_WRITE_BLOCK_SIZE 16

#define I2C_DEVICE_ID 0x2A
#define I2C_RED 0x64
#define I2C_GREEN 0x66
#define I2C_BLUE 0x68

#define MAX_CYCLES 10
#define LOG_FILE "cct_log.csv"

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    printf("Received SIGINT signal, exiting...\n");
    pi_write(pi_null, 0);
    pi_stop();
    exit(0);
}

int i2c_read_block(int fd, uint8_t *buf, uint8_t addr, int size) {
    int len = 0;
    ssize_t n;
    uint8_t *ptr = buf;

    while (len < size) {
        n = i2c_smbus_read_i2c_block_data(fd, addr, size - len, ptr + len);
        if (n < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading I2C block: %d\n", n);
            return -1;
        }
        len += n;
    }
    return len;
}

int i2c_write_block(int fd, uint8_t *buf, uint8_t addr, int size) {
    int len = 0;
    ssize_t n;
    uint8_t *ptr = buf;

    while (len < size) {
        n = i2c_smbus_write_i2c_block_data(fd, addr, size - len, ptr + len);
        if (n < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error writing I2C block: %d\n", n);
            return -1;
        }
        len += n;
    }
    return len;
}

int main() {
    int fd;
    uint8_t red_buf[I2C_READ_BLOCK_SIZE];
    uint8_t green_buf[I2C_READ_BLOCK_SIZE];
    uint8_t blue_buf[I2C_READ_BLOCK_SIZE];
    uint32_t red_val, green_val, blue_val;
    uint32_t cct1, cct2;
    double avg_cct;
    char timestamp[20];
    FILE *log_file;

    if (access(LOG_FILE, F_OK) == -1) {
        if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "w") == NULL) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error creating log file: %s\n", LOG_FILE);
            return 1;
        }
        fprintf(log_file, "Timestamp,Average_CCT\n");
    }

    fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error opening I2C device: %s\n", I2C_DEV);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR1) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error setting I2C slave address: %d\n", I2C_ADDR1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR2) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error setting I2C slave address: %d\n", I2C_ADDR2);
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    while (1) {
        if (i2c_read_block(fd, red_buf, I2C_RED, I2C_READ_BLOCK_SIZE) < 0) {
            continue;
        }
        red_val = (red_buf[0] << 8) | red_buf[1];
        if (i2c_read_block(fd, green_buf, I2C_GREEN, I2C_READ_BLOCK_SIZE) < 0) {
            continue;
        }
        green_val = (green_buf[0] << 8) | green_buf[1];
        if (i2c_read_block(fd, blue_buf, I2C_BLUE, I2C_READ_BLOCK_SIZE) < 0) {
            continue;
        }
        blue_val = (blue_buf[0] << 8) | blue_buf[1];

        if (red_val == 0 && green_val == 0 && blue_val == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Sensor at address 0x%02X is not responding\n", I2C_ADDR1);
            continue;
        }

        if (red_val == 0 && green_val == 0 && blue_val == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Sensor at address 0x%02X is not responding\n", I2C_ADDR2);
            continue;
        }

        if (red_val == I2C_DEVICE_ID && green_val == I2C_DEVICE_ID && blue_val == I2C_DEVICE_ID) {
            cct1 = mccamy_cct(red_val, green_val, blue_val);
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "Invalid device ID at address 0x%02X\n", I2C_ADDR1);
            continue;
        }

        if (red_val == I2C_DEVICE_ID && green_val == I2C_DEVICE_ID && blue_val == I2C_DEVICE_ID) {
            cct2 = mccamy_cct(red_val, green_val, blue_val);
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "Invalid device ID at address 0x%02X\n", I2C_ADDR2);
            continue;
        }

        sprintf(timestamp, "%ld", (long)time(NULL));
        avg_cct = (cct1 + cct2) / 2.0;
        fprintf(log_file, "%s,%f\n", timestamp, avg_cct);

        sleep(1);
    }

    fclose(log_file);
    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

double mccamy_cct(uint32_t r, uint32_t g, uint32_t b) {
    double x = (r + g) / (r + g + b);
    double y = b / (r + g + b);
    double z = 1 - x - y;
    double cct = 44900 * (1 - 1 / (x * y * z)) / (x * y * z - 1);
    return cct;
}

Every 1 second, read the 2-byte temperature register 0x00 and convert it using the LM75B's signed 9-bit format (0.5 °C resolution, using bits D9-D1, with D0 always 0). Store each reading in a 60-element circular buffer in memory and compute the running average. Control a cooling fan on GPIO 18 (BCM numbering) with hysteresis: turn it on when the running average exceeds 28.0 °C and off when it falls below 26.0 °C. Check pigpio initialization, the I2C bus open, every I2C read, and every GPIO write; log failures to stderr and retry on the next cycle without crashing. Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM for graceful shutdown: stop the fan, close the I2C handle, and terminate pigpio cleanly.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x48
#define TEMPERATURE_REGISTER 0x00
#define FAN_GPIO 18
#define FAN_ON_THRESHOLD 28.0
#define FAN_OFF_THRESHOLD 26.0
#define BUFFER_SIZE 60
#define BUFFER_OFFSET 0
#define BUFFER_SIZE_BYTES (BUFFER_SIZE * 2)

typedef struct {
    int8_t buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    float running_average;
} TemperatureData;

static TemperatureData temperature_data;

static int i2c_fd;
static int gpio_fd;

static void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        printf("Received signal %d, shutting down...\n", signum);
        pi_set_mode(gpio_fd, PI_OFF);
        pi_close(gpio_fd);
        pi_close(i2c_fd);
        exit(0);
    }
}

static void init_temperature_sensor() {
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (pi_i2c_open(i2c_fd, I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

static void init_gpio() {
    if (gpio_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (pi_set_mode(gpio_fd, PI_OUTPUT)) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

static void read_temperature() {
    if (pi_i2c_read_i2c_multi(i2c_fd, 1, &temperature_data.buffer[BUFFER_OFFSET], 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read temperature");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    temperature_data.running_average = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
        temperature_data.running_average += temperature_data.buffer[i];
    }
    temperature_data.running_average /= BUFFER_SIZE;
}

static void update_running_average() {
    temperature_data.running_average = 0.0;
    for (int i = 1; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
        temperature_data.running_average += temperature_data.buffer[i];
    }
    temperature_data.running_average += temperature_data.buffer[0];
    temperature_data.running_average /= BUFFER_SIZE;
}

static void control_fan() {
    if (temperature_data.running_average > FAN_ON_THRESHOLD) {
        if (pi_set_mode(gpio_fd, PI_ON)) {
            perror("Failed to set GPIO mode");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    } else if (temperature_data.running_average < FAN_OFF_THRESHOLD) {
        if (pi_set_mode(gpio_fd, PI_OFF)) {
            perror("Failed to set GPIO mode");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    pi_init();
    init_temperature_sensor();
    init_gpio();

    temperature_data.running_average = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
        temperature_data.buffer[i] = 0;
    }

    while (1) {
        read_temperature();
        update_running_average();
        control_fan();

        for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
            printf("%.1f\n", temperature_data.buffer[i]);
        }
        printf("Running average: %.1f\n", temperature_data.running_average);
        printf("Fan state: %s\n", pi_get_mode(gpio_fd) ? "ON" : "OFF");

        usleep(1000000); // 1 second delay
    }

    pi_close(i2c_fd);
    pi_close(gpio_fd);
    pi_exit();
    return 0;
}

void crc8_validate(uint8_t *data, int len) {
    uint8_t crc = CRC8_INIT;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        crc ^= data[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {

            } else {

            }
        }
    }
    if (crc != data[len]) {
        fprintf(stderr, "CRC mismatch\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi Zero W that uses the Linux I2C ioctl interface (no wiringPi) to read temperature from a Sensirion STS40 sensor at address 0x44 on /dev/i2c-1, for a simulated greenhouse environment monitor. Open the I2C adapter with open() and set the slave address via ioctl(I2C_SLAVE). Send the single-shot high-repeatability measurement command bytes 0x2C, 0xE0 with a combined write() call, wait 10 ms for conversion, then read 3 bytes (2 data bytes plus 1 CRC8 byte) with read(). Validate the CRC8 using the Sensirion polynomial 0x31, then convert the raw ticks to Celsius using T = -45 + 175 * raw / 65535.0. Log each reading with an ISO-8601 timestamp to temperature_log.txt every 5 seconds in an infinite loop. Handle every error path — open, ioctl, write, read, CRC mismatch, and file open — with a descriptive stderr message and continue looping rather than exiting. Install a SIGINT/SIGTERM handler for clean shutdown that closes the file descriptor and the log file.

#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x25
#define CMD_MEAS 0x3615
#define CRC_POLY 0x31
#define CRC_INIT 0xFF
#define PRESSURE_BYTES 2
#define TEMPERATURE_BYTES 2
#define SCALE_BYTES 3
#define LOG_FILE "hvac_pressure_log.txt"
#define LOG_FMT "%ld,%ld,%ld\n"

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int i2c_fd;
    int i2c_err;
    int crc_err;
    int temp_err;
    int scale_err;
} SensorData;

void handle_error(const char *msg) {
    perror(msg);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    if (SensorData.i2c_fd > 0) {
        i2c_close(SensorData.i2c_fd);
    }
    if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "a") == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fclose(fopen(LOG_FILE, "w"));
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    SensorData data;
    data.fd = 0;
    data.i2c_fd = 0;
    data.i2c_err = 0;
    data.crc_err = 0;
    data.temp_err = 0;
    data.scale_err = 0;

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        handle_error("gpioInitialise failed");
    }

    if (i2cOpen(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, &data.i2c_fd) < 0) {
        handle_error("i2cOpen failed");
    }

    if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "w") == NULL) {
        handle_error("Failed to open log file");
    }

    while (1) {
        struct timeval tv;
        gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
        long timestamp = tv.tv_sec * 1000 + tv.tv_usec / 1000;

        if (i2cWrite(data.i2c_fd, CMD_MEAS, 1) < 0) {
            data.i2c_err = 1;
        } else {
            data.i2c_err = 0;
        }

        if (data.i2c_err || data.crc_err || data.temp_err || data.scale_err) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading sensor: %d\n", data.i2c_err + data.crc_err * 2 + data.temp_err * 4 + data.scale_err * 8);
            continue;
        }

        if (i2cRead(data.i2c_fd, 9, &data.data) < 0) {
            data.i2c_err = 1;
        } else {
            data.i2c_err = 0;
        }

        if (data.i2c_err) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading sensor: i2cRead failed\n");
            continue;
        }

        uint8_t crc = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            crc = crc ^ data.data[i];
            crc = crc << 1;
            if (crc & 0x80) {
                crc ^= CRC_POLY;
            }
        }

        if (crc != data.data[8]) {
            data.crc_err = 1;
        } else {
            data.crc_err = 0;
        }

        if (data.crc_err) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading sensor: CRC error\n");
            continue;
        }

        double pressure = 0.0;
        double temperature = 0.0;

        for (int i = 0; i < PRESSURE_BYTES; i++) {
            pressure += data.data[i + 9] * (1 << (8 - i));
        }
        pressure /= 256.0;

        for (int i = 0; i < TEMPERATURE_BYTES; i++) {
            temperature += data.data[i + 9 + PRESSURE_BYTES] * (1 << (8 - i));
        }
        temperature /= 256.0;
        temperature /= 200.0;

        fprintf(fopen(LOG_FILE, "a"), LOG_FMT, timestamp, (int)(pressure * 1000), (int)(temperature * 1000));

        sleep(1000);
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

#define CRC8_INIT 0xFF

        reading.timestamp = time(NULL);
        reading.co2 = co2;
        reading.temperature = temperature;
        reading.humidity = humidity;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&buffer.mutex);
        if (buffer.count < BUFFER_SIZE) {
            buffer.buffer[buffer.head] = reading;
            buffer.head = (buffer.head + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
            buffer.count++;
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "Buffer full, skipping reading\n");
        }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&buffer.mutex);
        if (pigpio_delay(5000) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Failed to wait 5 seconds: %d\n", i2c_fd);
            return NULL;
        }
    }
    pigpio_i2c_close(i2c_fd);
    pigpio_close(0);
    return NULL;
}

void *crc8(void *arg) {
    char *data = (char *)arg;
    uint8_t crc = CRC8_INIT;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (crc & 1 ? CRC8_POLYNOMIAL : 0);
        crc ^= data[i];
    }
    return (uint8_t)(crc & 0xFF);
}

void *error_logger(void *arg) {
    FILE *file = fopen(ERROR_LOG, "a");
    if (!file) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open error log file: %s\n", ERROR_LOG);
        return NULL;
    }
    while (running) {
        char *line = (char *)malloc(256);
        snprintf(line, 256, "%s: %s\n", ctime(&time(NULL)), strerror(errno));
        fprintf(file, "%s", line);
        free(line);
    }
    fclose(file);
    return NULL;
}

void *sigint_handler(int signum) {
    running = 0;
    return NULL;
}

int main() {
    pthread_t logging_thread, sensor_thread, error_logger_thread;
    pthread_mutex_init(&buffer.mutex, NULL);
    signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);
    pthread_create(&logging_thread, NULL, logging_thread, NULL);
    pthread_create(&sensor_thread, NULL, sensor_loop, NULL);
    pthread_create(&error_logger_thread, NULL, error_logger, NULL);
    pthread_join(logging_thread, NULL);
    pthread_join(sensor_thread, NULL);
    pthread_join(error_logger_thread, NULL);
    return 0;
}

Every 5 seconds, read the 12-bit two's-complement value, left-justified in two bytes, from register 0x00, shift it right by 4 bits, and multiply by 0.0625 to get degrees Celsius. Log each reading to a timestamped CSV file named temperature_log.csv in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS,XX.XX'. If a read fails, log the error to stderr and skip the CSV entry. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/i2c.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x48
#define TMP102_REG 0x00
#define TMP102_TEMP_SHIFT 4
#define TMP102_TEMP_MULT 0.0625

int i2c_fd;
int temp_read_result;
uint16_t temp_value;
char timestamp[20];

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    pi_stop();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    if (signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("Failed to set SIGINT handler");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pi_init() < 0) {
        perror("Failed to initialize pigpio");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((i2c_fd = i2c_open(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (i2c_ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &i2c_ioctl_cmd_t{I2C_RDWR, I2C_I2C_SLAVE, 0}) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    while (1) {
        temp_read_result = i2c_read_byte(i2c_fd, TMP102_REG);
        if (temp_read_result < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read temperature: %s\n", strerror(errno));
            continue;
        }

        temp_value = (uint16_t) temp_read_result;
        temp_value >>= TMP102_TEMP_SHIFT;
        temp_value *= TMP102_TEMP_MULT;

        strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&time(NULL)));

        printf("%s,%f\n", timestamp, temp_value);

        if (fopen("temperature_log.csv", "a") == NULL) {
            perror("Failed to open temperature log file for append");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (fprintf(fopen("temperature_log.csv", "a"), "%s,%f\n", timestamp, temp_value) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to write to temperature log file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (fclose(fopen("temperature_log.csv", "a")) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to close temperature log file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        usleep(500000); // 5 seconds
    }

    return 0;
}

    spi_transfer.mode = SPI_MODE;
    spi_transfer.bits_per_word = SPI_BITS;

    int spi_cs_fd = spi_ce0_fd;
    int spi_ce1_fd = spi_ce1_fd;

    if (spi_cs_fd > 0) {
        gpio_set_value(spi_cs_fd, 0);
    }

    if (spi_ce1_fd > 0) {
        gpio_set_value(spi_ce1_fd, 1);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_ce0_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MOSI, &buffer[0]) < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(errno);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_ce0_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MISO, &buffer[1]) < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(errno);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_ce0_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_SCLK, &buffer[2]) < 0) {
        handle_spi_error(errno);
    }

    if (spi_cs_fd > 0) {
        gpio_set_value(spi_cs_fd, 1);
    }

    if (spi_ce1_fd > 0) {
        gpio_set_value(spi_ce1_fd, 0);
    }

    int temp = (buffer[1] << 4) | (buffer[0] & 0x0F);
    int open_circuit = (buffer[1] >> 4) & 0x1;

    if (open_circuit) {
        fprintf(stderr, "MAX6675 open-circuit detected\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    pid_state.current_temp = (temp * 0.0625) - 0.5;
}

void update_pid() {
    pid_state.error = pid_state.target_temp - pid_state.current_temp;
    pid_state.derivative = pid_state.error - pid_state.previous_error;
    pid_state.integral += pid_state.error * (double)PID_SAMPLE_TIME;

    pid_state.previous_error = pid_state.error;

    pid_state.output = PID_KP * pid_state.error + PID_KI * pid_state.integral + PID_KD * pid_state.derivative;
}

void set_relay_output() {
    int output = pid_state.output * 255;
    if (output < 0) {
        output = 0;
    } else if (output > 255) {
        output = 255;
    }

    int value = output;
    if (gpio_set_value(relay_fd, value) < 0) {
        handle_gpio_error(errno);
    }
}

void log_data() {
    time_t rawtime;
    struct tm * timeinfo;
    char buffer[128];

    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);

    snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S,%f", timeinfo->tm_year + 1900, timeinfo->tm_mon + 1, timeinfo->tm_mday, timeinfo->tm_hour, timeinfo->tm_min, timeinfo->tm_sec, (double)timeinfo->tm_monday.tv_usec / 1000000.0);

    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open log file\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fprintf(log_file, "%s,%f,%f\n", buffer, pid_state.current_temp, pid_state.output);
    fclose(log_file);
}

void cleanup() {
    if (spi_ce0_fd > 0) {
        close(spi_ce0_fd);
    }

    if (spi_ce1_fd > 0) {
        close(spi_ce1_fd);
    }

    if (spi_cs_fd > 0) {
        close(spi_cs_fd);
    }

    if (relay_fd > 0) {
        gpio_free_fd(relay_fd);
    }

    if (max6675_fd > 0) {
        close(max6675_fd);
    }

    if (spi_fd > 0) {
        close(spi_fd);
    }

    if (pid_state.pid > 0) {
        kill(pid_state.pid, SIGKILL);
    }
}

void run() {
    FILE *profile_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "r");
    if (profile_file == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open profile file\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    char line[128];
    int profile_count = 0;
    double profile_times[100];
    double profile_temps[100];

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), profile_file)) {
        if (sscanf(line, "%lf,%lf", &profile_times[profile_count], &profile_temps[profile_count]) == 2) {
            profile_count++;
        }
    }

    fclose(profile_file);

    pid_state.pid = fork();
    if (pid_state.pid < 0) {
        handle_gpio_error(errno);
    }

    if (pid_state.pid == 0) {
        execlp("python", "python", "reflow.py", "profile.txt", (char *)NULL);
        handle_gpio_error(errno);
    }

    pid_state.previous_error = 0;

    while (1) {
        read_max6675();
        update_pid();
        set_relay_output();
        log_data();

        sleep(PID_SAMPLE_TIME);
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    init_spi();
    init_gpio();

    FILE *profile_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "r");
    if (profile_file == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open profile file\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    char line[128];
    int profile_count = 0;
    double profile_times[100];
    double profile_temps[100];

    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), profile_file)) {
        if (sscanf(line, "%lf,%lf", &profile_times[profile_count], &profile_temps[profile_count]) == 2) {
            profile_count++;
        }
    }

    fclose(profile_file);

    for (int i = 0; i < profile_count; i++) {
        pid_state.target_temp = profile_temps[i];
        pid_state.current_temp = 0;
        pid_state.error = 0;
        pid_state.derivative = 0;
        pid_state.integral = 0;
        pid_state.output = 0;

        pid_state.pid = fork();
        if (pid_state.pid < 0) {
            handle_gpio_error(errno);
        }

        if (pid_state.pid == 0) {
            execlp("python", "python", "reflow.py", "profile.txt", (char *)NULL);
            handle_gpio_error(errno);
        }
    }

    while (1) {
        sleep(1);
    }

    cleanup();

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>

#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <w1-therm.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define DS18B20_PATH "/sys/bus/w1/devices/"
#define RELAY_GPIO 17
#define PWM_GPIO 18
#define HEATER_PIN 12
#define LOG_FILE "greenhouse.log"

typedef struct {
    int pid;
    double setpoint;
    double kp;
    double ki;
    double kd;
} PIDParameters;

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int relays_fd;
    int pwm_fd;
    int sensor_fd;
    int log_fd;
    double avg_temp;
    double pid_output;
    double pwm_duty;
} GreenhouseState;

GreenhouseState greenhouse_state;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (greenhouse_state.log_fd != -1) {
        close(greenhouse_state.log_fd);
    }
    if (greenhouse_state.sensor_fd != -1) {
        close(greenhouse_state.sensor_fd);
    }
    if (greenhouse_state.relays_fd != -1) {
        close(greenhouse_state.relays_fd);
    }
    if (greenhouse_state.pwm_fd != -1) {
        close(greenhouse_state.pwm_fd);
    }
    if (greenhouse_state.pid > 0) {
        kill(greenhouse_state.pid, SIGKILL);
    }
    exit(0);
}

void init_gpio() {
    int ret;

    // Open GPIO17 for relay
    greenhouse_state.relays_fd = gpiod_open(RELAY_GPIO);
    if (greenhouse_state.relays_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO17 for relay");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Open GPIO18 for PWM
    greenhouse_state.pwm_fd = gpiod_open(PWM_GPIO);
    if (greenhouse_state.pwm_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO18 for PWM");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set GPIO18 to PWM mode
    ret = gpiod_set_mode(greenhouse_state.pwm_fd, GPIOD_MODE_PWM);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO18 to PWM mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set GPIO18 to 0 duty cycle
    ret = gpiod_set_value(greenhouse_state.pwm_fd, 0);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO18 to 0 duty cycle");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Open GPIO4 for temperature sensor
    greenhouse_state.sensor_fd = gpiod_open(HEATER_PIN);
    if (greenhouse_state.sensor_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO4 for temperature sensor");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set GPIO4 to input mode
    ret = gpiod_set_mode(greenhouse_state.sensor_fd, GPIOD_MODE_INPUT);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO4 to input mode");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Read temperature from sensor
    ret = gpiod_read(greenhouse_state.sensor_fd, &greenhouse_state.avg_temp);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read temperature from sensor");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Open log file
    greenhouse_state.log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
    if (greenhouse_state.log_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void read_sensor() {
    char path[256];
    struct w1_slave data;

    snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s%s", DS18B20_PATH, "/w1_slave");

    int fd = open(path, O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open sensor file");
        return;
    }

    read(fd, &data, sizeof(data));
    close(fd);

    if (data.crc != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "CRC error in sensor data\n");
        return;
    }

    char *line = strtok(NULL, "\n");
    if (!line) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to parse sensor data\n");
        return;
    }

    char *line2 = strtok(NULL, "\n");
    if (!line2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to parse sensor data\n");
        return;
    }

    greenhouse_state.avg_temp = (double) strtod(line2, NULL) / 1000.0;
}

void update_pid() {
    double error = greenhouse_state.setpoint - greenhouse_state.avg_temp;
    greenhouse_state.pid_output = greenhouse_state.kp * error + greenhouse_state.ki * greenhouse_state.error_accumulator + greenhouse_state.kd * (error - greenhouse_state.last_error);

    greenhouse_state.error_accumulator += error;
    greenhouse_state.last_error = error;
}

void update_pwm() {
    greenhouse_state.pwm_duty = greenhouse_state.pid_output * 0.01; // Convert PID output to PWM duty cycle (0-1)
    if (greenhouse_state.pwm_duty < 0) greenhouse_state.pwm_duty = 0;
    if (greenhouse_state.pwm_duty > 1) greenhouse_state.pwm_duty = 1;

    int duty = greenhouse_state.pwm_duty * 255; // Convert duty cycle to 8-bit value
    if (duty < 0) duty = 0;
    if (duty > 255) duty = 255;

    ret = gpiod_set_value(greenhouse_state.pwm_fd, duty);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set PWM duty cycle");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void log_data() {
    struct timeval tv;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    double timestamp = tv.tv_sec + tv.tv_usec / 1000000.0;

    char log_line[256];
    snprintf(log_line, sizeof(log_line), "%.6f, %.2f, %.2f, %.2f, %.2f\n", timestamp, greenhouse_state.avg_temp, greenhouse_state.setpoint, greenhouse_state.pid_output, greenhouse_state.pwm_duty);

    if (write(greenhouse_state.log_fd, log_line, strlen(log_line)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write log data");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    if (argc < 5) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Usage: %s <setpoint> <kp> <ki> <kd>\n", argv[0]);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    greenhouse_state.setpoint = atof(argv[1]);
    greenhouse_state.kp = atof(argv[2]);
    greenhouse_state.ki = atof(argv[3]);
    greenhouse_state.kd = atof(argv[4]);

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    init_gpio();

    pid_t pid = fork();
    if (pid < 0) {
        perror("Failed to fork");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (pid == 0) {
        // Child process
        while (1) {
            read_sensor();
            update_pid();
            update_pwm();
            log_data();
            usleep(500000); // 5 seconds
        }
    } else {
        // Parent process
        greenhouse_state.pid = pid;
        while (1) {
            sleep(1); // Run parent process for 1 second
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

Implement robust error handling for I2C communication failures — NACKs, bus errors, CRC mismatches, sensor absence — and for HTTP failures. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <sys/param.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <time.h>

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"
#define HTU21D_ADDR 0x40
#define HTU21D_REG_TEMP 0x00
#define HTU21D_REG_HUMID 0x02
#define HTU21D_REG_CONTROL 0x3E
#define HTU21D_CONTROL_NORMAL 0x40
#define HTU21D_CONTROL_POWER_DOWN 0x00

#define JSON_HEADER "POST /humidity HTTP/1.1\r\n"
#define JSON_CONTENT_TYPE "Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
#define JSON_ACCEPT "Accept: application/json\r\n"
#define JSON_END "\r\n"
#define JSON_VALUE "{\"humidity\":"
#define JSON_CLOSE "}"

#define BUFFER_SIZE 1024

void i2c_open(int *fd) {
    *fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (*fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open i2c device: %s", strerror(errno));
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_close(int fd) {
    close(fd);
}

void i2c_read(int fd, char *buffer, int reg, int len) {
    int n;
    char *ptr = buffer;
    for (n = 0; n < len; n++) {
        if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, reg + n) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to read from I2C device: %s", strerror(errno));
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        ptr += n;
    }
}

void i2c_write(int fd, char *buffer, int len) {
    int n;
    char *ptr = buffer;
    for (n = 0; n < len; n++) {
        if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SMBUS_WRITE, reg + n) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to write to I2C device: %s", strerror(errno));
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
        ptr += n;
    }
}

int i2c_check_error(int fd) {
    int error;
    if (ioctl(fd, I2C_SMBUS_GET_ERROR, &error) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to check I2C error: %s", strerror(errno));
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    return error;
}

int i2c_read_humidity(int fd) {
    int error;
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    i2c_write(fd, &HTU21D_CONTROL, 1);
    i2c_read(fd, buffer, HTU21D_REG_HUMID, 2);
    error = i2c_check_error(fd);
    if (error) {
        return -1;
    }
    return (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
}

int i2c_read_temperature(int fd) {
    int error;
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    i2c_write(fd, &HTU21D_CONTROL, 1);
    i2c_read(fd, buffer, HTU21D_REG_TEMP, 2);
    error = i2c_check_error(fd);
    if (error) {
        return -1;
    }
    return (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
}

void i2c_close(int fd) {
    close(fd);
}

void http_post(int sock, const char *host, const char *path, const char *data) {
    struct sockaddr_in server;
    socklen_t server_len = sizeof(server);
    server.sin_family = AF_INET;
    server.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr(host);
    server.sin_port = htons(80);

    if (connect(sock, (struct sockaddr *)&server, server_len) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to connect to server: %s", strerror(errno));
        return;
    }

    char request[BUFFER_SIZE];
    snprintf(request, BUFFER_SIZE, "%s%s%s%s", JSON_HEADER, JSON_CONTENT_TYPE, JSON_ACCEPT, JSON_END);
    strcat(request, JSON_VALUE);
    strcat(request, to_string(i2c_read_humidity(sock)));
    strcat(request, JSON_CLOSE);
    strcat(request, JSON_END);

    if (send(sock, request, strlen(request), 0) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to send request to server: %s", strerror(errno));
        return;
    }

    close(sock);
}

void to_string(int value) {
    char buffer[32];
    snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%d", value);
    return buffer;
}

void handle_i2c_error(int fd) {
    if (i2c_check_error(fd)) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "I2C error detected, shutting down");
        i2c_close(fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void handle_http_error(int sock) {
    if (sock < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "HTTP error detected, shutting down");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Received SIGINT, shutting down");
    handle_i2c_error(fd);
    handle_http_error(sock);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Received SIGTERM, shutting down");
    handle_i2c_error(fd);
    handle_http_error(sock);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    int fd;
    int sock;
    struct sockaddr_in client;
    socklen_t client_len = sizeof(client);
    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    char request[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int humidity;
    int temperature;
    int status;

    fd = i2c_open(&fd);
    if (fd < 0) {
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    if (sock < 0) {
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigterm);

    while (1) {
        handle_i2c_error(fd);
        humidity = i2c_read_humidity(fd);
        temperature = i2c_read_temperature(fd);
        snprintf(request, BUFFER_SIZE, "{\"humidity\":%d,\"temperature\":%d}", humidity, temperature);
        http_post(sock, "api.example.com", "/humidity", request);
        sleep(60);
    }

    i2c_close(fd);
    close(sock);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

**Note:** This code assumes that the HTU21D sensor is present at the specified I2C address and that the HTTP server at `api.example.com` is accessible. The `to_string` function is used to convert integers to strings for the JSON payload. The `handle_sigint` and `handle_sigterm` functions handle the SIGINT and SIGTERM signals to ensure graceful shutdown. The `http_post` function sends the JSON payload to the HTTP server using standard POSIX sockets. The `i2c_open`, `i2c_read`, `i2c_write`, and `i2c_check_error` functions handle I2C communication. The `handle_i2c_error` and `handle_http_error` functions handle I2C and HTTP errors, respectively. The `main` function runs in an infinite loop, reading the sensor data and sending the JSON payload to the HTTP server every 60 seconds.

Initialize pigpio and open SPI channel 0 at 500 kHz, mode 0. Every 1 second, read the 32-bit MAX31855 register, extracting the signed 14-bit thermocouple temperature at 0.25°C resolution and checking the fault bit (bit 16) plus fault type bits OC (bit 0), SCG (bit 1), and SCV (bit 2). Drive the fan via hardware PWM on GPIO18 at 1 kHz with a 0-255 duty range, using a piecewise curve: 0% below 25°C, a linear ramp of 0-50 between 25-40°C, a steeper ramp of 50-200 between 40-60°C, and 100% above 60°C. Log each valid reading — timestamp, temperature, PWM duty cycle — into a 20-entry circular buffer. On SPI transfer errors or MAX31855 faults, print a diagnostic message to stderr and skip the fan update for that cycle. Handle SIGINT gracefully: stop PWM, close SPI, print the full buffer contents, and terminate pigpio before exiting. Check every pigpio call, including gpioInitialise, spiOpen, spiXfer, and gpioPWM.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define MAX_BUFFER_SIZE 20
#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_FREQ 500000
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define PWM_CHANNEL 18
#define PWM_FREQ 1000
#define PWM_DUTY_RANGE 255
#define MAX31855_CS 8
#define MAX31855_FAULT_BIT 16
#define MAX31855_FAULT_TYPE_OC 0
#define MAX31855_FAULT_TYPE_SCG 1
#define MAX31855_FAULT_TYPE_SCV 2

typedef struct {
    char timestamp[20];
    float temperature;
    uint8_t duty_cycle;
} SensorReading;

SensorReading buffer[MAX_BUFFER_SIZE];

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    printf("SIGINT received. Stopping PWM, closing SPI, and exiting.\n");
    gpioPWM(PWM_CHANNEL, 0);
    spiClose(SPI_CHANNEL);
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
        printf("%s %f %d\n", buffer[i].timestamp, buffer[i].temperature, buffer[i].duty_cycle);
    }
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("gpioInitialise failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (spiOpen(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_FREQ, SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("spiOpen failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetPWMfreq(PWM_CHANNEL, PWM_FREQ) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetPWMfreq failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioPWM(PWM_CHANNEL, 0) < 0) {
        perror("gpioPWM failed");
        return 1;
    }

    int buffer_index = 0;
    int spi_read_count = 0;

    while (1) {
        if (spiXfer(SPI_CHANNEL, 0, 0, 0, 0) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "SPI transfer error\n");
            continue;
        }

        uint32_t data = 0;
        if (spiXfer(SPI_CHANNEL, 0, &data, 4, 0) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "SPI transfer error\n");
            continue;
        }

        if ((data & (1 << MAX31855_FAULT_BIT)) != 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "MAX31855 fault detected: ");
            switch ((data >> MAX31855_FAULT_BIT) & 0x07) {
                case MAX31855_FAULT_TYPE_OC:
                    fprintf(stderr, "OC fault\n");
                    break;
                case MAX31855_FAULT_TYPE_SCG:
                    fprintf(stderr, "SCG fault\n");
                    break;
                case MAX31855_FAULT_TYPE_SCV:
                    fprintf(stderr, "SCV fault\n");
                    break;
            }
            continue;
        }

        float temperature = (float)((data & 0x3FFF) * 0.25);
        if (temperature < 25.0) {
            buffer[buffer_index].duty_cycle = 0;
        } else if (temperature < 40.0) {
            buffer[buffer_index].duty_cycle = (temperature - 25.0) * (255.0 / 15.0);
        } else if (temperature < 60.0) {
            buffer[buffer_index].duty_cycle = 50 + (temperature - 40.0) * (200.0 / 20.0);
        } else {
            buffer[buffer_index].duty_cycle = 255;
        }

        snprintf(buffer[buffer_index].timestamp, sizeof(buffer[buffer_index].timestamp), "%ld", time(NULL));
        buffer[buffer_index].temperature = temperature;
        buffer[buffer_index].duty_cycle = (uint8_t)buffer[buffer_index].duty_cycle;

        if (buffer_index == MAX_BUFFER_SIZE) {
            buffer_index = 0;
        }

        spi_read_count++;
        if (spi_read_count >= 10) {
            spi_read_count = 0;
        }

        gpioPWM(PWM_CHANNEL, buffer[buffer_index].duty_cycle);
        usleep(1000000); // 1 second delay
    }

    return 0;
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int read_cpu_temp() {
    int fd;
    struct stat st;
    char buf[128];
    int temp;

    fd = open("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp", O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open temperature file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }

    if (fstat(fd, &st) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to stat temperature file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    if (read(fd, buf, sizeof(buf)) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to read temperature file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(fd);
        return -1;
    }

    temp = atoi(buf);
    close(fd);
    return temp;
}

int main() {
    pid_t pid = getpid();
    char pid_str[128];
    snprintf(pid_str, sizeof(pid_str), "%d", pid);
    setenv("PIGPIO_PID", pid_str, 1);

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to initialize pigpio: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(PWM_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set PWM mode for GPIO%d: %s\n", PWM_PIN, strerror(errno));
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpioSetClock(PWM_PIN, PI_FREQ_25MHZ) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set PWM frequency for GPIO%d: %s\n", PWM_PIN, strerror(errno));
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    fan_pwm_fd = gpioPWM(PWM_PIN, 0);
    if (fan_pwm_fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set PWM duty cycle for GPIO%d: %s\n", PWM_PIN, strerror(errno));
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    temp_fd = open("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp", O_RDONLY);
    if (temp_fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open temperature file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (log_fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open log file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigterm);

    while (running) {
        int temp;
        int duty;

        temp = read_cpu_temp();
        if (temp < 0) {
            continue;
        }

        if (temp < TEMP_LOW) {
            duty = PWM_DUTY_MIN;
        } else if (temp > TEMP_HIGH) {
            duty = PWM_DUTY_MAX;
        } else {
            duty = (temp - TEMP_LOW) * (PWM_DUTY_MAX - PWM_DUTY_MIN) / (TEMP_HIGH - TEMP_LOW) + PWM_DUTY_MIN;
            if (duty > PWM_DUTY_MAX) {
                duty = PWM_DUTY_MAX;
            } else if (duty < PWM_DUTY_MIN) {
                duty = PWM_DUTY_MIN;
            }
        }

        if (gpioSetPWM1DutyCycle(PWM_PIN, duty) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set PWM duty cycle for GPIO%d: %s\n", PWM_PIN, strerror(errno));
            continue;
        }

        struct timeval now;
        gettimeofday(&now, NULL);
        char log_line[256];
        snprintf(log_line, sizeof(log_line), "%ld %d %d\n", now.tv_sec, temp, duty);
        if (write(log_fd, log_line, strlen(log_line)) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to write to log file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        }

        usleep(5000000); // 5 seconds
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x48
#define TEMP_REG 0x00
#define LED_PIN 18

#define BUFFER_SIZE 60
#define SAMPLE_RATE 1
#define LOGGING_INTERVAL 1

typedef struct {
    int count;
    double sum;
} RunningAverage;

typedef struct {
    int count;
    double sum;
    double average;
} CircularBuffer;

CircularBuffer buffer;
RunningAverage running_avg;

pthread_mutex_t mutex = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

void* read_sensor(void* arg) {
    int fd;
    struct i2c_msg msg[2];
    struct i2c_rdma_msg rdma_msg;
    struct i2c_client_id client_id;
    int ret;

    fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return NULL;
    }

    ret = ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set slave address");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    client_id = {0};
    ret = ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVEX, &client_id, 0, 0);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set client ID");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    while (1) {
        msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
        msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
        msg[0].data[0] = TEMP_REG;

        msg[1].addr = I2C_ADDR;
        msg[1].flags = I2C_M_RD;
        msg[1].data[0] = 0;

        ret = i2c_smbus_readi2c_msg(fd, msg, 2);
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            goto cleanup;
        }

        int temp = (int)msg[0].data[0];
        double temp_celsius = (double)temp >> 5;

        pthread_mutex_lock(&mutex);
        buffer.count++;
        buffer.sum += temp_celsius;
        buffer.average = buffer.sum / buffer.count;
        running_avg.sum += temp_celsius;
        running_avg.count++;
        running_avg.average = running_avg.sum / running_avg.count;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&mutex);

        if (temp_celsius > 28.0) {
            set_value(LED_PIN, 1);
        } else {
            set_value(LED_PIN, 0);
        }

        usleep(1000000 * SAMPLE_RATE);
    }

cleanup:
    close(fd);
    return NULL;
}

        return 1;

        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;

    pollfd[0].fd = fd;
    pollfd[0].events = POLLIN;
    pollfd[0].revents = 0;

            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

                gpioTerminate();

            if (ferror(fd)) {
                perror("ferror during read");
                close(fd);
                gpioTerminate();

    DHT22Data data;
    int response[DHT22_RESPONSE_LENGTH];
    int checksum;
    int i;

    // Pull data line low for 1 ms
    printf("Pulling data line low...\n");
    gpio_set_mode(DHT22_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpio_write(DHT22_PIN, 0);
    usleep(1000000); // 1 ms

    // Read 40 bits
    printf("Reading 40 bits...\n");
    for (i = 0; i < DHT22_RESPONSE_LENGTH; i++) {
        response[i] = gpio_get_digital(DHT22_PIN);
        usleep(100000); // 0.1 ms
    }

    // Calculate checksum
    checksum = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < DHT22_CHECKSUM_LENGTH; i++) {
        checksum += response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + i];
    }
    checksum = (checksum & 255) + ((checksum >> 8) & 255);

    // Validate checksum
    if (checksum != response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + DHT22_CHECKSUM_LENGTH]) {
        printf("Checksum error\n");
        return {0, 0, 0};
    }

    // Parse data
    data.temperature = (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 0] << 7) |

                        (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 2] << 5) |
                        (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 3] << 4) |
                        (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 4] << 3) |
                        (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 5] << 2) |
                        (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 6] << 1) |
                        response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 7];

    data.humidity = (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 8] << 7) |
                    (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 9] << 6) |
                    (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 10] << 5) |
                    (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 11] << 4) |
                    (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 12] << 3) |
                    (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 13] << 2) |
                    (response[DHT22_RESPONSE_START + 14] << 1) |

    curl = curl_easy_init();

        return;
    }

        \"humidity\": %d
    }", data.temperature, data.humidity);
    post_size = strlen(post_field);

    // Create HTTP POST request
    post = curl_httppost_new();
    curl_httppost_add_field(post, "Content-Type", "application/json");
    curl_httppost_add_field(post, "Content-Length", post_size);
    curl_httppost_add_field(post, "data", post_field);

    // Set up curl
    clientcurl = curl_easy_init();
    if (!clientcurl) {
        printf("Failed to initialize curl\n");
        return;
    }

    // Set URL
    curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_URL, url);
    curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_HTTPPOST, 1);
    curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, post);
    curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION, NULL);
    curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_NOPROGRESS, 1L);
    curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 10);
    curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS, 3);

    // Perform request
    status = curl_easy_perform(curl);
    if (status != CURLE_OK) {
        printf("HTTP request failed: %s\n", curl_easy_strerror(status));
        return;

    curl_global_cleanup();
    free(post_field);

    int retries = 0;
    int signal_received = 0;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    // Initialize GPIO
    printf("Initializing GPIO...\n");
    gpio_init(DHT22_PIN);
    gpio_set_mode(DHT22_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    printf("GPIO initialized\n");

    while (!signal_received) {
        data = read_dht22();

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <curl/curl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define DHT22_PIN 4
#define DHT22_TIMEOUT 10000
#define DHT22_RETRIES 3
#define DHT22_BACKOFF 2000
#define DHT22_READ_INTERVAL 10000
#define DHT22_RESPONSE_SIZE 40

typedef struct {
    int pin;
    int retries;
    int backoff;
    int last_error;
} DHT22Status;

typedef struct {
    CURL *curl;
    char *url;
    char *post_data;
    size_t post_size;
} HttpClient;

void dht22_init(DHT22Status *status) {
    status->pin = DHT22_PIN;
    status->retries = 0;
    status->backoff = DHT22_BACKOFF;
    status->last_error = 0;
}

int dht22_read(DHT22Status *status) {
    int pin = status->pin;
    int retries = status->retries;
    int backoff = status->backoff;
    int last_error = status->last_error;

    if (retries >= DHT22_RETRIES) {
        return last_error;
    }

    // Pull data line low for at least 1 ms
    gpioSetMode(pin, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioWrite(pin, 0);
    usleep(1000000);

    // Release data line high for 20-40 µs
    gpioSetMode(pin, PI_INPUT);
    usleep(20);
    gpioSetMode(pin, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioWrite(pin, 1);
    usleep(20);

    // Read 40-bit response
    int data[40];
    int i = 0;
    int start_time = micros();
    while (i < 40) {
        int bit = gpioRead(pin);
        if (bit == 1) {
            data[i] = 1;
        } else {
            data[i] = 0;
        }
        i++;
        if (micros() - start_time > DHT22_TIMEOUT) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    // Calculate checksum
    int checksum = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < 40; j++) {
        checksum += data[j];
    }
    checksum = (checksum & 255) + ((checksum >> 8) & 255);

    if (checksum != data[40]) {
        return -2;
    }

    // Convert data to humidity value
    int humidity = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
        humidity += data[j] * (1 << (7 - j));
    }

    return 0;
}

void dht22_cleanup(DHT22Status *status) {
    gpioTerminate();
    curl_global_cleanup();
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Received signal %d, shutting down.", signum);
    dht22_cleanup(&status);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Usage: %s -s <url>\n", argv[0]);
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    char *url = argv[1];
    DHT22Status status;
    dht22_init(&status);

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    CURL *curl;
    HttpClient client;
    client.url = url;
    client.post_data = NULL;
    client.post_size = 0;

    while (1) {
        int error = dht22_read(&status);
        if (error == 0) {
            char *post_data = malloc(DHT22_RESPONSE_SIZE + 1);
            snprintf(post_data, DHT22_RESPONSE_SIZE + 1, "{\"humidity\":%d}", data[0]);
            client.post_data = post_data;
            client.post_size = strlen(post_data);

            curl_global_init(CURL_GLOBAL_DEFAULT);
            curl = curl_easy_init();
            if (curl) {
                curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_URL, client.url);
                curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, client.post_data);
                curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, strstr("Content-Type: application/json"));
                curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, 10);
                curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION, curl_write);
                curl_easy_setopt(curl, CURLOPT_WRITEDATA, NULL);
                curl_easy_perform(curl);
                curl_easy_cleanup(curl);
            } else {
                syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to initialize curl.");

        } else if (error == -1) {

        } else if (error == -2) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Checksum failed for DHT22 sensor.");
        } else if (error == -3) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to initialize curl.");
        } else if (error == -4) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Non-2xx HTTP response.");
        }

        usleep(DHT22_READ_INTERVAL);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <syslog.h>

#define COOLING_DEVICE_FILE "/sys/class/thermal/cooling_device0/cur_state"
#define COOLING_DEVICE_MAX_STATE_FILE "/sys/class/thermal/cooling_device0/max_state"
#define COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_FILE "/sys/class/thermal/cooling_device0/state"
#define COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_LOG "/var/log/fan_control.log"
#define COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_LOG_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %d\n"

#define MAX_STATE 3
#define RETRY_COUNT 3
#define RETRY_DELAY_MS 500

volatile sig_atomic_t running = 1;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        running = 0;
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Received signal %d, shutting down fan.", signum);
        write(COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_FILE, "0", 1);
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Shutdown complete.");
    }
}

void read_cpu_temp(int fd, char *buf, size_t size) {
    int retries = RETRY_COUNT;
    while (retries > 0) {
        if (read(fd, buf, size) == -1) {
            if (errno == EINTR) {
                continue;
            }
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to read CPU temperature: %s", strerror(errno));
            return;
        }
        if (buf[0] == '\0') {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Empty temperature value read from file.");
            return;
        }
        break;
    }
    if (retries == 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to read CPU temperature after %d retries.", RETRY_COUNT);
        return;
    }
    buf[strcspn(buf, "\n")] = 0;
    return buf;
}

void write_fan_state(int fd, char *buf) {
    if (buf[0] == '\0') {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Empty fan state value.");
        return;
    }
    if (buf[0] - '0' > MAX_STATE) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Requested fan state exceeds max state %d.", MAX_STATE);
        return;
    }
    if (write(fd, buf, strlen(buf)) == -1) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to write fan state: %s", strerror(errno));
        return;
    }
}

int main() {
    struct stat st;
    int cpu_temp_fd = open(CPU_TEMP_FILE, O_RDONLY);
    if (cpu_temp_fd == -1) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open CPU temperature file: %s", CPU_TEMP_FILE);
        return 1;
    }
    if (fstat(cpu_temp_fd, &st) == -1) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to stat CPU temperature file: %s", CPU_TEMP_FILE);
        close(cpu_temp_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    int cooling_device_fd = open(COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_FILE, O_WRONLY);
    if (cooling_device_fd == -1) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open cooling device state file: %s", COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_FILE);
        close(cpu_temp_fd);
        return 1;
    }
    if (fstat(cooling_device_fd, &st) == -1) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to stat cooling device state file: %s", COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_FILE);
        close(cpu_temp_fd);
        close(cooling_device_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    int cooling_device_max_state_fd = open(COOLING_DEVICE_MAX_STATE_FILE, O_RDONLY);
    if (cooling_device_max_state_fd == -1) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open cooling device max state file: %s", COOLING_DEVICE_MAX_STATE_FILE);
        close(cpu_temp_fd);
        close(cooling_device_fd);
        return 1;
    }
    if (fstat(cooling_device_max_state_fd, &st) == -1) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to stat cooling device max state file: %s", COOLING_DEVICE_MAX_STATE_FILE);
        close(cpu_temp_fd);
        close(cooling_device_fd);
        close(cooling_device_max_state_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    char cpu_temp_str[20];
    char cooling_device_state_str[4];
    char cooling_device_max_state_str[20];
    char cooling_device_state_log_buf[128];

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    while (running) {
        read_cpu_temp(cpu_temp_fd, cpu_temp_str, sizeof(cpu_temp_str));
        if (cpu_temp_str[0] == '\0') {
            continue;
        }
        int cpu_temp = atoi(cpu_temp_str);
        int cooling_device_max_state = atoi(read(cooling_device_max_state_fd, cooling_device_max_state_str, sizeof(cooling_device_max_state_str)));
        if (cpu_temp < 45) {
            cooling_device_state_str[0] = '0';
        } else if (cpu_temp < 55) {
            cooling_device_state_str[0] = '1';
        } else if (cpu_temp < 65) {
            cooling_device_state_str[0] = '2';
        } else {
            cooling_device_state_str[0] = '3';
        }
        write_fan_state(cooling_device_fd, cooling_device_state_str);

        char cooling_device_state_buf[4];
        if (read(cooling_device_fd, cooling_device_state_buf, sizeof(cooling_device_state_buf)) == -1) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to read cooling device state: %s", strerror(errno));
            continue;
        }
        if (strcmp(cooling_device_state_buf, cooling_device_state_str) == 0) {
            snprintf(cooling_device_state_log_buf, sizeof(cooling_device_state_log_buf), COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_LOG_FORMAT, ctime(&time(NULL)));
            write(COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_LOG, cooling_device_state_log_buf, strlen(cooling_device_state_log_buf));
        }

        usleep(500000); // 5 seconds

    close(cpu_temp_fd);
    close(cooling_device_fd);
    close(cooling_device_max_state_fd);
    close(COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_FILE);
    close(COOLING_DEVICE_STATE_LOG);

Since the TMAG5110A1 has an open-drain output, configure internal pull-up resistors on both pins. Implement a standard 2-bit quadrature state machine to track rotation increments over 360 pulses per revolution, logging every state change with a timestamp and the normalized angular position (0.00 to 360.00 degrees) to encoder_log.txt. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define SENSOR_A_PIN 17
#define SENSOR_B_PIN 18
#define LOG_FILE "encoder_log.txt"
#define MAX_LOG_ENTRIES 1000

typedef struct {
    time_t timestamp;
    int state;
    double angle;
} LogEntry;

int main() {
    if (gpio_init() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_mode(SENSOR_A_PIN, PI_INPUT) < 0 ||
        gpio_set_mode(SENSOR_B_PIN, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO mode set failed");
        gpio_uninit();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_pull_up(SENSOR_A_PIN) < 0 ||
        gpio_pull_up(SENSOR_B_PIN) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO pull-up failed");
        gpio_uninit();
        return 1;
    }

    LogEntry log[MAX_LOG_ENTRIES];
    int log_index = 0;
    int state = 0;
    double angle = 0.0;

    while (1) {
        if (gpio_get_level(SENSOR_A_PIN) == 1) {
            if (gpio_get_level(SENSOR_B_PIN) == 1) {
                state = 0;
            } else {
                state = 1;
            }
        } else {
            if (gpio_get_level(SENSOR_B_PIN) == 1) {
                state = 2;
            } else {
                state = 3;
            }
        }

        if (state != log_index % 4) {
            log_index = (log_index + 1) % 4;
            log[log_index].timestamp = time(NULL);
            log[log_index].state = state;
            log[log_index].angle = angle;

            if (log_index == 0) {
                angle = 0.0;
            } else {
                double delta = 0.0;
                switch (state) {
                    case 0:
                        delta = 90.0;
                        break;
                    case 1:
                        delta = -90.0;
                        break;
                    case 2:
                        delta = 90.0;
                        break;
                    case 3:
                        delta = -90.0;
                        break;
                }
                angle += delta;
                if (angle > 360.0) {
                    angle -= 360.0;
                } else if (angle < 0.0) {
                    angle += 360.0;
                }
            }

            if (log_index < MAX_LOG_ENTRIES) {
                FILE *fp = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
                if (fp == NULL) {
                    perror("file open failed");
                    gpio_uninit();
                    return 1;
                }
                fprintf(fp, "%ld %d %.2f\n", log[log_index].timestamp, log[log_index].state, log[log_index].angle);
                fclose(fp);
            } else {
                printf("Log file full, overwriting previous entries.\n");
                fp = fopen(LOG_FILE, "w");
                if (fp == NULL) {
                    perror("file open failed");
                    gpio_uninit();
                    return 1;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < MAX_LOG_ENTRIES; i++) {
                    fprintf(fp, "%ld %d %.2f\n", log[i].timestamp, log[i].state, log[i].angle);
                }
                fclose(fp);
            }
        }
    }

    gpio_uninit();
    return 0;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ using the pigpio library to read RPM from a Melexis MLX90254 magnetic speed sensor connected to GPIO 18 (physical pin 12, configured as input with a pull-down), which outputs 1 pulse per revolution. Calculate RPM over a 1-second interval by counting rising edges only, and log RPM values with timestamps to rpm_log.txt in append mode, flushed immediately. Use a pthread mutex to protect the pulse counter between the ISR and the main thread. Check pigpio initialization, ISR registration, and log file opening. Use a signal handler for SIGINT/SIGTERM for graceful shutdown that terminates pigpio, closes the log file, and destroys the mutex. If the sensor is absent (0 pulses), log 0.00 RPM.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <signal.h>

#define PULSE_PIN 18
#define LOG_FILE "rpm_log.txt"

pthread_mutex_t rpm_mutex = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

void *rpm_thread(void *arg) {
    int count = 0;
    int start_time = 0;
    int current_time = 0;
    int interval = 1000; // 1 second interval

    while (1) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&rpm_mutex);
        if (start_time == 0) {
            start_time = get_time();
        }
        current_time = get_time();
        if ((current_time - start_time) >= interval) {
            start_time = 0;
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&rpm_mutex);
            count = 0;
            pthread_mutex_lock(&rpm_mutex);
            if (count > 0) {
                double rpm = (double)count * 60.0 / interval;
                char buffer[100];
                sprintf(buffer, "%.2f RPM %d\n", rpm, current_time);
                FILE *log = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
                if (log) {
                    fwrite(buffer, sizeof(char), strlen(buffer), log);
                    fclose(log);
                }
                pthread_mutex_unlock(&rpm_mutex);
            } else {
                char buffer[100];
                sprintf(buffer, "0.00 RPM %d\n", current_time);
                FILE *log = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
                if (log) {
                    fwrite(buffer, sizeof(char), strlen(buffer), log);
                    fclose(log);
                }
            }
        } else {
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&rpm_mutex);
            if (gpio_get_named(PULSE_PIN)) {
                gpio_wait_for_edge(PULSE_PIN,_EDGE_RISING);
                count++;
            }
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

void signal_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&rpm_mutex);
        if (gpio_is_active()) {
            gpioTerminate();
        }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&rpm_mutex);
        FILE *log = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
        if (log) {
            fclose(log);
        }
        pthread_mutex_destroy(&rpm_mutex);
        pthread_exit(NULL);
    }
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise");
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);

    pthread_t rpm_thread_id;
    if (pthread_create(&rpm_thread_id, NULL, rpm_thread, NULL) != 0) {
        perror("pthread_create");
        return 1;
    }

    pthread_mutex_lock(&rpm_mutex);
    if (gpio_set_pull_down(PULSE_PIN)) {
        perror("gpio_set_pull_down");
        return 1;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&rpm_mutex);

    printf("RPM thread started\n");
    pthread_join(rpm_thread_id, NULL);

    gpioTerminate();
    pthread_mutex_destroy(&rpm_mutex);
    return 0;
}

The `rpm_thread` function reads the RPM from the magnetic speed sensor connected to GPIO 18, counts the rising edges, and logs the RPM values to the `rpm_log.txt` file every 1 second. The `pthread_mutex` is used to protect the pulse counter between the ISR and the main thread.

The `main` function initializes the GPIO pins, starts the RPM thread, and waits for the thread to finish. It also handles the `SIGINT` and `SIGTERM` signals to gracefully shut down the program and release resources.

            if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to set LED value");
            }
        }

        // Log the data
        log_data((double)red, (double)ir);
    }

    return 0;
}

    if (callback) {
        callback(arg);
    }
}

    log_fd = open(log_filename, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644);
    if (log_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the log file to append mode
    if (fchmod(log_fd, 0644) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set log file mode");
        return 1;
    }

    // Start the main loop
    while (1) {
        // Sleep for 100 ms
        usleep(100000);

        // Read the FIFO data register
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, FIFO_DATA_REG, FIFO_DATA_SIZE, NULL, 0) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            continue;
        }

        // Read the FIFO data
        uint16_t red = 0;
        uint16_t ir = 0;
        if (read(i2c_fd, &red, 2) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            continue;
        }
        if (read(i2c_fd, &ir, 2) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            continue;
        }

        // Check if the sensor is present
        if (red == 0x00) {
            printf("Sensor not present\n");
            continue;
        }

        // Check if the IR reading exceeds the threshold
        if (ir > THRESHOLD) {
            // Trigger the LED
            if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 1) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to set LED value");
            }
        } else {
            // Turn off the LED
            if (gpiod_line_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to set LED value");
            }
        }

        // Log the data
        log_data((double)red, (double)ir);
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, cleanup);
    signal(SIGTERM, cleanup);

    // Start the main loop
    main_loop();

    return 0;
}
