#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO18 18
#define GAIN_PIN 60
#define SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS 10
#define LOG_FILE "audio_log.txt"

int main() {
    // Initialize GPIO subsystem
    int err = 0;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip = NULL;
    struct gpiod_line *line = NULL;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge = NULL;
    struct gpiod_edge_request *request = NULL;
    struct timespec ts;

    // Set up signal handlers for SIGINT and SIGTERM
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = sigint_handler;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) == -1 || sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL) == -1) {
        perror("sigaction");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Open GPIO subsystem
    err = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    chip = gpiod_chip_get_current();

    // Open GPIO line
    err = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO17, GPIOD_LINE_INPUT);
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_request_line");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, err);

    // Set up edge detection
    err = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_RISING);
    if (err < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    edge = gpiod_line_get_edge(line, err);

    // Create edge request
    request = gpiod_edge_request_new(edge, 0, 0, 0);
    if (request == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_edge_request_new");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up logging
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Sleep for SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS ms
        nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
        ts.tv_sec = 0;
        ts.tv_nsec = SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS * 1000000;

        // Check for rising edge
        if (gpiod_edge_request_get_status(request) == GPIOD_EDGE_RISING) {
            // Log the event
            time_t rawtime;
            struct tm *timeinfo;
            time(&rawtime);
            timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
            fprintf(log_file, "%s %d\n", asctime(timeinfo), 1);
        }

        // Release resources
        gpiod_edge_request_release(request);
        gpiod_line_request_release(line, request);
        gpiod_chip_request_line_release(chip, line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        fclose(log_file);
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }

    return 0;
}

// Signal handler for SIGINT and SIGTERM
void sigint_handler(int signum) {
    // Release resources
    gpiod_edge_request_release(request);
    gpiod_line_request_release(line, request);
    gpiod_chip_request_line_release(chip, line);
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    fclose(log_file);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi Zero W using the pigpio library to interface with a Honeywell MICS-VZ-89TE VOC sensor connected on I2C bus 1 at address 0x70. Read the 7-byte sensor state starting at register 0x00, extracting TVOC (ppb) from bytes 1-2 and eCO2 (ppm) from bytes 5-6 (big-endian), and compute an IAQ index using the formula IAQ = clamp(100 - (TVOC / 10.0) - ((eCO2 - 400) / 50.0), 0, 100). Every 5 seconds, log a timestamped line with the IAQ, TVOC, and eCO2 values to 'air_quality_log.csv'. Check every I2C read and write return value, and handle sensor-absent or bus-error conditions without crashing. Handle SIGINT gracefully by closing the I2C handle, flushing and closing the log file, and terminating pigpio.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x70
#define TVOC_OFFSET 1
#define eCO2_OFFSET 5
#define IAQ_INDEX 100
#define TVOC_WEIGHT 10.0
#define eCO2_WEIGHT 50.0

int i2c_fd;
int i2c_handle;

void handle_sensor_absent(int sig) {
    printf("Sensor absent or bus error detected. Exiting...\n");
    close(i2c_fd);
    close(i2c_handle);
    exit(1);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    printf("SIGINT received. Closing I2C handle, flushing log, and exiting...\n");
    close(i2c_fd);
    close(i2c_handle);
    fclose(f);
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_msg i2c_msg;
    struct i2c_rdma_msg i2c_rdma_msg;
    struct i2c_rdma_handle i2c_rdma_handle;
    int i2c_rdma_return;

    if (pigpio_init(NULL) < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_init");
        return 1;
    }

    i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("ioctl");
        return 1;
    }

    i2c_handle = pigpio_i2c_open(i2c_fd, I2C_ADDR);
    if (i2c_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_i2c_open");
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGABRT, handle_sensor_absent);

    f = fopen("air_quality_log.csv", "a");
    if (!f) {
        perror("fopen");
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        i2c_msg.addr = I2C_ADDR;
        i2c_msg.flags = I2C_MSG_READ | I2C_MSG_REPEATED_START;
        i2c_msg.len = 7;
        i2c_msg.buf = malloc(i2c_msg.len * sizeof(char));

        if (pigpio_i2c_rdma_read(&i2c_rdma_handle, &i2c_rdma_msg, &i2c_msg) < 0) {
            perror("pigpio_i2c_rdma_read");
            continue;
        }

        if (i2c_rdma_msg.flags & I2C_MSG_ERROR) {
            printf("I2C bus error detected. Exiting...\n");
            close(i2c_fd);
            close(i2c_handle);
            fclose(f);
            exit(1);
        }

        if (i2c_rdma_return = i2c_rdma_msg.flags & I2C_MSG_ERROR) {
            printf("Sensor absent or bus error detected. Exiting...\n");
            close(i2c_fd);
            close(i2c_handle);
            fclose(f);
            exit(1);
        }

        if (i2c_rdma_return == I2C_MSG_SUCCESS) {
            int tvoc = (i2c_msg.buf[TVOC_OFFSET] << 8) | i2c_msg.buf[TVOC_OFFSET + 1];
            int eco2 = (i2c_msg.buf[eCO2_OFFSET] << 8) | i2c_msg.buf[eCO2_OFFSET + 1];

            double iaq = clamp(100 - (tvoc / TVOC_WEIGHT) - ((eco2 - 400) / eCO2_WEIGHT), 0, 100);

            char line[100];
            sprintf(line, "%s,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f\n", ctime(&time(NULL)), iaq, tvoc, eco2);

            if (fwrite(line, strlen(line), 1, f) != 1) {
                perror("fwrite");
                continue;
            }

            free(i2c_msg.buf);
        }

        sleep(5);
    }

    pigpio_close(i2c_handle);
    pigpio_stop(NULL);
    close(i2c_fd);
    fclose(f);
    return 0;
}
```

**Note:** This code uses the `pigpio` library and requires the `pigpio` package to be installed on your Raspberry Pi. The `clamp` function is a custom function that ensures the IAQ value is within the range [0, 100]. The `ctime` function is used to get the current timestamp for logging. The `fwrite` function is used to write the log data to the file. The `close` and `fclose` functions are used to close the I2C handle and the log file, respectively. The `exit` function is used to terminate the program in case of an error.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <time.h>

#define GPIO_CHIP_NAME "gpiochip0"
#define GPIO_LINE_NAME "ttp223_tamper"
#define POLL_INTERVAL_MS 100
#define INTRUSION_TIMEOUT_MS 5000
#define TOUCH_EVENT_THRESHOLD 1

static int line_fd;
static struct gpiod_chip *chip;
static struct gpiod_line *line;

void handle_intrusion() {
    printf("INTRUSION DETECTED\n");
}

void handle_signal(int sig) {
    if (sig == SIGINT || sig == SIGTERM) {
        if (line_fd != -1) {
            gpiod_line_close(line);
            line_fd = -1;
        }
        if (chip) {
            gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
            gpiod_chip_free(chip);
            chip = NULL;
        }
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct timespec ts;
    struct timespec start, end;
    int touch_count = 0;
    int intrusion_detected = 0;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    if (gpiod_chip_open_by_name(GPIO_CHIP_NAME, &chip) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open_by_name");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO_LINE_NAME, &line) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_request_line");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_request_mode(line, GPIOD_MODE_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_mode");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_request_consumer(line, "ttp223_tamper") < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_consumer");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    line_fd = gpiod_line_get_fd(line);

    while (1) {
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        end.tv_sec = ts.tv_sec + INTRUSION_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000;
        end.tv_nsec = ts.tv_nsec + (INTRUSION_TIMEOUT_MS % 1000) * 1000;

        if (gpiod_line_poll(line, &ts, CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_poll");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }

        if (gpiod_line_get_value(line) == TOUCH_EVENT_THRESHOLD) {
            if (!intrusion_detected) {
                intrusion_detected = 1;
                handle_intrusion();
            }
        } else {
            intrusion_detected = 0;
        }

        if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) < 0) {
            perror("clock_gettime");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

            end_time = time(NULL);

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_FREQ 1000000
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_DATA_SIZE 32768
#define SPI_FRAME_SIZE (SPI_DATA_SIZE * 2)
#define SPI_FRAME_COUNT 64
#define SPI_FRAME_PERIOD 100000
#define MAGIC_NUMBER 0x52444144

typedef struct {
    uint64_t timestamp;
    uint32_t start_freq;
    uint32_t end_freq;
    uint32_t chirps;
    uint32_t samples;
    uint32_t frame_period;
} mmWaveConfig;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t frame_number;
    uint64_t timestamp;
    uint8_t data[SPI_FRAME_SIZE];
} mmWaveFrame;

int main() {
    if (gpio_init() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_mode(SPI_CHANNEL, PI_SPI_MODE, SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI mode set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_clock(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_FREQ) < 0) {
        perror("SPI clock set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_mode(23, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO 23 set as output failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_mode(24, PI_EDGE_FALL) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO 24 set as edge fall failed");
        return 1;
    }

    mmWaveConfig config;
    config.start_freq = 7700000000;
    config.end_freq = 7900000000;
    config.chirps = 64;
    config.samples = 256;
    config.frame_period = SPI_FRAME_PERIOD;

    FILE *fp = fopen("mmWaveData.bin", "wb");
    if (!fp) {
        perror("file open failed");
        return 1;
    }

    uint8_t magic_number[] = {MAGIC_NUMBER >> 24, MAGIC_NUMBER >> 16, MAGIC_NUMBER >> 8, MAGIC_NUMBER};
    fwrite(magic_number, 1, 4, fp);

    uint64_t timestamp = 0;
    uint32_t frame_number = 0;

    while (1) {
        if (gpio_get_value(23) == 1) {
            gpio_set_value(23, 0);
            if (gpio_wait_for_edge(24, PI_EDGE_FALL) < 0) {
                perror("data ready interrupt failed");
                return 1;
            }

            mmWaveFrame frame;
            frame.frame_number = frame_number++;
            frame.timestamp = timestamp;

            if (pigpio_spi_transfern(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_DATA_SIZE, frame.data) < 0) {
                perror("SPI transfer failed");
                return 1;
            }

            if (fwrite(&frame, sizeof(mmWaveFrame), 1, fp) < 1) {
                perror("file write failed");
                return 1;
            }

            timestamp += config.frame_period;
        }
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    fclose(fp);
    return 0;
}

#define I2C_ADDR 0x44
#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS

#define MAX_RETRIES 3
#define RETRY_DELAY_MS 100

typedef struct {
    uint16_t exponent;
    uint16_t mantissa;

void log_light_data(const char *filename, const char *timestamp, const LightData *data) {

        return;

    struct tm *timeinfo;
    time_t rawtime;

    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);
    fprintf(file, "%s %d %d\n", buffer, data->exponent, data->mantissa);
    fclose(file);
}

void handle_i2c_error(int error) {
    if (error) {
        printf("I2C transaction failed: %d\n", error);
        printf("Retrying...\n");
        sleep(RETRY_DELAY_MS);
    }
}

void handle_sensor_absent(int error) {
    if (error) {
        printf("Sensor absent or not found\n");
        printf("Retrying...\n");
        sleep(RETRY_DELAY_MS);
    }
}

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    printf("Received SIGINT signal, shutting down...\n");
    pi_close();
    exit(0);
}

    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    int i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);

        goto cleanup;

        pi_set_mode(PI_OUTPUT, 1);
        pi_set_pull_up(PI_OUTPUT, 1);

        int i2c_result = ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, 0x00, &data, 2, I2C_M_RD);
        handle_i2c_error(i2c_result);

        if (data.exponent == 0 && data.mantissa == 0) {
            handle_sensor_absent(i2c_result);
        }

        log_light_data(LIGHT_DATA_FILE, ctime(&time(NULL)), &data);

        retries = 0;
        while (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
            pi_set_mode(PI_OUTPUT, 0);
            pi_set_pull_up(PI_OUTPUT, 0);

            if (data.exponent != 0 || data.mantissa != 0) {
                break;

            retries++;
            sleep(RETRY_DELAY_MS);
        }

        if (retries == MAX_RETRIES) {

    }

    cleanup:
    pi_close();
    close(i2c_fd);
    return 0;
}

#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define SENSOR_GPIO 4
#define POLL_INTERVAL_MS 100
#define LOG_LINE_MAX 256

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("gpioInitialise() failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    struct timeval start, end;
    gettimeofday(&start, NULL);

    char log_line[LOG_LINE_MAX];
    int state = 0;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    printf("Tilt Sensor Monitor\n");
    printf("Press Ctrl+C to exit\n");

    while (1) {
        gettimeofday(&end, NULL);
        double elapsed_ms = (end.tv_sec - start.tv_sec) * 1000 + (end.tv_usec - start.tv_usec) / 1000.0;
        if (elapsed_ms >= POLL_INTERVAL_MS) {
            start = end;
            state = gpioRead(SENSOR_GPIO);
            if (state == 0) {
                printf("Tilted\n");
            } else {
                printf("Not Tilted\n");
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x60
#define UV_PART_ID 0x45
#define HW_KEY 0x17
#define CHLIST 0x01
#define ALS_FORCE 0x06

#define UV_INDEX 0x0
#define ALS_VIS 0x1

#define TIMESTAMP_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"

int i2c_fd;
int uv_sensor_present = 0;
int uv_sensor_absent = 0;
int uv_sensor_bus_error = 0;

void handle_i2c_error(int err) {
    if (err < 0) {
        uv_sensor_absent = 1;
        uv_sensor_bus_error = 1;
        printf("I2C error: %d\n", err);
    }
}

void handle_sensor_absent() {
    uv_sensor_absent = 1;
    printf("Sensor absent\n");
}

void handle_sensor_bus_error() {
    uv_sensor_bus_error = 1;
    printf("Sensor bus error\n");
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        printf("Exiting due to signal %d\n", signum);
        pi_write_i2c(i2c_fd, HW_KEY, 0x00);
        pi_close();
        exit(0);
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    if (pi_init(0) < 0) {
        printf("Pi init failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_i2c_open(i2c_fd, I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_i2c_read(i2c_fd, UV_PART_ID, 1) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_i2c_read(i2c_fd, HW_KEY, 1) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_i2c_read(i2c_fd, CHLIST, 1) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_i2c_read(i2c_fd, CHLIST, 1) & (1 << UV_INDEX) == 0) {
        printf("UV sensor not enabled\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_i2c_read(i2c_fd, CHLIST, 1) & (1 << ALS_VIS) == 0) {
        printf("ALS sensor not enabled\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_i2c_write(i2c_fd, HW_KEY, 0x17) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_i2c_write_i2c(i2c_fd, ALS_FORCE, 0x06) < 0) {
        handle_i2c_error(-1);
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        if (uv_sensor_absent || uv_sensor_bus_error) {
            printf("Sensor absent or bus error, exiting...\n");
            pi_write_i2c(i2c_fd, HW_KEY, 0x00);
            pi_close();
            exit(0);
        }

        struct timespec ts;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);

        char timestamp[128];
        strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), TIMESTAMP_FORMAT, &ts);

        int uv_index;
        int als_visible;

        if (pi_i2c_read(i2c_fd, UV_INDEX, 1) < 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(-1);
            return 1;
        }

        uv_index = pi_i2c_read(i2c_fd, UV_INDEX, 1);

        if (pi_i2c_read(i2c_fd, ALS_VIS, 1) < 0) {
            handle_i2c_error(-1);
            return 1;
        }

        als_visible = pi_i2c_read(i2c_fd, ALS_VIS, 1);

        printf("%s, %d, %d\n", timestamp, uv_index, als_visible);

        FILE *fp = fopen("uv_als_log.csv", "a");
        if (fp == NULL) {
            perror("Error opening file");
            return 1;
        }

        fprintf(fp, "%s, %d, %d\n", timestamp, uv_index, als_visible);
        fclose(fp);

        sleep(1);
    }

    return 0;
}

#define BUFFER_SIZE 100

typedef struct {
    uint8_t sensor;
    uint64_t timestamp;
    uint8_t newState;
} LogEntry;

LogEntry log_buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
uint8_t log_index = 0;

    gpioTerminate();
    printf("Logging buffer:\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {

    exit(0);
}

void handle_sigterm(int sig) {
    handle_sigint(sig);
}

int main() {

        entry.timestamp = timestamp;
        entry.newState = 0;

            entry.newState = 1;

            entry.newState = 0;

            log_buffer[log_index] = entry;

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define LOG_FILE "/var/log/rain_events.log"
#define POLL_INTERVAL_MS 500
#define LOG_MESSAGE_NO_RAIN "No Rain"
#define LOG_MESSAGE_RAIN_DETECTED "Rain Detected"

int main() {
    int fd;
    char buffer[256];
    struct timespec ts;
    int status;
    int rain_detected = 0;
    pid_t pid = getpid();

    if (gpio_init() < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "pigpio init failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_pull_up_down(17, PUD_UP) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Setting pull-up on GPIO 17 failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    fd = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open log file %s\n", LOG_FILE);
        return 1;
    }

    if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to get current time\n");
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        if ((status = gpio_get_named("17")) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read GPIO 17\n");
            return 1;
        }

        if (status == 1) {
            rain_detected = 1;
            if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) < 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "Failed to get current time\n");
                return 1;
            }
            snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%ld %s\n", ts.tv_sec, LOG_MESSAGE_RAIN_DETECTED);
            if (fprintf(fd, buffer) < 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "Failed to write to log file\n");
                return 1;
            }
        } else {
            rain_detected = 0;
            if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) < 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "Failed to get current time\n");
                return 1;
            }
            snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%ld %s\n", ts.tv_sec, LOG_MESSAGE_NO_RAIN);
            if (fprintf(fd, buffer) < 0) {
                fprintf(stderr, "Failed to write to log file\n");
                return 1;
            }
        }

        if (sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_MS / 1000) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Failed to sleep for %d ms\n", POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    fclose(fd);
    return 0;
}

void signal_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Received signal %d, shutting down\n", signum);
        gpioTerminate();
        fclose(fd);
        exit(0);
    }
}

            sensor1_state = 0;

            sensor2_state = 1;

        prev_state1 = sensor1_state;

Log all tilt-start, threshold-exceeded, and tilt-end events with ISO-8601 timestamps (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) to 'bridge_integrity.log'. Check pigpio initialization, log file opening, and gpioRead return values. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define BUFFER_SIZE 256
#define LOG_FILE "bridge_integrity.log"
#define ALARM_PIN 27
#define SENSOR1_PIN 17
#define SENSOR2_PIN 18
#define THRESHOLD 1000
#define POLL_INTERVAL 100000  // 100 ms

int alarm_on = 0;
int sensor1 = 0;
int sensor2 = 0;
int alarm_active = 0;
int alarm_deactivated = 0;
char log_buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
char log_timestamp_buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];

void log_event(const char *event, int sensor1, int sensor2) {
    time_t rawtime;
    struct tm * timeinfo;
    char log_time_buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];

    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);

    strftime(log_timestamp_buffer, BUFFER_SIZE, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", timeinfo);

    snprintf(log_buffer, BUFFER_SIZE, "%s: %s, sensor1=%d, sensor2=%d\n", log_timestamp_buffer, event, sensor1, sensor2);

    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file) {
        fprintf(log_file, "%s", log_buffer);
        fclose(log_file);
    } else {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
    }
}

void handle_alarm(int sig) {
    alarm_deactivated = 1;
    gpioSetMode(ALARM_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioWrite(ALARM_PIN, 0);
    log_event("Alarm deactivated", 0, 0);
    exit(0);
}

void handle_signal(int sig) {
    if (sig == SIGINT || sig == SIGTERM) {
        handle_alarm(sig);
    }
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio initialization failed");
        return 1;
    }

    gpioSetMode(SENSOR1_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    gpioSetMode(SENSOR2_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    gpioSetPullDownCallback(SENSOR1_PIN, NULL);
    gpioSetPullDownCallback(SENSOR2_PIN, NULL);

    gpioSetMode(ALARM_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    gpioSetPullUpCallback(ALARM_PIN, NULL);

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    while (1) {
        sensor1 = gpioRead(SENSOR1_PIN);
        sensor2 = gpioRead(SENSOR2_PIN);

        if (sensor1 && sensor2) {
            if (!alarm_on) {
                alarm_on = 1;
                log_event("Tilt started", sensor1, sensor2);
            }
        } else if (!sensor1 && !sensor2) {
            if (alarm_on) {
                alarm_on = 0;
                log_event("Tilt ended", sensor1, sensor2);
                alarm_deactivated = 1;
            }
        }

        if (sensor1 || sensor2) {
            if (!alarm_active) {
                alarm_active = 1;
                log_event("Threshold exceeded", sensor1, sensor2);
            }
        } else {
            if (alarm_active) {
                alarm_active = 0;
                log_event("Threshold cleared", sensor1, sensor2);
                alarm_deactivated = 1;
            }
        }

        if (alarm_active && alarm_deactivated) {
            alarm_deactivated = 0;
            gpioSetMode(ALARM_PIN, PI_INPUT);
            gpioWrite(ALARM_PIN, 0);
            log_event("Alarm deactivated", 0, 0);
        }

        gpioDelay(POLL_INTERVAL);

        if (alarm_active && alarm_deactivated) {
            alarm_deactivated = 0;
            gpioSetMode(ALARM_PIN, PI_INPUT);
            gpioWrite(ALARM_PIN, 0);
            log_event("Alarm deactivated", 0, 0);
        }
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

Poll the sensor every 500 milliseconds and log every reading with a timestamp to 'fire_events.log' (append mode). When a flame is detected (LOW), trigger an alert by setting GPIO 17 (BCM) HIGH for 1 second, then LOW. Check pigpio initialization, log file opening, and every GPIO read/write call; handle sensor read failures by logging the error and continuing. Ensure clean resource release (close the log file, reset GPIO, terminate pigpio) on all exit paths, including SIGINT (Ctrl+C), using signal-safe cleanup and avoiding unsafe functions in signal handlers.

</think>

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define LOG_FILE "fire_events.log"
#define GPIO_FLAME 4
#define GPIO_ALERT 17
#define POLL_INTERVAL 500000  // 500 ms in microseconds

void log_event(const char *message) {
    FILE *log = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return;
    }
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm *local = localtime(&now);
    fprintf(log, "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S %s\n", local->tm_year + 1900, local->tm_mon + 1, local->tm_mday, message);
    fclose(log);
}

void alert_flame() {
    gpioSetMode(GPIO_ALERT, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioWrite(GPIO_ALERT, 1);
    usleep(1000000); // 1 second
    gpioWrite(GPIO_ALERT, 0);
    gpioSetMode(GPIO_ALERT, PI_INPUT);
}

void cleanup() {
    gpioTerminate();
    fclose(log_file);
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio initialization failed");
        return 1;
    }

    int log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }
    log_file = fdopen(log_file, "a");

    if (signal(SIGINT, cleanup) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("Failed to set signal handler for SIGINT");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    if (signal(SIGTERM, cleanup) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("Failed to set signal handler for SIGTERM");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        int flame = gpioRead(GPIO_FLAME);
        if (flame == PI_BAD) {
            perror("Failed to read GPIO");
            log_event("Error reading GPIO");
            continue;
        }

        log_event("Flame detected: " + (flame ? "HIGH" : "LOW"));
        if (flame == 0) {
            alert_flame();
        }

        usleep(POLL_INTERVAL);
    }

    cleanup();
    return 0;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 5 that uses the libgpiod library to read capacitive touch events from a TTP223 touch sensor connected to GPIO4 (physical pin 7), configured as an input with a pull-down bias. Poll the line with a debounce interval of approximately 50 ms, and on every press or release transition append a line to the text file 'touch_log.txt' in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS: Touch Detected' or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS: Touch Released', flushing the file after each write. Verify every libgpiod call and print a diagnostic to stderr on failure; if the log file cannot be opened, release all GPIO resources before exiting with a non-zero status. Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM for graceful shutdown by releasing the line, closing the chip, closing the log file, and exiting cleanly.

</think>
```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define GPIO_PIN 4
#define DEBOUNCE_MS 50
#define LOG_FILE "touch_log.txt"

int main() {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct timespec ts;
    char buffer[128];
    FILE *log_file;

    // Open the GPIO chip
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod")) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Find the GPIO line
    if ((line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO_PIN)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the line to input with pull-down bias
    if (gpiod_line_set_direction(line, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_IN) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_direction");
        gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the pull-down bias
    if (gpiod_line_set_pull(line, GPIOD_LINE_PULL_DOWN) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_pull");
        gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Create an edge for the line
    if ((edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the debounce interval
    if (gpiod_edge_set_edge_mode(edge, GPIOD_EDGE_MODE_DEBOUNCE) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_edge_set_edge_mode");
        gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpiod_edge_set_debounce_time(edge, DEBOUNCE_MS) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_edge_set_debounce_time");
        gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Open the log file
    if ((log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a")) == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Get the current time
        if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) < 0) {
            perror("clock_gettime");
            gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            return 1;
        }

        // Check for edge events
        if (gpiod_edge_get_edge_status(edge, &ts) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_edge_get_edge_status");
            gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            return 1;
        }

        // Check for press or release
        if (edge->edge_status == GPIOD_EDGE_RISING) {
            // Touch detected
            if (fprintf(log_file, "%s Touch Detected\n", ctime(&ts.tv_sec))) {
                if (fflush(log_file) < 0) {
                    perror("fflush");
                    gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
                    fclose(log_file);
                    return 1;
                }
            }
        } else if (edge->edge_status == GPIOD_EDGE_FALLING) {
            // Touch released
            if (fprintf(log_file, "%s Touch Released\n", ctime(&ts.tv_sec))) {
                if (fflush(log_file) < 0) {
                    perror("fflush");
                    gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
                    fclose(log_file);
                    return 1;
                }
            }
        }

        // Sleep for debounce interval
        if (nanosleep(&ts.tv_sec, &ts.tv_nsec) < 0) {
            perror("nanosleep");
            gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    // Graceful shutdown
    gpiod_edge_free(edge);
    gpiod_line_free(line);
    gpiod_chip_unexport(chip);
    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;
}

**Note:** This code assumes that the TTP223 touch sensor is connected to GPIO4 (physical pin 7) and configured as an input with a pull-down bias. The log file is opened in append mode to ensure that new events are added to the end of the file. The program will exit cleanly if SIGINT or SIGTERM is received, releasing all GPIO resources and closing the log file.

Poll all three lines every 50 ms and append each reading (0 or 1 per sensor) with an ISO-8601 timestamp to a CSV file named 'path_log.csv' with columns timestamp,left,middle,right. Verify that the gpiochip opens successfully, that each line can be requested as input, and that file I/O succeeds. Handle SIGINT cleanly by releasing all GPIO lines, closing the chip, flushing, and closing the log file before exiting. Include the necessary system headers, such as errno.h and stdbool.h, so the code compiles without warnings under gcc -Wall -Wextra.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO27 27
#define GPIO22 22
#define POLL_INTERVAL 50000  // 50 ms
#define LOG_FILE "path_log.csv"

static void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    gpiod_line_close(line);
    gpiod_line_unref(line);
    gpiod_chip_unref(chip);
    fclose(log_file);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct gpiod_state *state;
    char buffer[128];
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "w");

    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod") < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod device");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    chip = gpiod_chip_get_default();
    if (!chip) {
        perror("Failed to get default chip");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO17, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, &line) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO17 line");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO27, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, &line) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO27 line");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO22, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, &line) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO22 line");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (gpiod_chip_request_edge(chip, line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH, &edge) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request edge");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    state = gpiod_chip_get_state(chip);
    if (state->state != GPIOD_STATE_ACTIVE) {
        perror("Chip is not active");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    while (1) {
        snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%ld,%d,%d,%d\n", (long)time(NULL), line->value, line->next->value, line->next->next->value);
        fprintf(log_file, buffer);

        usleep(POLL_INTERVAL);

        if (gpiod_line_poll(line, edge, POLL_INTERVAL) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to poll line");
            return EXIT_FAILURE;
        }
    }

    fclose(log_file);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

        perror("pi_init failed");

    }

    int i2c = i2c_open(I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR, 0);
    if (i2c == -1) {

            if (i2c_read_byte_data(i2c, 0x2A, 0) == -1) {

        if (count == 0) {

        moving_avg /= count;
        if (moving_avg < BPM_MIN || moving_avg > BPM_MAX) {

        if (fwrite(buffer, 1, strlen(buffer), f) != strlen(buffer)) {

    int fd, line, chip;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct gpiod_state *state;
    char buffer[128];
    char timestamp[128];
    int edge_detected = 0;
    int flame_detected = 0;
    int running = 1;

    // Open the log file in append mode
    fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up signal handlers
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = [](int sig) {
        if (running) {
            flame_detected = 0;
            edge_detected = 0;
            running = 0;
            close(fd);
            gpiod_chip_free(chip);
            return 0;
        }
        return 0;
    };
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    // Get the GPIO chip for GPIO17
    chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (chip == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO chip");
        return 1;
    }

    // Find the line for GPIO17
    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, 17);
    if (line == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to find GPIO17 line");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up the line as input with internal pull-up
    line = gpiod_line_request_input(line, 1);
    if (line == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to set line as input");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up edge detection
    edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_FALLING);
    if (edge == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to set edge detection");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Get the state of the line
    state = gpiod_line_request_state(edge, 0);
    if (state == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get line state");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Start polling
    while (running) {
        // Read the current state
        if (gpiod_state_get(state, &flame_detected) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to get line state");
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            return 1;
        }

        // Check for edge detection
        if (edge_detected) {
            // Record the timestamp
            if (strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), LOG_FORMAT, localtime()) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to format timestamp");
                return 1;
            }
            if (write(fd, timestamp, strlen(timestamp)) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to write to log file");
                return 1;
            }
            if (write(fd, "FLAME DETECTED\n", 13) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to write to log file");
                return 1;
            }

            // Print to console
            printf("FLAME DETECTED\n");

            // Reset edge detection
            edge_detected = 0;
        }

        // Poll every 100 ms
        usleep(100000);
    }

    // Clean up
    if (running) {
        flame_detected = 0;
        edge_detected = 0;
        running = 0;
        close(fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    }

    return 0;

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define SENSOR_1 1
#define SENSOR_2 2
#define DEBOUNCE_WINDOW 50
#define POLL_INTERVAL 100

int main() {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct gpiod_event *event;
    struct timespec ts;
    char buffer[256];
    char log_filename[256];
    char log_msg[256];
    int line_fd;
    int line_state;
    int event_detected;
    int event_count = 0;

    // Set up log file
    snprintf(log_filename, sizeof(log_filename), "/var/log/tilt_events.log");
    if ((fd = open(log_filename, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up signal handlers
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = [](int sig) {
        if (sig == SIGINT || sig == SIGTERM) {
            // Release all resources
            if (chip) {
                gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                chip = NULL;
            }
            if (line) {
                gpiod_line_unref(line);
                line = NULL;
            }
            if (edge) {
                gpiod_edge_unref(edge);
                edge = NULL;
            }
            if (event) {
                gpiod_event_unref(event);
                event = NULL;
            }
            if (fd) {
                close(fd);
                fd = -1;
            }
            syslog(LOG_INFO, "Tilt sensor monitoring stopped");
            return 0;
        }
        return -1;
    };
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    // Open GPIO chip
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod")) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO chip");
        return 1;
    }

    // Get GPIO lines
    if ((line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, SENSOR_1)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line 1");
        return 1;
    }
    if ((line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, SENSOR_2)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO line 2");
        return 1;
    }

    // Configure lines
    if (gpiod_line_request(line, GPIOD_LINE_MODE_INPUT, GPIOD_LINE_ACTIVE_LOW, GPIOD_LINE_PULL_UP)) {
        perror("Failed to configure GPIO line");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up edge detection
    if ((edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_FALLING, DEBOUNCE_WINDOW)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to set up edge detection");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up event handling
    if ((event = gpiod_line_request_event(line, GPIOD_LINE_EVENT_EDGE, GPIOD_LINE_EVENT_EDGE_FALLING)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to set up event handling");
        return 1;
    }

    // Poll lines
    while (1) {
        // Get current time
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);

        // Read line states
        if ((line_fd = gpiod_line_request_read(line)) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read GPIO line");
            return 1;
        }
        line_state = gpiod_line_read(line);
        gpiod_line_release_read(line_fd);
        line_fd = -1;

        // Check for event
        if (line_state == 0) {
            event_detected = 1;
        } else {
            event_detected = 0;
        }

        // Log event if detected
        if (event_detected && (event_count % 2 == 0)) {
            event_count++;
            snprintf(log_msg, sizeof(log_msg), "%s, Sensor %d tilted\n", ctime(&ts.tv_sec), SENSOR_1);
            if (write(fd, log_msg, strlen(log_msg)) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to write to log file");
                return 1;
            }
        }

        // Sleep for POLL_INTERVAL
        nanosleep(&ts, NULL);

        // Check for SIGINT or SIGTERM
        if (sigwaitignore(&sa.sa_mask, &sig) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to wait for signal");
            return 1;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

    struct gpiod_line *line;

    char buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int i, status;

    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        long long timestamp = ts.tv_sec * 1000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000;

        // Get line values
        for (i = 0; i < NUM_LINES; i++) {
            line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, i);

                perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");

        fflush(stdout);

        // Sleep for POLL_INTERVAL_MS
        nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
    }

    // Graceful shutdown
    handle_signal(EXIT_SUCCESS);

    return 0;
}

// Handle signal
void handle_signal(int signum) {
    // Release all resources
    for (i = 0; i < NUM_LINES; i++) {
        line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, i);
        if (line == NULL) {
            continue;

        gpiod_line_free(line);

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define APA102_MOSI 10
#define APA102_SCLK 11
#define BH1750_ADDR_LOW 0x23
#define BH1750_ADDR_HIGH 0x5C
#define BH1750_CMD_ONE_TIME_HIGH_RES_MODE_2 0x21
#define BH1750_CMD_MEASURE 0x51
#define BH1750_MEASUREMENT_TIMEOUT 180
#define BH1750_MEASUREMENT_RESULT_BYTES 2
#define BH1750_MEASUREMENT_RESULT_LUX 0x0F
#define BH1750_MEASUREMENT_RESULT_ERROR 0x10
#define APA102_MAX_BRIGHTNESS 31
#define APA102_FADE_TIME 500
#define APA102_DELAY 100

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    // Turn off APA102 strip
    gpio_write(APA102_MOSI, 0);
    gpio_delay(APA102_DELAY);

    // Close I2C handles
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (i2c_open(i, BH1750_ADDR_LOW + (i == 1 ? 0x40 : 0), I2C_MASTER, 0) == 0) {
            i2c_close(i);
        }
    }

    // Close SPI handle
    spi_close(0);

    // Terminate pigpio
    pigpio_stop();
}

int main() {
    // Initialize pigpio
    if (pigpio_init(NULL) < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_init");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up signal handler for SIGINT
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    // Set up APA102 strip
    if (gpio_initialise() < 0) {
        perror("gpio_initialise");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up SPI for APA102 strip
    if (spi_open(0, APA102_MOSI, APA102_SCLK) < 0) {
        perror("spi_open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Initialize BH1750 sensors
    int bh1750_sensors[2] = {0, 0};
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        int fd = i2c_open(i, BH1750_ADDR_LOW + (i == 1 ? 0x40 : 0), I2C_MASTER, 0);
        if (fd < 0) {
            printf("BH1750 sensor %d not found\n", i);
            continue;
        }
        i2c_ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, (unsigned char *) &BH1750_CMD_ONE_TIME_HIGH_RES_MODE_2, 1);
        gpio_delay(BH1750_MEASUREMENT_TIMEOUT);
        uint16_t measurement = i2c_read(fd, BH1750_MEASUREMENT_RESULT_BYTES);
        if (measurement & 0x10) {
            printf("BH1750 sensor %d reported error\n", i);
            i2c_close(fd);
            continue;
        }
        bh1750_sensors[i] = (uint16_t) (measurement & 0x0F) * 16;
        i2c_close(fd);
    }

    // Calculate average lux
    int average_lux = 0;
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (bh1750_sensors[i] > 0) {
            average_lux += bh1750_sensors[i];
            count++;
        }
    }
    if (count > 0) {
        average_lux /= count;
    }

    // Map average lux to global brightness
    int target_brightness = (int) (average_lux / 100.0 * APA102_MAX_BRIGHTNESS);

    // Fade to target brightness
    int current_brightness = 0;
    int fade_step = 1;
    while (1) {
        // Calculate fade step
        if (current_brightness < target_brightness) {
            current_brightness += fade_step;
        } else {
            current_brightness -= fade_step;
        }

        // Update APA102 strip brightness
        spi_write(0, APA102_MAX_BRIGHTNESS - current_brightness);

        // Delay
        gpio_delay(APA102_DELAY);

        // Check for SIGINT
        if (sigwaitignore(SIGINT, NULL) < 0) {
            handle_sigint(0);
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x23
#define BH1750_CMD 0x10
#define BH1750_RES 0x01
#define BH1750_RES_1HZ 0x01
#define BH1750_RES_0HZ 0x00

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO17_SYSFS "/sys/class/gpio/gpio" GPIO17

#define MAX_BUFFER_SIZE 60
#define MIN_LUX 0.5
#define MAX_LUX 5.0

typedef struct {
    uint8_t raw[2];
    double lux;
    double avg_lux;
} BH1750Data;

static BH1750Data buffer[MAX_BUFFER_SIZE];
static int buffer_index = 0;
static int buffer_full = 0;
static int i2c_fd;
static int gpio_fd;

void i2c_read() {
    if ((i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open i2c device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, BH1750_CMD | BH1750_RES) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read BH1750");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return;
    }

    if (read(i2c_fd, buffer->raw, 2) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read BH1750 data");
        close(i2c_fd);
        return;
    }

    buffer->lux = (double) buffer->raw[0] * 256.0 + buffer->raw[1] / 100.0;
    buffer->lux /= 1.2;

    if (buffer->lux > 1000) {
        buffer->lux = 1000.0;
    }

    if (buffer_full) {
        buffer_index = (buffer_index + 1) % MAX_BUFFER_SIZE;
        buffer_full = 0;
    } else {
        buffer_full = 1;
    }

    ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_RESTART) | I2C_SMBUS_STOP;
    close(i2c_fd);
}

void gpio_write(double lux) {
    if (access(GPIO17_SYSFS "direction", F_OK) < 0) {
        if (mkfifo(GPIO17_SYSFS "direction", 0666) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to create GPIO direction file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    if (access(GPIO17_SYSFS "value", F_OK) < 0) {
        if (mkfifo(GPIO17_SYSFS "value", 0666) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to create GPIO value file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    if (gpio_fd = open(GPIO17_SYSFS "direction", O_WRONLY) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO direction file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (write(gpio_fd, "out", 3) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO direction");
        close(gpio_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpio_fd = open(GPIO17_SYSFS "value", O_WRONLY) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO value file");
        close(gpio_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    double rate = MIN_LUX + (lux / 1000.0) * (MAX_LUX - MIN_LUX);
    int period = 2000000 / (int) rate;
    int on = period / 2;

    if (write(gpio_fd, &on, sizeof(on)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write GPIO value");
        close(gpio_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    close(gpio_fd);
}

void cleanup() {
    if (gpio_fd) {
        close(gpio_fd);
    }

    if (i2c_fd) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }

    if (access(GPIO17_SYSFS "direction", F_OK) == 0) {
        if (unlink(GPIO17_SYSFS "direction") < 0) {
            perror("Failed to remove GPIO direction file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }

    if (access(GPIO17_SYSFS "value", F_OK) == 0) {
        if (unlink(GPIO17_SYSFS "value") < 0) {
            perror("Failed to remove GPIO value file");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

void signal_handler(int signum) {
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);

    while (1) {
        i2c_read();

        if (buffer_full) {
            buffer_index = (buffer_index + 1) % MAX_BUFFER_SIZE;
            buffer_full = 0;
        }

        buffer[buffer_index].avg_lux = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
            if (i == buffer_index) continue;
            buffer[buffer_index].avg_lux += buffer[i].lux;
        }

        buffer[buffer_index].avg_lux /= MAX_BUFFER_SIZE;

        gpio_write(buffer[buffer_index].avg_lux);

        usleep(1000000);
    }

    return 0;
}

Sample every 100 ms, reading the range status register (0x04d) to detect errors such as overrange or signal failure. If the measured distance is less than 100 mm, log 'DOOR_OPEN'; otherwise log 'DOOR_CLOSED'. Log timestamped readings to 'distance_log.txt'. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x29
#define VL6180X_REG_0x016 0x16
#define VL6180X_REG_0x000 0x00
#define VL6180X_REG_0x0207 0x07
#define VL6180X_REG_0x04D 0x4d

#define MAX_LOG_ENTRIES 1000
#define LOG_FILE "distance_log.txt"

volatile sig_atomic_t running = 1;

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    running = 0;
    printf("SIGINT received, exiting...\n");
    piLock();
    piUnexport(0);
    piUnload();
    exit(0);
}

void init_vl6180x() {
    int fd;
    struct i2c_msg messages[2];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg ioctl_msg;
    int status;

    fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return;
    }

    ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);

    messages[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    messages[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    messages[0].len = 1;
    messages[0].buf = (unsigned char *) &VL6180X_REG_0x016;

    messages[1].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    messages[1].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    messages[1].len = 1;
    messages[1].buf = (unsigned char *) &VL6180X_REG_0x000;

    status = ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, messages);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to initialize VL6180X");
        return;
    }

    messages[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    messages[0].flags = I2C_M_WRITE;
    messages[0].len = 1;
    messages[0].buf = (unsigned char *) &VL6180X_REG_0x0207;

    status = ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, messages);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write VL6180X register");
        return;
    }

    close(fd);
}

void read_range_status() {
    int fd;
    struct i2c_msg messages[1];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg ioctl_msg;
    int status;

    fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return;
    }

    ioctl(fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);

    messages[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    messages[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
    messages[0].len = 1;
    messages[0].buf = (unsigned char *) &VL6180X_REG_0x04D;

    status = ioctl(fd, I2C_RDWR, messages);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read VL6180X range status");
        return;
    }

    close(fd);

    if (messages[0].buf[0] & 0x80) {
        printf("Error: VL6180X range status error\n");
    } else {
        printf("Distance: %.2f mm\n", (float) (messages[0].buf[0] & 0x7F) * 100);
    }
}

int main() {
    piLock();
    piUnexport(0);
    piUnload();

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    init_vl6180x();

    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return 1;
    }

    while (running) {
        piExport(0);
        piSetMode(0, PI_OUTPUT);
        piSetPullup(0, PI_PUPD_ON);
        piSetClock(0, 4000000);
        piSetServo(0, 0);
        piDelayMicroseconds(1000000); // 100 ms

        read_range_status();

        if (running) {
            if (piWrite(0, 0, 0) == 0) {
                if ((float) (piRead(0, 0) & 0x7F) * 100 < 100) {
                    fprintf(log_file, "%s DOOR_OPEN\n", ctime(&time(NULL)));
                } else {
                    fprintf(log_file, "%s DOOR_CLOSED\n", ctime(&time(NULL)));
                }
            } else {
                printf("Error writing to GPIO\n");
            }
        }

        piSetMode(0, PI_OFF);
        piUnexport(0);
        piLock();
    }

    fclose(log_file);
    piLock();
    piUnexport(0);
    piUnload();
    return 0;
}

}

void i2c_write(int reg_start, int reg_count, int *data) {
    int retries = 0;
    int reg_end = reg_start + reg_count * reg_size;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < reg_count; i++) {
        while (retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
            if (write(i2c_fd, &data[i], reg_size) < 0) {
                if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EIO) {
                    retries++;
                    usleep(I2C_TIMEOUT);
                } else {
                    perror("Failed to write to I2C");
                    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
                }
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        if (retries >= MAX_RETRIES) {
            perror("Failed to write to I2C after retries");
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }
    }
}

Check every I2C read/write call, handle sensor-absent and bus-error paths, and ensure clean resource release of the I2C handle, LED, log file, and pigpio on all exit paths including SIGINT/SIGTERM.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x53
#define ADXL345_ID 0xE5
#define LED_PIN 17
#define POLL_INTERVAL 10
#define IMPACT_THRESHOLD 2.5
#define SCALE_FACTOR 256

int i2c_fd;
int led_fd;
int log_fd;
int sensor_present = 0;
int bus_error = 0;
int sigint_received = 0;

void handle_sigint() {
    if (sigint_received) {
        printf("Caught SIGINT, exiting...\n");
        exit(0);
    }
    sigint_received = 1;
}

void handle_error(int error_code) {
    if (error_code) {
        printf("I2C error: %d\n", error_code);
        bus_error = 1;
    }
}

void handle_sensor_absent() {
    printf("Sensor not found, exiting...\n");
    exit(0);
}

void handle_bus_error() {
    printf("Bus error occurred, exiting...\n");
    exit(0);
}

void read_sensor_data() {
    int data[6];
    int i;
    int reg = 0x00;
    int reg_count = 1;
    int reg_data;

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &reg) < 0) {
        handle_error(ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, &reg));
        return;
    }

    if (read(i2c_fd, &reg_data, 1) < 0) {
        handle_error(read(i2c_fd, &reg_data, 1));
        return;
    }

    if (reg_data != ADXL345_ID) {
        handle_sensor_absent();
        return;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < reg_count; i++) {
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDMSB, reg + i) < 0) {
            handle_error(ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDMSB, reg + i));
            return;
        }

        if (read(i2c_fd, &data[i], 1) < 0) {
            handle_error(read(i2c_fd, &data[i], 1));
            return;
        }
    }

    int x = data[1] * SCALE_FACTOR / 256.0;
    int y = data[2] * SCALE_FACTOR / 256.0;
    int z = data[3] * SCALE_FACTOR / 256.0;

    double magnitude = sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z);

    if (magnitude > IMPACT_THRESHOLD) {
        printf("Impact detected! Magnitude: %.2f g\n", magnitude);
        gpioWrite(led_fd, 1);
        sleep(500);
        gpioWrite(led_fd, 0);

        char timestamp[100];
        struct tm *now;
        time_t t;
        t = time(NULL);
        now = localtime(&t);
        strftime(timestamp, 100, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", now);

        char log_entry[200];
        snprintf(log_entry, 200, "%s, X: %d, Y: %d, Z: %d\n", timestamp, x, y, z);

        if (write(log_fd, log_entry, strlen(log_entry)) < 0) {
            handle_error(write(log_fd, log_entry, strlen(log_entry)));
        }
    }
}

void init_i2c() {
    if ((i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        exit(1);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        exit(1);
    }

    sensor_present = 1;
}

void init_gpio() {
    if ((led_fd = gpioOpen(LED_PIN)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO");
        exit(1);
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(led_fd, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO mode");
        exit(1);
    }

    if (gpioSetPullUp(led_fd, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO pull-up");
        exit(1);
    }

    if (gpioSetPullDown(led_fd, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO pull-down");
        exit(1);
    }
}

void init_pigpio() {
    if (pigpio Haram()) {
        perror("Failed to initialize pigpio");
        exit(1);
    }
}

void cleanup() {
    if (sensor_present) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }

    if (led_fd >= 0) {
        gpioClose(led_fd);
    }

    if (log_fd >= 0) {
        close(log_fd);
    }

    if (i2c_fd >= 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }

    if (pigpio Haram()) {
        pigpio Haram();
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    init_pigpio();
    init_i2c();
    init_gpio();

    while (!sigint_received) {
        read_sensor_data();
        usleep(POLL_INTERVAL * 1000000);
    }

    cleanup();

    return 0;
}

#define LED_PIN 17

void i2c_read(int fd, uint8_t *buf, size_t size) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

void init_gpio() {
    chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (!chip) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO chip");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    line = gpiod_chip_new(chip, GPIO_LINE);
    if (!line) {

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (!event) {

    }

void cleanup() {

        gpiod_chip_release(chip);
    }
    if (i2c_fd >= 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
    if (gpio_fd >= 0) {
        close(gpio_fd);
    }
    if (event) {
        gpiod_event_release(event);
    }
    if (line) {
        gpiod_line_release(line, GPIO_LINE);
    }
    if (chip) {
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    }
    if (fopen(LOG_FILE, "r") != NULL) {
        fclose(fopen(LOG_FILE, "w"));
    }
}

int main() {
    init_i2c();
    read_i2c(0x00);
    if (buffer[0] != 0xE5) {
        log_data("Sensor ID mismatch, exiting\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    init_gpio();
    while (1) {
        handle_event(gpio_fd, event);
    }
    cleanup();
    return 0;

The read command sends the register address with bit 7 set (0x80 OR), and the response is returned in the next transaction. Read the X_GYRO_OUT register (0x14) every 10 ms, scale the value at 0.0305 deg/sec/LSB, and log timestamped angular-rate readings in degrees/sec to 'gyro_log.csv', opened once at startup with a CSV header rather than reopened on every write. Check every pigpio SPI call's return value, verify the WHO_AM_I register (expected 0x3F5A or a device-specific ID) on startup, and print informative error messages on failure. Handle SIGINT gracefully by closing the SPI handle, terminating pigpio, and closing the log file.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_MODE 3
#define SPI_FREQ 1000000
#define SPI_BYTES 2
#define SPI_REG_ADDR 0x14
#define ANGULAR_RATE_SCALE 0.0305
#define LOG_FILE "gyro_log.csv"

int spi_handle;
int log_fd;

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    if (log_fd != -1) {
        close(log_fd);
    }
    if (spi_handle != -1) {
        close(spi_handle);
    }
    pi_close();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    if (pi_init() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_mode(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("SPI mode set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_clock(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_FREQ) < 0) {
        perror("SPI clock set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_set_mode(piSPI_MODE0, piSPI_CS0) < 0) {
        perror("SPI CS set failed");
        return 1;
    }

    spi_handle = pi_spi_open(SPI_CHANNEL, SPI_MODE, SPI_FREQ, SPI_BYTES, 0);
    if (spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("SPI open failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (pi_write(spi_handle, 0x80 | SPI_REG_ADDR, SPI_BYTES) < 0) {
        perror("SPI write failed");
        return 1;
    }

    int whoami = pi_read(spi_handle, 0x00, SPI_BYTES);
    if (whoami < 0) {
        perror("SPI read failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (whoami != 0x3F5A) {
        printf("WHO_AM_I register value: 0x%02X\n", whoami);
        printf("Expected value: 0x3F5A\n");
        printf("Device-specific ID: 0x%02X\n", whoami);
        return 1;
    }

    if (log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_TRUNC, 0644) < 0) {
        perror("log file open failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (write(log_fd, "timestamp,angular_rate\n", 20) < 0) {
        perror("log file write failed");
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        if (pi_read(spi_handle, 0x00, SPI_BYTES) < 0) {
            perror("SPI read failed");
            return 1;
        }

        double angular_rate = (double) whoami * ANGULAR_RATE_SCALE;
        char buffer[100];
        sprintf(buffer, "%ld,%f\n", (long) time(NULL), angular_rate);
        if (write(log_fd, buffer, strlen(buffer)) < 0) {
            perror("log file write failed");
            return 1;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

Install a SIGINT handler so Ctrl+C sets a flag that stops the loop cleanly, and on any exit path close the log file if open and call gpioTerminate(). #define LOG_FILE "flame_events.log"
#define LOG_FORMAT "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS - Flame detected: YES|NO"
#define FLAME_PRESENT 0
#define NO_FLAME 1

volatile sig_atomic_t flame_detected = 0;
volatile sig_atomic_t exit_flag = 0;

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "pigpio init failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (open(LOG_FILE, O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_APPEND, 0644) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to open log file\n");
        return 1;
    }

    struct stat log_file_stat;
    fstat(open(LOG_FILE, O_RDONLY), &log_file_stat);
    if (log_file_stat.st_mode & S_IFREG) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Log file is not empty\n");
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    while (!exit_flag) {
        if (gpioRead(17) == FLAME_PRESENT) {
            flame_detected = 1;
            printf("FLAME DETECTED!\n");
        } else {
            flame_detected = 0;
        }

        if (flame_detected) {
            char log_line[128];
            struct tm *now = localtime(&time(NULL));
            strftime(log_line, sizeof(log_line), LOG_FORMAT, now);
            fprintf(stdout, "%s\n", log_line);
            fflush(stdout);
            fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", log_line);
            fflush(stderr);
        }

        usleep(500000); // 500ms delay
    }

    if (gpioTerminate() < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "pigpio terminate failed\n");
    }

    if (close(open(LOG_FILE, O_RDONLY)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to close log file\n");
    }

    return 0;
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    exit_flag = 1;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B that uses libgpiod (v1.6+ API) to monitor a conveyor belt safety system by reading the digital output of two TI DRV5032 digital Hall-Effect sensors connected to GPIO17 and GPIO27, configured as inputs with internal pull-ups enabled via bias flags. Log timestamps with millisecond precision and the sensor states to 'conveyor_log.txt' every 50 ms, and if both sensors read logic 1 (triggered), halt the conveyor, simulated with a print statement. Include robust error handling for GPIO access (chip opening, line requests, reads) and log file I/O, and handle SIGINT and SIGTERM for graceful shutdown, releasing all libgpiod resources cleanly on all exit paths.
raw:
<think>

</think>
```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <time.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO27 27
#define LOG_FILE "conveyor_log.txt"
#define LOG_FORMAT "%ld,%ld,%ld\n"

typedef struct {
    int gpio;
    int direction;
    int bias;
    int pull;
    int edge;
    int edge_dir;
} gpio_request_t;

void handle_signal(int sig) {
    if (sig == SIGINT || sig == SIGTERM) {
        gpiod_close_all();
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct timespec ts;
    char buffer[256];
    FILE *log_file;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod")) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO17, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_IN, GPIOD_LINE_BIAS_PULL_UP)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_request_line");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_EDGE_RISING)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO27, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_IN, GPIOD_LINE_BIAS_PULL_UP)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_request_line");
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        gpiod_line_free(edge);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((edge = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_EDGE_RISING)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        gpiod_line_free(edge);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        gpiod_line_free(edge);
        gpiod_line_free(edge);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    while (1) {
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        long long timestamp = ts.tv_sec * 1000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000;

        if (gpiod_line_get_value(line) == 1) {
            if (gpiod_edge_get_edge(edge) == 1) {
                printf("Both sensors triggered. Halting conveyor.\n");
            }
        }

        if (fprintf(log_file, LOG_FORMAT, timestamp, gpiod_line_get_value(line), gpiod_edge_get_edge(edge)) < 0) {
            perror("fprintf");
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (ferror(log_file)) {
            perror("ferror");
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (fprintf(log_file, "\n") < 0) {
            perror("fprintf");
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (ferror(log_file)) {
            perror("ferror");
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (sleep(50) == -1) {
            perror("sleep");
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_line_free(edge);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            fclose(log_file);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (gpiod_line_get_value(line) == 1) {
            if (gpiod_edge_get_edge(edge) == 1) {
                printf("Both sensors triggered. Halting conveyor.\n");
            }
        }
    }

    gpiod_line_free(edge);
    gpiod_line_free(edge);
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;
}

The `fprintf` calls are used to write log entries to the file, and error handling is included to ensure that the file is closed properly in case of an error.

#define I2C_ADDR 0x1E
#define WHO_AM_I 0x0F
#define XOUT 0x28
#define YOUT 0x29
#define ZOUT 0x2A

#define CTRL_REG4 0x0C
#define CTRL_REG3 0x00
#define CAL_X 0.000146
#define CAL_Y 0.000146
#define CAL_Z 0.000146
#define THRESHOLD 800.0

int i2c_fd;

void handle_error(int err, const char *msg) {
    if (err) {
        perror(msg);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void init_i2c() {
    if ((i2c_fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        handle_error(errno, "open i2c device");
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        handle_error(errno, "set slave address");
    }
}

void init_sensor() {
    int retries = 0;
    while (retries < 3) {
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_RDWR, 0) < 0) {
            handle_error(errno, "ioctl i2c");
        }
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_WRITE, 0, &CTRL_REG1, 1, 0) < 0) {
            handle_error(errno, "write CTRL_REG1");
        }
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_WRITE, 0, &CTRL_REG4, 1, 0) < 0) {
            handle_error(errno, "write CTRL_REG4");
        }
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_WRITE, 0, &CTRL_REG3, 1, 0) < 0) {
            handle_error(errno, "write CTRL_REG3");
        }
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, &WHO_AM_I, 1, 0) < 0) {
            handle_error(errno, "read WHO_AM_I");
        }
        if (memcmp(&WHO_AM_I, &0x3D, 1) == 0) {
            break;
        }
        retries++;
    }
    if (retries == 3) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Sensor not found after 3 retries\n");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void read_sensor() {
    int x, y, z;
    while (1) {
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, &XOUT, 1, 0) < 0) {
            handle_error(errno, "read XOUT");
        }
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, &YOUT, 1, 0) < 0) {
            handle_error(errno, "read YOUT");
        }
        if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, 0, &ZOUT, 1, 0) < 0) {
            handle_error(errno, "read ZOUT");
        }
        x = (int)((*((unsigned char *) &XOUT) << 8) | *((unsigned char *) &XOUT));
        y = (int)((*((unsigned char *) &YOUT) << 8) | *((unsigned char *) &YOUT));
        z = (int)((*((unsigned char *) &ZOUT) << 8) | *((unsigned char *) &ZOUT));
        x *= CAL_X;
        y *= CAL_Y;
        z *= CAL_Z;
        double total = x + y + z;

            fprintf(stderr, "Metal detected: %f mG\n", total);
        }
        char buf[100];
        sprintf(buf, "%f,%f,%f\n", x / CAL_X, y / CAL_Y, z / CAL_Z);
        write(STDERR, buf, strlen(buf));
        write(STDOUT, buf, strlen(buf));
        fflush(STDOUT);
    }
}

void cleanup() {
    if (i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(i2c_fd);
    }
}

void signal_handler(int sig) {
    cleanup();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {

    signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);
    init_i2c();
    init_sensor();

    return 0;
}

#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define SPI_CHANNEL 0
#define SPI_CLOCK 1000000
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_READ 0x80
#define SPI_MULTIBYTE 0x40
#define SPI_TIMEOUT 100
#define SPI_RETRIES 3
#define SPI_TIMEOUT_MS 1
#define SPI_FILE "vibration_log.txt"

#define ADXL354_RESET 0x52
#define ADXL354_PARTID 0x01
#define ADXL354_MEASUREMENT_MODE 0x00
#define ADXL354_RUN_BIT 0x40
#define ADXL354_STABLE_BIT 0x80
#define ADXL354_MEASUREMENT_STATUS 0x04

#define ADXL354_XDATA 0x08
#define ADXL354_YDATA 0x0B
#define ADXL354_ZDATA 0x0E

typedef struct {
    int spi_fd;
    int spi_handle;
    int file_fd;
} ADXL354Config;

void adxl354_init(ADXL354Config *config) {
    config->spi_fd = pigpio_spi_open(SPI_CHANNEL);
    if (config->spi_fd < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_open failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->spi_handle = pigpio_spi_set_mode(config->spi_fd, SPI_MODE);
    if (config->spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_set_mode failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->spi_handle = pigpio_spi_set_clock(config->spi_fd, SPI_CLOCK);
    if (config->spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_set_clock failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->spi_handle = pigpio_spi_set_bit_order(config->spi_fd, SPI_ORDER_MSB);
    if (config->spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_set_bit_order failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->spi_handle = pigpio_spi_set_speed(config->spi_fd, SPI_SPEED);
    if (config->spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_set_speed failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->spi_handle = pigpio_spi_set_read(config->spi_fd, SPI_READ);
    if (config->spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_set_read failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->spi_handle = pigpio_spi_set_multi_byte(config->spi_fd, SPI_MULTIBYTE);
    if (config->spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_set_multi_byte failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->spi_handle = pigpio_spi_set_timeout(config->spi_fd, SPI_TIMEOUT);
    if (config->spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_set_timeout failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->spi_handle = pigpio_spi_set_retries(config->spi_fd, SPI_RETRIES);
    if (config->spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_set_retries failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->spi_handle = pigpio_spi_set_timeout_ms(config->spi_fd, SPI_TIMEOUT_MS);
    if (config->spi_handle < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_set_timeout_ms failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    config->file_fd = fopen(SPI_FILE, "w");
    if (config->file_fd < 0) {
        perror("fopen failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void adxl354_reset(ADXL354Config *config) {
    int status = pigpio_spi_write(config->spi_fd, ADXL354_RESET, 1);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_write failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    usleep(SPI_TIMEOUT_MS * 1000);
}

void adxl354_measure_mode(ADXL354Config *config) {
    int status = pigpio_spi_write(config->spi_fd, 0x1F, 1);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_write failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    usleep(SPI_TIMEOUT_MS * 1000);

    status = pigpio_spi_write(config->spi_fd, 0x2D, 1);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_write failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    usleep(SPI_TIMEOUT_MS * 1000);

    status = pigpio_spi_read(config->spi_fd, 0x04, 1);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_read failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    usleep(SPI_TIMEOUT_MS * 1000);

    status = pigpio_spi_write(config->spi_fd, 0x2D, ADXL354_MEASUREMENT_MODE);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_write failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    usleep(SPI_TIMEOUT_MS * 1000);
}

void adxl354_log_data(ADXL354Config *config, int x, int y, int z) {
    struct timeval tv;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    fprintf(config->file_fd, "%ld.%06ld %d %d %d\n", tv.tv_sec, tv.tv_usec / 1000000.0, x, y, z);
}

void adxl354_read_data(ADXL354Config *config) {
    int status = pigpio_spi_read(config->spi_fd, ADXL354_XDATA, 1);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_read failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    int x = (int)(config->spi_data[0] << 16) >> 16;
    status = pigpio_spi_read(config->spi_fd, ADXL354_YDATA, 1);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_read failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    int y = (int)(config->spi_data[1] << 16) >> 16;
    status = pigpio_spi_read(config->spi_fd, ADXL354_ZDATA, 1);
    if (status < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_spi_read failed");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    int z = (int)(config->spi_data[2] << 16) >> 16;

    adxl354_log_data(config, x, y, z);
}

void adxl354_shutdown(ADXL354Config *config) {
    if (config->file_fd > 0) {
        fclose(config->file_fd);
    }

    if (config->spi_fd > 0) {
        pigpio_spi_close(config->spi_fd);
    }

    if (config->spi_handle > 0) {
        pigpio_spi_close(config->spi_handle);
    }

    pigpio_stop();
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    adxl354_shutdown(&config);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    ADXL354Config config;
    config.spi_fd = 0;
    config.spi_handle = 0;
    config.file_fd = 0;

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    adxl354_init(&config);
    adxl354_reset(&config);
    adxl354_measure_mode(&config);

    while (1) {
        adxl354_read_data(&config);
        usleep(100000);
    }

    return 0;
}
