#include <string.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define GPIO_CHIP 0
#define GPIO_LINE_1 17
#define GPIO_LINE_2 27
#define POLL_INTERVAL 100000  // 100 ms
#define LOG_FORMAT "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"

int main() {
    int line_fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line1, *line2;
    struct gpiod_request *request1, *request2;
    struct gpiod_value *value1, *value2;
    struct timespec ts;
    char buffer[128];

    // Initialize the GPIO chip
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open(GPIO_CHIP)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Request both lines
    if ((line1 = gpiod_chip_request_get(line1, GPIO_LINE_1, GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_INPUT)) == NULL ||
        (line2 = gpiod_chip_request_get(line2, GPIO_LINE_2, GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_INPUT)) == NULL) {
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        perror("gpiod_chip_request_get");
        return 1;
    }

    // Request values
    if ((request1 = gpiod_line_request_get_values(line1, GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_VALUES)) == NULL ||
        (request2 = gpiod_line_request_get_values(line2, GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_VALUES)) == NULL) {
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_request_close(line1);
        gpiod_line_request_close(line2);
        perror("gpiod_line_request_get_values");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set polling interval
    if (gpiod_line_request_set_poll_interval(request1, POLL_INTERVAL) < 0 ||
        gpiod_line_request_set_poll_interval(request2, POLL_INTERVAL) < 0) {
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_request_close(line1);
        gpiod_line_request_close(line2);
        perror("gpiod_line_request_set_poll_interval");
        return 1;
    }

    // Initialize timestamp
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);

    while (1) {
        // Read values
        if (gpiod_line_request_get_values(request1, value1) < 0 ||
            gpiod_line_request_get_values(request2, value2) < 0) {
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            gpiod_line_request_close(line1);
            gpiod_line_request_close(line2);
            perror("gpiod_line_request_get_values");
            return 1;
        }

        // Log status
        sprintf(buffer, "%s %d %d", ctime(&ts), value1->value, value2->value);

        // Check for obstacle
        if (value1->value == 0 || value2->value == 0) {
            printf("%s\n", buffer);
        }

        // Update timestamp
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);

        // Sleep for polling interval
        nanosleep(&ts, NULL);
    }

    // Cleanup
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    gpiod_line_request_close(line1);
    gpiod_line_request_close(line2);
    return 0;
}

#include <gpiod.h>

#define SPI_MODE_3 3
#define MSB_FIRST 1
#define SPI_CLOCK_SPEED 1000000
#define X_REG 0x04

#define Z_REG 0x08
#define MSC_CTRL 0x24

int spi_fd;
int spi_cs_fd;
struct gpiod_chip *chip;
struct gpiod_line *line;

void spi_init() {
    spi_fd = open("/dev/spidev0.0", O_RDWR);
    if (spi_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    line = gpiod_line_request(spi_cs_fd, SPI0_CE0, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_OUT);

        perror("Failed to request SPI CS line");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

        perror("Failed to open SPI chip");
        close(spi_fd);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    if ((edge = gpiod_edge_request(line->dev, GPIOD_EDGE_EDGE_NONE)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to request SPI chip edge");
        close(spi_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpiod_chip_request_edge(chip, edge) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request SPI chip edge");
        close(spi_fd);
        gpiod_edge_free(edge);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpiod_chip_enable(chip) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to enable SPI chip");
        close(spi_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_edge_free(edge);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MSC, MSC_CTRL) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write MSC_CTRL register");
        close(spi_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_edge_free(edge);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_DATA_READY, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read MSC_CTRL register");
        close(spi_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_edge_free(edge);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE_3) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write SPI mode");
        close(spi_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_edge_free(edge);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_BIT_ORDER, MSB_FIRST) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write bit order");
        close(spi_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_edge_free(edge);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SPD, SPI_CLOCK_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write SPI clock speed");
        close(spi_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_edge_free(edge);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

    uint8_t who_am_i;
    if ((err = i2cReadByte(fd, WHO_AM_I, 0)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "WHO_AM_I read failed: %d\n", err);
        i2cClose(fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }
    if (who_am_i != 0x6B) {
        fprintf(stderr, "WHO_AM_I mismatch: expected 0x6B, got 0x%02x\n", who_am_i);
        i2cClose(fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    // Configure accelerometer
    if ((err = i2cWriteByte(fd, 0x3A, 0x42)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Accelerometer CTRL1 write failed: %d\n", err);
        i2cClose(fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;

    // Configure gyroscope
    if ((err = i2cWriteByte(fd, 0x3B, 0x42)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Gyroscope CTRL2 write failed: %d\n", err);
        i2cClose(fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Burst read
        uint8_t data[12];
        if ((err = i2cBurstRead(fd, OUTX_L_G, 12, data)) < 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Burst read failed: %d\n", err);
            i2cClose(fd);
            gpioTerminate();
            return 1;
        }

        // Convert data
        double gyro_x = (data[0] << 8 | data[1]) * GYRO_SENSITIVITY;
        double gyro_y = (data[2] << 8 | data[3]) * GYRO_SENSITIVITY;
        double gyro_z = (data[4] << 8 | data[5]) * GYRO_SENSITIVITY;

        double accel_x = (data[6] << 8 | data[7]) * ACCEL_SENSITIVITY;
        double accel_y = (data[8] << 8 | data[9]) * ACCEL_SENSITIVITY;
        double accel_z = (data[10] << 8 | data[11]) * ACCEL_SENSITIVITY;

        // Print data
        printf("%.6f %.6f %.6f %.6f %.6f %.6f\n", gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z, accel_x, accel_y, accel_z);

static void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    if (I2CContext.i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(I2CContext.i2c_fd);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    I2CContext context;
    context.i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-1", O_RDWR);
    if (context.i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C bus");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (ioctl(context.i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set I2C slave address");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if (ioctl(context.i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_WRITE, BH1750_CMD_ONE_TIME_HIGH_RESOLUTION_MODE_2) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to write to BH1750");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    context.error = 0;

    FILE *log_file = fopen(LIGHT_LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    while (1) {
        if (context.error) {
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", context.error);
            context.error = 0;
        }

        if (ioctl(context.i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, BH1750_DATA_BYTE0) < 0) {
            context.error = -1;
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C read error\n");
            continue;
        }

        if (ioctl(context.i2c_fd, I2C_SMBUS_READ, BH1750_DATA_BYTE1) < 0) {
            context.error = -2;
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C read error\n");
            continue;
        }

        uint16_t raw_value = (uint16_t)(context.i2c_data[0] << 8 | context.i2c_data[1]);
        double lux = (raw_value * 5.0) / 6.0;

        char timestamp[128];
        time_t now = time(NULL);
        strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), LIGHT_LOG_FORMAT, localtime(&now));

        fprintf(log_file, "%s", timestamp);
        fflush(log_file);

        usleep(5000000); // 5 seconds
    }

cleanup:
    if (context.i2c_fd > 0) {
        close(context.i2c_fd);
    }
    fclose(log_file);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

The `BH1750_DATA_BYTE0` and `BH1750_DATA_BYTE1` are the addresses of the two bytes to read from the sensor. The `raw_value` is calculated using the formula provided, and the resulting `lux` value is printed to the log file. The program handles potential I2C errors and releases resources on all exit paths, including signal handling for SIGINT.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <time.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x1E
#define CTRL_REG1_M 0x20
#define OUT_X_L_M 0x08
#define OUT_X_H_M 0x0A
#define OUT_Y_L_M 0x0C
#define OUT_Y_H_M 0x0E
#define OUT_Z_L_M 0x10
#define OUT_Z_H_M 0x12
#define I2C_BLOCK_READ 0x40

#define LED_PIN 17
#define PWM_FREQ 1000000
#define PWM_RESOLUTION 16

int i2c_fd;
struct gpiod_handle *gpio_handle;
struct gpiod_line *gpio_line;
struct gpiod_state *gpio_state;
int pwm_fd;
int led_value = 0;

void i2c_error_handler(int err) {
    fprintf(stderr, "I2C error: %d\n", err);
    close(i2c_fd);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void gpio_error_handler(int err) {
    fprintf(stderr, "GPIO error: %d\n", err);
    gpiod_line_close(gpio_line);
    gpiod_handle_close(gpio_handle);
    close(pwm_fd);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void init_i2c() {
    i2c_fd = open("/dev/i2c-" I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        i2c_error_handler(errno);
    }
    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        i2c_error_handler(errno);
    }
}

void init_gpio() {
    gpio_handle = gpiod_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (!gpio_handle) {
        gpio_error_handler(errno);
    }
    gpio_state = gpiod_get_state(gpio_handle);
    if (!gpio_state) {
        gpio_error_handler(errno);
    }
    gpio_line = gpiod_get_line(gpio_handle, LED_PIN);
    if (!gpio_line) {
        gpio_error_handler(errno);
    }
    gpio_state = gpiod_get_state(gpio_handle);
    if (!gpio_state) {
        gpio_error_handler(errno);
    }
    gpio_line->direction = GPIODIRECTION_OUT;
    if (gpio_state->set(gpio_line, GPIODIRECTION_OUT) < 0) {
        gpio_error_handler(errno);
    }
    pwm_fd = gpiod_pwm_open(gpio_handle, LED_PIN);
    if (!pwm_fd) {
        gpio_error_handler(errno);
    }
    if (gpiod_pwm_set_frequency(pwm_fd, PWM_FREQ) < 0) {
        gpio_error_handler(errno);
    }
    if (gpiod_pwm_set_resolution(pwm_fd, PWM_RESOLUTION) < 0) {
        gpio_error_handler(errno);
    }
    led_value = 0;
    if (gpiod_pwm_write(pwm_fd, led_value) < 0) {
        gpio_error_handler(errno);
    }
}

void read_magnetometer() {
    int data[6];
    ssize_t bytes_read;
    if ((bytes_read = i2c_smbus_read_i2c_block_data(i2c_fd, OUT_X_L_M, 6, data)) < 0) {
        i2c_error_handler(errno);

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO4 4
#define PIR_PIN 4
#define RELAY_PIN 17
#define PIR_TIMEOUT 10000  // 10 seconds
#define POLL_INTERVAL 50    // 50 ms

int main() {
    int ret;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_line_request *request;
    struct gpiod_event *event;
    struct gpiod_event_request *event_request;
    struct gpiod_loop *loop;
    struct gpiod_loop_event *loop_event;
    int motion_detected = 0;
    int relay_state = 0;
    int timeout = 0;

    // Open the GPIO chip by name
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open("gpiochip0")) == NULL) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open GPIO chip: %s\n", gpiod_chip_errno(chip));
        return 1;
    }

    // Request the PIR pin
    if ((line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO4, GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_INPUT)) == NULL) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to request PIR pin: %s\n", gpiod_line_request_errno(line));
        gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Request the relay pin
    if ((line = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO17, GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_OUTPUT)) == NULL) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to request relay pin: %s\n", gpiod_line_request_errno(line));
        gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
        gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Set the relay pin to LOW
    if (gpiod_line_request_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set relay pin to LOW: %s\n", gpiod_line_request_errno(line));
        gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Create an event request for the PIR pin
    if ((event_request = gpiod_line_request_event(line, GPIOD_EVENT_EDGE_ANY)) == NULL) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to request event for PIR pin: %s\n", gpiod_line_request_event_errno(event_request));
        gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Create a loop to poll the PIR pin
    if ((loop = gpiod_loop_new()) == NULL) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to create loop: %s\n", gpiod_loop_new_errno(loop));
        gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Create an event request for the loop
    if ((event_request = gpiod_loop_request_event(loop, GPIOD_EVENT_EDGE_ANY)) == NULL) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to request event for loop: %s\n", gpiod_loop_request_event_errno(event_request));
        gpiod_loop_close(loop);
        gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Start the loop
    if (gpiod_loop_start(loop) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to start loop: %s\n", gpiod_loop_start_errno(loop));
        gpiod_loop_close(loop);
        gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        return 1;
    }

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Read the PIR pin
        if (gpiod_line_get_value(line, &motion_detected) < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to read PIR pin: %s\n", gpiod_line_get_value_errno(line));
            gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip);
            return 1;
        }

        // Check if motion is detected
        if (motion_detected) {
            // Energize the relay
            if (gpiod_line_request_set_value(line, 1) < 0) {
                syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to energize relay: %s\n", gpiod_line_request_set_value_errno(line));
                gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
                gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                return 1;
            }
            relay_state = 1;
            syslog(LOG_INFO, "Motion detected, energizing relay\n");
        } else {
            // De-energize the relay
            if (gpiod_line_request_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
                syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to de-energize relay: %s\n", gpiod_line_request_set_value_errno(line));
                gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
                gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                return 1;
            }
            relay_state = 0;
            syslog(LOG_INFO, "No motion detected, de-energizing relay\n");
        }

        // Check for timeout
        if (timeout >= PIR_TIMEOUT) {
            // De-energize the relay and log a warning
            if (gpiod_line_request_set_value(line, 0) < 0) {
                syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to de-energize relay: %s\n", gpiod_line_request_set_value_errno(line));
                gpiod_chip_unrequest_line(chip, line);
                gpiod_chip_close(chip);
                return 1;
            }
            relay_state = 0;
            syslog(LOG_WARNING, "PIR sensor remains HIGH for %d seconds, de-energizing relay\n", timeout);
        }

        // Poll the PIR pin every 50 ms
        usleep(POLL_INTERVAL * 1000);

        // Increment the timeout
        timeout++;
    }

    // Clean shutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM
    if (signal(SIGINT, [](int signum) {
        // Release all GPIO lines
        gpiod_line_request_release(line, event_request);
        gpiod_line_request_release(line, request);
        gpiod_chip_release(line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        // Close the log

        // Exit
        exit(0);
    }) == SIG_ERR) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set SIGINT handler: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return 1;
    }

    if (signal(SIGTERM, [](int signum) {
        // Release all GPIO lines
        gpiod_line_request_release(line, event_request);
        gpiod_line_request_release(line, request);
        gpiod_chip_release(line);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        // Close the log
        close(logfd);
        // Exit
        exit(0);
    }) == SIG_ERR) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set SIGTERM handler: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;

#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <time.h>

volatile sig_atomic_t running = 1;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Irrigation system shutting down...");
        running = 0;
        gpioTerminate();
        close_syslog();
        exit(0);
    }
}

void init_syslog() {
    openlog("irrigation_system", LOG_PID | LOG_CONS | LOG_NDELAY, LOG_LOCAL0);
}

void close_syslog() {
    closelog();
}

void log_state_change(int gpio, int state, time_t timestamp) {
    char buffer[256];
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&timestamp));
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Relay %d: %s -> %s (%s)", gpio, (state ? "ON" : "OFF"), (state ? "OFF" : "ON"), buffer);
}

int main() {
    init_syslog();

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "pigpioInitialise failed: %d", gpioInitialise());
        close_syslog();
        exit(1);
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(4, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "gpioSetMode(4, PI_OUTPUT) failed: %d", gpioSetMode(4, PI_OUTPUT));
        close_syslog();
        exit(1);
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(17, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "gpioSetMode(17, PI_OUTPUT) failed: %d", gpioSetMode(17, PI_OUTPUT));
        close_syslog();
        exit(1);
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(27, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "gpioSetMode(27, PI_OUTPUT) failed: %d", gpioSetMode(27, PI_OUTPUT));
        close_syslog();
        exit(1);
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(22, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "gpioSetMode(22, PI_OUTPUT) failed: %d", gpioSetMode(22, PI_OUTPUT));
        close_syslog();
        exit(1);
    }

    int relays[4] = {4, 17, 27, 22};
    int states[4] = {1, 1, 1, 1}; // 1 = HIGH (OFF), 0 = LOW (ON)
    int current = 0;
    time_t last_time = 0;
    time_t current_time = 0;
    time_t timer_start = 0;
    int timer_state = 0;

    gpioSetTimerFuncEx(0, 60, 0, (void (*)(void))timer_callback, NULL);

    while (running) {
        current_time = time(NULL);
        if (current_time - last_time >= 60) {
            last_time = current_time;
            timer_state = 1;
        }

        if (timer_state == 1) {
            if (current_time - timer_start >= 300) {
                states[current] = 0;
                log_state_change(relays[current], states[current], current_time);
                timer_start = current_time;
                timer_state = 0;
                current = (current + 1) % 4;
            } else {
                states[current] = 1;
                log_state_change(relays[current], states[current], current_time);
                timer_start = current_time;
                timer_state = 0;
            }
        }

        if (running) {
            sleep(1);
        }
    }

    handle_signal(SIGINT);
    handle_signal(SIGTERM);

    close_syslog();
    exit(0);
}

#define GPIO_PIN_18 18

#define RELAY_2 1
#define RELAY_3 2

    struct gpiod_line *line;

            perror("SIGINT");
        }
        if (signal(SIGTERM, [](int) { exit(EXIT_SUCCESS; }) == SIG_ERR) {
            perror("SIGTERM");
        }

        // Sleep for the interval
        clock_nanosleep(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, 0, &interval, NULL);

        // Toggle the relays

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define ALARM_LOG_FILE "alarm_log.txt"
#define ALARM_THRESHOLD 1000 // 1000 microseconds (1ms)
#define ALARM_DURATION 3000 // 3 seconds
#define DEBOUNCE_TIME 100 // 100ms

int alarm_active = 0;
int alarm_last_time = 0;
int alarm_last_state = 0;

void alarm_handler(int sig) {
    if (alarm_active) {
        printf("Shutting down alarm...\n");
        gpio_write(27, 0);
        alarm_active = 0;
        alarm_last_time = 0;
        alarm_last_state = 0;
    }
    printf("Received signal %d, shutting down...\n", sig);
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, alarm_handler);
    signal(SIGTERM, alarm_handler);

    if (gpio_initialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_mode(17, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting GPIO17 to input failed");
        gpio_deinit();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_pull_up(17, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Setting GPIO17 to pull-up failed");
        gpio_deinit();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_mode(27, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting GPIO27 to output failed");
        gpio_deinit();
        return 1;
    }

    FILE *log_file = fopen(ALARM_LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Opening log file failed");
        gpio_deinit();
        return 1;
    }

    while (1) {
        int state = gpio_read(17);
        if (state && !alarm_active && alarm_last_state != state) {
            alarm_active = 1;
            alarm_last_time = gpio_get_time();
            alarm_last_state = state;
            printf("Alarm triggered at %ld\n", alarm_last_time);
            gpio_write(27, 1);
            fprintf(log_file, "%ld\n", alarm_last_time);
        } else if (!state && alarm_active) {
            alarm_active = 0;
            alarm_last_time = 0;
            alarm_last_state = 0;
            gpio_write(27, 0);
            printf("Alarm deactivated at %ld\n", gpio_get_time());
        }

        if (alarm_active) {
            if (gpio_get_time() - alarm_last_time > ALARM_DURATION) {
                alarm_active = 0;
                alarm_last_time = 0;
                alarm_last_state = 0;
                gpio_write(27, 0);
                printf("Alarm duration expired at %ld\n", gpio_get_time());
            }
        }

        if (alarm_active) {
            if (gpio_get_time() - alarm_last_time > DEBOUNCE_TIME) {
                alarm_last_time = gpio_get_time();
            }
        }

        if (alarm_active) {
            fprintf(log_file, "%ld\n", gpio_get_time());
        }

        if (gpio_get_time() - alarm_last_time > 100) {
            alarm_last_time = gpio_get_time();
        }

        sleep(0.1);
    }

    gpio_write(27, 0);
    gpio_set_mode(27, PI_INPUT);
    gpio_deinit();
    fclose(log_file);
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>

#include <string.h>

#include <pigpio.h>

#define I2C_BUS 1
#define I2C_ADDR 0x1E
#define REG_A 0x00
#define REG_B 0x01
#define REG_MODE 0x02
#define REG_DATA 0x03
#define X_OFFSET 100
#define Y_OFFSET -50
#define TARGET_HEADING 90.0
#define DISTANCE_THRESHOLD 10.0
#define BUFFER_SIZE 100
#define BUFFER_MASK (BUFFER_SIZE - 1)

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int *addr;
    int *data;
    int *offsets;
    double *buffer;
    int buffer_size;
    int buffer_head;
    int buffer_tail;
} SensorConfig;

void handle_error(int err, const char *msg) {
    perror(msg);
    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

void init_sensor(SensorConfig *config) {
    config->fd = pigpio_open(config->fd, I2C_BUS, I2C_ADDR);
    if (config->fd < 0) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "pigpio_open");
    }

    config->addr = (int *)mmap(NULL, sizeof(int), PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, config->fd, 0);
    if (config->addr == MAP_FAILED) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "mmap");
    }

    config->data = (int *)mmap(NULL, sizeof(int), PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, config->fd, 0x03);
    if (config->data == MAP_FAILED) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "mmap");
    }

    config->offsets = (int *)malloc(2 * sizeof(int));
    config->offsets[0] = X_OFFSET;
    config->offsets[1] = Y_OFFSET;

    config->buffer = (double *)malloc(BUFFER_SIZE * sizeof(double));
    if (!config->buffer) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "malloc");
    }

    config->buffer_size = BUFFER_SIZE;
    config->buffer_head = 0;
    config->buffer_tail = 0;

    config->buffer[config->buffer_head] = TARGET_HEADING;
    config->buffer_tail = 0;
}

void configure_sensor(SensorConfig *config) {
    int reg_a = *config->addr;
    int reg_b = *config->addr + 1;
    int reg_mode = *config->addr + 2;

    int config_a = 0x70;
    int config_b = 0x20;
    int config_mode = 0x00;

    int reg_a_val = config_a;
    int reg_b_val = config_b;
    int reg_mode_val = config_mode;

    int reg_a_err = ioctl(config->fd, I2C_SLAVE, reg_a);
    if (reg_a_err < 0) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "ioctl");
    }
    *config->addr = reg_a_val;

    int reg_b_err = ioctl(config->fd, I2C_WRITE, reg_b, reg_b_val);
    if (reg_b_err < 0) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "ioctl");
    }

    int reg_mode_err = ioctl(config->fd, I2C_WRITE, reg_mode, reg_mode_val);
    if (reg_mode_err < 0) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "ioctl");
    }

    int reg_data_err = ioctl(config->fd, I2C_WRITE, REG_DATA, 0x00);
    if (reg_data_err < 0) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "ioctl");
    }
}

void read_sensor_data(SensorConfig *config) {
    int reg_data = *config->addr + 3;
    int reg_data_err = ioctl(config->fd, I2C_SLAVE, reg_data);
    if (reg_data_err < 0) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "ioctl");
    }

    int data = 0;
    int reg_data_err = ioctl(config->fd, I2C_READ, reg_data, &data);
    if (reg_data_err < 0) {
        handle_error(config->fd, "ioctl");
    }

    int x = (data & 0xFF00) >> 8;
    int z = data & 0xFF;
    int y = (data & 0xFF00) >> 8;

    double x_comp = x - config->offsets[0];
    double y_comp = y - config->offsets[1];

    double heading = atan2(y_comp, x_comp) * 180.0 / M_PI;

    config->buffer[config->buffer_head] = heading;
    config->buffer_tail = (config->buffer_tail + 1) & BUFFER_MASK;

    if (heading > TARGET_HEADING + DISTANCE_THRESHOLD || heading < TARGET_HEADING - DISTANCE_THRESHOLD) {
        gpio_set_mode(config->fd, PI_OUTPUT, 1);
        gpio setwpi_high(config->fd, 17);
    } else {
        gpio_set_mode(config->fd, PI_OUTPUT, 0);
        gpio setwpi_low(config->fd, 17);
    }
}

void cleanup_sensor(SensorConfig *config) {
    if (config->fd > 0) {
        pigpio_close(config->fd);
    }

    free(config->addr);
    free(config->data);
    free(config->offsets);
    free(config->buffer);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    cleanup_sensor(config);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    SensorConfig config;
    config.fd = 0;
    config.addr = NULL;
    config.data = NULL;
    config.offsets = NULL;
    config.buffer = NULL;
    config.buffer_size = 0;
    config.buffer_head = 0;
    config.buffer_tail = 0;

    init_sensor(&config);
    configure_sensor(&config);

    while (1) {
        read_sensor_data(&config);
        usleep(100000);
    }

    cleanup_sensor(&config);
    return 0;
}

#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define PWM_FREQ 1000
#define PWM_RANGE 255
#define MIN_DISTANCE 10
#define MAX_DISTANCE 100
#define THRESHOLD 50

int motorA_pwm = 17;
int motorB_pwm = 22;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    printf("Received SIGINT, stopping motor control...\n");
    stop_motors();
    exit(0);
}

void stop_motors() {
    gpioSetMode(motorA_pwm, PI_OFF);
    gpioSetMode(motorB_pwm, PI_OFF);
    gpioTerminate();
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    if (argc != 2) {
        printf("Usage: %s <distance>\n", argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    int distance = atoi(argv[1]);
    if (distance < MIN_DISTANCE || distance > MAX_DISTANCE) {
        printf("Invalid distance. Must be between %d and %d cm.\n", MIN_DISTANCE, MAX_DISTANCE);
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("gpioInitialise failed");
        return 1;
    }

    gpioSetMode(motorA_pwm, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetMode(motorB_pwm, PI_OUTPUT);

    int motorA_in1 = 17;
    int motorA_in2 = 18;
    int motorB_in3 = 22;
    int motorB_in4 = 23;

    gpioSetMode(motorA_in1, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetMode(motorA_in2, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetMode(motorB_in3, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetMode(motorB_in4, PI_OUTPUT);

    int motorA_pwm_duty = 0;
    int motorB_pwm_duty = 0;

    while (1) {
        usleep(100000); // 100 ms delay

        if (distance < THRESHOLD) {
            motorA_pwm_duty = PWM_RANGE;
            motorB_pwm_duty = PWM_RANGE;
        } else {
            motorA_pwm_duty = 0;
            motorB_pwm_duty = 0;
        }

        gpioWrite(motorA_in1, 1);
        gpioWrite(motorA_in2, 0);
        gpioWrite(motorB_in3, 1);
        gpioWrite(motorB_in4, 0);

        gpioSetPWMfreq(motorA_pwm, PWM_FREQ);
        gpioSetPWMdutycycle(motorA_pwm, motorA_pwm_duty);

        gpioSetPWMfreq(motorB_pwm, PWM_FREQ);
        gpioSetPWMdutycycle(motorB_pwm, motorB_pwm_duty);
    }

    return 0;
}

Prevent re-triggering while a button is held down. Handle pigpio initialisation failure and check every GPIO configuration return code. On SIGINT or SIGTERM, de-energize the motor coils and release all pigpio resources before exiting. Print console feedback for lock and unlock actions and for exit events.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO18 18
#define GPIO27 27
#define GPIO22 22
#define GPIO24 24
#define GPIO23 23

#define STEP_DELAY 2000  // 2 ms

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up GPIO17, GPIO18, GPIO27, GPIO22 as outputs
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO17, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO17 set to output failed");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO18, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO18 set to output failed");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO27, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO27 set to output failed");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO22, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO22 set to output failed");
        return 1;

    // Set up GPIO24 and GPIO23 as inputs with pull-up
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO24, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO24 set to input failed");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetPullUp(GPIO24, 1) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO24 pull-up enabled failed");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO23, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO23 set to input failed");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetPullUp(GPIO23, 1) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO23 pull-up enabled failed");
        return 1;
    }

    int button24_state = 0;
    int button23_state = 0;

    int steps = 0;
    int direction = 1; // 1 for clockwise, -1 for counter-clockwise

    signal(SIGINT, [](int) {
        printf("SIGINT received, de-energizing motor...\n");
        gpioWrite(GPIO17, 0);
        gpioWrite(GPIO18, 0);
        gpioWrite(GPIO27, 0);
        gpioWrite(GPIO22, 0);
        return 0;
    });

    signal(SIGTERM, [](int) {
        printf("SIGTERM received, de-energizing motor...\n");
        gpioWrite(GPIO17, 0);
        gpioWrite(GPIO18, 0);
        gpioWrite(GPIO27, 0);
        gpioWrite(GPIO22, 0);
        return 0;
    });

    while (1) {
        // Read button states
        button24_state = gpioRead(GPIO24);
        button23_state = gpioRead(GPIO23);

        if (button24_state == 0 && button23_state == 0) {
            // No buttons pressed, continue
            continue;
        }

        if (button24_state == 0) {
            // Button 24 pressed, rotate clockwise
            direction = 1;
            steps = 0;
        } else if (button23_state == 0) {
            // Button 23 pressed, rotate counter-clockwise
            direction = -1;
            steps = 0;
        }

        if (button24_state == 0 || button23_state == 0) {
            // Prevent re-triggering while a button is held down
            continue;
        }

        // Calculate number of steps to take
        int steps_to_take = 512 * direction;

        for (int i = 0; i < steps_to_take; i++) {
            // Drive the motor in full-step mode
            gpioWrite(GPIO17, 1);
            gpioDelay(STEP_DELAY);
            gpioWrite(GPIO18, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO27, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO22, 0);

            gpioWrite(GPIO17, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO18, 1);
            gpioWrite(GPIO27, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO22, 0);

            gpioWrite(GPIO17, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO18, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO27, 1);
            gpioWrite(GPIO22, 0);

            gpioWrite(GPIO17, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO18, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO27, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO22, 1);

            // Wait for the next step
            gpioDelay(STEP_DELAY);
        }

        printf("Rotated %d steps\n", steps_to_take);
        steps += steps_to_take;
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

Check the schedule every second and, when the current time matches an entry, smoothly fade the lamp's brightness using PWM (100 Hz, 0-100 duty range) over a 1800-second (30-minute) transition. Handle file read errors, GPIO initialisation failures, and invalid schedule entries gracefully. Use SIGINT/SIGTERM signal handling to turn off all relays and release GPIO resources cleanly on exit, and avoid calling non-reentrant functions such as fopen and localtime inside the signal handler.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define MAX_SCHEDULE_ENTRIES 100
#define MAX_RELAY_NUM 4
#define MAX_DUTY_RANGE 100
#define MAX_PWM_FREQ 100000

typedef struct {
    char time[9];
    int relay;
    int state;
} ScheduleEntry;

ScheduleEntry schedule[MAX_SCHEDULE_ENTRIES];
int schedule_size = 0;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        printf("Exiting...\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < schedule_size; i++) {
            if (schedule[i].relay >= 0 && schedule[i].relay <= MAX_RELAY_NUM) {
                gpio pwm = gpio(pigpio_PWM1);
                pwm.set_mode(schedule[i].relay, PI_OUTPUT);
                pwm.set_PWM_dutycycle(schedule[i].relay, 0);
            }
        }
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(0);
    }
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise");
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    FILE *schedule_file = fopen("lighting_schedule.txt", "r");
    if (schedule_file == NULL) {
        perror("fopen");
        return 1;
    }

    ScheduleEntry entry;
    while (fgets(entry.time, sizeof(entry.time), schedule_file)) {
        if (sscanf(entry.time, "%*[^0-9]%d:%d:%d", &entry.relay, &entry.state, NULL) == 3) {
            schedule[schedule_size++] = entry;
        } else {
            fprintf(stderr, "Invalid schedule entry: %s\n", entry.time);
        }
    }

    fclose(schedule_file);

    if (schedule_size == 0) {
        printf("No schedule entries found.\n");
        return 0;
    }

    struct timeval now;
    gettimeofday(&now, NULL);
    time_t now_time = now.tv_sec;

    while (1) {
        struct tm *now_tm = localtime(&now_time);
        if (now_tm == NULL) {
            perror("localtime");
            return 1;
        }

        char now_time_str[9];
        strftime(now_time_str, sizeof(now_time_str), "%H:%M:%S", now_tm);

        for (int i = 0; i < schedule_size; i++) {
            if (strcmp(schedule[i].time, now_time_str) == 0) {
                int relay = schedule[i].relay;
                int state = schedule[i].state;
                if (relay >= 0 && relay <= MAX_RELAY_NUM) {
                    gpio pwm = gpio(relay);
                    pwm.set_mode(relay, PI_OUTPUT);
                    pwm.set_PWM_dutycycle(relay, state ? MAX_DUTY_RANGE : 0);
                }
            }
        }

        usleep(1000000); // 1 second

        // Check for schedule changes
        schedule_file = fopen("lighting_schedule.txt", "r");
        if (schedule_file == NULL) {
            perror("fopen");
            continue;
        }

        ScheduleEntry new_entry;
        while (fgets(new_entry.time, sizeof(new_entry.time), schedule_file)) {
            if (sscanf(new_entry.time, "%*[^0-9]%d:%d:%d", &new_entry.relay, &new_entry.state, NULL) == 3) {
                schedule[schedule_size++] = new_entry;
            } else {
                fprintf(stderr, "Invalid schedule entry: %s\n", new_entry.time);
            }
        }

        fclose(schedule_file);

        if (schedule_size > 0) {
            ScheduleEntry first_entry = schedule[0];
            if (strcmp(first_entry.time, now_time_str) != 0) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

Linearly map distances from 2 cm to 30 cm to frequencies from 200 Hz to 2000 Hz, clamping the result to that range before applying it. Generate the 10 microsecond trigger pulse with gpioDelay and measure the echo pulse width with microsecond-precision gpioTick timing. Run the main loop at roughly 50 Hz with at least a 60 ms gap between measurements to avoid trigger/echo overlap. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define TRIG_PIN 23
#define ECHO_PIN 24
#define BUZZER_PIN 18
#define MIN_DISTANCE 2
#define MAX_DISTANCE 30
#define MIN_FREQ 200
#define MAX_FREQ 2000

int distance_to_freq(int distance) {
    if (distance < MIN_DISTANCE) {
        return MIN_FREQ;
    } else if (distance > MAX_DISTANCE) {
        return MAX_FREQ;
    } else {
        return MIN_FREQ + (MAX_FREQ - MIN_FREQ) * (distance - MIN_DISTANCE) / (MAX_DISTANCE - MIN_DISTANCE);
    }
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    printf("Shutting down...\n");
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(TRIG_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(ECHO_PIN, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(BUZZER_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode");
        return 1;
    }

    int distance = 0;
    int freq = 0;
    int last_time = 0;
    int last_freq = 0;

    while (1) {
        if (gpioDelay(10) < 0) {
            perror("gpioDelay");
            return 1;
        }

        if (gpioWrite(TRIG_PIN, 1) < 0) {
            perror("gpioWrite");
            return 1;
        }

        gpioDelay(10); // Trigger pulse

        gpioWrite(TRIG_PIN, 0);

        int start = 0;
        int end = 0;
        int timeout = 200000; // 200ms timeout

        while (1) {
            if (gpioTick() < 0) {
                perror("gpioTick");
                return 1;
            }

            if (gpioRead(ECHO_PIN) == 1) {
                start = gpioTick();
            }

            if (gpioRead(ECHO_PIN) == 0) {
                end = gpioTick();
                break;
            }

            if (gpioTick() > timeout) {
                printf("Timeout\n");
                return 1;
            }
        }

        if (start == 0 || end == 0) {
            printf("Sensor not detected\n");
            return 1;
        }

        int duration = end - start;
        distance = (duration * 17150) / 1000000; // 17150 us/cm

        freq = distance_to_freq(distance);

        if (freq != last_freq) {
            if (last_freq != 0) {
                gpioWrite(BUZZER_PIN, 0);
            }
            last_freq = freq;
            if (freq > 0) {
                gpioWrite(BUZZER_PIN, 1);
            }
        }

        if (last_time + 60000 < gpioTick()) {
            printf("Measured %d cm, %d Hz\n", distance, freq);
            last_time = gpioTick();
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#define GPIO_RED 17

#define PWM_FREQ 1000
#define MAX_PROXIMITY 1.0

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise failed");
        return 1;

    // Set up PWM for each color
    if (gpioSetPWMfreq(GPIO_RED, PWM_FREQ) < 0) {
        perror("Setting PWM frequency for GPIO_RED failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetPWMfreq(GPIO_GREEN, PWM_FREQ) < 0) {
        perror("Setting PWM frequency for GPIO_GREEN failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetPWMfreq(GPIO_BLUE, PWM_FREQ) < 0) {
        perror("Setting PWM frequency for GPIO_BLUE failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up GPIOs for common-anode RGB LED
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_RED, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting GPIO_RED to output failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_GREEN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting GPIO_GREEN to output failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_BLUE, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("Setting GPIO_BLUE to output failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;

    // Set initial LED state to off
    gpioWrite(GPIO_RED, 1);
    gpioWrite(GPIO_GREEN, 1);
    gpioWrite(GPIO_BLUE, 1);

    double proximity = 0.0;
    double angle = 0.0;
    double amplitude = 0.5; // Amplitude of the sine wave
    double frequency = 1.0; // Frequency of the sine wave in Hz
    double period = 1.0 / frequency; // Period of the sine wave in seconds

    while (1) {
        angle = (2 * M_PI * (time(NULL) % period)) + phase;
        proximity = amplitude * sin(angle);
        if (proximity < 0.0) {
            proximity = 0.0;
        }

        // Set PWM duty cycle based on proximity
        int duty_cycle = (int)(proximity * 255.0);
        gpioPWM(GPIO_RED, duty_cycle);
        gpioPWM(GPIO_GREEN, (255 - duty_cycle));
        gpioPWM(GPIO_BLUE, duty_cycle);

        // Update phase for next iteration
        phase += 2 * M_PI * frequency;
    }

    // Graceful exit
    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

#include <pigpio.h>

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>

#define BUTTON_PIN 17
#define BUZZER_PIN 18
#define DEBOUNCE_MS 50
#define PLAYBACK_MS 500
#define PLAYBACK_MS_MAX 1000

volatile int play_flag = 0;
volatile int play_flag2 = 0;
volatile int play_flag3 = 0;

void button_isr(void) {
    if (gpioGetIsrType() == PIGPIO_ISR_EDGE_FALL) {
        if (play_flag2) {
            gpioHardwarePWM(BUZZER_PIN, 0);
            play_flag2 = 0;
        } else {
            play_flag = 1;
            play_flag2 = 1;
        }
    }
}

void stop_isr(void) {
    if (play_flag) {
        gpioHardwarePWM(BUZZER_PIN, 0);
        play_flag = 0;
    }
}

void cleanup(void) {
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(0);
}

void play melody() {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        gpioHardwarePWM(BUZZER_PIN, 50000);
        usleep(PLAYBACK_MS);
        gpioHardwarePWM(BUZZER_PIN, 0);
        usleep(PLAYBACK_MS);
    }
}

void play_melody() {

    for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        gpioHardwarePWM(BUZZER_PIN, 50000);
        usleep(PLAYBACK_MS);
        gpioHardwarePWM(BUZZER_PIN, 0);
        usleep(PLAYBACK_MS);
    }
}

        return 1;

        perror("gpioSetMode");
        return 1;

    if (gpioSetMode(BUZZER_PIN, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetISRFuncEx(BUTTON_PIN, PI_EDGE_FALL, button_isr) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetISRFuncEx");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetISRFuncEx(BUZZER_PIN, PI_EDGE_ANY, stop_isr) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetISRFuncEx");
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, cleanup);
    signal(SIGTERM, cleanup);

    while (1) {
        if (play_flag) {
            play_melody();
            play_flag = 0;
        }
        if (play_flag2) {
            play_melody2();
            play_flag2 = 0;

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

#define VIBRATION_LOG_FILE "vibration_events.log"
#define VIBRATION_WINDOW_SIZE 5
#define VIBRATION_THRESHOLD 3
#define POLL_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT 1000

volatile sig_atomic_t exit_flag = 0;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    exit_flag = 1;
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Received signal %d, exiting gracefully.", signum);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    if (argc < 2) {
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Using default poll timeout of 1000 ms.");
        poll_timeout = POLL_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT;
    } else {
        poll_timeout = atoi(argv[1]);
        if (poll_timeout <= 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Invalid poll timeout value. Using default 1000 ms.");
            poll_timeout = POLL_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT;
        }
    }

    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_line_request *request;
    struct pollfd pollfd;
    struct timespec ts;
    char buffer[128];
    int fd;
    int events;
    int high_count = 0;
    int window[5];
    int window_index = 0;
    time_t timestamp;
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    char timestamp_str[128];

    // Open vibration log file
    if ((fd = open(VIBRATION_LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open vibration log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up signal handler
    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    // Get GPIO17 line
    if ((line = gpiod_get_line_by_number(17)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get GPIO17 line");
        close(fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Create request for input
    if ((request = gpiod_line_request_input(line)) == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to create input request");
        close(fd);
        gpiod_line_unref(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Set up pollfd
    pollfd.fd = request->line->file->fd;
    pollfd.events = POLLIN | POLLERR | POLLHUP | POLLNVAL;
    pollfd.revents = 0;

    // Main loop
    while (!exit_flag) {
        ts.tv_sec = 0;
        ts.tv_nsec = 0;
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);

        if (poll(&pollfd, 1, poll_timeout) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to poll");
            close(fd);
            gpiod_line_unref(line);
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (request->line->file->events & POLLIN) {
            int value;
            if (gpiod_line_request_read(request, &value) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to read line value");
                close(fd);
                gpiod_line_unref(line);
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }

            if (value == 1) {
                high_count++;
                window[window_index] = 1;
                window_index = (window_index + 1) % VIBRATION_WINDOW_SIZE;
                if (high_count >= VIBRATION_THRESHOLD) {
                    time_t now = time(NULL);
                    struct tm *nowinfo = localtime(&now);
                    strftime(timestamp_str, sizeof(timestamp_str), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", nowinfo);
                    syslog(LOG_INFO, "EARTHQUAKE ALERT: Vibration sensor detected high value at %s", timestamp_str);
                }
            } else {
                high_count = 0;
                window[window_index] = 0;
            }

            // Log event
            if (fprintf(fd, "%ld %d\n", (long)ts.tv_sec, value) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to log event");
                close(fd);
                gpiod_line_unref(line);
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
            if (fsync(fd) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to flush log file");
                close(fd);
                gpiod_line_unref(line);
                exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
            }
        }
    }

    // Close log file
    if (close(fd) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to close log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    // Unref line
    gpiod_line_unref(line);

    return 0;
}

#define X_OFFSET 10
#define Y_OFFSET -5

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi Zero W using the libgpiod library (not wiringPi, which is deprecated) to run a smart irrigation system controlling four 5V relay modules on BCM GPIO17, GPIO23, GPIO24, and GPIO25. Open the gpiochip once and request the four lines as outputs with an inactive (OFF) drive of 1, since the relays are active-low; do not call the setup function more than once. Every 10 seconds, generate a simulated soil-moisture value from 0 to 100 using rand(), seeded once at startup. If the moisture reading is below 30, sequentially activate each relay (drive the line to 0) for 5 seconds, then deactivate it (drive to 1), leaving a 1-second gap between relays. Log every activation with an ISO-8601 timestamp, relay number, and moisture level to irrigation_log.txt in append mode, flushing after each write. Check every libgpiod call and file operation for errors, printing diagnostics to stderr. On SIGINT or SIGTERM, deactivate all relays, release the lines, close the chip and the log file, and exit cleanly.

</think>

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define RELAY_COUNT 4
#define RELAY_GPIO[RELAY_COUNT] {17, 23, 24, 25}
#define RELAY_PIN_COUNT 4
#define RELAY_PIN[RELAY_PIN_COUNT] {1, 1, 1, 1}
#define RELAY_TIMEOUT 5000
#define RELAY_GAP 1000
#define LOG_FILE "irrigation_log.txt"

void log_irrigation(int relay_num, int moisture_level) {
    char buffer[256];
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    time_t rawtime;
    FILE *log_file;

    rawtime = time(NULL);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);

    log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    fprintf(log_file, "%s %d %d\n", buffer, relay_num, moisture_level);
    fflush(log_file);
    fclose(log_file);
}

void activate_relay(int relay_num) {
    int gpio_fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;

    gpio_fd = gpiod_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (gpio_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    chip = gpiod_get_chip(gpio_fd);
    if (chip == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get chip");
        gpiod_close(gpio_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    line = gpiod_get_line(chip, RELAY_GPIO[relay_num]);
    if (line == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get line");
        gpiod_close(gpio_fd);
        gpiod_chip_free(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    edge = gpiod_get_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (edge == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get edge");
        gpiod_close(gpio_fd);
        gpiod_chip_free(chip);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    gpiod_edge_request_edge(edge, GPIOD_EDGE_REQUEST_EDGE);
    gpiod_edge_enable(edge, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);

    gpiod_line_request_output(line, RELAY_PIN[relay_num]);
    gpiod_line_request_drive(line, 0);

    gpiod_line_request_value(line, 0);
    gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);

    gpiod_chip_request_close(chip);
    gpiod_chip_free(chip);
    gpiod_line_request_close(line);
    gpiod_line_free(line);
    gpiod_edge_request_close(edge);
    gpiod_edge_free(edge);
    gpiod_close(gpio_fd);
}

void deactivate_relay(int relay_num) {
    int gpio_fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;

    gpio_fd = gpiod_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (gpio_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    chip = gpiod_get_chip(gpio_fd);
    if (chip == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get chip");
        gpiod_close(gpio_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    line = gpiod_get_line(chip, RELAY_GPIO[relay_num]);
    if (line == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get line");
        gpiod_close(gpio_fd);
        gpiod_chip_free(chip);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    edge = gpiod_get_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);
    if (edge == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to get edge");
        gpiod_close(gpio_fd);
        gpiod_chip_free(chip);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    gpiod_edge_request_edge(edge, GPIOD_EDGE_REQUEST_EDGE);
    gpiod_edge_enable(edge, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);

    gpiod_line_request_output(line, RELAY_PIN[relay_num]);
    gpiod_line_request_drive(line, 1);

    gpiod_line_request_value(line, 1);
    gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH);

    gpiod_chip_request_close(chip);
    gpiod_chip_free(chip);
    gpiod_line_request_close(line);
    gpiod_line_free(line);
    gpiod_edge_request_close(edge);
    gpiod_edge_free(edge);
    gpiod_close(gpio_fd);
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < RELAY_COUNT; i++) {
        activate_relay(i);
    }
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    int moisture_level;
    srand(time(NULL));
    struct sigaction sa;

    sa.sa_handler = handle_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);

    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    while (1) {
        moisture_level = rand() % 101;
        log_irrigation(moisture_level / 10, moisture_level);

        if (moisture_level < 30) {
            for (int i = 0; i < RELAY_COUNT; i++) {
                activate_relay(i);
                usleep(RELAY_TIMEOUT * 1000);
                deactivate_relay(i);
                usleep(RELAY_GAP * 1000);
            }
        }

        usleep(10 * 1000);
    }

    return 0;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi Zero W using the pigpio library to run a miniature automated plant watering system with two SG90 servo motors: a water valve servo on GPIO17 (physical pin 11) and a directional nozzle servo on GPIO18 (physical pin 12), driven by simulated soil-moisture readings that cycle every second through the hardcoded values 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. Control both servos with gpioServo() using pulse widths in the 500-2500 microsecond range (500 us is about 0 degrees, 1500 us about 90 degrees, 2500 us about 180 degrees): the valve servo is closed at 0 degrees and open at 90 degrees, and the nozzle servo sweeps through 0, 45, 90, 135, and 180 degrees during watering. If the moisture reading is below the 50 threshold, open the valve to 90 degrees, sweep the nozzle through all five angles at 2 seconds per step, hold for 5 seconds, then close the valve to 0 degrees; if it is 50 or above, skip watering. After each cycle, wait 5 seconds before reading the next moisture value. Check the return value of gpioInitialise() and exit on failure. Retry each gpioServo() call up to 3 times with a 100 ms backoff on failure; abort the watering cycle if the valve fails to open, print a critical warning if it fails to close, and log an error and continue to the next angle if a nozzle position fails. Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM using volatile sig_atomic_t flags: stop both servos with gpioServo(..., 0), call gpioTerminate(), and exit cleanly, never calling gpio functions before gpioInitialise() or after gpioTerminate() in the signal handler. Compile with gcc -Wall -Wextra -O2 -o watering watering.c -lpigpio -lrt.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

volatile sig_atomic_t stop = 0;
volatile sig_atomic_t watering = 0;
volatile sig_atomic_t wateringDone = 0;

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "pigpio init failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    int moistureValues[] = {20, 40, 60, 80, 100};
    int moistureIndex = 0;

    while (!stop) {
        if (stop) {
            break;
        }

        if (watering) {
            if (stop) {
                break;
            }

            int moisture = moistureValues[moistureIndex];
            if (moisture >= 50) {
                wateringDone = 1;
                break;
            }

            int servoValveClosed = 500;
            int servoValveOpen = 1500;
            int servoNozzleAngles[] = {500, 1750, 1500, 1250, 1000};

            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                int servoAngle = servoNozzleAngles[i];
                if (gpioServo(17, servoAngle) < 0) {
                    int attempts = 0;
                    while (attempts < 3) {
                        usleep(100000);
                        attempts++;
                        if (gpioServo(17, servoAngle) < 0) {
                            fprintf(stderr, "Valve servo failed to open at %d degrees\n", servoAngle);
                            if (i == 4) {
                                fprintf(stderr, "Critical warning: Valve servo failed to open\n");
                            }
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (attempts == 3) {
                        fprintf(stderr, "Valve servo failed to open after 3 attempts\n");
                        gpioTerminate();
                        return 1;
                    }
                }

                if (gpioServo(18, servoAngle) < 0) {
                    int attempts = 0;
                    while (attempts < 3) {
                        usleep(100000);
                        attempts++;
                        if (gpioServo(18, servoAngle) < 0) {
                            fprintf(stderr, "Nozzle servo failed to move to %d degrees\n", servoAngle);
                            break;

                perror("i2cRead");
                return 1;
            }

            }

            printf("No data ready\n");
        }

        // Poll every 100 ms
        usleep(POLL_INTERVAL);
    }

    return 0;

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>

#define I2C_BUS "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x68
#define MPU6050_REG_PWR_MGMT_1 0x6B
#define MPU6050_REG_GYRO_CONFIG 0x1B
#define MPU6050_REG_GYRO_XOUT_H 0x43

#define MPU6050_GYRO_SENSITIVITY 131.0

int i2c_fd;

void i2c_init() {
    i2c_fd = open(I2C_BUS, O_RDWR);
    if (i2c_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open i2c bus");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(i2c_fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set slave address");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_deinit() {
    close(i2c_fd);
}

void i2c_read_register(int reg) {
    char buffer[2];
    ssize_t bytes_read;

    if ((bytes_read = write(i2c_fd, &reg, 1)) != 1) {
        perror("Failed to write to I2C register");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((bytes_read = read(i2c_fd, buffer, 2)) != 2) {
        perror("Failed to read from I2C register");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    printf("Register 0x%02x: %d %d\n", reg, buffer[0], buffer[1]);
}

void i2c_write_register(int reg, int value) {
    char buffer[2];
    buffer[0] = reg;
    buffer[1] = value;

    if (write(i2c_fd, buffer, 2) != 2) {
        perror("Failed to write to I2C register");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void i2c_read_gyro_data() {
    char buffer[6];
    ssize_t bytes_read;

    if ((bytes_read = read(i2c_fd, buffer, 6)) != 6) {
        perror("Failed to read from I2C register");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    int x = (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
    int y = (buffer[2] << 8) | buffer[3];
    int z = (buffer[4] << 8) | buffer[5];

    double x_deg_per_sec = (double)x * MPU6050_GYRO_SENSITIVITY / 32768.0;
    double y_deg_per_sec = (double)y * MPU6050_GYRO_SENSITIVITY / 32768.0;
    double z_deg_per_sec = (double)z * MPU6050_GYRO_SENSITIVITY / 32768.0;

    printf("Gyroscope: %.2f, %.2f, %.2f dps\n", x_deg_per_sec, y_deg_per_sec, z_deg_per_sec);
}

void i2c_handle_error(int error) {
    if (error == -EIO) {
        printf("I2C bus error\n");
    } else if (error == -EBUSY) {
        printf("I2C bus busy\n");
    } else {
        perror("I2C error");
    }
}

void i2c_signal_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        i2c_deinit();
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;

    sa.sa_handler = i2c_signal_handler;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);

    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) == -1 || sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL) == -1) {
        perror("Failed to set signal handler");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    i2c_init();

    i2c_write_register(MPU6050_REG_PWR_MGMT_1, 0x00); // Wake up the sensor
    i2c_write_register(MPU6050_REG_GYRO_CONFIG, 0x01); // Set full-scale range to ±250 dps

    while (1) {
        i2c_read_gyro_data();
        sleep(0.1); // Read every 100ms
    }

    return 0;
}

Log each reading with an ISO-8601 timestamp including nanoseconds to gyro_log.txt in CSV format: timestamp,x_rate,y_rate,z_rate. Retry SPI communication errors up to 3 times; on persistent failure, log to stderr and continue. Handle file write errors gracefully, and check every system and library call. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <sys/signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <linux/spi/spidev.h>

#define SPI_DEV "/dev/spidev0.0"
#define SPI_CS_GPIO "/dev/gpiochip0"
#define SPI_CS_LINE 8
#define SPI_SPEED 1000000
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_BITS 8
#define SPI_MSB_FIRST 1
#define SPI_BUFFER_SIZE 6
#define GYRO_XOUT_H 0x43
#define GYRO_YOUT_H 0x45
#define GYRO_ZOUT_H 0x47
#define GYRO_XOUT_L 0x48
#define GYRO_YOUT_L 0x4A
#define GYRO_ZOUT_L 0x4C
#define GYRO_SCALE 131.0
#define MAX_RETRIES 3
#define LOG_FILE "gyro_log.txt"

void cleanup_spi(int spi_fd) {
    if (spi_fd > 0) {
        close(spi_fd);
    }
}

void cleanup_gpio(gpiod_handle_t *gpio_handle) {
    if (gpio_handle) {
        gpiod_close(gpio_handle);
    }
}

void cleanup_log() {
    if (access(LOG_FILE, F_OK) == 0) {
        remove(LOG_FILE);
    }
}

void log_data(double x, double y, double z) {
    char timestamp[128];
    struct timeval tv;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    snprintf(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%lu.%06lu", tv.tv_sec, tv.tv_usec);
    char log_line[128];
    snprintf(log_line, sizeof(log_line), "%s,%f,%f,%f", timestamp, x, y, z);
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (log_file) {
        fprintf(log_file, "%s\n", log_line);
        fclose(log_file);
    } else {
        perror("Failed to write to log file");
    }
}

int main() {
    int retries = 0;
    int spi_fd = open(SPI_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (spi_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        return 1;
    }

    gpiod_handle_t *gpio_handle = gpiod_open(SPI_CS_GPIO);
    if (!gpio_handle) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO chip");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    gpiod_line_t *line = gpiod_get_line(gpio_handle, SPI_CS_LINE);
    if (!line) {
        perror("Failed to get SPI CS line");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    int line_fd = line->fd;
    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MOSI, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI mode");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MOSI, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI mode");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI mode");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_BIT_ORDER, SPI_MSB_FIRST) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI mode");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SPD, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI speed");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_BITS_PER_WORD, SPI_BITS) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI bits per word");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_BITS_PER_WORD, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI bits per word");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MODE, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI mode");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_BIT_ORDER, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI mode");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_SPD, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI speed");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_BITS_PER_WORD, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to configure SPI bits per word");
        cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
        cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
        cleanup_log();
        return 1;
    }

    char buffer[SPI_BUFFER_SIZE];
    while (1) {
        for (retries = 0; retries < MAX_RETRIES; retries++) {
            if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_XOUT_H, buffer) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to read gyroscope data");
                continue;
            }
            if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_XOUT_L, buffer + 2) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to read gyroscope data");
                continue;
            }
            if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_YOUT_H, buffer + 4) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to read gyroscope data");
                continue;
            }
            if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_YOUT_L, buffer + 6) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to read gyroscope data");
                continue;
            }
            if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_ZOUT_H, buffer + 8) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to read gyroscope data");
                continue;
            }
            if (ioctl(line_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_ZOUT_L, buffer + 10) < 0) {
                perror("Failed to read gyroscope data");
                continue;
            }

            double x = (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
            double y = (buffer[4] << 8) | buffer[5];
            double z = (buffer[8] << 8) | buffer[9];
            x = (x * GYRO_SCALE) / 32768.0;
            y = (y * GYRO_SCALE) / 32768.0;
            z = (z * GYRO_SCALE) / 32768.0;

            log_data(x, y, z);

            usleep(1000000 / 100);
        }

        if (retries == MAX_RETRIES) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Failed to read gyroscope data after %d retries\n", retries);
            cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
            cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
            cleanup_log();
            return 1;
        }
    }

    cleanup_spi(spi_fd);
    cleanup_gpio(gpio_handle);
    cleanup_log();

    return 0;

Store each reading, with its timestamp, in a 64-entry in-memory circular buffer. If any axis exceeds ±200 deg/s, blink an LED on GPIO17 (physical pin 11) with 500 ms on/off intervals. Handle SPI initialisation failures and sensor read failures (check for zero or invalid data). #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <linux/spi/spidev.h>

#define CE0 8
#define SPI_DEV "/dev/spi0.0"
#define SPI_MODE 0
#define SPI_SPEED 3900000
#define BUFFER_SIZE 64
#define LED_PIN 17

typedef struct {
    uint64_t timestamp;
    int16_t x, y, z;
} SensorReading;

typedef struct {
    SensorReading buffer[BUFFER_SIZE];
    int head, tail;
} CircularBuffer;

CircularBuffer cb;

int spi_fd;
gpiod_handle_t gpiod_handle;
gpiod_line_mixin_t line_mixin;
gpiod_line_t line;
gpiod_state_t state;

void init_spi() {
    if ((spi_fd = open(SPI_DEV, O_RDWR)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open SPI device");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MODE, SPI_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI mode");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MOSI, 1) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI MOSI mode");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MISO, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI MISO mode");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SPICLK, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI clock mode");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_SCLK, 0) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI SCLK mode");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_CS, SPI_CS_FRONT) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI CS mode");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_WR_MAX_SPEED_hz, SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set SPI speed");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_MAX_SPEED_hz, &SPI_SPEED) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read SPI speed");
        close(spi_fd);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void init_gpio() {
    if ((gpiod_handle = gpiod_open()) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open gpiod");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((line_mixin = gpiod_line_mixin_new()) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to create line mixin");
        gpiod_handle_close(gpiod_handle);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((line = gpiod_line_new(gpiod_handle, CE0, GPIOD_LINE_DIR_OUT)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to create line");
        gpiod_handle_close(gpiod_handle);
        gpiod_line_mixin_delete(line_mixin);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((state = gpiod_line_state_new(line)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to create state");
        gpiod_handle_close(gpiod_handle);
        gpiod_line_mixin_delete(line_mixin);
        gpiod_line_delete(line);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpiod_line_state_set(line, state, GPIOD_STATE_ACTIVE)) {
        gpiod_line_state_get(line, state, &state);
    }

    gpiod_line_mixin_add(line_mixin, line);
    gpiod_handle_close(gpiod_handle);
}

void spi_read() {
    uint8_t buffer[3];
    int bytes_read;

    if (ioctl(spi_fd, SPI_IOC_RD_XO, buffer, 3, &bytes_read) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to read gyroscope data");
        return;
    }

    cb.buffer[cb.head].timestamp = (uint64_t)time(NULL);
    cb.buffer[cb.head].x = (int16_t)((buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1]) * 131.0 / 32768.0;
    cb.buffer[cb.head].y = (int16_t)((buffer[2] << 8) | buffer[3]) * 131.0 / 32768.0;
    cb.buffer[cb.head].z = (int16_t)((buffer[4] << 8) | buffer[5]) * 131.0 / 32768.0;

    cb.head = (cb.head + 1) % BUFFER_SIZE;
}

void check_stability() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (cb.buffer[(cb.tail + i) % BUFFER_SIZE].x > 200 || cb.buffer[(cb.tail + i) % BUFFER_SIZE].x < -200 ||
            cb.buffer[(cb.tail + i) % BUFFER_SIZE].y > 200 || cb.buffer[(cb.tail + i) % BUFFER_SIZE].y < -200 ||
            cb.buffer[(cb.tail + i) % BUFFER_SIZE].z > 200 || cb.buffer[(cb.tail + i) % BUFFER_SIZE].z < -200) {
            digitalWrite(LED_PIN, 1);
            usleep(500000);
            digitalWrite(LED_PIN, 0);
            usleep(500000);
        }
    }
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    printf("Timestamp,X,Y,Z\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < BUFFER_SIZE; i++) {
        printf("%llu,%d,%d,%d\n", cb.buffer[i].timestamp, cb.buffer[i].x, cb.buffer[i].y, cb.buffer[i].z);
    }

    gpiod_line_state_set(line, state, GPIOD_STATE_OFF);
    close(spi_fd);
    gpiod_line_mixin_delete(line_mixin);
    gpiod_line_delete(line);
    gpiod_handle_close(gpiod_handle);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    init_spi();
    init_gpio();

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    while (1) {
        spi_read();
        check_stability();
        usleep(1000000); // 1 second delay
    }

    return 0;
}

}

The sensor is at I2C address 0x5A (8-bit). Read the 2-byte little-endian ambient-light value from register 0x20 and the 2-byte little-endian proximity value from register 0x22 every 100 ms. Log each timestamped reading in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS,AmbientLight:XXXX,Proximity:XXXX' to biometric_log.txt in append mode. If the proximity value exceeds 100, set GPIO17 high to simulate a presence-detected LED; otherwise set it low. Handle I2C communication errors with up to 3 retries and a 10 ms delay between attempts. Install SIGINT/SIGTERM signal handlers for graceful cleanup: close the I2C file descriptor, close the log file, and turn off the LED.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x5A
#define REG_AMBIENT 0x20
#define REG_PROXIMITY 0x22
#define AMBIENT_REG_SIZE 2
#define PROXIMITY_REG_SIZE 2
#define LED_PIN 17
#define LED_PIN_NAME "gpio17"
#define LED_PIN_MODE "output"
#define LED_PIN_VALUE 1
#define MAX_RETRIES 3
#define I2C_TIMEOUT 10

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int retries;
    int last_error;
} I2CContext;

typedef struct {
    time_t timestamp;
    int ambient;
    int proximity;
    int led_state;
} BiometricReading;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    I2CContext *ctx = (I2CContext *) signal_info(signum)->si_signsig;
    if (ctx->fd > 0) {
        close(ctx->fd);
    }
    if (ctx->log_fd > 0) {
        close(ctx->log_fd);
    }
    if (ctx->gpio_fd > 0) {
        gpiod_line_close(ctx->gpio_fd);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_sigint;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    I2CContext ctx;
    ctx.retries = 0;
    ctx.last_error = 0;
    ctx.fd = 0;
    ctx.log_fd = 0;
    ctx.gpio_fd = 0;

    ctx.fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (ctx.fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        return 1;
    }

    ctx.gpio_fd = gpiod_line_open(LED_PIN_NAME);
    if (ctx.gpio_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO line");
        close(ctx.fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_request_mode(ctx.gpio_fd, LED_PIN_MODE) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to request GPIO mode");
        close(ctx.fd);
        close(ctx.gpio_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_set_value(ctx.gpio_fd, LED_PIN_VALUE) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set GPIO value");
        close(ctx.fd);
        close(ctx.gpio_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    ctx.log_fd = fopen("biometric_log.txt", "a");
    if (ctx.log_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        close(ctx.fd);
        close(ctx.gpio_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    struct i2c_msg msg[2];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_msg ioctl_msg;
    msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[0].flags = I2C_MSG_WRITE;
    msg[0].data[0] = REG_AMBIENT;
    msg[1].addr = I2C_ADDR;
    msg[1].flags = I2C_MSG_READ;
    msg[1].data[0] = 0;
    msg[1].data[1] = 0;

    while (1) {
        ioctl_msg.msgs = msg;
        ioctl_msg.nmsgs = 2;
        ioctl_msg.control = I2C_RDWR;

        ctx.retries = 0;
        while (ctx.retries < MAX_RETRIES) {
            ctx.last_error = 0;
            if (ioctl(ctx.fd, ioctl_msg.control, 0) < 0) {
                ctx.last_error = errno;
                if (ctx.retries < MAX_RETRIES - 1) {
                    usleep(I2C_TIMEOUT);
                    ctx.retries++;
                }
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }

        if (ctx.last_error) {
            fprintf(stderr, "I2C communication error: %d\n", ctx.last_error);
            continue;
        }

        if (msg[0].data[0] == REG_AMBIENT) {
            if (msg[1].data[0] == 0 && msg[1].data[1] == 0) {
                if (msg[1].data[0] == REG_PROXIMITY) {
                    BiometricReading reading;
                    reading.timestamp = time(NULL);
                    reading.ambient = (int) msg[1].data[0];
                    reading.proximity = (int) msg[1].data[1];
                    reading.led_state = (msg[1].data[1] > 100) ? LED_PIN_VALUE : 0;
                    fprintf(ctx.log_fd, "%s,%d,%d\n", ctime(&reading.timestamp), reading.ambient, reading.proximity);
                    if (reading.proximity > 100) {
                        gpiod_line_set_value(ctx.gpio_fd, LED_PIN_VALUE);
                    } else {
                        gpiod_line_set_value(ctx.gpio_fd, 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>

#include <sys/ioctl.h>
