#define SEISMIC_EVENTS_FILE "/dev/shm/seismic_events.txt"
#define ALERT_PIN 17
#define SENSOR1_PIN 23
#define SENSOR2_PIN 24

void log_event(const char *timestamp, const char *message) {
    char buffer[256];
    struct tm *timeinfo;
    time_t rawtime;
    FILE *file;

    time(&rawtime);
    timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
    strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);
    sprintf(buffer + strlen(buffer), " - %s", message);

    file = fopen(SEISMIC_EVENTS_FILE, "a");
    if (file == NULL) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    fprintf(file, "%s\n", buffer);
    fclose(file);
}

void handle_seismic_event() {
    gpioWrite(ALERT_PIN, 1);
    usleep(2000000); // 2 seconds
    gpioWrite(ALERT_PIN, 0);
}

void handle_log_close(int sig) {
    FILE *file;
    if ((file = fopen(SEISMIC_EVENTS_FILE, "r")) != NULL) {
        fclose(file);
    }
    gpioWrite(ALERT_PIN, 0);
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    int fd;
    struct gpio_callback_args_t args;
    struct gpio_callback_t cb;
    struct gpio_event_t event;
    int status;
    int count = 0;
    char timestamp[256];

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio initialisation failed");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if ((fd = open(SEISMIC_EVENTS_FILE, O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_APPEND, 0644)) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if (signal(SIGINT, handle_log_close) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("Failed to set SIGINT handler");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    if (signal(SIGTERM, handle_log_close) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("Failed to set SIGTERM handler");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    cb.callback = handle_seismic_event;
    cb.edge = PI_EDGE_BOTH;
    cb.gpio = SENSOR1_PIN;
    cb.count = 0;

    if (gpioSetCallback(SENSOR1_PIN, &cb, &args) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to register callback for GPIO23");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    cb.callback = handle_seismic_event;
    cb.edge = PI_EDGE_BOTH;
    cb.gpio = SENSOR2_PIN;
    cb.count = 0;

    if (gpioSetCallback(SENSOR2_PIN, &cb, &args) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to register callback for GPIO24");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    while (1) {
        if (gpioRead(SENSOR1_PIN) && gpioRead(SENSOR2_PIN)) {
            time_t rawtime;
            struct tm *timeinfo;
            rawtime = time(NULL);
            timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
            strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);
            log_event(timestamp, "Seismic event detected!");
            count++;
            if (count % 10 == 0) {
                printf("Event %d detected\n", count);
            }
            usleep(1000000); // 1 second
        }
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#define RATE_XH 0x03

    time_t timestamp;
    int x_axis;

        perror("pigpio init");

        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    if (gpio setwpi_spi0_clock(1000000) < 0) {

    uint8_t address = RATE_XL;

        perror("SPI CS cleared");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_spi0_write(0) < 0) {
        perror("SPI write");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_spi0_read(address) < 0) {
        perror("SPI read");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_spi0_cs(1) < 0) {
        perror("SPI CS set");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    x_axis = (uint16_t) (buffer[buffer_head].timestamp = time(NULL)) << 16;
    x_axis |= (uint16_t) gpio setwpi_spi0_read(RATE_XH);

    if (gpio setwpi_spi0_cs(0) < 0) {
        perror("SPI CS cleared");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_spi0_write(0) < 0) {
        perror("SPI write");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_spi0_read(RATE_XL) < 0) {
        perror("SPI read");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpio setwpi_spi0_cs(1) < 0) {
        perror("SPI CS set");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    x_axis |= (uint16_t) gpio setwpi_spi0_read(RATE_XL);

    if (x_axis > 32767 || x_axis < -32768) {
        x_axis = 0;
    }

    buffer[buffer_head].x_axis = (int) x_axis;
    buffer_head = (buffer_head + 1) & BUFFER_MASK;
}

    int gpio_initialized = 0;

    // Initialize pigpio
    if (gpio_initialise(NULL) < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_initialise");
        return 1;
    }
    gpio_initialized = 1;

    // Set up GPIO pins
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_LAMPS; i++) {
        gpio_fd[i] = gpio_open(gpio_pins[i]);
        if (gpio_fd[i] < 0) {
            perror("gpio_open");
            return 1;
        }

        if (gpio_set_mode(gpio_fd[i], PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
            perror("gpio_set_mode");
            return 1;
        }

        if (gpio_pwm_frequency(gpio_fd[i], PWM_FREQ) < 0) {
            perror("gpio_pwm_frequency");
            return 1;
        }

        if (gpio_pwm_range(gpio_fd[i], PWM_RANGE) < 0) {
            perror("gpio_pwm_range");
            return 1;
        }

        if (gpio_pwm_duty_cycle(gpio_fd[i], 255) < 0) {
            perror("gpio_pwm_duty_cycle");
            return 1;
        }

        status[i] = 0;
        lamp_count++;
    }

    // Log startup message
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Smart Sunset Simulator Started");

    // Start fading each lamp sequentially
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_LAMPS; i++) {
        int start_time = time(NULL);
        int end_time = start_time + fade_duration;

        while (time(NULL) < end_time) {
            int current_time = time(NULL);
            int elapsed_time = end_time - current_time;

            int duty_cycle = 255 - (elapsed_time * 255 / fade_duration);

            if (duty_cycle < 0) {
                duty_cycle = 0;
            }

            if (gpio_pwm_duty_cycle(gpio_fd[i], duty_cycle) < 0) {
                perror("gpio_pwm_duty_cycle");
                return 1;
            }

            if (lamp_index < MAX_LAMPS - 1) {
                // Wait for the current lamp to finish
                while (gpio_get_duty_cycle(gpio_fd[i]) != 0) {
                    usleep(1000);
                }
            } else {
                // Last lamp finished, exit loop
                break;
            }

            lamp_index = (lamp_index + 1) % MAX_LAMPS;
        }

        // Log completion message
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Lamp %d completed fading", i + 1);
    }

    // Log completion message
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Smart Sunset Simulator Completed");

    // Clean up GPIO resources
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_LAMPS; i++) {
        gpio_close(gpio_fd[i]);
    }

    // Deinitialize pigpio
    if (gpio_initialized) {
        gpio_deinitialise();
    }

    // Log shutdown message
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Smart Sunset Simulator Shutting Down");

    // Exit program
    return 0;
}

// Signal handler for SIGINT and SIGTERM
void signal_handler(int signum) {
    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Received signal %d. Shutting down.", signum);

    // Turn off all lamps
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_LAMPS; i++) {
        if (gpio_pwm_duty_cycle(gpio_fd[i], 0) < 0) {
            perror("gpio_pwm_duty_cycle");
        }
    }

    // Deinitialize pigpio
    if (gpio_initialized) {
        gpio_deinitialise();
    }

    // Exit program
    exit(0);
}

// Register signal handler
signal(SIGINT, signal_handler);
signal(SIGTERM, signal_handler);

#define GPIO23 23
#define GPIO24 24

int main() {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    int state = 0;
    int duration = 1000; // 10 seconds in milliseconds
    int cycle = 0;

    // Open the GPIO device
    if ((fd = gpiod_open("/dev/gpiod")) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Get the chip

        perror("gpiod_get_chip");
        gpiod_close(fd);
        return 1;
    }

    // Create a new line for each GPIO pin
    int pins[] = {GPIO17, GPIO22, GPIO23, GPIO24};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if ((line = gpiod_request_line(chip, pins[i])) == NULL) {
            perror("gpiod_request_line");
            gpiod_close(fd);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    // Set up the lines for active-low relays
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if ((edge = gpiod_request_edge(line[i], GPIOD_EDGE_BOTH)) == NULL) {
            perror("gpiod_request_edge");
            gpiod_close(fd);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    // Set up the initial state
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        gpiod_set_value(line[i], 1); // HIGH (relay OFF)

        printf("Exiting...\n");
        exit(0);

    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

            case 0: // Red
                printf("Red\n");
                usleep(duration);
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    gpiod_set_value(line[i], 0); // LOW (relay ON)

                state = 1;
                break;
            case 1: // Red + Yellow
                printf("Red+Yellow\n");
                usleep(duration * 0.2);
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    gpiod_set_value(line[i], 0); // LOW (relay ON)

                state = 2;
                break;
            case 2: // Green
                printf("Green\n");
                usleep(duration);
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    gpiod_set_value(line[i], 0); // LOW (relay ON)

                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

                break;

gpiod_line_mfd_t *line_mfd;

        perror("SIGINT handler setup failed");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;

        perror("Failed to open /dev/gpiod");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;

    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_open(fd_gpio)) == NULL) {
        handle_gpio_error(-1);

    gpiod_line_cnf_set(line_cnf, line, GPIOD_LINE_CNF_DIR_INPUT);
    gpiod_line_cnf_set(line_cnf, line, GPIOD_LINE_CNF_EDGE_FALLING);
    gpiod_line_state_set(line_state, line, GPIOD_LINE_STATE_LOW);

        handle_gpio_error(-1);

        perror("Failed to open log file");
        handle_gpio_error(-1);
    }

    if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to get current time");
        handle_gpio_error(-1);

        }

        if (flame_detected) {
            if (count < DEBOUNCE_COUNT) {
                count++;
                if (count == DEBOUNCE_COUNT) {
                    count = 0;
                    flame_detected = 0;
                    break;
                }
            } else {

                flame_detected = 0;

                gpiod_pwm_write(fd_led, 1, 1);

                handle_gpio_error(-1);
            }

            if (strftime(log_buffer, sizeof(log_buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&ts.tv_sec)) < 0) {
                handle_gpio_error(-1);
            }

            if (fprintf(fd_log, "%s Flame Detected\n", log_buffer) < 0) {

                gpiod_pwm_write(fd_led, 0, 1);
            }
        }

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define LOG_FILE "balance_log.txt"
#define PID_KP 1.0
#define PID_KI 0.01
#define PID_KD 0.1
#define CONTROL_INTERVAL_MS 5000
#define MOTOR_SPEED_LIMIT 255
#define OBSTACLE_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD 20.0

typedef struct {
    float tilt_error;
    float distance;
    int motor_a_speed;
    int motor_b_speed;
} ControlState;

ControlState control_state;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    printf("Received SIGINT signal. Stopping motors and exiting.\n");
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(0);
}

void log_control_cycle(const char *filename, const char *format, ...) {
    FILE *log_file = fopen(filename, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(1);
    }
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, format);
    vfprintf(log_file, format, args);
    va_end(args);
    fclose(log_file);
}

void init_pigpio() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise failed");
        return 1;
    }
    gpioSetMode(17, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetMode(18, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetMode(22, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetMode(23, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetMode(24, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetMode(25, PI_OUTPUT);
    gpioSetPWMfreq(17, 1000);
    gpioSetPWMfreq(18, 1000);
    gpioSetPWMfreq(22, 1000);
    gpioSetPWMfreq(23, 1000);
    gpioSetPWMrange(17, MOTOR_SPEED_LIMIT);
    gpioSetPWMrange(18, MOTOR_SPEED_LIMIT);
    gpioSetPWMrange(22, MOTOR_SPEED_LIMIT);
    gpioSetPWMrange(23, MOTOR_SPEED_LIMIT);
}

void update_motor_speeds() {
    float kp = PID_KP;
    float ki = PID_KI;
    float kd = PID_KD;
    float dt = CONTROL_INTERVAL_MS / 1000.0;
    float integral = 0.0;
    float derivative = 0.0;

    control_state.motor_a_speed = 0;
    control_state.motor_b_speed = 0;

    // Simulate tilt error
    control_state.tilt_error = (float)rand() / RAND_MAX * 20.0 - 10.0;

    // Simulate ultrasonic distance sensor
    control_state.distance = (float)rand() / RAND_MAX * 398.0 + 2.0;

    if (control_state.distance < OBSTACLE_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD) {
        control_state.motor_a_speed = -128; // 50% speed
        control_state.motor_b_speed = -128; // 50% speed
    } else {
        // PID controller
        integral += control_state.tilt_error * dt;
        derivative = (control_state.tilt_error - control_state.tilt_error_prev) / dt;
        control_state.tilt_error_prev = control_state.tilt_error;

        float error = control_state.tilt_error;
        float output = kp * error + ki * integral + kd * derivative;

        control_state.motor_a_speed = (int)(output * MOTOR_SPEED_LIMIT);
        control_state.motor_b_speed = (int)(-output * MOTOR_SPEED_LIMIT);
    }
}

void run_control_loop() {
    while (1) {
        update_motor_speeds();
        log_control_cycle(LOG_FILE, "%s %f %f %d %d\n", 
            ctime(&time(NULL)), 
            control_state.tilt_error, 
            control_state.distance, 
            control_state.motor_a_speed, 
            control_state.motor_b_speed);

        gpioPWM(17, control_state.motor_a_speed);
        gpioPWM(18, control_state.motor_a_speed * -1);
        gpioPWM(22, control_state.motor_b_speed);
        gpioPWM(23, control_state.motor_b_speed * -1);

        gpioDelay(CONTROL_INTERVAL_MS);
    }
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    init_pigpio();

    run_control_loop();

    return 0;
}

The relays are active-low and wired to physical pins 11, 13, 15, and 17 (BCM GPIO17, GPIO27, GPIO22, GPIO23). Cycle repeatedly and indefinitely through four phases: sunrise, a gradual brightness increase over 1 hour; daytime, full brightness for 6 hours; sunset, a gradual brightness decrease over 1 hour; and nighttime, off for 14.4 hours. Simulate brightness with PWM-like relay toggling rather than true PWM, using an increasing duty cycle during sunrise and a decreasing duty cycle during sunset, with all four lamps running the same phase simultaneously. Use only the libgpiod functions gpiod_chip_open_by_name, gpiod_line_get, gpiod_line_request_output, gpiod_line_set_value, gpiod_line_release, and gpiod_chip_close. Handle initialization failures from gpiod_chip_open_by_name and gpiod_line_request_output with clear error messages and a graceful exit. On SIGINT or SIGTERM, turn off all relays and release GPIO resources cleanly.
raw:

</think>
```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO_PIN_11 11
#define GPIO_PIN_13 13
#define GPIO_PIN_15 15
#define GPIO_PIN_17 17

#define SUNRISE_DURATION 3600
#define DAYTIME_DURATION 21600
#define SUNSET_DURATION 3600
#define NIGHTTIME_DURATION 3456

#define MAX_DUTY_CYCLE 100

int main() {
    int chip_fd;
    int line_fd[4];
    int duty_cycle = 0;
    int phase = 0;
    int i;

    // Open GPIO chip
    if ((chip_fd = gpiod_chip_open_by_name("gpiochip0")) < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open GPIO chip");
        return 1;
    }

    // Open GPIO lines
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if ((line_fd[i] = gpiod_line_get(GPIO_PIN_11 + i)) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to open GPIO line");
            gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
            return 1;
        }
        if ((gpiod_line_request_output(line_fd[i], 1)) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to request output on GPIO line");
            gpiod_line_release(line_fd[i]);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    // Set initial state to off
    for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd[i], 0);
    }

    // Register signal handlers
    signal(SIGINT, [](int) {
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd[i], 0);
        }
        gpiod_line_release(line_fd[0]);
        gpiod_line_release(line_fd[1]);
        gpiod_line_release(line_fd[2]);
        gpiod_line_release(line_fd[3]);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        exit(0);
    });

    signal(SIGTERM, [](int) {
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd[i], 0);
        }
        gpiod_line_release(line_fd[0]);
        gpiod_line_release(line_fd[1]);
        gpiod_line_release(line_fd[2]);
        gpiod_line_release(line_fd[3]);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        exit(0);
    });

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        switch (phase) {
            case 0: // Sunrise
                for (i = 0; i < SUNRISE_DURATION; i++) {
                    if (duty_cycle < MAX_DUTY_CYCLE) {
                        duty_cycle++;
                        gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd[i], duty_cycle);
                    }
                    usleep(1000000);
                }
                phase = 1;
                break;
            case 1: // Daytime
                for (i = 0; i < DAYTIME_DURATION; i++) {
                    gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd[i], MAX_DUTY_CYCLE);
                    usleep(1000000);
                }
                phase = 2;
                break;
            case 2: // Sunset
                for (i = 0; i < SUNSET_DURATION; i++) {
                    if (duty_cycle > 0) {
                        duty_cycle--;
                        gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd[i], duty_cycle);
                    }
                    usleep(1000000);
                }
                phase = 3;
                break;
            case 3: // Nighttime
                for (i = 0; i < NIGHTTIME_DURATION; i++) {
                    gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd[i], 0);
                    usleep(1000000);
                }
                phase = 0;
                break;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

On motion detection, execute raspivid to record a 5-second video saved to /home/pi/videos/ with a timestamp-based filename such as 20250321_143022.h264, and log each event with an ISO 8601 timestamp to /home/pi/logs/motion_log.txt. Implement debouncing with a 200 ms minimum interval between triggers. Handle errors gracefully by checking pigpio initialization, file operations, and system command execution. Install a SIGINT signal handler for clean shutdown that closes the log file and terminates pigpio, and keep the program running continuously until interrupted.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define IR_PIN 17
#define MIN_INTERVAL_MS 200
#define LOG_FILE "/home/pi/logs/motion_log.txt"
#define VIDEO_FILE "/home/pi/videos/"
#define VIDEO_NAME_FORMAT "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S.h264"

void handle_motion(int gpio, int level, uint64_t tick) {
    static int last_level = 0;
    static time_t last_trigger = 0;
    static char timestamp[128];
    struct tm *timeinfo;

    if (level == 0 && last_level == 1) {
        if (tick - last_trigger >= MIN_INTERVAL_MS) {
            time_t now = time(NULL);
            struct tm *timeinfo = localtime(&now);
            strftime(timestamp, sizeof(timestamp), VIDEO_NAME_FORMAT, timeinfo);
            char video_path[256];
            snprintf(video_path, sizeof(video_path), "%s%s%s", VIDEO_FILE, timestamp, ".h264");
            if (access(video_path, F_OK) == 0) {
                printf("Video already exists: %s\n", video_path);
                return;
            }
            if (system("raspivid -o " video_path "-fps 30 -t 3000") == 0) {
                printf("Video recorded: %s\n", video_path);
            } else {
                printf("Failed to record video: %s\n", video_path);
            }
            last_trigger = now;
            last_level = 0;
            FILE *log = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
            if (log) {
                fprintf(log, "%s\n", ctime(&now));
                fclose(log);
            }
        }
    }
    last_level = level;
}

int main() {
    if (gpio_initialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio initialization failed");
        return 1;
    }

    gpio_set_mode(IR_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    gpio_pull_up(IR_PIN, 1);

    signal(SIGINT, [](int) {
        if (gpio_close() < 0) {
            perror("pigpio close failed");
        }
        return 0;
    });

    while (1) {
        if (gpio_get_level(IR_PIN) == 0) {
            handle_motion(IR_PIN, 0, 0);
        }
        usleep(1000);
    }

    return 0;
}
```

Each relay corresponds to one irrigation zone, and a simulated moisture sensor using rand() % 101 produces readings from 0 to 100 every 5 seconds, with the random generator seeded from time(NULL). If a zone's reading is below 30, drive its relay LOW to activate it, since the relays are active-low; otherwise drive it HIGH to deactivate it. Append each sensor reading, relay state, and a timestamp to irrigation_log.txt. Check pigpio initialization, the log file open, and every GPIO operation. On SIGINT or any error, safely deactivate all relays (drive HIGH), close the log file, and terminate pigpio, installing the handler with signal().

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define LOG_FILE "irrigation_log.txt"
#define NUM_RELAYS 4
#define MOISTURE_THRESHOLD 30

int main() {
    int gpio_fd[NUM_RELAYS];
    int moisture_sensor;
    int moisture_value;
    int zone_state[NUM_RELAYS];
    int zone_id[NUM_RELAYS] = {4, 17, 27, 22};
    int zone_count = 0;
    int i;
    int log_fd;
    char log_buffer[256];
    struct sigaction sa;

    // Initialize pigpio
    if (gpio_init() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio_init");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up signal handlers
    sa.sa_handler = [](int sig) {
        for (i = 0; i < NUM_RELAYS; i++) {
            gpio_write(zone_id[i], 1); // Deactivate all relays
        }
        close(log_fd);
        gpioTerminate();
        exit(0);
    };
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) < 0) {
        perror("sigaction");
        return 1;
    }

    // Open log file
    if ((log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644)) < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Initialize relays to HIGH (deactivated)
    for (i = 0; i < NUM_RELAYS; i++) {
        gpio_fd[i] = gpio_open(zone_id[i]);
        if (gpio_fd[i] < 0) {
            perror("gpio_open");
            return 1;
        }
        zone_state[i] = 0;
        gpio_set_mode(gpio_fd[i], PI_OUTPUT);
        gpio_write(gpio_fd[i], 1); // Deactivate
    }

    // Initialize moisture sensor
    moisture_sensor = gpio_open(4); // BCM GPIO 4
    if (moisture_sensor < 0) {
        perror("gpio_open");
        return 1;
    }
    gpio_set_mode(moisture_sensor, PI_INPUT);
    gpio_pull_up(moisture_sensor, 1); // Set to active-low

    // Main loop
    while (1) {
        // Read moisture sensor
        if (gpio_get_value(moisture_sensor) == 0) {
            moisture_value = rand() % 101;
        } else {
            moisture_value = 100; // Simulate high moisture
        }

        // Determine relay state
        for (i = 0; i < NUM_RELAYS; i++) {
            if (moisture_value < MOISTURE_THRESHOLD) {
                zone_state[i] = 0; // Activate relay
            } else {
                zone_state[i] = 1; // Deactivate relay
            }
            // Write relay state
            gpio_write(gpio_fd[i], zone_state[i]);
        }

        // Log data
        snprintf(log_buffer, sizeof(log_buffer), "%d,%d,%d\n", moisture_value, zone_state[0], zone_state[1], zone_state[2], zone_state[3]);
        if (write(log_fd, log_buffer, strlen(log_buffer)) < 0) {
            perror("write");
            return 1;
        }

        // Sleep for 5 seconds
        usleep(5000000); // 5 seconds

        // Check for SIGINT
        if (sigwaitinfo(NULL, NULL) && siginfo->si_signo == SIGINT) {
            break;
        }
    }

    // Close log file and terminate
    close(log_fd);
    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define MOTOR_STEPS_PER_MM 10
#define MOTOR_STEPS_PER_REV 2048
#define MICROSECOND_STEP_DELAY 1000
#define STEPS_TO_DRAW 50 * MOTOR_STEPS_PER_MM * 2

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpioSetMode(4, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO4 not set as output");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(17, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO17 not set as output");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(27, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO27 not set as output");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(22, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO22 not set as output");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(5, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO5 not set as output");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(6, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO6 not set as output");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(13, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO13 not set as output");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(19, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("GPIO19 not set as output");
        return 1;
    }

    int motor1_steps[4] = {1, 0, 0, 0};
    int motor2_steps[4] = {0, 1, 0, 0};

    for (int i = 0; i < STEPS_TO_DRAW; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            if (motor1_steps[j]) {
                gpioWrite(4, 1);
                gpioWrite(17, 0);
                gpioWrite(27, 0);
                gpioWrite(22, 0);
            } else {
                gpioWrite(4, 0);
            }
            if (motor2_steps[j]) {
                gpioWrite(5, 1);
                gpioWrite(6, 0);
                gpioWrite(13, 0);
                gpioWrite(19, 0);
            } else {
                gpioWrite(5, 0);
            }
            usleep(MICROSECOND_STEP_DELAY);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            if (motor1_steps[j]) {
                gpioWrite(4, 0);
            }
            if (motor2_steps[j]) {
                gpioWrite(5, 0);
            }
            usleep(MICROSECOND_STEP_DELAY);
        }
        for (int j = 3; j >= 0; j--) {
            if (motor1_steps[j]) {
                gpioWrite(4, 1);
                gpioWrite(17, 0);
                gpioWrite(27, 0);
                gpioWrite(22, 0);
            } else {
                gpioWrite(4, 0);
            }
            if (motor2_steps[j]) {
                gpioWrite(5, 1);
                gpioWrite(6, 0);
                gpioWrite(13, 0);
                gpioWrite(19, 0);
            } else {
                gpioWrite(5, 0);
            }
            usleep(MICROSECOND_STEP_DELAY);
        }
        for (int j = 3; j >= 0; j--) {
            if (motor1_steps[j]) {

            }
            if (motor2_steps[j]) {
                gpioWrite(5, 0);
            }
            usleep(MICROSECOND_STEP_DELAY);
        }
    }

    gpioTerminate();
    return 0;
}

void signalHandler(int signum) {

        printf("Received SIGINT, stopping motors...\n");
        gpioTerminate();
    }
}

In a 100 ms polling loop, read 3 bytes (2 data + 1 CRC-8) from each sensor and validate the CRC-8 (polynomial 0x31, init 0xFF, no final XOR); on a read error or CRC mismatch, log a warning to stderr and skip that cycle without updating the relay. Convert each signed 16-bit big-endian raw value to ml/min using the scale factor 1/1500.0. If both reads succeed and either sensor reports flow below 5.0 ml/min, energize GPIO 18 (active-high relay, write 1); de-energize (write 0) when both sensors are at or above 5.0 ml/min. Log every successful cycle's flow rates with millisecond timestamps to flow_log.txt in append mode, flushing after each write. Install a single SIGINT/SIGTERM handler that sets a volatile flag so the main loop can exit cleanly; on shutdown, de-energize the relay, close both I2C handles if open, call gpioTerminate(), and print a shutdown message. The code must compile cleanly with gcc -Wall -Wextra.

Two momentary push-buttons are wired to GPIO 21 (BCM) and GPIO 22 (BCM), each connecting its pin to ground when pressed, so internal pull-ups must be enabled. Pressing the GPIO 21 button drives the servo to the locked position with a 2000 µs pulse width; pressing the GPIO 22 button drives it to the unlocked position with a 1000 µs pulse width. Check the return value of gpioInitialise() and exit with an error message on failure, and verify that gpioServo() succeeds for both pulse-width commands. Implement button debouncing so a single press is not registered multiple times, waiting for release plus a short debounce delay, and poll the buttons in a tight loop with a small sleep to avoid high CPU usage. Install a SIGINT/SIGTERM handler so Ctrl+C cleanly stops the servo (pulse width 0) and calls gpioTerminate() before exiting. Print status messages to stdout for lock, unlock, and shutdown events.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define DEBOUNCE 500  // Debounce delay in microseconds
#define PULSE_LOCK 2000
#define PULSE_UNLOCK 1000
#define PULSE_SHUTDOWN 0

void handle_shutdown(int sig) {
    printf("Shutdown requested. Stopping servo...\n");
    gpioServo(PULSE_SHUTDOWN);
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("gpioInitialise failed");
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_shutdown);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_shutdown);

    int button1 = gpioOpen(21);
    int button2 = gpioOpen(22);

    if (button1 < 0 || button2 < 0) {
        perror("gpioOpen failed");
        gpioTerminate();
        return 1;
    }

    gpioSetPullUp(button1, 1);
    gpioSetPullUp(button2, 1);

    int last_state1 = 0;
    int last_state2 = 0;
    int last_time1 = 0;
    int last_time2 = 0;

    while (1) {
        int state1 = gpioRead(button1);
        int state2 = gpioRead(button2);

        if (state1 != last_state1) {
            last_time1 = gettime();
            last_state1 = state1;
        }

        if (state2 != last_state2) {
            last_time2 = gettime();
            last_state2 = state2;
        }

        if (state1 && last_time1 + DEBOUNCE > gettime()) {
            continue;
        }

        if (state2 && last_time2 + DEBOUNCE > gettime()) {
            continue;
        }

        if (state1) {
            printf("Lock button pressed. Setting servo to locked position...\n");
            gpioServo(PULSE_LOCK);
        } else if (state2) {
            printf("Unlock button pressed. Setting servo to unlocked position...\n");
            gpioServo(PULSE_UNLOCK);
        } else {
            printf("No buttons pressed. Servo is in default position.\n");
        }

        usleep(1000); // Poll buttons every 1ms
    }

    return 0;
}
```

**Note:** The `gettime()` function is a placeholder for actual timing functions. In practice, you should use `gettimeofday()` or similar to get the current time in microseconds. Also, ensure that the `pigpio` library is installed and configured correctly on your Raspberry Pi.

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ that uses the pigpio library to read ambient light levels from a BH1750 sensor at I2C address 0x23 on I2C1 (GPIO2=SDA, GPIO3=SCL). Trigger a relay on GPIO23 to activate a grow light when the lux reading falls below 150, and deactivate it when lux is 150 or above. Use the BH1750 One-Time High-Resolution mode (command 0x20) and wait at least 120 ms for the conversion before reading the 2-byte result, converting to lux with lux = raw / 1.2. Log timestamps and lux values to grow_log.txt, sampling every 2 seconds. Implement robust error handling for I2C communication failures by checking the return codes of i2cOpen, i2cWriteByte, i2cReadDevice, and file operations, and handle sensor-absent and bus-error paths by logging errors and retrying on the next cycle. Ensure clean resource release on all exit paths — close the I2C handle, close the log file, deactivate the relay, and call gpioTerminate — with SIGINT and SIGTERM signal handling.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <mosquitto.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define MQTT_BROKER "localhost"
#define MQTT_PORT 1883
#define MQTT_CLIENT_ID "relay_controller_1"
#define MQTT_QOS 0
#define MQTT_KEEPALIVE 60
#define MQTT_CLEANSESSION 1
#define MQTT_LOG_USER 1

#define GPIO_PIN 17
#define GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT 1
#define GPIO_LOW 0
#define GPIO_HIGH 1

void mqtt_callback(struct mosquitto *mosq, void *userdata, int reason) {
    char *payload;
    size_t payload_len;
    int ret;

    if (mosquitto_message_get_payload(mosq, &payload, &payload_len) == MOSQ_ERR_SUCCESS) {
        if (strcmp(payload, "ON") == 0) {
            gpioSetValue(GPIO_PIN, GPIO_HIGH);
        } else if (strcmp(payload, "OFF") == 0) {
            gpioSetValue(GPIO_PIN, GPIO_LOW);
        } else {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "Invalid payload: %s", payload);
        }
    } else {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to get payload: %d", ret);
    }
    mosquitto_message_destroy(mosq, &payload);
}

void mqtt_connect_handler(struct mosquitto *mosq, int ret) {
    if (ret == MOSQ_ERR_SUCCESS) {
        syslog(LOG_USER, "Connected to MQTT broker");
        mosquitto_subscribe(mosq, NULL, "home/lights/control", MQTT_QOS);
    } else {
        syslog(LOG_USER, "Failed to connect to MQTT broker: %s", mosquitto_connack_string(mosq));
        // Keep the process alive for retry
    }
}

void mqtt_loop(int *running) {
    int ret;
    struct mosquitto *mosq;

    if ((mosq = mosquitto_new(NULL, MQTT_CLEANSESSION, NULL)) == NULL) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to create mosquitto client");
        return;
    }

    if ((ret = mosquitto_connect(mosq, MQTT_BROKER, MQTT_PORT, MQTT_KEEPALIVE)) != MOSQ_ERR_SUCCESS) {
        syslog(LOG_USER, "Failed to connect to MQTT broker: %s", mosquitto_connack_string(mosq));
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((ret = mosquitto_set_callback(mosq, MQTT_CALLBACK_FUNCTION, mqtt_callback, NULL)) != MOSQ_ERR_SUCCESS) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set MQTT callback: %d", ret);
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if ((ret = mosquitto_loop_start(mosq)) != MOSQ_ERR_SUCCESS) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to start MQTT loop: %d", ret);
        goto cleanup;
    }

    *running = 1;

    cleanup:
    mosquitto_destroy(mosq);
    return;
}

void mqtt_loop_cleanup(int *running) {
    if (*running) {
        mosquitto_loop_stop(mosq);
        mosquitto_destroy(mosq);
    }
}

void gpio_init() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to initialise pigpio: %d", gpioInitialise());
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (gpioSetMode(GPIO_PIN, GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set GPIO mode: %d", gpioSetMode(GPIO_PIN, GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT));
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (gpioWrite(GPIO_PIN, GPIO_LOW) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set GPIO to LOW: %d", gpioWrite(GPIO_PIN, GPIO_LOW));
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
}

void gpio_cleanup() {
    gpioTerminate();
}

void signal_handler(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        syslog(LOG_USER, "Received signal %d, shutting down", signum);
        gpio_cleanup();
        mosquitto_loop_destroy(NULL);
        closelog();
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    int running = 1;
    struct sigaction sa;

    sa.sa_handler = signal_handler;
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);

    if (sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL) < 0 || sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set signal handler");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    gpio_init();

    if (mosquitto_lib_init() < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to initialise mosquitto library: %d", mosquitto_lib_init());
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if ((running = mqtt_loop(&running)) != 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to start MQTT loop: %d", running);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <math.h>

#define PWM_FREQ 10000
#define PWM_RESOLUTION 255
#define Kp 0.5
#define Ki 0.05
#define ENC_STALL_TIME 2000  // 2 seconds
#define ENC_STALL_THRESHOLD 0

typedef struct {
    uint32_t count;
    uint32_t last_count;
    uint32_t last_time;
    uint32_t last_error;
    uint32_t integral;
    uint32_t derivative;
    uint32_t pwm;
} EncoderState;

EncoderState encA, encB;

void init_encoder(EncoderState *state, int gpioA, int gpioB) {
    state->count = 0;
    state->last_count = 0;
    state->last_time = 0;
    state->last_error = 0;
    state->integral = 0;
    state->derivative = 0;
    state->pwm = 0;

    gpio_set_mode(gpioA, PI_INPUT);
    gpio_set_mode(gpioB, PI_INPUT);
    gpio_pull_up(gpioA, 1);
    gpio_pull_up(gpioB, 1);

    gpio_hot_add(gpioA, gpioB, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);
}

void update_encoder(EncoderState *state, int gpioA, int gpioB) {
    int a = gpio_get_value(gpioA);
    int b = gpio_get_value(gpioB);

    if (a != state->last_count % 2) {
        state->count++;
    }

    if (b != state->last_count % 2) {
        state->count--;
    }

    state->last_count = state->count;
    state->last_time = micros();
}

void compute_error(EncoderState *state, int target_rpm) {
    int rpm = (state->count / 64) * 60;
    int error = rpm - target_rpm;

    state->derivative = (state->last_error - error) / 1000000.0;
    state->integral += error * (micros() - state->last_time) / 1000000.0;
    state->last_error = error;
}

void compute_pwm(EncoderState *state) {
    state->pwm = (int)(Kp * state->last_error + Ki * state->integral);
    if (state->pwm < 0) state->pwm = 0;
    if (state->pwm > PWM_RESOLUTION) state->pwm = PWM_RESOLUTION;
}

void set_pwm(int gpio, int pwm) {
    gpio_write(gpio, 1);
    gpio_set_pwm(gpio, 0, pwm);
}

void stop_motors() {
    set_pwm(17, 0);
    set_pwm(22, 0);
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    stop_motors();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    atexit(stop_motors);
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    if (gpio_initialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpio init failed");
        return 1;
    }

    init_encoder(&encA, 4, 5);
    init_encoder(&encB, 6, 12);

    int target_rpm = 50;
    int period = 100000; // 100 ms

    while (1) {
        update_encoder(&encA, 4, 5);
        update_encoder(&encB, 6, 12);

        compute_error(&encA, target_rpm);
        compute_error(&encB, target_rpm);

        compute_pwm(&encA);
        compute_pwm(&encB);

        set_pwm(17, encA.pwm);
        set_pwm(22, encB.pwm);

        printf("Motor A RPM: %d, PWM: %d\n", encA.count / 64 * 60, encA.pwm);
        printf("Motor B RPM: %d, PWM: %d\n", encB.count / 64 * 60, encB.pwm);
        printf("\n");

        usleep(period);
    }

    return 0;
}

int pulse_counter = PULSE_COUNTER_INIT;

int solenoid_pin = 27;

void* pulse_counter_thread(void* arg) {

        int current_state = gpio_get_isr_num(flow_sensor_pin);

            pulse_counter = 0;
            int pulses = gpio_get_count(flow_sensor_pin);

            if (lpm > 5.0) {
                solenoid_state = 0;
            } else if (lpm < 4.5) {
                solenoid_state = 1;
            }
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&pulse_counter_mutex);
            if (log_fd != -1) {
                char buffer[256];
                struct tm* timeinfo;
                time_t rawtime;

                timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);

            pthread_mutex_unlock(&pulse_counter_mutex);
            if (log_fd != -1) {
                char buffer[256];
                struct tm* timeinfo;
                time_t rawtime;
                time(&rawtime);
                timeinfo = localtime(&rawtime);
                strftime(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);
                fprintf(log_fd, "%s Shutting down\n", buffer);

            pthread_mutex_destroy(&pulse_counter_mutex);
            gpioTerminate();
            exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);

    syslog(LOG_LEVEL, "Received signal %d", *pid);

        gpioTerminate();
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    if ((log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC, 0644)) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error opening log file: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        gpioTerminate();

A two-pole magnet on the motor shaft produces one pulse per revolution, detected on the rising edge. Configure GPIO 17 as input with the internal pull-up enabled via the GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_FLAG_BIAS_PULL_UP bias flag, since the A3144's open-collector output requires a pull-up. Use edge-triggered event detection (gpiod_line_event_wait) to count pulses, with a 2 ms debounce window to reject contact bounce and double-edge noise. Every 5 seconds, compute RPM = (pulseCount / 5.0) * 60.0, append the sample to motor_rpm.log in CSV format (timestamp in ISO 8601, rpm_value to 2 decimal places), flushing after every write, and print the current RPM to stdout. Check the return values of gpiod_chip_open, gpiod_chip_get_line, and gpiod_line_request_input_flags, printing clear diagnostics to stderr and exiting non-zero on failure. Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM for graceful shutdown: stop the main loop, release the GPIO line, close the chip, close the log file, and exit cleanly. Use the monotonic clock (clock_gettime with CLOCK_MONOTONIC) for timing, not clock().

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <gpiod.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>

#define GPIO_LINE 17
#define DEBOUNCE_WINDOW_MS 2
#define SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS 5000
#define LOG_FILE "motor_rpm.log"

static int gpiod_fd;
static struct gpiod_chip *chip;
static struct gpiod_line *line;
static int pulse_count = 0;
static time_t last_sample_time = 0;
static FILE *log_file;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (line) {
            gpiod_line_request_input_flags(line, GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_FLAG_BIAS_PULL_UP);
            gpiod_line_free(line);
            line = NULL;
        }
        if (chip) {
            gpiod_chip_free(chip);
            chip = NULL;
        }
        if (log_file) {
            fclose(log_file);
            log_file = NULL;
        }
        if (gpiod_fd > 0) {
            close(gpiod_fd);
            gpiod_fd = 0;
        }
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

int main() {
    struct timespec ts;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    int ret;
    char buffer[128];

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    gpiod_fd = gpiod_open("/dev/gpiod", O_RDWR);
    if (gpiod_fd < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_open");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    chip = gpiod_chip_open(gpiod_fd);
    if (chip == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    line = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO_LINE);
    if (line == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Line %d not found\n", GPIO_LINE);
        goto cleanup;
    }

    ret = gpiod_line_request_input_flags(line, GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_FLAG_BIAS_PULL_UP);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_input_flags");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    ret = gpiod_line_request_event(line, GPIOD_LINE_EVENT_WAIT);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_event");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    ret = gpiod_line_request_edge(line, GPIOD_LINE_EDGE_RISING);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_edge");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    ret = gpiod_line_request_debounce(line, DEBOUNCE_WINDOW_MS);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_debounce");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "a");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("fopen");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    while (1) {
        ret = gpiod_line_event_wait(line, &ts);
        if (ret < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_event_wait");
            goto cleanup;
        }

        if (ts.tv_sec - last_sample_time >= SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS / 1000.0) {
            pulse_count = 0;
            last_sample_time = ts.tv_sec;
        }

        if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000) {
            ts.tv_sec += 1;
            ts.tv_nsec = 0;
        }

        if (pulse_count > 0) {
            fprintf(log_file, "%s,%.2f\n", ctime(&ts.tv_sec), (double)pulse_count / (SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS / 1000.0) * 60.0);
            fflush(log_file);
            pulse_count = 0;
        }
    }

cleanup:
    if (line) {
        gpiod_line_request_input_flags(line, GPIOD_LINE_REQUEST_FLAG_BIAS_PULL_UP);
        gpiod_line_free(line);
        line = NULL;
    }
    if (chip) {
        gpiod_chip_free(chip);
        chip = NULL;
    }
    if (gpiod_fd > 0) {
        close(gpiod_fd);
        gpiod_fd = 0;
    }
    if (log_file) {
        fclose(log_file);
        log_file = NULL;
    }

    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

volatile int exit_flag = 0;
volatile int relay_state = 0;
volatile int touch_state = 0;
volatile int timeout = 0;

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    exit_flag = 1;
}

void cleanup() {
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("gpioInitialise");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }

    gpioSetMode(4, PI_INPUT); // Set GPIO4 as input
    gpioSetMode(17, PI_OUTPUT); // Set GPIO17 as output

    gpioSetPullUpDown(4, PI_DISABLE); // Disable pull-up/down for GPIO4

    signal(SIGINT, handle_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal);

    while (!exit_flag) {
        touch_state = gpioRead(4);
        if (touch_state == PI_BAD_GPIO) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Error reading GPIO4\n");
            cleanup();
            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
        }

        if (touch_state == 1) {
            relay_state = !relay_state;
            gpioWrite(17, relay_state);
        }

        if (touch_state == 1) {
            timeout++;
        } else {
            timeout = 0;
        }

        if (timeout > 10) {
            relay_state = 0;
            gpioWrite(17, relay_state);
        }

        gpioDelay(50);
    }

    cleanup();
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}

    }

        int rfid_read = 0;
        int rfid_read_error = 0;

        if (spiXfer(SPI_CHANNEL, 0, rfid_tag, RFID_TAG_SIZE) < 0) {

            rfid_read_error = 1;
        } else {
            if (memcmp(rfid_tag, RFID_TAG_VALID, RFID_TAG_SIZE) == 0) {
                rfid_tag_valid = 1;
            }
        }

        // Read button press
        if (gpioRead(GPIO22) == 0) {
            button_pressed = 1;
        }

        // Log access attempt
        if (rfid_read_error) {
            log_message("RFID", "SIGINT", "RFID read error");
        } else if (!rfid_tag_valid) {
            log_message("RFID", "SIGINT", "Invalid RFID tag");
        } else if (button_pressed) {
            log_message("RFID", "SIGINT", "Button pressed");
        } else {
            log_message("RFID", "SIGINT", "No RFID tag present");
        }

        // Unlock locks
        if (rfid_tag_valid && button_pressed) {
            gpioWrite(GPIO17, 0);
            gpioWrite(GPIO27, 0);
            gpioDelay(5000);
            gpioWrite(GPIO17, 1);
            gpioWrite(GPIO27, 1);
        }

        // Poll for 100ms
        gpioDelay(100);
    }

    return 0;

#include <fcntl.h>

#include <pigpio.h>

#define LOG_FILE "door_events.log"
#define RELAY_PIN 18
#define PIR_PIN 17
#define PIR_PIN_MODE_INPUT
#define PIR_PIN_EDGE_FALL
#define RELAY_PIN_MODE_OUTPUT
#define RELAY_PIN_VALUE_HIGH
#define MAX_EVENTS 1000
#define LOG_EVENT_SIZE 100

typedef struct {
    time_t timestamp;
    char event[LOG_EVENT_SIZE];
} LogEvent;

int log_fd;
int last_event_time;
int last_unlocked;
int running;

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    if (running) {
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "SIGINT received, exiting...");
        close(log_fd);
        pi_event_clear();
        pi_set_mode(RELAY_PIN, PI_OFF);
        pi_set_pull_up(RELAY_PIN, 0);
        pi_event_stop();
        pi_stop();
        exit(0);
    }
}

void log_event(const char *event) {
    LogEvent log;
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    log.timestamp = now;
    snprintf(log.event, LOG_EVENT_SIZE, "%s %ld", event, now);
    if (log_fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open log file: %s", LOG_FILE);
        exit(1);
    }
    if (write(log_fd, &log, sizeof(log)) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to write to log file: %s", LOG_FILE);
        exit(1);
    }
}

void handle_motion(int level) {
    if (level == 1) {
        if (time(NULL) - last_unlocked < 2000) {
            syslog(LOG_WARNING, "Rate-limited motion detected");
            return;
        }
        last_unlocked = time(NULL);
        log_event("Motion detected");
        pi_set_mode(RELAY_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
        pi_set_pull_up(RELAY_PIN, 0);
        pi_set_value(RELAY_PIN, RELAY_PIN_VALUE_HIGH);
        usleep(500000); // 500 ms
        pi_set_pull_up(RELAY_PIN, 1);
        pi_set_mode(RELAY_PIN, PI_INPUT);
        pi_event_clear();
        pi_event_set(PI_EVENT_EDGE_FALL, PIR_PIN, 1);
    } else {
        syslog(LOG_INFO, "Motion stopped");
    }
}

int main() {
    running = 1;
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    signal(SIGTERM, handle_sigint);

    if (pi_init() < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "pigpio init failed");
        exit(1);
    }

    if (pi_set_mode(PIR_PIN, PIR_PIN_MODE_INPUT) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set PIR mode");
        exit(1);
    }
    if (pi_set_pull_up(PIR_PIN, 1) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set PIR pull-up");
        exit(1);
    }
    if (pi_set_mode(RELAY_PIN, RELAY_PIN_MODE_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set relay mode");
        exit(1);
    }
    if (pi_set_pull_up(RELAY_PIN, 0) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set relay pull-up");
        exit(1);
    }
    if (pi_set_value(RELAY_PIN, RELAY_PIN_VALUE_HIGH) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to set relay value");
        exit(1);
    }

    pi_event_callback(PIR_PIN, handle_motion);
    pi_event_callback_period_ms(RELAY_PIN, 0, 50);

    log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
    if (log_fd < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "Failed to open log file: %s", LOG_FILE);
        exit(1);
    }

    while (running) {
        pi_event_wait(0);
    }

    close(log_fd);
    pi_event_clear();
    pi_set_mode(RELAY_PIN, PI_OFF);
    pi_set_pull_up(RELAY_PIN, 0);
    pi_event_stop();
    pi_stop();
    exit(0);
}

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define HX711_PIN 4
#define HX711_CLOCK_PIN 17
#define SOLENOID_PIN 27
#define CALIBRATION_FILE "calibration.txt"
#define WEIGHT_THRESHOLD 10.0
#define CALIBRATION_SAMPLE_COUNT 100
#define CALIBRATION_SAMPLE_INTERVAL 500
#define LOG_FILE "weight_log.txt"
#define LOG_SAMPLE_INTERVAL 500

int calibrate(int fd) {
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < CALIBRATION_SAMPLE_COUNT; i++) {
        int16_t value = pigpio_read(HX711_PIN);
        sum += value;
        usleep(CALIBRATION_SAMPLE_INTERVAL * 1000);
    }
    double offset = sum / CALIBRATION_SAMPLE_COUNT;
    double scale = 1.0;
    if (access(CALIBRATION_FILE, F_OK) == 0) {
        FILE *fp = fopen(CALIBRATION_FILE, "r");
        char line[128];
        if (fgets(line, sizeof(line), fp)) {
            char *tok = strtok(line, " ");
            scale = atof(tok);
            tok = strtok(NULL, " ");
            offset = atof(tok);
        }
        fclose(fp);
    }
    return scale, offset;
}

void log_reading(double weight, const char *filename) {
    struct timeval tv;
    gettimeofday(&tv, NULL);
    double timestamp = tv.tv_sec + tv.tv_usec / 1000000.0;
    FILE *fp = fopen(filename, "a");
    if (fp) {
        fprintf(fp, "%.6f,%.6f\n", timestamp, weight);
        fclose(fp);
    }
}

void handle_sigint(int sig) {
    printf("Received SIGINT, shutting down...\n");
    pi_lock_all();
    pi_set_mode(SOLENOID_PIN, PI_OFF);
    pi_set_mode(HX711_PIN, PI_OFF);
    pi_set_mode(HX711_CLOCK_PIN, PI_OFF);
    pi_close();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    int fd = pi_open(HX711_CLOCK_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open HX711 clock pin");
        return 1;
    }

    int solenoid_fd = pi_open(SOLENOID_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    if (solenoid_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open solenoid pin");
        return 1;
    }

    int hx711_fd = pi_open(HX711_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    if (hx711_fd < 0) {
        perror("Failed to open HX711 data pin");
        return 1;
    }

    double scale, offset;
    scale, offset = calibrate(fd);

    FILE *calibration_file = fopen(CALIBRATION_FILE, "w");
    if (calibration_file) {
        fprintf(calibration_file, "%.6f %.6f\n", scale, offset);
        fclose(calibration_file);
    }

    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "w");
    if (log_file) {
        fprintf(log_file, "Timestamp,Weight\n");
        fclose(log_file);
    }

    pi_set_mode(HX711_CLOCK_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);
    pi_set_mode(HX711_PIN, PI_INPUT);
    pi_set_mode(SOLENOID_PIN, PI_OUTPUT);

    pi_set_pull_up_down(HX711_CLOCK_PIN, PI_PUD_OFF);
    pi_set_pull_up_down(HX711_PIN, PI_PUD_OFF);

    while (1) {
        int16_t value = pigpio_read(HX711_PIN);
        double weight = (value - offset) * scale;
        if (weight > WEIGHT_THRESHOLD) {
            pi_set_mode(SOLENOID_PIN, PI_HIGH);
        } else {
            pi_set_mode(SOLENOID_PIN, PI_LOW);
        }
        log_reading(weight, LOG_FILE);
        usleep(LOG_SAMPLE_INTERVAL * 1000);
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    int chip_fd, line_fd, log_fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    struct timespec ts;
    char timestamp[20];

    // Open GPIO chip
    chip_fd = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (chip_fd < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Open GPIO17 line
    line_fd = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip_fd, GPIO17, GPIOD_LINE_INPUT);
    if (line_fd < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_request_line");
        goto error;
    }

    // Open GPIO18 line
    line_fd = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip_fd, GPIO18, GPIOD_LINE_OUTPUT);
    if (line_fd < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_request_line");
        goto error;
    }

    // Set GPIO17 line to input
    if (gpiod_line_request_input(line_fd) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_input");
        goto error;
    }

    // Set GPIO18 line to output
    if (gpiod_line_request_output(line_fd) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_output");
        goto error;
    }

    // Set GPIO18 line to high (active-high)
    if (gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd, 1) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
        goto error;
    }

    // Open log file
    log_fd = open(LOG_FILE, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_APPEND, 0644);
    if (log_fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        goto error;
    }

    // Set up signal handlers
    signal(SIGINT, [](int sig) {
        if (line_fd >= 0) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd, 0);
            close(log_fd);
            close(line_fd);
            close(chip_fd);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
            return 0;
        }
        return 1;
    });

    signal(SIGTERM, [](int sig) {
        if (line_fd >= 0) {
            gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd, 0);
            close(log_fd);
            close(line_fd);
            close(chip_fd);
            gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
            return 0;
        }
        return 1;
    });

    while (1) {
        // Read GPIO17 line
        if (gpiod_line_request_value(line_fd, &ts.tv_sec, &ts.tv_nsec) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_value");
            goto error;
        }

        // Check if GPIO17 line is high
        if (ts.tv_sec > 0) {
            // Record timestamp
            strftime(timestamp, 20, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", localtime(&ts.tv_sec));
            fprintf(log_fd, "%s\n", timestamp);

            // Set GPIO18 line to high
            if (gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd, 1) < 0) {
                perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
                goto error;
            }

            // Sleep for 2 seconds
            usleep(BUZZER_ON_TIME);

            // Set GPIO18 line to low
            if (gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd, 0) < 0) {
                perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
                goto error;
            }
        }
    }

    error:
    if (line_fd >= 0) {
        gpiod_line_set_value(line_fd, 0);
        close(log_fd);
        close(line_fd);
        close(chip_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
    }

    return 0;
}

Install SIGINT and SIGTERM handlers that set a volatile sig_atomic_t flag; the main loop must check this flag and turn the valve off before exiting. On every exit path — normal completion, signal, or error — release the GPIO line and close the chip, ensuring the valve is always left off. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO_LINE 18
#define VALVE_ON 1
#define VALVE_OFF 0

volatile sig_atomic_t sigint_received = 0;
volatile sig_atomic_t sigterm_received = 0;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    sigint_received = 1;
}

void handle_sigterm(int signum) {
    sigterm_received = 1;
}

int main() {
    if (access("watering.conf", F_OK) == -1) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: watering.conf not found\n");
        return 1;
    }

    FILE *config_file = fopen("watering.conf", "r");
    if (!config_file) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: failed to open watering.conf\n");
        return 1;
    }

    char line[256];
    if (fgets(line, sizeof(line), config_file) == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: failed to read watering.conf\n");
        fclose(config_file);
        return 1;
    }

    if (strstr(line, "duration=") == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: invalid format in watering.conf\n");
        fclose(config_file);
        return 1;
    }

    char *end;
    long duration = strtol(strstr(line, "duration=") + strlen("duration="), &end, 10);
    if (duration <= 0 || duration > 3600) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: invalid duration in watering.conf\n");
        fclose(config_file);
        return 1;
    }

    if (*end != '\n') {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: invalid format in watering.conf\n");
        fclose(config_file);
        return 1;
    }

    fclose(config_file);

    int chip_fd = gpiod_chip_open("/dev/gpiod");
    if (chip_fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: failed to open chip\n");
        return 1;
    }

    struct gpiod_chip *chip = gpiod_chip_new(chip_fd);
    if (!chip) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: failed to create chip\n");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    struct gpiod_line *line_fd = gpiod_chip_request_line(chip, GPIO_LINE);
    if (!line_fd) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: failed to request line\n");
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_request_mode(line_fd, GPIOD_MODE_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: failed to set mode\n");
        gpiod_line_free(line_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpiod_line_request_value(line_fd, VALVE_OFF) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Error: failed to set value\n");
        gpiod_line_free(line_fd);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip);
        gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);
        return 1;
    }

    gpiod_line_request_callback(line_fd, SIGINT, handle_sigint);
    gpiod_line_request_callback(line_fd, SIGTERM, handle_sigterm);

    printf("Watering duration: %ld seconds\n", duration);

    while (!sigint_received && !sigterm_received) {
        usleep(duration * 1000);
        if (gpiod_line_get_value(line_fd) == VALVE_ON) {
            printf("Valve activated\n");
        } else {
            printf("Valve deactivated\n");
        }
    }

    if (sigint_received || sigterm_received) {
        printf("Valve deactivated due to signal\n");
    }

    gpiod_line_free(line_fd);
    gpiod_chip_close(chip);
    gpiod_chip_close(chip_fd);

    return 0;
}

Log each control cycle to trace_log.txt with an ISO 8601 timestamp, the three sensor states as 0 or 1, and the left and right motor speeds. Include robust error handling for pigpio initialization, file opening, and GPIO operations, use only the pigpio API and never wiringPi, and on SIGINT stop the motors, close the log file, terminate pigpio, and release all GPIOs before exiting.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define LOG_FILE "trace_log.txt"
#define BASE_SPEED 150
#define MAX_SPEED 255
#define LEFT_GPIO 22
#define RIGHT_GPIO 23
#define LEFT_MOTOR 24
#define RIGHT_MOTOR 25
#define IR_GPIO4 4
#define IR_GPIO17 17
#define IR_GPIO27 27

int left_motor_speed = 0;
int right_motor_speed = 0;
int left_sensor = 0;
int right_sensor = 0;
int middle_sensor = 0;

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    printf("SIGINT received, stopping motors and exiting...\n");
    gpioTerminate();
    fclose(log_file);
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct timespec ts;
    char log_buffer[256];
    FILE *log_file = fopen(LOG_FILE, "w");
    if (!log_file) {
        perror("Failed to open log file");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("Failed to initialize pigpio");
        fclose(log_file);
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    while (1) {
        clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        fprintf(log_file, "%s,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d,%d\n", 
                asctime(localtime(&ts.tv_sec)), 
                left_sensor, right_sensor, middle_sensor, 
                left_motor_speed, right_motor_speed, 0);
        fflush(log_file);

        // Read sensors
        left_sensor = gpioRead(IR_GPIO4);
        right_sensor = gpioRead(IR_GPIO17);
        middle_sensor = gpioRead(IR_GPIO27);

        // Apply control law
        if (middle_sensor == 0) {
            left_motor_speed = BASE_SPEED;
            right_motor_speed = BASE_SPEED;
        } else if (left_sensor == 0 && right_sensor == 1) {
            left_motor_speed = BASE_SPEED / 2;
            right_motor_speed = BASE_SPEED;
        } else if (left_sensor == 1 && right_sensor == 0) {
            left_motor_speed = BASE_SPEED;
            right_motor_speed = BASE_SPEED / 2;
        } else {
            left_motor_speed = 0;
            right_motor_speed = 0;
        }

        // Set motor speeds
        gpioSetPWMCb(LEFT_GPIO, NULL, NULL);
        gpioSetPWMCb(RIGHT_GPIO, NULL, NULL);
        gpioSetPWM(LEFT_GPIO, left_motor_speed);
        gpioSetPWM(RIGHT_GPIO, right_motor_speed);

        // Wait 10 ms
        nanosleep(&ts, &ts);
    }

    return 0;
}

When the lock button is pressed, move the servo to the locked position with a pulse width of 1000 microseconds (about 0 degrees); when the unlock button is pressed, move it to the unlocked position with a pulse width of 2000 microseconds (about 180 degrees). Debounce each button press with a 100 ms delay. Constrain the servo pulse width to the safe range of 500-2500 microseconds at all times. Handle initialization failures gracefully, print status messages, use only pigpio API calls and never wiringPi, and cleanly release all resources on exit through a SIGINT signal handler.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <pigpio.h>

#define PULSE_MIN 500
#define PULSE_MAX 2500
#define PULSE_LOCK 1000
#define PULSE_UNLOCK 2000

void handle_sigint(int signum) {
    printf("SIGINT received, exiting...\n");
    gpioTerminate();
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    if (gpioInitialise() < 0) {
        perror("pigpioInitialise failed");
        return 1;
    }

    signal(SIGINT, handle_sigint);

    // Set up GPIO pins
    if (gpioSetPullUpDownByDefault(21, PI_OFF) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetPullUpDownByDefault failed for GPIO21");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetPullUpDownByDefault(22, PI_OFF) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetPullUpDowmByDefault failed for GPIO22");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up servo motor on GPIO18
    if (gpioSetMode(18, PI_OUTPUT) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetMode failed for GPIO18");
        return 1;
    }
    if (gpioSetPWMfreq(18, 50) < 0) {
        perror("gpioSetPWMfreq failed for GPIO18");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set up button debouncing
    int last_state = 0;
    int last_time = 0;
    int debounce_delay = 100;

    while (1) {
        // Read button states
        int state21 = gpioRead(21);
        int state22 = gpioRead(22);

        // Check for button presses
        if (state21 == 0 && last_state == 1) {
            // Lock button pressed
            if (state22 == 1) {
                printf("Unlocking...\n");
                gpioServoPulse(18, PULSE_UNLOCK);
            } else {
                printf("Locking...\n");
                gpioServoPulse(18, PULSE_LOCK);
            }
            last_state = 0;
            last_time = 0;
        } else if (state22 == 0 && last_state == 1) {
            // Unlock button pressed
            if (state21 == 1) {
                printf("Unlocking...\n");
                gpioServoPulse(18, PULSE_UNLOCK);
            } else {
                printf("Locking...\n");
                gpioServoPulse(18, PULSE_LOCK);
            }
            last_state = 0;
            last_time = 0;
        }

        // Debounce
        if (state21 == 0 && state22 == 0) {
            if (last_time + debounce_delay < time(NULL)) {
                last_state = 1;
                last_time = time(NULL);
            }
        }

        // Wait for next iteration
        usleep(1000);
    }

    return 0;
}

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B that uses the libgpiod library to run a haptic feedback system pulsing two Precision Microdrives 310-101 vibration motors, which require 3 V at 60 mA typical and must not be connected directly to GPIO. Drive motor 1 through a driver circuit such as an NPN transistor with a flyback diode on GPIO17, and motor 2 the same way on GPIO27. Pulse motor 1 for 200 ms, then motor 2 for 300 ms, repeating this sequential pattern indefinitely. Use gpiod_line_request_output() and gpiod_line_set_value() with error checking on every call. Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM to gracefully stop the motors and release the GPIO lines, including robust handling of line request failures, value write failures, and signal handler registration, and call gpiod_line_release() for cleanup on all exit paths.

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <gpiod.h>

#define GPIO17 17
#define GPIO27 27
#define PULSE_MS 200
#define PULSE2_MS 300
#define FREQUENCY_MS 500

int main() {
    int fd;
    struct gpiod_chip *chip;
    struct gpiod_line *line1, *line2;
    struct gpiod_request *request1, *request2;
    struct gpiod_edge *edge;
    int err;

    // Open the gpiod device
    if ((fd = gpiod_open("/dev/gpiod")) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_open");
        return 1;
    }

    // Get the first chip
    if ((chip = gpiod_chip_get(fd)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get");
        return 1;
    }

    // Get the first line
    if ((line1 = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO17)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        return 1;
    }
    if ((line2 = gpiod_chip_get_line(chip, GPIO27)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_chip_get_line");
        return 1;
    }

    // Create requests
    if ((request1 = gpiod_line_request_output(line1, PULSE_MS, 0)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_output");
        return 1;
    }
    if ((request2 = gpiod_line_request_output(line2, PULSE2_MS, 0)) == NULL) {
        perror("gpiod_line_request_output");
        return 1;
    }

    // Set initial values
    if ((err = gpiod_line_set_value(request1, 0)) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
        return 1;
    }
    if ((err = gpiod_line_set_value(request2, 0)) < 0) {
        perror("gpiod_line_set_value");
        return 1;
    }

    // Register signal handlers
    if (signal(SIGINT, handle_signal) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("signal");
        return 1;
    }
    if (signal(SIGTERM, handle_signal) == SIG_ERR) {
        perror("signal");
        return 1;
    }

    // Start the main loop
    while (1) {
        // Pulse motor 1
        if ((err = gpiod_line_request_request(request1, 1)) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_request");
            return 1;
        }
        usleep(PULSE_MS * 1000);
        if ((err = gpiod_line_request_request(request1, 0)) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_request");
            return 1;
        }

        // Pulse motor 2
        if ((err = gpiod_line_request_request(request2, 1)) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_request");
            return 1;
        }
        usleep(PULSE2_MS * 1000);
        if ((err = gpiod_line_request_request(request2, 0)) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_request");
            return 1;
        }

        // Wait for the next cycle
        usleep(FREQUENCY_MS * 1000);
    }

    // Cleanup
    gpiod_line_release(request1);
    gpiod_line_release(request2);
    gpiod_chip_release(chip);
    gpiod_close(fd);

    return 0;
}

void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        // Stop the motors
        if ((err = gpiod_line_request_request(request1, 0)) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_request");
        }
        if ((err = gpiod_line_request_request(request2, 0)) < 0) {
            perror("gpiod_line_request_request");
        }

        // Release the GPIO lines
        gpiod_line_release(request1);
        gpiod_line_release(request2);

        // Cleanup
        gpiod_chip_release(chip);
        gpiod_close(fd);

        exit(0);
    }
}
```
**Note:** This code assumes that the Precision Microdrives 310-101 motors are connected to the GPIO pins via a driver circuit (NPN transistor with a flyback diode) and that the Raspberry Pi 4 Model B is powered with 3 V. The code uses the `libgpiod` library and checks for errors on every call to `gpiod_line_request_output`, `gpiod_line_set_value`, and `gpiod_line_request_request`. The `handle_signal` function is registered to handle `SIGINT` and `SIGTERM` signals, and the GPIO lines are released on exit.

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B+ that uses the pigpio library to decode NEC IR remote signals from an IR receiver such as a TSOP38238 connected to GPIO17 (BCM). Register a pigpio alert callback on the falling edge to capture pulse timings, and decode the 32-bit NEC frame using its 9 ms mark plus 4.5 ms space header, 560 microsecond bit marks, 1690 microsecond spaces for logic 1, and 560 microsecond spaces for logic 0. Validate the decoded command against its inverted copy — extended NEC frames are allowed, so inverted-address validation is not required — and log the decoded address and command to syslog. Publish each decoded command as JSON to an MQTT broker at localhost:1883 on topic ir/decoded, using paho-mqtt v2 callback semantics, with the MQTT client initialized once at startup and its network loop serviced from the main loop. Check pigpio initialization, handle GPIO initialization failures, guard against pulse buffer overflow, validate the NEC checksum, and cleanly release pigpio, MQTT, and syslog resources on SIGINT or SIGTERM.
raw:
<think>

</think>

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <syslog.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <pigpio.h>
#include <mosquitto.h>

#define IR_PIN 17
#define MQTT_BROKER "localhost"
#define MQTT_PORT 1883
#define MQTT_TOPIC "ir/decoded"

typedef struct {
    uint32_t address;
    uint32_t command;
} decoded_data_t;

void decode_nec(uint32_t address, uint32_t command) {
    char buf[256];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Address: 0x%08x, Command: 0x%08x\n", address, command);
    syslog(LOG_INFO, buf);
    char json[256];
    snprintf(json, sizeof(json), "{\"address\":0x%08x,\"command\":0x%08x}", address, command);
    mosquitto_publish(pubc, MQTT_TOPIC, json, strlen(json), 0, 0, 1, 0);
}

void handle_alert(int gpio, int level, int tick) {
    static uint32_t buffer[32];
    static int buffer_index = 0;
    static int buffer_full = 0;
    static uint32_t checksum = 0;

    if (level == 0) {
        buffer[buffer_index] = tick;
        buffer_index++;
    } else {
        buffer[buffer_index] = tick;
        buffer_index++;
        buffer_full = 1;
    }

    if (buffer_index == 32) {
        uint32_t address = 0;
        uint32_t command = 0;
        int i;
        for (i = 0; i < 32; i += 2) {
            uint32_t bit = (buffer[i] - buffer[i + 1]) / 1000;
            command |= (bit << (31 - i / 2));
        }

        address = command >> 16;
        command &= 0xFFFF;

        // Validate checksum
        int checksum_calculated = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            checksum_calculated += (address & 0xFF) + (command & 0xFF);
            address >>= 8;
            command >>= 8;
        }
        checksum_calculated += (address & 0xFF) + (command & 0xFF);
        if (checksum_calculated != checksum) {
            syslog(LOG_WARNING, "Invalid checksum");
            return;
        }

        decode_nec(address, command);
    }
}

int main() {
    if (gpio_initialise() < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "pigpio initialization failed");
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_set_mode(IR_PIN, PI_INPUT) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "GPIO mode set failed");
        gpio_deinitialise();
        return 1;
    }

    if (gpio_pull_up(IR_PIN) < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "GPIO pull-up failed");
        gpio_deinitialise();
        return 1;
    }

    if (mosquitto_init() < 0) {
        syslog(LOG_ERR, "mosquitto initialization failed");
        gpio_deinitialise();
        return 1;
    }

    mosquitto_subscribe(mosquitto, MQTT_TOPIC, 0, 0);

    signal(SIGINT, [](int) {
        mosquitto_destroy(mosquitto);
        gpio_unexport(IR_PIN);
        gpio_deinitialise();
        return 0;
    });

    signal(SIGTERM, [](int) {
        mosquitto_destroy(mosquitto);
        gpio_unexport(IR_PIN);
        gpio_deinitialise();
        return 0;
    });

    pigpio.setOnItemClickListener(handle_alert);

    syslog(LOG_INFO, "Starting IR decoder");

    for (;;) {
        if (mosquitto_loop() < 0) {
            syslog(LOG_ERR, "mosquitto loop failed");
            break;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

Once per second, broadcast all four readings as a single UDP multicast packet to 239.255.255.250:5005, formatted as semicolon-separated sensor_id,lux pairs, e.g. 1,120.5;2,85.0;3,210.5;4,45.0. If any sensor fails — open error, address-set error, write error, read error, or partial read — report NaN for that sensor and continue. Handle SIGINT and SIGTERM by setting a flag to exit the loop cleanly, and close all file descriptors, both I2C and UDP socket, on every exit path.

prompt: Write a C program for a Raspberry Pi Zero W that reads airflow data from a Honeywell AWM7300V mass airflow sensor at I2C address 0x28 on /dev/i2c-1, using the Linux I2C character device interface (<linux/i2c-dev.h>, <sys/ioctl.h>, read() and write() syscalls) rather than wiringPi. To read flow data, issue a zero-length I2C write as a start condition followed by a 2-byte read; the sensor returns a 14-bit flow value in the first two bytes, masked with 0x3FFF. Convert the raw value to SLPM using flow = (raw - 3277) * 0.1, sampling once per second, and log each timestamped flow rate to airflow_log.txt. Check every syscall, retry transient I2C read failures up to 3 times with 100 ms delays between retries, and handle sensor-absent (ENXIO) and bus-error (EIO) conditions. Install a SIGINT handler that closes the I2C file descriptor and flushes the log file for a clean shutdown.

```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/i2c-dev.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <signal.h>

#define I2C_DEV "/dev/i2c-1"
#define I2C_ADDR 0x28
#define I2C_TIMEOUT 100  // ms
#define I2C_RETRIES 3

typedef struct {
    int fd;
    int flow;
} SensorData;

void sigint_handler(int signum) {
    if (SensorData.flow) {
        close(SensorData.fd);
        fflush(stdout);
        fflush(stderr);
        fflush(SensorData.flow);
    }
    exit(0);
}

int main() {
    struct i2c_msg msg[2];
    struct i2c_rdwr_ioctl_data ioctl_data;
    SensorData sensor_data;
    char buffer[3];
    char log_buffer[256];
    int flow;
    int i;
    int ret;

    signal(SIGINT, sigint_handler);

    sensor_data.fd = open(I2C_DEV, O_RDWR);
    if (sensor_data.fd == -1) {
        perror("Failed to open I2C device");
        return 1;
    }

    ret = ioctl(sensor_data.fd, I2C_SLAVE, I2C_ADDR);
    if (ret < 0) {
        perror("Failed to set slave address");
        goto cleanup;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < I2C_RETRIES; i++) {
        msg[0].addr = I2C_ADDR;
        msg[0].flags = I2C_M_RD;
        msg[0].data[0] = 0x00;
        msg[1].addr = I2C_ADDR;
        msg[1].flags = I2C_M_RD;
        msg[1].data[0] = 0x02;
        msg[1].data[1] = 0x00;

        ret = ioctl(sensor_data.fd, I2C_RDWR, msg, &ioctl_data);
        if (ret < 0) {
            if (errno == EIO) {
                fprintf(stderr, "I2C bus error\n");
            } else if (errno == ENXIO) {
                fprintf(stderr, "Sensor absent\n");
            } else {
                perror("I2C ioctl failed");
            }
            goto cleanup;
        }

        if (read(sensor_data.fd, buffer, 2) < 0) {
            perror("Failed to read I2C data");
            goto cleanup;
        }

        flow = (buffer[0] << 8) | buffer[1];
        flow = (flow - 3277) * 0.1;
        snprintf(log_buffer, sizeof(log_buffer), "%ld, %ld SLPM\n", (long)time(NULL), (long)flow);
        write(sensor_data.flow, log_buffer, strlen(log_buffer));
        usleep(1000000); // 1 second delay
    }

cleanup:
    close(sensor_data.fd);
    return 0;
}
```

**Note:** This code assumes that the `time` function is available and that the `write` function can be used to log data to a file. #include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <termios.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/select.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <time.h>

#define UART_DEV "/dev/serial0"
#define UART_BAUD 115200
#define UART_TIMEOUT 500000  // 0.5 seconds
#define SELECT_TIMEOUT 2000000  // 2 seconds

#define MAX_LINE_LENGTH 1024
#define MAX_LINE_BUFFER 1024

typedef struct {
    char line[MAX_LINE_LENGTH];
    char timestamp[20];
    double range;
} Detection;

static Detection line_buffer[MAX_LINE_BUFFER];
static int line_buffer_index = 0;
static int line_buffer_size = 0;

static int uart_fd;
static struct termios uart_config;

static void handle_signal(int signum) {
    if (signum == SIGINT || signum == SIGTERM) {
        if (uart_fd != -1) {
            close(uart_fd);
        }
        exit(EXIT_SUCCESS);
    }
}

static void init_uart() {
    struct sigaction sa;
    sa.sa_handler = handle_signal;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);

    uart_fd = open(UART_DEV, O_RDWR | O_NOCTTY);
    if (uart_fd == -1) {
        perror("open");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }

    tcgetattr(uart_fd, &uart_config);
    cfmakeraw(&uart_config);
    cfsetispeed(&uart_config, UART_BAUD);
    cfsetospeed(&uart_config, UART_BAUD);
    tcsetattr(uart_fd, TCSANOW, &uart_config);

    fd_set read_set;
    FD_ZERO(&read_set);
    FD_SET(uart_fd, &read_set);
    struct timeval tv;
    tv.tv_sec = 0;
    tv.tv_usec = UART_TIMEOUT;
    select(uart_fd + 1, &read_set, NULL, NULL, &tv);
}

static void read_line() {
    char buffer[MAX_LINE_LENGTH];
    ssize_t bytes_read = read(uart_fd, buffer, MAX_LINE_LENGTH);
    if (bytes_read == -1) {
        perror("read");
        exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
    }
    if (bytes_read == 0) {
        return;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < bytes_read; i++) {
        if (buffer[i] == '\n') {
            buffer[i] = '\0';
            if (line_buffer_index < MAX_LINE_BUFFER) {
                strncpy(line_buffer[line_buffer_index].line, buffer, strlen(buffer));
                sscanf(line_buffer[line_buffer_index].line, "%s %lf", line_buffer[line_buffer_index].timestamp, &line_buffer[line_buffer_index].range);
                line_buffer_index++;
            }
            memset(buffer, 0, MAX_LINE_LENGTH);
            line_buffer_size = 0;
        } else {
            if (line_buffer_size < MAX_LINE_BUFFER) {
                line_buffer[line_buffer_size].line[line_buffer_size] = buffer[i];
            }
            line_buffer_size++;
        }
    }
}

static void print_detection() {
    if (line_buffer_index > 0) {
        char timestamp[20];
        struct tm *timeinfo;
        time_t now = time(NULL);
        timeinfo = localtime(&now);
        strftime(timestamp, 20, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", timeinfo);
        printf("Timestamp: %s, Range: %.2f meters\n", timestamp, line_buffer[0].range);
        line_buffer_index = 0;
    }
}

int main() {
    init_uart();

    while (1) {
        fd_set read_set;
        FD_ZERO(&read_set);
        FD_SET(uart_fd, &read_set);
        struct timeval tv;
        tv.tv_sec = 0;
        tv.tv_usec = SELECT_TIMEOUT;
        select(uart_fd + 1, &read_set, NULL, NULL, &tv);

        if (FD_ISSET(uart_fd, &read_set)) {
            read_line();
        }

        if (line_buffer_size > 0) {
            print_detection();
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
